egomaniak.name: Egomaniak
egomaniak.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
egomaniak.lore: This self-important boss is willing to use anyone to protect their own hide.

slippery skumbag.name: Slippery Skumbag
slippery skumbag.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, it can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
slippery skumbag.lore: This wily boss has mastered the art of the feint, breaking away from fights that aren’t going his way and then coming back for another go when the odds are in his favour.

backstabba.name: Backstabba
backstabba.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with both this unit and another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted for each friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit in combat with the target in addition to the first two **KRULEBOYZ** units.
backstabba.lore: When their enemy’s back is turned, this boss has no qualms about sticking a dagger in it.

mork s eye pebble.name: Mork's Eye Pebble
mork s eye pebble.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
mork s eye pebble.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **WARD** **(5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
mork s eye pebble.lore: When rubbed, this dark-grey rock produces a swirling bank of thick fog that protects the bearer and their allies from harm.

swamp staff.name: Swamp Staff
swamp staff.description: Effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to this unit’s power level.
swamp staff.lore: Hewn from a root of an ancient bogwood, this gnarled staff grants its bearer mastery over the swamps and can be used to ward off enemy magics.

eye biter ash.name: Eye-biter Ash
eye biter ash.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
eye biter ash.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
eye biter ash.lore: Stored in a heatproof pouch, this strange ash never stops smouldering. The bearer can cast it at a foe, creating a blistering ash cloud that blinds the targets and causes them terrible pain.

lethal surprise.name: Lethal Surprise
lethal surprise.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
lethal surprise.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, for the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability.
lethal surprise.lore: As the enemy charges into the Kruleboyz line, little do they know that they have been lured into a series of cunningly concealed traps.
lethal surprise.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

noisy racket.name: Noisy Racket
noisy racket.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
noisy racket.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
noisy racket.lore: After a sustained barrage of hurled insults and the clanging of weapons on shields, the Kruleboyz have driven some of their foes to distraction.
noisy racket.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

venom encrusted weapons.name: Venom-encrusted Weapons
venom encrusted weapons.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
venom encrusted weapons.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
venom encrusted weapons.lore: These weapons are smeared with a lethal mix of toxins extracted from poison sludge, venomous swamp creatures and spit.
venom encrusted weapons.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

dirty tricks.name: Dirty Tricks
dirty tricks.description: Effect: The effect of a **DIRTY TRICK** ability is only applied if you make a successful dirty trick roll. The success of a dirty trick roll depends on the number of **DIRTY TRICK** abilities your army has already used this battle round.
dirty tricks.lore: Kruleboyz will use whatever devious means they can to gain the upper hand over the foe.
dirty tricks.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

sneaky sneakin.name: Sneaky Sneakin'
sneaky sneakin.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
sneaky sneakin.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit that has 10 or fewer models, is not in combat and has not been the target of a **DIRTY TRICK** ability this turn to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
sneaky sneakin.lore: Cloying swamp-mists mask the Kruleboyz’ movements.
sneaky sneakin.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

tough un.name: Tough 'Un
tough un.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.
tough un.lore: This beast has endured the lash of its cruel masters for many a season, which has inured it to pain.
tough un.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

sneaky un.name: Sneaky 'Un
sneaky un.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
sneaky un.description: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ or ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities this phase.
sneaky un.lore: This beast prefers to sneak up on its prey and skulk off when the going gets tough, traits its Kruleboyz masters darkly approve of.
sneaky un.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

mean un.name: Mean 'Un
mean un.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s **Companion** weapons.
mean un.lore: This beast is a kunnin’ and ruthless predator, targeting vulnerable areas and vital spots with a hunter’s eye.
mean un.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

tattermask.name: Tattermask
tattermask.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, that attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
tattermask.lore: Patched together from assorted flaps of flayed skin, this enchanted mask has the unsurprisingly off-putting effect of turning the wearer’s bellows into keening cries for help in the native tongues of nearby enemies.

spell in a rattle.name: Spell in a Rattle
spell in a rattle.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
spell in a rattle.description: Effect: This unit can use a non‐**SUMMON SPELL** ability from a spell lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 9 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound.
spell in a rattle.lore: With a shake of this unassuming, knobbly rattle, the bearer releases the spell stored within.

woggly bogstikk.name: Woggly Bogstikk
woggly bogstikk.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
woggly bogstikk.lore: Plucked from the grasp of a bog-drowned shaman, this gnarled staff can turn the earth beneath a foe’s feet into acidic slime.

quick un.name: Quick 'Un
quick un.description: Effect: Add half your **fury level** (rounding up) to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.
quick un.lore: Getting the drop on this hot‐tempered creature is nigh on impossible.

sly un.name: Sly 'Un
sly un.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
sly un.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
sly un.lore: Whether covered in mud or submerged in a mire, this brute emerges from the muck with little warning, ready to ambush the enemy.

spittin un.name: Spittin' 'Un
spittin un.description:
Effect: This unit is armed with the ranged weapon below, where **X** is equal to your **fury level**.

Ranged Weapon
**Caustic Saliva**
Rng: 12"
Atk: X
Hit: 4+
Wnd: 3+
Rnd: 2
Dmg: D3
spittin un.lore: This beast has specialised glands that allow it to spit corrosive saliva that can burn flesh and eat through armour. The more riled up the creature is, the greater the volume of spittle it produces.

summon gork roara.name: Summon Gork-Roara
summon gork roara.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon gork roara.lore: The shaman summons a leering visage of Gorkamorka that spills forth Waaagh! power.

summon morkspit marsh.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
summon morkspit marsh.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summon morkspit marsh.lore: The shaman summons a cruel, glowing swamp that channels memories of Gorkamorka’s past brawls.

summon foot of gork.name: Summon Foot of Gork
summon foot of gork.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
summon foot of gork.lore: Stamping a furiously belligerent beat, the shaman dares Gork himself to stomp the battlefield flat.

da black pit.name: Da Black Pit
da black pit.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
da black pit.lore: The shaman taps his staff on the ground. Forking out from that spot, and surging towards a nearby foe, the earth turns into a noisome quagmire that sucks victims below its surface to their doom.

mork s kunnin.name: Mork's Kunnin'
mork s kunnin.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 12" of them, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to save rolls for the target.
mork s kunnin.lore: The shaman channels the raw power of Mork to imbue their allies with uncanny cunning so they might evade enemy blows.

choking mist.name: Choking Mist
choking mist.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
choking mist.lore: The shaman summons a cloud of corrosive vapour that scorches the lungs of any caught within it.

formations.name: Kruleboyz Klaw
formations.description: Effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units that are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" away from them.

ability.name: Swamp Shroud
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units that are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" away from them.
ability.lore: Before the warriors of a Kruleboyz Klaw strike, the shamans enact a mighty ritual to smother the battlefield in a thick, stinky mist that conceals them from the enemy.

abilities.name: Swamp Shroud
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units that are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" away from them.
abilities.lore: Before the warriors of a Kruleboyz Klaw strike, the shamans enact a mighty ritual to smother the battlefield in a thick, stinky mist that conceals them from the enemy.

formations.name: Light Finga
formations.description: Effect: You can use the ‘Sneaky Sneakin'’ **DIRTY TRICK** ability twice per turn instead of only once per turn.

ability.name: Ded Sneaky
ability.description: Effect: You can use the ‘Sneaky Sneakin'’ **DIRTY TRICK** ability twice per turn instead of only once per turn.
ability.lore: Comprised of hobgrots and ‘yoofs’, the ladz of the Light Finga are in charge of ‘nikkin’ stuff and are skilled at sneaking up on the enemy.

abilities.name: Ded Sneaky
abilities.description: Effect: You can use the ‘Sneaky Sneakin'’ **DIRTY TRICK** ability twice per turn instead of only once per turn.
abilities.lore: Comprised of hobgrots and ‘yoofs’, the ladz of the Light Finga are in charge of ‘nikkin’ stuff and are skilled at sneaking up on the enemy.

formations.name: Badmouthing Baiterz
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the **Insult Hurla**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **MOVE** ability and does not end that move closer to the **Insult Hurla** than it was at the start of that move, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target after that **MOVE** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Krule Mockery
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the **Insult Hurla**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **MOVE** ability and does not end that move closer to the **Insult Hurla** than it was at the start of that move, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target after that **MOVE** ability has been resolved.
ability.lore: These orruks have perfected the art of hurling biting insults at the enemy to taunt them and lure them into hidden traps.

abilities.name: Krule Mockery
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the **Insult Hurla**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **MOVE** ability and does not end that move closer to the **Insult Hurla** than it was at the start of that move, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target after that **MOVE** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: These orruks have perfected the art of hurling biting insults at the enemy to taunt them and lure them into hidden traps.

formations.name: Middul Finga
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Man‑skewer Boltboyz** or **Beast-skewer** **Killbow** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets’ ranged weapons.

ability.name: Far-killa Bolts
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Man‑skewer Boltboyz** or **Beast-skewer** **Killbow** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets’ ranged weapons.
ability.lore: The many Deffspikerz of the Middul Finger often keep a limited supply of bolts fletched with bog-shryke feathers, which give their shots that extra bit of distance when needed.

abilities.name: Far-killa Bolts
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Man‑skewer Boltboyz** or **Beast-skewer** **Killbow** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets’ ranged weapons.
abilities.lore: The many Deffspikerz of the Middul Finger often keep a limited supply of bolts fletched with bog-shryke feathers, which give their shots that extra bit of distance when needed.

formations.name: Swamphorde Bullies
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the target. That unit must be in combat with an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit. **Kragnos** cannot be picked to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Gangin' Up
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the target. That unit must be in combat with an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit. **Kragnos** cannot be picked to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
ability.lore: These orruks like to overwhelm their enemies with a flurry of strikes from all directions interspersed with sneaky stabs and low blows.

abilities.name: Gangin' Up
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the target. That unit must be in combat with an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit. **Kragnos** cannot be picked to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: These orruks like to overwhelm their enemies with a flurry of strikes from all directions interspersed with sneaky stabs and low blows.

formations.name: Trophy Finga
formations.description: Effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

ability.name: Meanest Beasts
ability.description: Effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
ability.lore: The warbeasts ridden by the orruks of the Trophy Finga are particularly foul and belligerent specimens of their kind.

abilities.name: Meanest Beasts
abilities.description: Effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
abilities.lore: The warbeasts ridden by the orruks of the Trophy Finga are particularly foul and belligerent specimens of their kind.

mighty destroyers.name: Mighty Destroyers
mighty destroyers.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
mighty destroyers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.

Effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.
mighty destroyers.lore: The Ironjawz won’t let anything get between them and a good scrap.
mighty destroyers.restrictionText: Ironjawz armies can use the following abilities:

ironjawz waaagh.name: Ironjawz Waaagh!
ironjawz waaagh.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
ironjawz waaagh.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ HERO** to be the target. You cannot pick the same **HERO** to be the target of this ability more than once per battle.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply to friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of the target:

• Add 1 to charge rolls for those units.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units’ melee weapons.
ironjawz waaagh.lore: With a roar that shakes the battlefield, the Ironjawz charge as one, eager to crack skulls.
ironjawz waaagh.restrictionText: Ironjawz armies can use the following abilities:

fast un.name: Fast 'Un
fast un.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
fast un.description: Effect: If this unit was not set up this turn, it can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
fast un.lore: This beast lurches forward at a speed that would take anyone by surprise.
fast un.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

fast un.name: Fast 'Un
fast un.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
fast un.description: Effect: If this unit was not set up this turn, it can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
fast un.lore: The beast lurches forward at a speed that would take anyone by surprise.

big un.name: Big 'Un
big un.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons.
big un.lore: This beast is noticeably more muscular and krumpier than others of its kind.
big un.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

big un.name: Big 'Un
big un.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons.
big un.lore: This beast is noticeably more muscular and krumpier than others of its kind.

mad un.name: Mad 'Un
mad un.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
mad un.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, after those models are removed from the battlefield, if this unit is still in combat, this unit can immediately use this ability again.
mad un.lore: Once this crazed beast starts its rampage, it will keep going until everything nearby has been smashed into a red paste.
mad un.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

an eye for da fight.name: An Eye For Da Fight
an eye for da fight.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly IRONJAWZ unit wholly within 12" of this unit
an eye for da fight.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
an eye for da fight.lore: This orruk is among the most dangerous of their brutal kind: one who instinctively understands the flow of battle and knows just where the best fights are likely to kick off.

mega bossy.name: Mega Bossy
mega bossy.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.
mega bossy.lore: This boss’s booming voice constantly rings out across the battlefield, ‘encouraging’ their ladz to get krumpin’.

hulking brute.name: Hulking Brute
hulking brute.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If this unit’s unmodified charge roll this turn was 8+, roll a D6 instead of a D3.
hulking brute.lore: Even by orruk standards, this boss is huge, and he is ever eager to throw his immense weight around in battle.

trophy skulls.name: Trophy Skulls
trophy skulls.description: Effect: Add 10 to this unit’s control score.
trophy skulls.lore: Festooned with the skulls of those who crossed them, be they ferocious beast or mighty warrior, there’s no doubt that this orruk means business.

armour of gork.name: Armour of Gork
armour of gork.lore: This bashed-together armour is thick, heavy and possessed of its own fierce fighting spirit.

amberbone whetstone.name: Amberbone Whetstone
amberbone whetstone.description: Effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.
amberbone whetstone.lore: This prized sharpening stone, laced with veins of realmstone, is found deep in the crags of Ghur. It is loved by the Ironjawz for its ability to make a weapon ‘ded sharp’.

chimeric mantle.name: Chimeric Mantle
chimeric mantle.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract D3 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Companion** weapons while it is in combat with this unit.
chimeric mantle.lore: Crudely stitched together from the pelts and hides of myriad different creatures, this orruk’s ragged cloak causes beasts to recoil in fear.

weird skullz.name: Weird Skullz
weird skullz.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the target is within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the roll. On a 4+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• Subtract 1 from the target’s power level until the start of your next turn.
weird skullz.lore: Originally belonging to Weirdnobs who died of ‘unknown causes’, these caved-in skulls exude Waaagh! energy that can give nearby foes pounding headaches, making it difficult for them to focus.

horn of shattatusk.name: Horn of Shattatusk
horn of shattatusk.phase: Reaction: You declared the 'Ironjawz Waaagh!' ability and picked this unit to be the target
horn of shattatusk.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.
horn of shattatusk.lore: Purportedly crafted from one of the godbeast’s tusks, a blast from this horn imbues the Ironjawz’ charging beasts with the same bellicosity as their riders.

angry un.name: Angry 'Un
angry un.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
angry un.lore: Particularly irascible, this beast takes its rage out on anything that gets in its way.

fixin beat.name: Fixin' Beat
fixin beat.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: **Heal (D6)** the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3+3)** the target instead.
fixin beat.lore: The Warchanter pounds a restorative rhythm that gives the ladz a second wind.

get em beat.name: Get 'Em Beat
get em beat.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.
get em beat.lore: A pounding rhythm is played by the Warchanter, inspiring nearby Ironjawz to wreak destruction and ruin upon their enemies.

killa beat.name: Killa Beat
killa beat.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
killa beat.lore: The Warchanter drums a thumping beat that causes raw Waaagh! energy to course through the weapons of the orruks.

summon gork roara.name: Summon Gork-Roara
summon gork roara.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon gork roara.lore: The shaman summons a leering visage of Gorkamorka that spills forth Waaagh! power.

summon foot of gork.name: Summon Foot of Gork
summon foot of gork.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
summon foot of gork.lore: Stamping a furiously belligerent beat, the shaman dares Gork himself to stomp the battlefield flat.

summon morkspit marsh.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
summon morkspit marsh.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summon morkspit marsh.lore: The shaman summons a cruel, glowing swamp that channels memories of Gorkamorka’s past brawls.

bash em ladz.name: Bash 'Em Ladz!
bash em ladz.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn.
bash em ladz.lore: Pulsing waves of Waaagh! energy radiate from the shaman, boosting the fighting prowess of nearby Ironjawz.

da great big green hand of gork.name: Da Great Big Green Hand of Gork
da great big green hand of gork.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
da great big green hand of gork.lore: A ghostly green hand picks up a mob of Ironjawz and plonks them back down where they are most needed.

mighty eadbutt.name: Mighty 'Eadbutt
mighty eadbutt.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target is a **WIZARD**, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target instead.
mighty eadbutt.lore: The shaman headbutts the air, projecting a wave of green energy that seeks out enemies, especially spell-flingas, to nut.

formations.name: Ironjawz Brawl
formations.description: Effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly non-**HERO IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Natural Disaster
ability.description: Effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly non-**HERO IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: A mass of heavily armoured orruks and their bulky beasts of war, an Ironjawz Brawl hits the enemy line like a landslide if it gains enough momentum, leaving a trail of carnage and blazing ruin in its wake.

abilities.name: Natural Disaster
abilities.description: Effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly non-**HERO IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A mass of heavily armoured orruks and their bulky beasts of war, an Ironjawz Brawl hits the enemy line like a landslide if it gains enough momentum, leaving a trail of carnage and blazing ruin in its wake.

formations.name: Weirdfist
formations.description: Effect: Friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARDS** or **PRIESTS**.

ability.name: Spirit of Gork
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARDS** or **PRIESTS**.
ability.lore: The roiling Waaagh! energy that emanates from the Weirdfist shamans fills nearby Ironjawz with the fighting spirit and hardiness of Gork.

abilities.name: Spirit of Gork
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARDS** or **PRIESTS**.
abilities.lore: The roiling Waaagh! energy that emanates from the Weirdfist shamans fills nearby Ironjawz with the fighting spirit and hardiness of Gork.

formations.name: Ironfist
formations.description: Effect: The first time each turn that an enemy unit is destroyed by a **FIGHT** ability used by a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the next friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Smashin' and Bashin'
ability.description: Effect: The first time each turn that an enemy unit is destroyed by a **FIGHT** ability used by a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the next friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The orruks of an Ironfist won’t be outdone by each other – when one mob duffs up the enemy, it inspires others to show them how to do it properly!

abilities.name: Smashin' and Bashin'
abilities.description: Effect: The first time each turn that an enemy unit is destroyed by a **FIGHT** ability used by a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the next friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The orruks of an Ironfist won’t be outdone by each other – when one mob duffs up the enemy, it inspires others to show them how to do it properly!

formations.name: Bigsnikkaz
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has a Health characteristic greater than its own.

ability.name: Duff Up Da Big Thing
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has a Health characteristic greater than its own.
ability.lore: The ladz get ready to bash some uppity git who thinks that being bigger than an orruk gives them some kind of advantage.

abilities.name: Duff Up Da Big Thing
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has a Health characteristic greater than its own.
abilities.lore: The ladz get ready to bash some uppity git who thinks that being bigger than an orruk gives them some kind of advantage.

formations.name: Brutefist
formations.description:
Effect: If there are any friendly **Megabosses** on the battlefield, for the rest of the turn, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target when using the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability.

If there are no friendly **Megabosses** on the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target when using the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability.

ability.name: Mightiest Destroyers
ability.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.description:
Effect: If there are any friendly **Megabosses** on the battlefield, for the rest of the turn, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target when using the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability.

If there are no friendly **Megabosses** on the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target when using the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability.
ability.lore: Wherever the Megabosses lead from the front lines, the Ironjawz surge forward as an unstoppable tide of green muscle and heavy armour plates.

abilities.name: Mightiest Destroyers
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If there are any friendly **Megabosses** on the battlefield, for the rest of the turn, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target when using the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability.

If there are no friendly **Megabosses** on the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target when using the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability.
abilities.lore: Wherever the Megabosses lead from the front lines, the Ironjawz surge forward as an unstoppable tide of green muscle and heavy armour plates.

formations.name: Grunta Stampede
formations.description: Effect: Add the number of enemy units that have been destroyed this battle to the Move characteristic of friendly **Gore-gruntas** and **MAW-GRUNTA** units, to a maximum of +4.

ability.name: 'Ere We Come!
ability.description: Effect: Add the number of enemy units that have been destroyed this battle to the Move characteristic of friendly **Gore-gruntas** and **MAW-GRUNTA** units, to a maximum of +4.
ability.lore: Once a grunta stampede gets going and the hogs are all riled up, there are few forces in the realms with the power to halt its momentum.

abilities.name: 'Ere We Come!
abilities.description: Effect: Add the number of enemy units that have been destroyed this battle to the Move characteristic of friendly **Gore-gruntas** and **MAW-GRUNTA** units, to a maximum of +4.
abilities.lore: Once a grunta stampede gets going and the hogs are all riled up, there are few forces in the realms with the power to halt its momentum.

the need for perfection.name: The Need For Perfection
the need for perfection.description: Effect: The first time each turn that an unmodified charge roll, casting roll, unbinding roll or banishment roll for a friendly non-**EUPHORIC** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is 5 or less, that unit has the **EUPHORIC** keyword for the rest of the turn.
the need for perfection.lore: This hero inspires a compulsive, self‐destructive desire in their allies to push themselves ever further, all thoughts of temperance and restraint dismissed from their minds.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Hedonites of Slaanesh

celebrity warlord.name: Celebrity Warlord
celebrity warlord.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
celebrity warlord.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
celebrity warlord.lore: This hero has gained a cult following that seeks them out on the battlefield.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Hedonites of Slaanesh

master of temptation.name: Master of Temptation
master of temptation.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if your opponent has any **temptation dice**. Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, while your opponent has not used any of their **temptation dice** to replace a roll for the target this turn, the target can only use **CORE** abilities.
master of temptation.lore: Twisting the old adage, this hero demonstrates that good things do not come to those who wait.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Hedonites of Slaanesh

bashful visage.name: Bashful Visage
bashful visage.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly non-**MONSTER** non-**WAR MACHINE** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.
bashful visage.lore: Those who meet the gaze of this delicate mask are compelled to turn away in shame as they are confronted with sudden awareness of their own basest desires.

crown of the ur slaanesh.name: Crown of the Ur-Slaanesh
crown of the ur slaanesh.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
crown of the ur slaanesh.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO INFANTRY** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
crown of the ur slaanesh.lore: Once worn by Luxcious, the first Pretender, this majestic crown draws in devoted followers by the score.

the rod of misrule.name: The Rod of Misrule
the rod of misrule.description:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, when the target uses the ‘Power Through’ command, you can pick an enemy target for that command that does not have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using that command.
the rod of misrule.lore: This bejewelled staff bestows a lunatic charisma, with which champions bid their warriors achieve the impossible.

fall from grace.name: Fall From Grace
fall from grace.description:
Effect: A friendly non-**UNIQUE PARAGON** immediately loses the **PARAGON** keyword when any of the following happen:

• That **PARAGON** has 3 or more damage points allocated to it by the same use of a non-**ATTACK** ability.
• That **PARAGON** uses a **CHARGE** ability and the unmodified charge roll is 5 or less (after any re‑rolls).
• A spell cast by that **PARAGON** is **miscast** (after any re-rolls).
fall from grace.lore: Slaanesh is a capricious patron, and he can quickly lose interest…
fall from grace.restrictionText: Hedonites of Slaanesh armies can use the following abilities:

sensuous arcana.name: Sensuous Arcana
sensuous arcana.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
sensuous arcana.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE PARAGON** that has successfully cast a spell this turn and has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.
sensuous arcana.lore: Those who please Slaanesh are granted mystical secrets of excess.
sensuous arcana.restrictionText: Hedonites of Slaanesh armies can use the following abilities:

cutting barbs.name: Cutting Barbs
cutting barbs.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
cutting barbs.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** that has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with that **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: If the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.

***Rise to the Insults***: For the rest of the turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1.

***Turn Aside from the Insults***: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units that target that enemy unit.
cutting barbs.lore: This champion releases a wave of snide vitriol that pierces to their foe’s core.
cutting barbs.restrictionText: Hedonites of Slaanesh armies can use the following abilities:

chief of revels.name: Chief of Revels
chief of revels.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
chief of revels.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE PARAGON** that charged this turn and has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.
chief of revels.lore: Slaanesh’s champions earn favour through locating and embracing new debaucheries at a voracious pace.
chief of revels.restrictionText: Hedonites of Slaanesh armies can use the following abilities:

enthralling vanity.name: Enthralling Vanity
enthralling vanity.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
enthralling vanity.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** unit that has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: If the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.

***Mesmerised***: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units for attacks that target that unit, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

***Break their Gaze***: For the rest of the turn, other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by the target have no effect.
enthralling vanity.lore: When a Hedonite champion calls for adoration, it is difficult to resist.
enthralling vanity.restrictionText: Hedonites of Slaanesh armies can use the following abilities:

excess of agility.name: Excess of Agility
excess of agility.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
excess of agility.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE PARAGON** that has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, while the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON** and is in combat, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.
excess of agility.lore: When truly ‘inspired’, the servants of Slaanesh are almost impossible to strike, twisting around blows with mocking laughter.
excess of agility.restrictionText: Hedonites of Slaanesh armies can use the following abilities:

beguiling glance.name: Beguiling Glance
beguiling glance.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
beguiling glance.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** unit that has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: If the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.

***Succumb***: For the rest of the turn, when the target is using a **CHARGE** ability, it must end that charge move no further from the **HERO** using this ability.

***Resist***: For the rest of the turn, subtract 2 from charge rolls for the target.
beguiling glance.lore: One glance from Slaanesh’s chosen can ensnare a wayward soul.
beguiling glance.restrictionText: Hedonites of Slaanesh armies can use the following abilities:

paragons of slaanesh.name: Paragons of Slaanesh
paragons of slaanesh.description:
Declare: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **PARAGONS** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit that does not have the **PARAGON** keyword and has not had the **PARAGON** keyword this battle to be the target.

Effect: The target gains the **PARAGON** keyword.

**Designer’s Note:** *Friendly units with the **PARAGON*** *keyword on their warscroll count towards the* *number of friendly **PARAGONS** on the battlefield.* *If there are more than 3 friendly **PARAGONS** on the* *battlefield at the same time, you must immediately* *remove those units from the battlefield one at a time* *until there are only 3 friendly **PARAGONS** left on* *the battlefield.*
paragons of slaanesh.lore: Those who serve their own dark desires earn Slaanesh’s favour.
paragons of slaanesh.restrictionText: Hedonites of Slaanesh armies can use the following abilities:

dilettante.name: Dilettante
dilettante.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
dilettante.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
dilettante.lore: This champion is always flitting to and fro, forever hungry to sample new horrors.

unseemly vitality.name: Unseemly Vitality
unseemly vitality.lore: No wound or exertion seems able to slow this libertine for long.

centre of attention.name: Centre of Attention
centre of attention.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while this unit is wholly within 12" of the centre of the battlefield and visible to the target:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units that target that enemy unit.
centre of attention.lore: Such is the dazzling self-possession of this champion that many enemies cannot help but be stupefied around them.

favour most fickle.name: Favour Most Fickle
favour most fickle.description:
Effect: The following effects apply based on the number of friendly units on the battlefield. These effects are not cumulative:

**• 5 or more units:** Add 2 to the Control characteristic of friendly units.
**• 4 units:** Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons.
**• 3 units:** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units.
**• 2 units:** Friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
**• 1 unit:** Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly units’ melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons.
favour most fickle.lore: The Dark Prince smiles only on those who perform for his twisted amusement.

agonisingly elusive.name: Agonisingly Elusive
agonisingly elusive.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: If it is your turn, apply the effect below. If it is your opponent’s turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below:

Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit must move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
agonisingly elusive.lore: Sinuous and graceful, this Hedonite leaps and twirls around their opponents, inflicting delicious pain before nimbly springing out of reach.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Hedonites of Slaanesh

incensed.name: Incensed
incensed.description:
Declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 9" from them while all models in those friendly units are contesting the target objective.
incensed.lore: By burning a mixture of tree resin and aromatic leaves, this champion envelops a key location in an eye‐stingingly pungent cloud of smoke.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Hedonites of Slaanesh

arcane magnetism.name: Arcane Magnetism
arcane magnetism.description: Effect: If this unit has 3 or more damage points, it can use a **SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **UNLIMITED** keyword and as if this unit had **WIZARD (1)**.
arcane magnetism.lore: Though they are no natural mage, something about this hero’s blood attracts errant motes of magic and renders them ripe for exploitation.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Hedonites of Slaanesh

obsession with form.name: Obsession with Form
obsession with form.phase: Reaction: You declared the 'RUN' ability for this unit
obsession with form.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.
obsession with form.lore: Instead of sprinting, these warriors skip and spin their way across the battlefield with acrobatic grace.
obsession with form.restrictionText:
All-consuming Obsessions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 All-consuming Obsession.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Hedonites of Slaanesh

obsession with pain.name: Obsession with Pain
obsession with pain.description: Effect: If this unit is damaged, spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
obsession with pain.lore: The throbbing of a fresh wound coupled with the feeling of blood trickling over their skin sends these warriors into apoplexy.
obsession with pain.restrictionText:
All-consuming Obsessions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 All-consuming Obsession.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Hedonites of Slaanesh

obsession with control.name: Obsession with Control
obsession with control.description:
Declare: Pick an objective to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, while this unit is contesting the target objective:

• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
• Add 5 to this unit’s control score.
obsession with control.lore: Once these Hedonites have acquired the object of their desire, they simply will not relinquish it.
obsession with control.restrictionText:
All-consuming Obsessions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 All-consuming Obsession.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Hedonites of Slaanesh

overwhelming acquiescence.name: Overwhelming Acquiescence
overwhelming acquiescence.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, weapons used by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units for attacks that target that enemy unit, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
overwhelming acquiescence.lore: The wizard engulfs the foe in an arcane haze of dreams and unattainable desires.

last ecstasy.name: Last Ecstasy
last ecstasy.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the target unit is a **MONSTER**, roll 10 dice instead. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
last ecstasy.lore: The caster induces such a state of mania that even death cannot stop a final revel.

hysterical frenzy.name: Hysterical Frenzy
hysterical frenzy.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.
hysterical frenzy.lore: The wizard fires a sudden surge of ecstasy through nearby flesh, inspiring their minions into a maddened and cackling assault.

summon dreadful visage.name: Summon Dreadful Visage
summon dreadful visage.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Dreadful Visage** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Dreadful Visage** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon dreadful visage.lore: Inhaling draughts of hallucinogenic incense, the caster externalises their most unnatural desires in the form of a screaming daemonic visage.

summon mesmerising mirror.name: Summon Mesmerising Mirror
summon mesmerising mirror.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Mesmerising Mirror** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Mesmerising Mirror** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon mesmerising mirror.lore: Smashing a small glass mirror to the ground, the wizard uses magical energy to cause it to reform and grow in size.

summon wheels of excruciation.name: Summon Wheels of Excruciation
summon wheels of excruciation.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Wheels of Excruciation** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Wheels of Excruciation** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon wheels of excruciation.lore: Throwing a small multi-bladed knife into the air and channelling magical energy into it, the caster summons forth a storm of swiftly moving razor-sharp blades.

formations.name: Invaders
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SYBARITE INFANTRY** units while they are wholly outside friendly territory.

ability.name: Ecstatic Revellers
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SYBARITE INFANTRY** units while they are wholly outside friendly territory.
ability.lore: The thrill of piercing the lands of their enemies like a hot needle through flesh gives strength to these avaricious revellers.

abilities.name: Ecstatic Revellers
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SYBARITE INFANTRY** units while they are wholly outside friendly territory.
abilities.lore: The thrill of piercing the lands of their enemies like a hot needle through flesh gives strength to these avaricious revellers.

formations.sourcePublication: Scourge of Ghyran: Hedonites of Slaanesh

formations.name: Depraved Carnival
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** units to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move D6". It can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move.

ability.name: In Search of Sin
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** units to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move D6". It can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move.
ability.lore: Numbness dogging their heels, these Hedonites are always seeking new thrills.

abilities.name: In Search of Sin
