Effect: Each target can move D6". It can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move.
abilities.lore: Numbness dogging their heels, these Hedonites are always seeking new thrills.

formations.name: Pretenders
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** that has an artefact of power to be the target.

Effect: Give the target a heroic trait from the ‘Figureheads of the Dark Prince’ or ‘Hedonistic Obsessions’ tables.

**Designer’s Note**: *This heroic trait is given to the target during the deployment phase, not during army composition*.

ability.name: Prodigy of Excess
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** that has an artefact of power to be the target.

Effect: Give the target a heroic trait from the ‘Figureheads of the Dark Prince’ or ‘Hedonistic Obsessions’ tables.

**Designer’s Note**: *This heroic trait is given to the target during the deployment phase, not during army composition*.
ability.lore: A narcissistic monstrosity, this follower of the Dark Prince possesses a grotesque surfeit of hedonistic qualities that inspire craven envy in their followers.

abilities.name: Prodigy of Excess
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** that has an artefact of power to be the target.

Effect: Give the target a heroic trait from the ‘Figureheads of the Dark Prince’ or ‘Hedonistic Obsessions’ tables.

**Designer’s Note**: *This heroic trait is given to the target during the deployment phase, not during army composition*.
abilities.lore: A narcissistic monstrosity, this follower of the Dark Prince possesses a grotesque surfeit of hedonistic qualities that inspire craven envy in their followers.

formations.sourcePublication: Scourge of Ghyran: Hedonites of Slaanesh

formations.name: Artisans of Torment
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that unit and that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• All of the combat attacks made by that friendly unit must target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that friendly unit’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Sadistic Tendencies
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that unit and that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• All of the combat attacks made by that friendly unit must target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that friendly unit’s melee weapons.
ability.lore: These Hedonites have given themselves to pleasures of the flesh – or rather, of torturing said flesh without limit.

abilities.name: Sadistic Tendencies
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that unit and that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• All of the combat attacks made by that friendly unit must target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that friendly unit’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: These Hedonites have given themselves to pleasures of the flesh – or rather, of torturing said flesh without limit.

formations.name: Godseeker Cavalcade
formations.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Godly Spoor
ability.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
ability.lore: The merest trace of Slaanesh’s divine power sees these Hedonites hurtling along at pace.

abilities.name: Godly Spoor
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The merest trace of Slaanesh’s divine power sees these Hedonites hurtling along at pace.

formations.name: Lurid Dreamers
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by an enemy ability to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Amidst the Phantasmagoria
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Shooting Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by an enemy ability to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.lore: Where these revellers travel, their divine ecstasy breaks down the nature of reality; everything becomes as a twisted dream, through which the devotees of pain dance without warning.

abilities.name: Amidst the Phantasmagoria
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by an enemy ability to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Where these revellers travel, their divine ecstasy breaks down the nature of reality; everything becomes as a twisted dream, through which the devotees of pain dance without warning.

the voice and the talon.name: The Voice and the Talon
the voice and the talon.description: Effect: The friendly **Synessa** and **Dexcessa** have the **TWIN** keyword.
the voice and the talon.lore: For all their mutual and endless antipathy, Slaanesh’s twin heirs are most deadly when they work in tandem.
the voice and the talon.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

the more glorious slaughter.name: The More Glorious Slaughter
the more glorious slaughter.phase: Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn
the more glorious slaughter.description:
Declare: If a friendly **TWIN** destroyed an enemy unit in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by units in the regiment of the unit using this ability.
the more glorious slaughter.lore: In a flush of vainglory, one of the Twins boasts extravagantly of their superior acts of death-dealing, goading their sibling and their entourage to new heights of lethality in their efforts not to be overshadowed.
the more glorious slaughter.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

the longer shadow.name: The Longer Shadow
the longer shadow.description:
Declare: If a friendly **TWIN** is contesting an objective you control and the other is not, pick the one that is not to use this ability.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is contesting an objective you control, add 5 to the control scores of units in its regiment.
the longer shadow.lore: Both Synessa and Dexcessa are forever competing to prove themselves the more domineering of their god-father’s spawn.
the longer shadow.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

the grander visage.name: The Grander Visage
the grander visage.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
the grander visage.description:
Declare: If either friendly **TWIN** is damaged, pick the one with fewer or no damage points to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the unit using this ability has **WARD (4+)**.
the grander visage.lore: Should one of the Twins show a sign of weakening, the other will seize the chance to better display their own immaculacy.
the grander visage.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

the swifter surge.name: The Swifter Surge
the swifter surge.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
the swifter surge.description:
Declare: If a friendly **TWIN** charged in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for units in the regiment of the unit using this ability, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
the swifter surge.lore: To be the first into the fray is a mark of honour between the vindictive Twins. Should one of them fall behind for even a moment, they will act swiftly lest they leave themselves open to their sibling’s ridicule.
the swifter surge.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

the more cunning ruse.name: The More Cunning Ruse
the more cunning ruse.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
the more cunning ruse.description:
Declare: If both friendly **TWINS** are within 12" of and visible to each other, pick one of them to use this ability.

Effect: Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
the more cunning ruse.lore: Strategic intellect is another arena of mastery – one that both Twins are eager to prove the superior in.
the more cunning ruse.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

tethered to the twins.name: Tethered to the Twins
tethered to the twins.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
tethered to the twins.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **TWIN** that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
tethered to the twins.lore: This daemon is a vassal of Synessa or Dexcessa – or both. So long as they persist, so will the accursed Twins.
tethered to the twins.groupName: Court of the Godlings Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

the triplet trinket.name: The Triplet Trinket
the triplet trinket.description:
Effect: While a friendly **TWIN** is within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that **TWIN** and this unit.
While 2 friendly **TWINS** are within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target those **TWINS** and this unit instead.
the triplet trinket.lore: This bipartite charm is given to the Twins’ latest plaything – a supposed mark of favour that protects the godlings also.
the triplet trinket.groupName: Court of the Godlings Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

summon manifestation of depravity.name: Summon Manifestation of Depravity
summon manifestation of depravity.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION** that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.

If you picked a **Dreadful Visage** or **Wheels of Excruciation**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Mesmerising Mirror**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon manifestation of depravity.lore: The god-spawn of Slaanesh and their chosen retainers are masters of the most extreme and decadent forms of magical conjuration.

essence transfusion.name: Essence Transfusion
essence transfusion.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **TWIN** to be the donor, pick another visible friendly **TWIN** to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Allocate any number of damage points to the donor (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is double the number of damage points allocated to the donor by this use of this ability.
essence transfusion.lore: Though bitter rivals, the Twins are ultimately born of the same godly stuff and can share strength between them if necessary.

sibilant whispers.name: Sibilant Whispers
sibilant whispers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while a friendly **TWIN** is visible to the target, halve the target’s Move characteristic. In addition, while 2 friendly **TWINS** are visible to the target, your opponent must roll 1 fewer dice, to a minimum of 1, when making charge rolls for it.
sibilant whispers.lore: The commands of the Twins are cast into the enemies’ minds, leaving them stumbling, uncertain and vulnerable.

ecstatic furore.name: Ecstatic Furore
ecstatic furore.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **TWIN** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to the target.
ecstatic furore.lore: The baser, bloodier aspects of Slaanesh’s nature are channelled through one of the Twins, filling their sycophants with rapturous murder‑lust.

lores.name: Court of the Godlings Manifestation Lore
Court of the Godlings Spell Lore

protege.name: Protégé
protege.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'The Prince in the Mirror' ability
protege.description: Effect: You can set up a replacement **Sigvald** within 1" of this unit instead of within 6" of a friendly **Contorted Epitome**. If you do so, after setting up that replacement unit, this unit is automatically destroyed.
protege.lore: Sigvald took a liking to this champion, to the point of binding their souls in a one-sided ritual of great power. Of course, the Prince has ways of using this bond…
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Decadent Host

perfection made manifest.name: Perfection Made Manifest
perfection made manifest.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
perfection made manifest.description:
Declare: Pick the friendly **Sigvald** to use this ability then pick a visible unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of him to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each model slain by this ability this turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the friendly **Sigvald**’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
perfection made manifest.lore: To witness Sigvald at war is to witness a martial skill so magnificent that onlookers are entranced even as they are cut down.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Decadent Host

petulant wrath.name: Petulant Wrath
petulant wrath.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
petulant wrath.description:
Declare: If the friendly **Sigvald** is not in combat and did not charge this turn, pick him to use this ability, then pick another friendly **DECADENT HOST** unit within 1" of him to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. Before removing any slain models from play, remove the friendly **Sigvald** from the battlefield then set him up again within 1" of the target.
petulant wrath.lore: Woe betide the hapless Hedonite who looks liable to upstage Sigvald in their eagerness to reach combat…
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Decadent Host

infernal handmaidens.name: Infernal Handmaidens
infernal handmaidens.description: Effect: While the friendly **Sigvald** is within 3" of and visible to any friendly **DECADENT HOST DAEMON** units, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by those **DAEMON** units.
infernal handmaidens.lore: Sigvald is often accompanied by throngs of adulating daemons who delight in the Prince’s utter unrighteous conviction.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Decadent Host

all for the prince.name: All for the Prince
all for the prince.description:
Effect: While the friendly **Sigvald** is within the combat range of another friendly **DECADENT HOST SYBARITE** unit:

• He has **WARD (2+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for him, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly **DECADENT HOST** unit within his combat range after the damage sequence for him has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
all for the prince.lore: Sigvald is the centre of his libertine followers’ world – they would rather be rent limb from limb than allow a single blade to mar his immaculate flesh.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Decadent Host

important people have important places t.name: Important People Have Important Places To Be
important people have important places t.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
important people have important places t.description: Effect: If the friendly **Sigvald** is not contesting an objective, he can move 2D6" but must end that move contesting an objective. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
important people have important places t.lore: Sigvald is easily bored and easily distracted – but when something does catch his eye, he moves with incredible haste.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Decadent Host

the prince in the mirror.name: The Prince in the Mirror
the prince in the mirror.description:
Declare: If the friendly **Sigvald** has been destroyed, pick him to be the target. He can be replaced even if he is a replacement unit.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a friendly **Contorted Epitome** and not in combat.
the prince in the mirror.lore: It is said that all mirrors are enthralled by Sigvald’s beauty. Should he fall, they readily allow his soul back to the field.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Decadent Host

mirror plate.name: Mirror-Plate
mirror plate.description:
Effect: Weapons used by this unit have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 1.

While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the friendly **Sigvald**, add 20 to the friendly **Sigvald**’s control score.
mirror plate.lore: One who wears this polished armour is a member of the vaunted Mirror Guard. Their duty is not to fight but to ensure the Prince can always admire his favourite sight: himself.
mirror plate.groupName: The Decadent Host Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Decadent Host

diverting excruciation.name: Diverting Excruciation
diverting excruciation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DECADENT HOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **Sigvald** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** the target.
diverting excruciation.lore: Sigvald’s pet mages know all sorts of magical means to enthuse, empower and revive their beloved lord.

visions of eternal bliss.name: Visions of Eternal Bliss
visions of eternal bliss.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DECADENT HOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **Sigvald** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target scores critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
visions of eternal bliss.lore: One of the chief duties of Sigvald’s sorcerers is to stoke his eager sword-arm with mystic visions of his master’s sinful domain.

summon manifestations of depravity.name: Summon Manifestations of Depravity
summon manifestations of depravity.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DECADENT HOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION** that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.

If you picked a **Dreadful Visage** or **Wheels of Excruciation**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Mesmerising Mirror**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon manifestations of depravity.lore: There is no sort of spellcraft that Sigvald will not encourage his lackeys to pursue – no matter how vile.

always three clawsteps ahead.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
always three clawsteps ahead.phase: Once Per Phase, Enemy Movement Phase
always three clawsteps ahead.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat.

Effect: That unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
always three clawsteps ahead.lore: The best-laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).

always three clawsteps ahead.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
always three clawsteps ahead.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
always three clawsteps ahead.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER SKAVEN** unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.
always three clawsteps ahead.lore: The best laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).
always three clawsteps ahead.restrictionText: Skaven armies can use the following abilities:

gnawhole ambush.name: Gnawhole Ambush
gnawhole ambush.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **in the tunnels below** to use this ability.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a corner of the battlefield and more than 9" from all enemy units.
gnawhole ambush.lore: A pack of Skaven emerges onto the battlefield from a glowing green rift in reality.

gnawhole ambush.name: Gnawhole Ambush
gnawhole ambush.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN** unit that is **in the** **tunnels below** to use this ability.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Gnawhole** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
gnawhole ambush.lore: Emerging from a green, glowing rift, the Skaventide pours onto the battlefield.
gnawhole ambush.restrictionText: Skaven armies can use the following abilities:

the lurking vermintide.name: The Lurking Vermintide
the lurking vermintide.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.

Effect: The target unit is set up in reserve in the tunnels below. Units **in the tunnels below** that have not used the ‘Gnawhole Ambush’ ability by the end of the third battle round are destroyed.

the lurking vermintide.name: The Lurking Vermintide
the lurking vermintide.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the tunnels below**. It has now been deployed.
the lurking vermintide.restrictionText: Skaven armies can use the following abilities:

skilled manipulator.name: Skilled Manipulator
skilled manipulator.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
skilled manipulator.lore: This Skaven warlord is particularly devious and selfserving, deftly ensuring that their minions are always conveniently positioned between themselves and potential threats.

scurry away.name: Scurry Away
scurry away.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
scurry away.lore: This Skaven chief does not think twice about scampering to safety when things look to be going south. Perhaps that’s why they have lived so long.

short tempered.name: Short-tempered
short tempered.description: Effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **SKAVEN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
short tempered.lore: This twitching and irascible Skaven has succeeded in making their minions more afraid of their displeasure than of the enemy.

pit tinkerer.name: Pit Tinkerer
pit tinkerer.description: Effect: You can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for the Move characteristic of friendly **SKRYRE WAR MACHINES** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. In addition, each time a friendly **SKRYRE WAR MACHINE** wholly within 18" of this unit uses the ‘Rolling Doom’ or ‘Whirling Doom’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any.
pit tinkerer.lore: This mechanically minded Skaven has a compulsion to make ‘improvements’ to the Skryre devices under his command.

devious underling.name: Devious Underling
devious underling.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **SKAVEN HERO** on the battlefield with a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit’s Health characteristic to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle:

• While the target has not been slain, friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
• Once the target has been slain, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
devious underling.lore: Sly in the extreme, this ratman has mastered the art of biding his time, content to wait until his superiors’ demise before violently seizing control for himself.

fleshmeddler.name: Fleshmeddler
fleshmeddler.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MOULDER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.
fleshmeddler.lore: This Skaven carries syringe darts filled with warpstone serum that can be fired into the patchwork hides of nearby Moulder creations to give them a ‘bit of extra bite’.

skavenbrew.name: Skavenbrew
skavenbrew.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
skavenbrew.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
skavenbrew.lore: This foul concoction, brewed from blood and warpstone, is dispensed to expendable underlings to drive them into a short-lived but devastating killing frenzy.

foulhide.name: Foulhide
foulhide.lore: Fashioned from the flensed flesh of Rat Ogors and soaked in cloying alchemical agents, this stinking armour sticks to its wearer like a bloated second skin and regrows as fast as it can be hacked apart.

warpstone charm.name: Warpstone Charm
warpstone charm.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
warpstone charm.lore: This foul talisman radiates mutating energy that can be directed at an enemy unit to erode their armour.

too quick to hit hit.name: Too Quick To Hit-hit
too quick to hit hit.description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units by **RETREAT** abilities.
too quick to hit hit.lore: These skittish ratmen dart and run in all directions, avoiding retribution as they flee from combat.
too quick to hit hit.restrictionText: Skaven armies can use the following abilities:

splinters of the vermindoom.name: Splinters of the Vermindoom
splinters of the vermindoom.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
splinters of the vermindoom.description:
Declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly **Gnawholes** on the battlefield.

Effect: Set up a **Gnawhole** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.
splinters of the vermindoom.lore: In the aftermath of the Vermindoom, reality continues to fracture and tear as gnawholes bore into reality, spewing forth endless tides of ratmen.
splinters of the vermindoom.restrictionText: Skaven armies can use the following abilities:

cloaked in shadow.name: Cloaked in Shadow
cloaked in shadow.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
cloaked in shadow.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** to use this ability. Then, pick a different friendly unit that has 2 or more models to be the target.

Effect: Make a **shadow-travel roll** of D6. On a 3+, remove the **HERO** using this ability from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of the target. They can be set up in combat with any enemy units that are already in combat.
cloaked in shadow.lore: By the time enemies have uncovered a band of Skaven assassins, the ratmen are already in place to strike.

masterclan connections.name: Masterclan Connections
masterclan connections.phase: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** or **UNBIND** ability for a visible **SKAVEN** unit wholly within 13" of this unit
masterclan connections.description: Effect: Add D3 to that casting roll or unbinding roll.
masterclan connections.lore: This Skaven’s obsequious nature has allowed them to curry favour with a member of the sorcerous Masterclan.

master of the swarm.name: Master of the Swarm
master of the swarm.description: Effect: Each time an ability returns 1 or more slain models to a friendly **SKAVEN** unit wholly within 13" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.
master of the swarm.lore: This warlord understands the importance of numbers, ensuring their burrows are teeming with fresh warriors.

essence of the gnaw.name: Essence of the Gnaw
essence of the gnaw.description:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly **SKAVEN** unit wholly within 13" of this unit and in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** and the target has **STRIKE-LAST**.
essence of the gnaw.lore: A cursed combination of warpstone and daemonic power allows this rodent to twist reality.

serrated bone protrusions.name: Serrated Bone Protrusions
serrated bone protrusions.description: Effect: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by an enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
serrated bone protrusions.lore: The jagged shards of bone that jut out from these abominations can inflict nasty injuries on careless attackers.
serrated bone protrusions.restrictionText:
Moulder Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**WAR MACHINE** **SKAVEN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Moulder Mutation.

anabolic accelerators.name: Anabolic Accelerators
anabolic accelerators.description: Effect: If this unit was set up this turn, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
anabolic accelerators.lore: The limbs of these mutants have been injected with a serum that promotes rapid tissue growth, giving them a monstrous – if short-lived – burst of speed.
anabolic accelerators.restrictionText:
Moulder Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**WAR MACHINE** **SKAVEN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Moulder Mutation.

transplanted brains.name: Transplanted Brains
transplanted brains.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following brains. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn:

***Warpstone Addict’s Brain***:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
• This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

***Warlock Whelp’s Brain***: Add 10 to this unit’s control score.
transplanted brains.lore: The grey matter of various ‘willing’ Moulder volunteers has been grafted onto these mutants’ brains, allowing them to change their personalities in an instant.
transplanted brains.restrictionText:
Moulder Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**WAR MACHINE** **SKAVEN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Moulder Mutation.

skitterleap.name: Skitterleap
skitterleap.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN HERO** wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
skitterleap.lore: Vanishing in a puff of foul-smelling smoke, the verminkin reappear elsewhere on the battlefield an eye-blink later.

wither.name: Wither
wither.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
wither.lore: The spellcaster hurls a glowing green globe of magical energy at the foe. Anyone touched by the globe starts to shrivel and wither away.

warpgale.name: Warpgale
warpgale.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
warpgale.lore: Screeching in an unholy tongue, the caster parts the veil of reality and draws a ravening gale of unnatural energies forth.

summon vermintide.name: Summon Vermintide
summon vermintide.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon vermintide.lore: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.

summon warp lightning vortex.name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
summon warp lightning vortex.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Warp Lightning Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up the first part of the **Warp Lightning Vortex** within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.
summon warp lightning vortex.lore: Warpstone shards are cast into the air, growing impossibly large and discharging bolts of warp lightning.

summon bell of doom.name: Summon Bell of Doom
summon bell of doom.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bell of Doom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bell of Doom** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon bell of doom.lore: Invoking ancient creation myths, the spellcaster causes a great Bell of Doom to manifest upon the battlefield.

bile torrent.name: Bile-torrent
bile torrent.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.
bile torrent.lore: The priest screeches with glowing green eyes as a torrent of bile sweeps over their foe.

rabid tough.name: Rabid-tough
rabid tough.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
rabid tough.lore: The priest snarls and conjures a dense cloud of toxins that sends their followers into a frenzy that numbs them to pain.

filth crust.name: Filth-crust
filth crust.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.
filth crust.lore: The Great Horned Rat heeds the call of this priest to encrust the weapons of their minions with irresistible contagions.

formations.name: Fleshmeld Menagerie
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**HERO MOULDER** units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:

**1-2 - *Self-destructive Fury***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

**3-4 - *Rabid Infusion***
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

**5-6 -** ***Blinded by Frenzy***
In addition to the effect of ‘Rabid Infusion’, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Prized Creations
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**HERO MOULDER** units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:

**1-2 - *Self-destructive Fury***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

**3-4 - *Rabid Infusion***
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

**5-6 -** ***Blinded by Frenzy***
In addition to the effect of ‘Rabid Infusion’, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
ability.lore: Moulder warbeasts are studded with warpstone crystals and pumped full of vile serums that spur their battle-rage – at the occasional cost of overtaxing their forms.

abilities.name: Prized Creations
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:

formations.name: Virulent Procession
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **PESTILENS** units that are in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

ability.name: Corrupted Earth
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **PESTILENS** units that are in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
ability.lore: The Clans Pestilens are relentless in advancing the spread of plague and corruption.

abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

abilities.lore: The Clans Pestilens are relentless in advancing the spread of plague and corruption.

formations.name: Claw-horde
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **VERMINUS** units that charged this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Claw-picked
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **VERMINUS** units that charged this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The Stormvermin and Clanrats of a Verminus Claw‑horde are amongst the most ferocious of all ratmen.

abilities.name: Claw-picked
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:

abilities.lore: The Stormvermin and Clanrats of a Verminus Claw‑horde are amongst the most ferocious of all ratmen.

formations.name: Kill-Pack
formations.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **ESHIN** units.

ability.name: Kill-Kill! Scurry-Flee!
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **ESHIN** units.
ability.lore: A kill-pack has one purpose: slay the target. Once this goal has been achieved and the element of surprise lost, the Eshin agents must see to their own survival…

abilities.name: Kill-Kill! Scurry-Flee!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **ESHIN** units.
abilities.lore: A kill-pack has one purpose: slay the target. Once this goal has been achieved and the element of surprise lost, the Eshin agents must see to their own survival…

formations.name: Envoys of the Deepengnaw
formations.description:
Effect: While a friendly **SKAVEN DAEMON** is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit:

• That **SKAVEN DAEMON** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **SKAVEN DAEMON**, allocate 1 mortal damage on a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within that unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved. (ward rolls cannot be made for these damage points).

ability.name: Will of the Horned Rat
ability.description:
Effect: While a friendly **SKAVEN DAEMON** is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit:

• That **SKAVEN DAEMON** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **SKAVEN DAEMON**, allocate 1 mortal damage on a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within that unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved. (ward rolls cannot be made for these damage points).
ability.lore: Although they tower over the rest of the swarm, Verminlords are as craven and cunning as any Skaven – in truth even more so – and will readily use their underlings as fodder to protect their own hides.

abilities.name: Will of the Horned Rat
abilities.description:

• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **SKAVEN DAEMON**, allocate 1 mortal damage on a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within that unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved. (ward rolls cannot be made for these damage points).
abilities.lore: Although they tower over the rest of the swarm, Verminlords are as craven and cunning as any Skaven – in truth even more so – and will readily use their underlings as fodder to protect their own hides.

formations.name: Gathering of the Clans
formations.description: Effect: Pick up to 2 other friendly **SKAVEN** units that are not in combat and are wholly within 13" of the unit using the ‘Redeploy’ command to be the targets. Each target must have at least one of the following keywords: **VERMINUS**, **SKRYRE**, **MOULDER**, **PESTILENS**, **ESHIN**. After that ‘Redeploy’ command has been resolved, each of the targets can immediately use the ‘Redeploy’ command in an order of your choice without any command points being spent.

ability.name: Backstabbing Allies
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly SKAVEN unit
ability.description: Effect: Pick up to 2 other friendly **SKAVEN** units that are not in combat and are wholly within 13" of the unit using the ‘Redeploy’ command to be the targets. Each target must have at least one of the following keywords: **VERMINUS**, **SKRYRE**, **MOULDER**, **PESTILENS**, **ESHIN**. After that ‘Redeploy’ command has been resolved, each of the targets can immediately use the ‘Redeploy’ command in an order of your choice without any command points being spent.
ability.lore: The Skaven often form uneasy alliances between clans, but none of them want to suffer the brunt of the fighting when the enemy draws near.

abilities.name: Backstabbing Allies
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly SKAVEN unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick up to 2 other friendly **SKAVEN** units that are not in combat and are wholly within 13" of the unit using the ‘Redeploy’ command to be the targets. Each target must have at least one of the following keywords: **VERMINUS**, **SKRYRE**, **MOULDER**, **PESTILENS**, **ESHIN**. After that ‘Redeploy’ command has been resolved, each of the targets can immediately use the ‘Redeploy’ command in an order of your choice without any command points being spent.
abilities.lore: The Skaven often form uneasy alliances between clans, but none of them want to suffer the brunt of the fighting when the enemy draws near.

formations.name: Warpcog Convocation
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **SKRYRE** units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 -** ***Kaboom!***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

**2-5 - *More Power!***
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

**6 - *More-more Power!***
In addition to the effect of ‘More Power!’, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Skryre Prototypes
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **SKRYRE** units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 -** ***Kaboom!***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

**2-5 - *More Power!***
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

**6 - *More-more Power!***
In addition to the effect of ‘More Power!’, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The fell contraptions wielded by these ratmen were created by the Clans Skryre’s most ingenious weaponsmiths.

abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

pack tactics.name: Pack Tactics
pack tactics.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
pack tactics.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: The targets can each use the 'All-out Attack' or 'All-out Defence' command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.
pack tactics.lore: Though insane with frenzy, the beasts of Thanquol's menagerie retain some of their predatory swarming instincts..
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Thanquol's Mutated Menagerie

warpstone innards.name: Warpstone Innards
warpstone innards.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warpstone innards.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the battle. However, at the end of each turn, allocate D3 damage points to the target.
warpstone innards.lore: A 'gift' from Thanquol, these warpstone-studded organs have been inserted into a prized warbeast to augment its power.
warpstone innards.groupName: Thanquol's Mutated Menagerie Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Thanquol's Mutated Menagerie

monstrous entourage.name: Monstrous Entourage
monstrous entourage.description:
Effect: The **Companion** weapon ability has no effect on **MUTATED MENAGERIE** units. While a friendly **Thanquol** is within the combat range of another friendly Mutated Menagerie unit:

• That **Thanquol** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Thanquol**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **MUTATED MENAGERIE** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.
monstrous entourage.lore: Thanquol is well practised in getting Moulder mutants to die on his behalf.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Thanquol's Mutated Menagerie

more more mutation.name: More-more Mutation!
more more mutation.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
more more mutation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE** unit to be the target. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per battle.

Effect: For the rest of the battle:

• Add 2 to the target's Health characteristic.
• Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
• The target has **WARD (5+)**.
• At the end of each turn, allocate D3+2 damage points to the target.
more more mutation.lore: The sponsorship of a Grey Seer gives Thanquol's flesh-grafting lackeys licence to pursue their most deranged experiments.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Thanquol's Mutated Menagerie

rampaging demise.name: Rampaging Demise
rampaging demise.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rampaging demise.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability.

Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. However, at the end of the turn, this unit is destroyed. When this unit would be destroyed, before it is removed from play, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
rampaging demise.lore: Thanquol cares little for the survival of his beasts and is more than willing to have them sacrifice themselves in spasms of fury.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Thanquol's Mutated Menagerie

spiteful swarms.name: Spiteful Swarms
spiteful swarms.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
spiteful swarms.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability.

Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. However, at the end of the turn, this unit is destroyed. When this unit would be destroyed, before it is removed from play, roll a dice for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of that enemy unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
spiteful swarms.lore: Always one for a cunning trick, churning rat-swarms have been stitched into the guts of Thanquol's beasts, ready to burst free in a wave of disorienting fangs and claws when their host is slain.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Thanquol's Mutated Menagerie

untapped mutation.name: Untapped Mutation
untapped mutation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MUTATED MENAGERIE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible friendly **MUTATED MENAGERIE** units wholly within 13" of them that are affected by the 'More-more Mutation!' ability to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For each damage point allocated to the target at the end of this turn by the 'More-more Mutation!' ability, add 1 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.
untapped mutation.lore: This wizard manipulates the warpstone melded into the flesh of their minions, pushing the limits of their physicality before they are inevitably destroyed.

summon warp lightning vortex.name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
summon warp lightning vortex.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Warp Lightning Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up the first part of the **Warp Lightning Vortex** within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.
summon warp lightning vortex.lore: Warpstone shards are cast into the air, growing impossibly large and discharging bolts of warp lightning.

reckless abandon.name: Reckless Abandon
reckless abandon.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
reckless abandon.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target those friendly units.
reckless abandon.lore: With the death frenzy upon them, the Gnawhorde's warriors show a most unusual disregard for self-preservation.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

disciples of vizzik.name: Disciples of Vizzik
disciples of vizzik.description:
Effect: While a friendly **Vizzik Skour** is within the combat range of another friendly **GNAWHORDE** Unit:

• That **Vizzik Skour** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Vizzik** **Skour**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **GNAWHORDE** Unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.
disciples of vizzik.lore: The clawpacks of the Great-grand Gnawhorde protect their daemon-prophet by any means necessary.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

frenzied momentum.name: Frenzied Momentum
frenzied momentum.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
frenzied momentum.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the targets.
• Subtract 1 from the targets' control scores.
frenzied momentum.lore: Hateful bells clanging in their minds, the swarms of the Great-grand Gnawhorde surge into the fray.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

unstoppable warp volley.name: Unstoppable Warp-volley
unstoppable warp volley.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
unstoppable warp volley.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.
• The targets cannot use commands.
unstoppable warp volley.lore: The Warlocks of the Gnawhorde are no less aggressive than their Verminus kin - they are simply able to strike from further away.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

harbinger of the great ascendancy.name: Harbinger of the Great Ascendancy
harbinger of the great ascendancy.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
harbinger of the great ascendancy.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, you can use 2 different **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn instead of 1.
harbinger of the great ascendancy.lore: In the eyes of this Skaven warlord, nothing can stop the Horned Rat's ascendancy and the ruination of the Mortal Realms.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

icon of great total supremacy.name: Icon of Great-total Supremacy
icon of great total supremacy.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
icon of great total supremacy.description: Effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to each friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit with a Health characteristic of up to 3.
icon of great total supremacy.lore: Within this jagged brass reliquary lies a cutting from the Horned Rat's whiskers. It exerts a natural hold over the Skaven, drawing frothing warriors to it.
icon of great total supremacy.groupName: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

deafening frenzy.name: Deafening Frenzy
deafening frenzy.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GNAWHORDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. The casting roll for this spell cannot be modified.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
• The target cannot use commands.
deafening frenzy.lore: The caster enhances the clangour of the thirteen Warpshatter Bells in the minds of a nearby swarm, driving them to even greater heights of fury.

summon vermintide.name: Summon Vermintide
summon vermintide.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon vermintide.lore: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.

reverberating ritual.name: Reverberating Ritual
reverberating ritual.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GNAWHORDE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target can move an extra 3" when it makes a pile-in move. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.
reverberating ritual.lore: The priest chants in time with the tolling of the Warpshatter Bells, sonically shattering the last dregs of sanity from nearby ratmen and filling them with dreadful hunger.

let s get stuck in.name: Let's Get Stuck In
let s get stuck in.description: Effect: Set up this unit wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, and not in combat.
let s get stuck in.lore: The Ironguts start to arrive, and woe betide whoever gets in their way.

bellowing arrival.name: Bellowing Arrival
bellowing arrival.description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
bellowing arrival.lore: A mighty roar echoes across the battlefield as more hungry ogors join the fray.

mage swallower.name: Mage-swallower
mage swallower.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.
mage swallower.lore: Ever since they ate an entire party of wizardly scholars, the mere presence of this ogor is enough to disrupt magical defences.
mage swallower.restrictionText: Big Names are enhancements that can only be given to **OGOR MAWTRIBES HEROES**.

gutslugger.name: Gutslugger
gutslugger.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks if it did not charge in the same turn.
gutslugger.lore: This ogor is usually found fighting in the thick of a melee and is renowned for their uncanny ability to come out on top.
gutslugger.restrictionText: Big Names are enhancements that can only be given to **OGOR MAWTRIBES HEROES**.

megagobbler.name: Megagobbler
megagobbler.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following keywords:

• **INFANTRY**
• **CAVALRY**
• **MONSTER**
• **WAR MACHINE**
• **BEAST**

For the rest of the battle, each time any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit with that keyword by this unit’s combat attacks and that enemy unit is destroyed in the same turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. This effect is cumulative.
megagobbler.lore: Surveying the enemies lined up before them as if considering items on a menu, this ogor chooses today’s main course.
megagobbler.restrictionText: Big Names are enhancements that can only be given to **OGOR MAWTRIBES HEROES**.

extremely obstinate.name: Extremely Obstinate
extremely obstinate.description: Effect: This unit has a Control characteristic of 15.
extremely obstinate.lore: Once this beast has laid claim to something, there is no shifting it.

horn toss.name: Horn Toss
horn toss.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model, that is in combat with this unit and that has charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
horn toss.lore: Dipping its head against an onrushing foe, with an effortless flick of its horns, this beast sends its attacker flying into the air.

grumpy alpha.name: Grumpy Alpha
grumpy alpha.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick another visible friendly **OGOR MONSTER** wholly within 12" of this unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll a dice. The target can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can end that move in combat. If it does so, the target has charged.
grumpy alpha.lore: Having established its dominance, this irascible beast can bring another member of the herd to its side with a single bellow.

a choice cut.name: A Choice Cut
a choice cut.description:
Effect: • This unit cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit each phase while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
a choice cut.lore: The sight of this colossal slab of meat being awkwardly hefted across the battlefield inspires nearby ogors to fight through the pain – the quicker they flatten the foe, the quicker they can get to feasting.

rusty grater.name: Rusty Grater
rusty grater.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** this unit.
rusty grater.lore: By attaching this crudely perforated metal sheet to their favoured blade, this ogor is gifted a snack of shredded flesh when they wield their weapon with enough ferocity.

key to the larder.name: Key to the Larder
key to the larder.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
key to the larder.lore: This ogor has promised their favoured warriors access to one of the legendary larders in the Great Gutfort – if they are suitably impressive in battle.

eat em alive.name: Eat 'Em Alive
eat em alive.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability that targeted a unit, excluding **FACTION TERRAIN**, this turn to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly **OGOR** unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect.

• ***Raw and Bloody Flesh***: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit.

• ***Exotic Giblets***: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks made with non-**Companion** weapons.

• ***Steaming Brains***: Add 2 to that unit’s Control characteristic.

• ***Crunchy Bones***: That unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**. If that unit’s melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** instead.

• ***Slick Innards***: That unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

• ***Mystery Meat***: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0.

**Designer’s Note**: *Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.*
eat em alive.lore: For ogors, there is no real distinction between fighting and feasting.
eat em alive.restrictionText: Ogor Mawtribes armies can use the following abilities:

bull charge.name: Bull Charge
bull charge.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
bull charge.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat.

After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a **GUTBUSTERS** unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile‑in move.

**Designer’s Note**: *Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.*
bull charge.lore: The bulk and surprising speed of ogors can see them trample right over enemies.
bull charge.restrictionText: Ogor Mawtribes armies can use the following abilities:

jaws of the beast.name: Jaws of the Beast
jaws of the beast.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTCLAW HERO** that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-**HERO** unit in that **HERO**'s regiment that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve **tracking the prey**. They have now been deployed.
jaws of the beast.lore: Beastclaw ogors are inevitably skilled hunters and trackers.
jaws of the beast.restrictionText: Ogor Mawtribes armies can use the following abilities:

closing the jaws.name: Closing the Jaws
closing the jaws.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTCLAW HERO** that is **tracking the prey**.

Effect: Set up that **HERO** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is **tracking the prey** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that **HERO** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
closing the jaws.lore: The chieftains of the Beastclaw signal when it is time to strike.
closing the jaws.restrictionText: Ogor Mawtribes armies can use the following abilities:

leave not a morsel.name: Leave Not a Morsel
leave not a morsel.description: Effect: While they are within 6" of and visible to this unit, enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them.
leave not a morsel.lore: If it’s eaten, so says this ogor, then it stays eaten.

dreaded far and wide.name: Dreaded Far and Wide
dreaded far and wide.description:
Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to:

• This unit’s control score.
• Hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s non-**Companion** attacks.
• Charge rolls for this unit.
• The number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit.
dreaded far and wide.lore: Terrifying tales cross the frontiers of the atrocities perpetrated by this ogor; their shadow looms large both literally and psychologically.

the crusherguts.name: The Crusherguts
the crusherguts.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
the crusherguts.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain and the target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
the crusherguts.lore: An ogor who has mastered the Crusherguts – an ancient and feared belly flop technique – has weedier enemies at their mercy.

carvalox hide.name: Carvalox Hide
carvalox hide.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**. It also has **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
carvalox hide.lore: Carvalox are colossal birds of prey found in the arctic regions of Ghur. They are favoured quarry of ogor Hunters, for their meat can be used to barter with the Yhetee clans while their feathered hides offer protection from magic.

mantle of entrails.name: Mantle of Entrails
mantle of entrails.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
mantle of entrails.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
mantle of entrails.lore: This crown of guts, sinew and burned flesh was ‘woven’ by a vision-wracked Butcher over three restless nights. It is horrific to look upon, instilling a terror that seems to reach right into the beholder’s bowels.

trophy rack.name: Trophy Rack
trophy rack.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following trophies. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used by other friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units have the corresponding weapon ability while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit:

• ***Squeezed Head***: **Anti‑MONSTER (+1 Rend)**

• ***Smashed City Rubble***: **Anti‑WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**

• ***Torn Appendages***: **Anti‑CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**
trophy rack.lore: These gruesome trophies prove that an ogor has lived up to their many boasts, encouraging their tribemates to follow their lead.

more ogors my lord.name: More Ogors, My Lord
more ogors my lord.description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield so that every model is within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
more ogors my lord.lore: Just when the enemy thinks they’ve stemmed the tide, heavy stomps and bellowing voices mark the arrival of more Gutbusters…

scoff down fresh flesh.name: Scoff Down Fresh Flesh
scoff down fresh flesh.description:
Declare: If an enemy unit was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly unit for the rest of the battle:

• ***Raw and Bloody Flesh***: Add 1 to hit rolls for that unit’s combat attacks if it charged in the same turn.
• ***Exotic Giblets***: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks.
• ***Steaming Brains***: Add 3 to that unit’s control score.
scoff down fresh flesh.lore: Gutbusters are always thinking with their stomach; battle is a feast that only increases their eagerness to fight.

frenzied hunters.name: Frenzied Hunters
frenzied hunters.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round
frenzied hunters.description: Effect: Set up this unit within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
frenzied hunters.lore: Desperate to sate their hunger, the Gorgers emerge from the darkness.

wot no meat.name: Wot? No Meat!?
wot no meat.description: Effect: Your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron starts the battle **empty**.
wot no meat.lore: The thought of an empty cooking pot is nigh heretical to a Butcher. Fortunately, battle provides them ample opportunities to fill it.

chuck em in the pot.name: Chuck 'Em in the Pot
chuck em in the pot.description:
Declare: You must use this ability if an enemy unit was destroyed this turn.

Effect: Your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron becomes **full**.
chuck em in the pot.lore: To a Butcher and their followers, any meat is good meat.

shincruncher.name: Shincruncher
shincruncher.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move or is set up on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the ability has been resolved.

**Designer’s Note**: *The ‘Bull Charge’ ability in the battle traits forces an enemy unit to move.*
shincruncher.lore: The shaman strips the meat and splits the bone of a huge beast haunch; as they do so, the limbs of their enemies crack and splinter at the slightest movement.

blood feast.name: Blood Feast
blood feast.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
blood feast.lore: The liver of a powerful beast is held high over the shaman’s head. Gore drips and runs down their face before they take a great bite from it, filling nearby ogors with a frenzied blood-lust.

tallowflage.name: Tallowflage
tallowflage.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.
tallowflage.lore: Smearing their flesh with sizzling, heated fat, the Butcher conjures a hazy shroud that conceals a band of nearby ogors from the enemy’s sight.

freezing tailwinds.name: Freezing Tailwinds
freezing tailwinds.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. Add 2 instead if the chanting roll was 6+.
freezing tailwinds.lore: At the priest’s urging, the howling winds of the Everwinter blow with greater ferocity, biting at the ogors and speeding the horde onwards.

pulverising hailstorm.name: Pulverising Hailstorm
pulverising hailstorm.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Then, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target(s).
pulverising hailstorm.lore: The harsh bellowing of the priest summons a rain of fist-sized hailstones to pummel the enemy from above.

fortifying hoarfrost.name: Fortifying Hoarfrost
fortifying hoarfrost.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.
fortifying hoarfrost.lore: As the priest growls a command to winter itself, a glittering layer of ice starts spreading over the flesh of their followers, a mystical armour capable of turning blades.

formations.name: Greedy Eaters
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to D3 friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** units that were in combat this turn with an enemy unit that was destroyed this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Return 1 slain model to each target unit.

ability.name: Postprandial Warfare
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to D3 friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** units that were in combat this turn with an enemy unit that was destroyed this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Return 1 slain model to each target unit.
ability.lore: Having slurped up their fallen enemies’ innards and picked their bones clean, these ogors rejoin the battle in search of their next repast.

abilities.name: Postprandial Warfare
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to D3 friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** units that were in combat this turn with an enemy unit that was destroyed this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Return 1 slain model to each target unit.
abilities.lore: Having slurped up their fallen enemies’ innards and picked their bones clean, these ogors rejoin the battle in search of their next repast.

formations.name: Mawpath Menaces
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If it ended that move in combat, the target has charged

ability.name: Fixated on Feeding
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If it ended that move in combat, the target has charged
ability.lore: Once they have sighted a potential meal, it is nigh impossible to stop these ever-ravenous ogors from consuming their prize.

abilities.name: Fixated on Feeding
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If it ended that move in combat, the target has charged
abilities.lore: Once they have sighted a potential meal, it is nigh impossible to stop these ever-ravenous ogors from consuming their prize.

formations.name: Hunger-Filled Tribe
formations.description:
