Declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that is not in combat and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn to be the target.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

ability.name: Feast of Bloodshed
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that is not in combat and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn to be the target.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
ability.lore: Monstrous by nature, ogors are never more energised than when tearing meat and guzzling down gore.

abilities.name: Feast of Bloodshed
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that is not in combat and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn to be the target.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Monstrous by nature, ogors are never more energised than when tearing meat and guzzling down gore.

formations.name: Hinterland Hunters
formations.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.

ability.name: Prowling Predators
ability.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.
ability.lore: Ogors are surprisingly skilful trackers; they surround their prey, carefully avoiding retribution before striking with terrible savagery.

abilities.name: Prowling Predators
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.
abilities.lore: Ogors are surprisingly skilful trackers; they surround their prey, carefully avoiding retribution before striking with terrible savagery.

formations.name: Vanguard of the Mawpath
formations.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.

ability.name: Smash and Grab
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.
ability.lore: These rampaging ogor raiders crash through the enemy lines without stopping, always seeking more to eat and loot.

abilities.name: Smash and Grab
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.
abilities.lore: These rampaging ogor raiders crash through the enemy lines without stopping, always seeking more to eat and loot.

formations.name: Maw-Cult Fanatics
formations.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that has used the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability this battle to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal** (**D3**) each target.

ability.name: Grub's Up, Mateys!
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that has used the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability this battle to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal** (**D3**) each target.
ability.lore: Guts roiling with a divine hunger, these fanatical ogors relish gulping down revitalising blood and offal.

abilities.name: Grub's Up, Mateys!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that has used the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability this battle to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal** (**D3**) each target.
abilities.lore: Guts roiling with a divine hunger, these fanatical ogors relish gulping down revitalising blood and offal.

prime gutserver.name: Prime Gutserver
prime gutserver.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
prime gutserver.description: Effect: If this unit is within 1" of a friendly **Mawpit**, gain 1 **tasty morsel**.
prime gutserver.lore: This general has fed entire armies to the Mawpits.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

mawpits of ghur.name: Mawpits of Ghur
mawpits of ghur.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
mawpits of ghur.description:
Effect: Roll 2D6 and add the number of **tasty morsels** you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your **tasty morsels** to 0.

**2-3 – *Subdued*:**
No effect.

**4-5 – *Peckish*:**
Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits**.

**6-8 – *Rumbling*:**
Roll a dice for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

**9-11 – *Famished*:**
Units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits** cannot use commands.

**12+ – *Ravenous*:**
Roll a D3 for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
mawpits of ghur.lore: These highly aggressive, teeth-filled rents in the ground are drawn to the wider realms by the Butchers’ gastromantic magic.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

driven by starvation.name: Driven By Starvation
driven by starvation.description: Effect: Friendly **Gorger Mawpack** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn unless they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature.
driven by starvation.lore: Each offering the Head Butcher submits to the Mawpit is one fewer scrap for a ravening Gorger.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

trampling charge.name: Trampling Charge
trampling charge.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
trampling charge.lore: The charge of bellowing ogors resembles a living avalanche of blubber and metal. Anything in their path is quickly squished into an edible paste.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

the realm hungers.name: The Realm Hungers
the realm hungers.description: Effect: Units and **MANIFESTATIONS** are **vulnerable** **to Mawpits** while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a **Mawpit**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **FLY**.
the realm hungers.lore: None can tell where hungry, chomping Mawpits will next manifest in the ground.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

tasty morsels.name: Tasty Morsels
tasty morsels.description: Effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly **Mawpit**’s ‘Hungry Sinkhole’ ability, you gain 1 **tasty morsel**.
tasty morsels.lore: Ogors hate wasting even a scrap of meat. Any foes they do not gobble down on the spot are hacked to pieces and saved for the Butcher’s pot.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

flasks of congealed maw juices.name: Flasks of Congealed Maw-juices
flasks of congealed maw juices.description: Effect: Friendly **Mawpits** within this unit’s combat range have **WARD** **(5+)**.
flasks of congealed maw juices.lore: These vessels contains greasy, pungent fluids that squirted from a Mawpit as it gobbled down a victim. They have fortifying effects on those chomping sinkholes into which they are poured.
flasks of congealed maw juices.groupName: The Roving Maw Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

retcher.name: Retcher
retcher.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the caster’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
retcher.lore: As they cast this spell, the Butcher spews their stomach contents over their weaponry, giving their blades ‘extra bite’.

mawmeat.name: Mawmeat
mawmeat.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, units on or within 1" of the target are **vulnerable to Mawpits**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **FLY**.
mawmeat.lore: Chunks of meat glistening with ichor are flung into overgrown ruins and undergrowth to attract more Mawpits to the battlefield.

thick blubber.name: Thick Blubber
thick blubber.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.
thick blubber.lore: An exemplar of their girthy kind, this ogor has a particularly thick layer of blubber that cushions their vital organs from arrows and bullets.

overpowering mass.name: Overpowering Mass
overpowering mass.description: Effect: When making meaty charge rolls for this unit, you can re-roll unmodified rolls of 1.
overpowering mass.lore: It is said that this absolute goliath of an ogor has some gargant blood in their veins. No one’s stupid enough to argue the point.

force of savage personality.name: Force of Savage Personality
force of savage personality.description: Effect: Enemy units and enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.
force of savage personality.lore: Such is the fell and bellicose reputation of this ogor that it is said that even the power of magic doesn’t dare draw too close to them.

snott gnoblar thief.name: Snott, Gnoblar Thief
snott gnoblar thief.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** that has any artefacts of power to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or lower than the current battle round number, the target no longer has any artefacts of power.
snott gnoblar thief.lore: Said to be a descendant (don’t ask…) of the legendary Head Honcho of Skrappa Spill, the gnoblar Snott is a skilled pickpocket. His talents for purloining enemy gewgaws even in the press of battle amuses Morga the Mighty, and so her spawn and chieftains have to put up with him hanging around.

trapper s arsenal.name: Trapper's Arsenal
trapper s arsenal.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
trapper s arsenal.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
trapper s arsenal.lore: Having run with the Beastclaw for a time – perhaps even being sired by one – this ogor maintains a collection of vicious-looking snaptraps to hobble and waylay their enemies.

rusty leadbelcher gun.name: Rusty Leadbelcher Gun
rusty leadbelcher gun.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
rusty leadbelcher gun.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick to load the gun with **Jagged Shrapnel** or **Lumpen Metal** **Scrap**, then apply the corresponding effect below:

***Jagged Shrapnel:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models were slain by that mortal damage, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

***Lumpen Metal Scrap:*** Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
rusty leadbelcher gun.lore: While many of the Meatfist abandoned their blastpowder cannons at the urging of the Mawseekers, this chieftain couldn’t let go of their faithful weapon. Its lethality has not dimmed…

gruesome devourers.name: Gruesome Devourers
gruesome devourers.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
gruesome devourers.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by a friendly **MEATFIST** unit’s combat attacks to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use **RETREAT** abilities.
gruesome devourers.lore: Enemies struggle to escape the grasp of hungry ogors.

the unstoppable feast.name: The Unstoppable Feast
the unstoppable feast.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
the unstoppable feast.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MEATFIST** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this battle to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability earlier in the same turn.
the unstoppable feast.lore: When their blood is up and the promise of imminent butchery is in the air, Meatfist warriors become an all but overwhelming force.

gluttonous conquerors.name: Gluttonous Conquerors
gluttonous conquerors.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Control characteristic of friendly **MEATFIST** units while they are in combat.
gluttonous conquerors.lore: At the command of their Overtyrant Morga, the Meatfist aim to establish a great ogor empire – and they believe that domination is best proved by bone-crunching violence.

greedy chompers.name: Greedy Chompers
greedy chompers.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
greedy chompers.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **MEATFIST** units that are in combat to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, **Heal (X)** the target where **X** is equal to the roll.
greedy chompers.lore: A Meatfist ogor won’t miss an opportunity to take a bite from warm flesh.

bloodthirsty arrogance.name: Bloodthirsty Arrogance
bloodthirsty arrogance.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets a friendly **MEATFIST INFANTRY** unit that did not charge in the same turn, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
bloodthirsty arrogance.lore: Meatfist warriors take their status as the pre-eminent mawtribe seriously. Any who actually manage to hurt them are marked for grisly vengeance.

fleshy stampede.name: Fleshy Stampede
fleshy stampede.description: Effect: Add 2 to run rolls for friendly **MEATFIST** units.
fleshy stampede.lore: The Meatfist do not care much for strategy or tactics; they charge headlong at their foes and trust in raw strength to sort things out.

meaty charge.name: Meaty Charge
meaty charge.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MEATFIST** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this phase to be the target.

Effect: Make a meaty charge roll by rolling a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll made this turn for the unit using this ability. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability has more models than the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
meaty charge.lore: The Meatfist win their battles through the most straightforward means. They have learned to harness the sheer bulk of their massed ogor warriors better than any other tribe, trampling their adversaries in a series of crushing charges

fried limbs.name: Fried Limbs
fried limbs.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
fried limbs.description:
Declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 3 to charge rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.
fried limbs.lore: These crunchy limbs – some still clad in scraps of armour – are the perfect snack to enthuse a marauding band of Mawseekers.

prepare the feast.name: Prepare the Feast
prepare the feast.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
prepare the feast.description: Effect: If there is no friendly **Feastmaster** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GOLLOP HERO** to be the **Feastmaster** for the rest of the battle.
prepare the feast.lore: The role of Feastmaster is a sacred one amongst the gollops, as it is this ogor who oversees the ravenous rites and doles out the latest creations of the maw-shamans.

ooh that looks tasty.name: Ooh, That Looks Tasty...
ooh that looks tasty.description:
Effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain a number of **raw ingredients**.

The number of **raw ingredients** yielded by a destroyed unit is the Health characteristic of that unit multiplied by the number of starting models in that unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *If a destroyed enemy unit had a Health characteristic of 2 and its starting size was 10 models, it would yield 20 raw ingredients when it was destroyed.*
ooh that looks tasty.lore: As a gollop slaughters its way through its enemies, the ogors collect up tasty-looking morsels to gorge upon.

gland goulash.name: Gland Goulash
gland goulash.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
gland goulash.description:
Declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, when making casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.
gland goulash.lore: Though the Butchers swear by the magical properties these glands give their creations, no one truly knows where they come from. For the best, really…

bone slurry soup.name: Bone-Slurry Soup
bone slurry soup.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
bone slurry soup.description:
Declare: Spend 5 **raw ingredients**.

Effect: **HEAL (D6)** each friendly **GOLLOP** unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.
bone slurry soup.lore: This revitalising gruel is a favourite of ogor whelps; it brings a pang of nostalgia to any Mawseeker who eats it, numbing the pain of their wounds.

the organ platter.name: The Organ Platter
the organ platter.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
the organ platter.description:
Declare: Spend 20 **raw ingredients**.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feastmaster**, melee weapons used by friendly **GOLLOP** units have **Crit (Mortal)**.
the organ platter.lore: To properly prepare a heaving platter of organs – some of which still seem to be pulsing with life – is a coup for any Feastmaster, and one that sees their followers struck with a divine mania.

gore offal dumplings.name: Gore-Offal Dumplings
gore offal dumplings.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
gore offal dumplings.description:
Declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.

Effect: Each friendly **GOLLOP** unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster** can immediately use a **CHARGE** ability as if it were your charge phase, but subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making the charge roll for that unit.
gore offal dumplings.lore: These small, dripping tangles of gut-meat are difficult to prepare and bless correctly. When eaten, though, they grant faithful ogors a surprise burst of energy.

unwashed innards.name: Unwashed Innards
unwashed innards.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
unwashed innards.description:
Declare: Spend 5 **raw ingredients**.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 4 to run rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.
unwashed innards.lore: The ‘earthy’ flavour of these raw entrails fills ogors who consume them with vigour.

indomitable guts.name: Indomitable Guts
indomitable guts.description: Effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for this unit.
indomitable guts.lore: Many, many esoteric (and ill-advised) feasts in worship of their hungry god has granted this ogor a truly prodigious resistance to damage.

overflowing larder.name: Overflowing Larder
overflowing larder.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
overflowing larder.description: Effect: Gain D6 **raw ingredients**. If this unit is a **Feastmaster**, gain D3+3 **raw ingredients** instead.
overflowing larder.lore: This faithful Mawseeker is never seen without a wide collection of mystical, grotesque ‘offerings’ ready to contribute to the feast.

bonecruncher.name: Bonecruncher
bonecruncher.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GOLLOP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Gain a number of **raw ingredients** equal to the number of those damage points that are allocated to the target.
bonecruncher.lore: Chomping down on skulls, femurs and ribs, the Butcher mystically breaks the bodies of their enemies, ripe for harvesting.

bloodgruel.name: Bloodgruel
bloodgruel.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GOLLOP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GOLLOP** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return 1 slain model to the target.
• **Heal (D6)** the target.
bloodgruel.lore: The Butcher sucks the congealed blood, marrow and other juices from a specially preserved severed limb before belching it up in a magical cloud that invigorates other ogors.

the cosmos writhes.name: The Cosmos Writhes
the cosmos writhes.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GOLLOP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GOLLOP** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
the cosmos writhes.lore: The glottal spells of the Butchers tap into something beyond sane knowledge – a divine power that contorts the world like twisting guts, briefly breaking spatial law with its hunger.

a clan of hunters.name: A Clan of Hunters
a clan of hunters.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Hunters with Sabrefangs** unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can use the ‘Through the Frosts’ ability even if another friendly **Hunters with Sabrefangs** unit has used that ability this battle.
a clan of hunters.lore: Keepers of the ‘old ways’, the ogors of a Beastclaw clan are expert trackers, relentlessly running their prey to the ground.

grasp of the everwinter.name: Grasp of the Everwinter
grasp of the everwinter.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
grasp of the everwinter.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly **ALFROSTUN** units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
grasp of the everwinter.lore: To wage war against an alfrostun is to battle the brutality of winter itself.

run em down.name: Run 'Em Down
run em down.description:
Effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **ALFROSTUN** unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *This mortal damage is in addition to any mortal damage inflicted on that enemy unit by that* **RETREAT** *ability.*
run em down.lore: Beastclaw ogors relish the thrill of the chase. Enemies can flee, but for not long…

fearsome breed.name: Fearsome Breed
fearsome breed.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of a friendly **ALFROSTUN MONSTER**. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of a friendly **ALFROSTUN MONSTER** instead.
fearsome breed.lore: The monsters of a Beastclaw alfrostun are creatures born of winter; they shake the earth with each step and attract the fiercest ice storms, leaving enemies rattled and disoriented.

masked by the endless white.name: Masked by the Endless White
masked by the endless white.description: Effect: Friendly **ALFROSTUN** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" away.
masked by the endless white.lore: When Beastclaw ogors gather in number, ice storms and hail shards swirl with savage vigour, obscuring the hunters from sight.

hard bitten chieftain.name: Hard-Bitten Chieftain
hard bitten chieftain.description: Effect: Other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit made by enemy units that charged in the same turn have no effect.
hard bitten chieftain.lore: As tough as old frozen meat, with ice running through their veins: such is how this venerable ogor warlord is described, and with good reason.

alvagr rune tokens.name: Alvagr Rune-Tokens
alvagr rune tokens.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
alvagr rune tokens.description: Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2 to chanting rolls for friendly **ALFROSTUN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
alvagr rune tokens.lore: Said to be fashioned from ice chipped from the flanks of mighty Mount Alvagr, these charms – carved with Svoringar runes – deepen an ogor’s connection to the ancient ice.

keening gale.name: Keening Gale
keening gale.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALFROSTUN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **ALFROSTUN** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2 to run rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, until the start of your next turn, add 2 to charge rolls for the target.
keening gale.lore: Marshalling the might of the Everwinter, the Huskard empowers their fellows to ride the freezing hurricane.

terrors of the old ice.name: Terrors of the Old Ice
terrors of the old ice.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALFROSTUN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick an objective or terrain feature wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are contesting the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are contesting the target.
terrors of the old ice.lore: At the Huskard’s gesture, the Everwinter swirls around a part of the battlefield. Primeval mirages dance in its embrace, sapping even the sternest courage.

avalanche voice.name: Avalanche Voice
avalanche voice.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALFROSTUN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent declares a command for the target, as a reaction, make a tremor roll of D6 for the target. On a 5+, unless they spend 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, add 2 to tremor rolls for the target.
avalanche voice.lore: Bashing their weapon against their gutplate, the ogor priest inhales deeply before loosing a deafening bellow like an arctic wind roaring through a mountain pass. Enemies caught in the blast of sound are temporarily deafened and stunned, and it takes a while for them to regather their wits.

seed of rebirth.name: Seed of Rebirth
seed of rebirth.description: Effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.
seed of rebirth.lore: Should the bearer of this seed ever fall, its rejuvenating energies will grant them new life.

wychwood glaive.name: Wychwood Glaive
wychwood glaive.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s combat attacks this turn to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.
wychwood glaive.lore: The blade of this polearm, which glows dully with the bleak white- grey of a snow-laden sky, inflicts a bone-deep chill on those it does not slay outright.

amberglade nectar.name: Amberglade Nectar
amberglade nectar.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
amberglade nectar.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **SYLVANETH** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.
amberglade nectar.lore: Collected from the fearsome elder trees of Ghur, the scent of this sticky sap sends spites into a feral frenzy.

spellsinger.name: Spellsinger
spellsinger.description:
Effect: If this unit is a **WIZARD**, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
spellsinger.lore: The magical motes of the realms are drawn to this champion like pollinating insects, enhancing their arcane aptitude.

spirit of the dark forest.name: Spirit of the Dark Forest
spirit of the dark forest.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
spirit of the dark forest.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
spirit of the dark forest.lore: This Sylvaneth’s grim aspect strikes atavistic terror into those who meet its gaze.

realmroot guide.name: Realmroot Guide
realmroot guide.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
realmroot guide.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**. Pick this unit and up to 1 other friendly **SYLVANETH** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
realmroot guide.lore: The spirit paths offer swift egress to this realms-wise Sylvaneth, who has an intricate knowledge of their wending ways.

ranu s lamentiri.name: Ranu's Lamentiri
ranu s lamentiri.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
ranu s lamentiri.description: Effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.
ranu s lamentiri.lore: Even in death, Ranu lends sorcerous strength to their kin.

glamourweave.name: Glamourweave
glamourweave.description: Effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
glamourweave.lore: The Glamourweave’s illusory enchantments both enhance the wearer’s forest camouflage and conceal their strikes when battle is joined.

glamourweave.name: Glamourweave
glamourweave.description: Effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
glamourweave.lore: The Glamourweave’s illusory enchantments both enhance the wearer’s forest camouflage and conceal their strikes when battle is joined.

acorn of the ages.name: Acorn of the Ages
acorn of the ages.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
acorn of the ages.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** have **WARD (5+).**
acorn of the ages.lore: Within this unassuming acorn lies untold potential for life.

strike and fade.name: Strike and Fade
strike and fade.phase: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
strike and fade.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within 3" of any terrain features, then roll a dice.

Effect: On a 2+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again so that each model in the unit is within 3" of any terrain features and more than 6" from all enemy units.
strike and fade.lore: These warriors use the spirit paths to ambush the enemy before retreating back into the shadows.

ley lines.name: Ley Lines
ley lines.phase: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
ley lines.description: Effect: **Heal (1)** each friendly unit that is within 3" of any terrain features.
ley lines.lore: The Sylvaneth draw strength from natural sites of mystical power.

endless growth.name: Endless Growth
endless growth.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
endless growth.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth to be the targets.

Effect: For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:

• **HEAL (X)** the target, where **X** is equal to the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.
endless growth.lore: As the land itself is roused to wrath, life energies bloom and surge, filling the Sylvaneth with renewed vigour.
endless growth.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

creeping dread.name: Creeping Dread
creeping dread.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
creeping dread.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
creeping dread.lore: The creaking of the trees and the oppressive hum of the spirit-song in their subconscious makes the enemy jumpy and distracted, causing them to hesitate and second- guess orders in the absence of clear leadership.
creeping dread.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

the land awakens.name: The Land Awakens
the land awakens.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO REVENANT INFANTRY** unit or friendly **DRYADS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
the land awakens.lore: The spirit-song thrums with strident aggression and the shrill lamentations of the fallen, rousing dormant forest spirits in the vicinity and drawing them to battle.
the land awakens.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

fury of the forest.name: Fury of the Forest
fury of the forest.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and that is in combat with only 1 enemy unit to use this ability.

Effect: The unit using this ability has **STRIKE‑FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
fury of the forest.lore: The Sylvaneth are overcome with rage at the presence of interlopers in their sacred forest homes.
fury of the forest.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

reclaimed by nature.name: Reclaimed by Nature
reclaimed by nature.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
reclaimed by nature.description: Effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, you can set up an **Awakened Wyldwood** on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** and more than 1" from all other terrain features.
reclaimed by nature.lore: In twisting profusions of unfurling branches, shivering leaves and billowing pollen, trees that would normally take many cycles to reach maturity attain their full, bountiful potential in mere moments.
reclaimed by nature.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

the creeping overgrowth.name: The Creeping Overgrowth
the creeping overgrowth.description:
Effect: The **creeping overgrowth** is measured from each terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token. The range of the **creeping overgrowth** is based on the number of friendly **overgrown tokens** on the battlefield as shown:

Overgrown Tokens - Creeping Overgrowth Range
0-2 - 6"
3-5 - 9"
6-8 - 12"
9+ - Whole battlefield

**Designer’s Note:** *Awakened Wyldwoods are your main way of generating overgrown tokens. Some unit abilities allow you to do so too.*
the creeping overgrowth.lore: As children of Ghyran, the Sylvaneth are redolent with the energies of life, which cause the ambient flora to rapidly grow and spread.
the creeping overgrowth.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

target of vengeance.name: Target of Vengeance
target of vengeance.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
target of vengeance.description:
Declare: If there is no enemy **quarry** on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: The target is the **quarry** for the rest of the battle.
target of vengeance.lore: The Spitewing Flight engages one foe at a time, swooping down to annihilate them before selecting a new target.

song of the hunt.name: Song of the Hunt
song of the hunt.description:
Effect: You gain 1 **chord** each time an enemy **quarry** is destroyed. The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of **chords** you have:

1 chord - **Simple**: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units while they are within 9" of the enemy **quarry**.
2 chords - **Tuneful**: Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units’ attacks while they are within 9" of the enemy **quarry**.
3+ chords - **Melodic**: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units’ attacks while they are within 9" of the enemy **quarry**.
song of the hunt.lore: The warriors of a Spitewing Flight are energised by the increasingly harmonious notes of the spirit-song as they fight, building momentum with every defeated foe.

airborne cohesion.name: Airborne Cohesion
airborne cohesion.description: Effect: Friendly units have a coherency range of 2".
airborne cohesion.lore: These warriors fly in tight formation, their dragonspites perfectly attuned to the movements of their kin.

dancing mystflies.name: Dancing Mystflies
dancing mystflies.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for an unit within 30" of this unit
dancing mystflies.description:
Effect: • If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the
'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
Otherwise, it can use the 'Unbind' ability an additional time each phase.

• If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.
dancing mystflies.lore: Their abdomens aglow with jade magic, these spites flutter across the battlefield, intercepting and absorbing arcane outbursts. In areas redolent with life energies, they have power enough to twist these captured spells and fire them back at the caster.

amulet of resonance.name: Amulet of Resonance
amulet of resonance.description: Effect: If this unit used the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability this turn or you spent **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit.
amulet of resonance.lore: This charm serves to amplify the spirit-song, ensuring it cuts through even the most furious tumult of battle.

aspect of ironbark.name: Aspect of Ironbark
aspect of ironbark.description:
Effect: When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit’s damage pool.

After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle
aspect of ironbark.lore: These Sylvaneth can rapidly draw forth minerals from the earth in order to grant their barkflesh greater durability.
aspect of ironbark.restrictionText: Aspects of the Deepwoods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO** non-**MONSTER** **SYLVANETH** units. A unit can only have 1 Aspect of the Deepwoods.

aspect of heartwood.name: Aspect of Heartwood
aspect of heartwood.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Endless Growth’ ability
aspect of heartwood.description:
Effect: If this unit is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**, for each target of that ability that is wholly within 12" of this unit, you can pick 1 of the following effects:

•  When resolving that ability, roll a D6 for the target instead of a D3. If, as a result of another ability, you would **Heal (3)** the target instead of rolling a dice, **Heal (6)** the target instead.
•  If the target is **KURNOTHI**, instead of rolling a D3 and picking 1 of the effects of that ability to apply to it, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit.
aspect of heartwood.lore: Brave and true, these warriors are loyal to all Sylvaneth, regardless of glade, and seek to aid them however they can.
aspect of heartwood.restrictionText: Aspects of the Deepwoods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO** non-**MONSTER** **SYLVANETH** units. A unit can only have 1 Aspect of the Deepwoods.

aspect of harvestboon.name: Aspect of Harvestboon
aspect of harvestboon.description: Effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth.**
aspect of harvestboon.lore: These forest spirits are possessed of a youthful energy and vibrant enthusiasm.
aspect of harvestboon.restrictionText: Aspects of the Deepwoods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO** non-**MONSTER** **SYLVANETH** units. A unit can only have 1 Aspect of the Deepwoods.

song of war.name: Song of War
song of war.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target(s) melee weapons.
song of war.lore: The spirit-song becomes an angry, staccato beat that awakens something primal in the Sylvaneth, seeing them crush bones and twist steel with the latent strength in their barkflesh.

song of dread.name: Song of Dread
song of dread.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick an enemy unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each time a target uses a **MOVE** ability and ends that move within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict D3 mortal damage on that target after that **MOVE** ability has been resolved.
song of dread.lore: Discordant notes and eerie wails herald a sinister change in the spirit-song, causing the shadows to gather thick around a group of foes. It takes but a single misstep to discover what lurks within the dark…

song of the lost.name: Song of the Lost
song of the lost.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• You can **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not a **MONSTER**, ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.
song of the lost.lore: The chanter alters the spirit-song to remind the Sylvaneth of the fallen, inspiring them with heroic resolve.

grasping roots.name: Grasping Roots
grasping roots.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• The target cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Subtract 1 from charge rolls for the target.
grasping roots.lore: The caster commands the undergrowth to bind and slow the enemy.

zephyrspite rush.name: Zephyrspite Rush
zephyrspite rush.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
zephyrspite rush.lore: The caster calls on a swarm of zephyrspites to carry their allies swiftly into battle.

jade thorns.name: Jade Thorns
jade thorns.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons.
jade thorns.lore: The caster enhances the blades and claws of the Sylvaneth and their spite companions with spectral thorns that rake flesh and cause horrific ragged wounds.

summon spiteswarm hive.name: Summon Spiteswarm Hive
summon spiteswarm hive.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Spiteswarm Hive** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Spiteswarm Hive** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon spiteswarm hive.lore: The air is filled with the buzzing of a thousand wings as a swarm of iridescent insects bursts from its hive.

summon vengeful skullroot.name: Summon Vengeful Skullroot
summon vengeful skullroot.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **VENGEFUL SKULLROOT** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vengeful Skullroot** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon vengeful skullroot.lore: From the shadows comes a nightmarish form: the wretched husk of a tortured tree, the skeletal remains of past victims tangled among its writhing root mass.

summon gladewyrm.name: Summon Gladewyrm
summon gladewyrm.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Gladewyrm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Gladewyrm** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon gladewyrm.lore: The earth splits apart as a huge serpentine form heaves itself free of the earth, its eyes blazing with jade energy.

formations.name: Glade Defenders
formations.description:
Declare: For each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit or friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be a target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Memories of the Fallen
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: For each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit or friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be a target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: As the spirit-song resounds with the memories of the recently slain, the Sylvaneth are driven to a vengeful fury.

abilities.name: Memories of the Fallen
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: For each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit or friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be a target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As the spirit-song resounds with the memories of the recently slain, the Sylvaneth are driven to a vengeful fury.

formations.name: Lords of the Clan
formations.description: Effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for **MONSTER** targets. Instead, **Heal (3)** each of those targets.

ability.name: Nature's Titans
ability.description: Effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for **MONSTER** targets. Instead, **Heal (3)** each of those targets.
ability.lore: The eldest beings of the glades are so saturated with the life-giving magic of Ghyran that their wounds swiftly gum up with sticky sap and seal over with knotted barkflesh.

abilities.name: Nature's Titans
abilities.description: Effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for **MONSTER** targets. Instead, **Heal (3)** each of those targets.
abilities.lore: The eldest beings of the glades are so saturated with the life-giving magic of Ghyran that their wounds swiftly gum up with sticky sap and seal over with knotted barkflesh.

formations.name: Wargrove of the Burgeoning
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit within 12" a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of another friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** and more than 9" from all enemies.

ability.name: Walk the Hidden Paths
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit within 12" a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of another friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** and more than 9" from all enemies.
ability.lore: Sylvaneth can draw upon the magic of the Wyldwoods to open hidden passageways across the battlefield.

abilities.name: Walk the Hidden Paths
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit within 12" a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of another friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** and more than 9" from all enemies.
abilities.lore: Sylvaneth can draw upon the magic of the Wyldwoods to open hidden passageways across the battlefield.

formations.name: Outcasts
formations.description: Effect: In the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability, replace ‘while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army’ with ‘while it is not wholly within 6" of a **HERO** in their army’.

ability.name: Fear of the Deepwoods
ability.description: Effect: In the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability, replace ‘while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army’ with ‘while it is not wholly within 6" of a **HERO** in their army’.
ability.lore: The flitting shadows of lurking spites and the cruel laughter of these malicious Sylvaneth instil paranoia in the enemy; clearly they are not welcome in this place.

abilities.name: Fear of the Deepwoods
abilities.description: Effect: In the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability, replace ‘while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army’ with ‘while it is not wholly within 6" of a **HERO** in their army’.
abilities.lore: The flitting shadows of lurking spites and the cruel laughter of these malicious Sylvaneth instil paranoia in the enemy; clearly they are not welcome in this place.

formations.name: Wargrove of Everdusk
formations.description: Effect: The first time each phase an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** uses a command, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after that command has been resolved. If that command was a reaction, instead inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after the ability that command was a reaction to has been resolved.

ability.name: Spiteful Dusk
ability.description: Effect: The first time each phase an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** uses a command, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after that command has been resolved. If that command was a reaction, instead inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after the ability that command was a reaction to has been resolved.
ability.lore: Within the creeping darkness of Everdusk lurk hate-filled spites that seek every opportunity to hinder the foe’s efforts to coordinate their attack.

abilities.name: Spiteful Dusk
abilities.description: Effect: The first time each phase an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** uses a command, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after that command has been resolved. If that command was a reaction, instead inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after the ability that command was a reaction to has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Within the creeping darkness of Everdusk lurk hate-filled spites that seek every opportunity to hinder the foe’s efforts to coordinate their attack.

formations.name: Followers of Kurnoth
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy **WARMASTER**.

ability.name: Sacred Quarry
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy **WARMASTER**.
ability.lore: There can be no hunt without a quarry. Once the followers of Kurnoth have marked the enemy’s commander, they will stop at nothing until its blood stains their spears and claws.

abilities.name: Sacred Quarry
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy **WARMASTER**.
abilities.lore: There can be no hunt without a quarry. Once the followers of Kurnoth have marked the enemy’s commander, they will stop at nothing until its blood stains their spears and claws.

sapwood leader.name: Sapwood Leader
sapwood leader.description: Effect: If you pick this unit to be a target of the 'Abundant Growth’ ability, **Heal (3)** this unit instead of **Heal (1)**.
sapwood leader.lore: This young and vibrant general flourishes with the life-giving magic of the Everqueen.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

questing tendrils.name: Questing Tendrils
questing tendrils.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
questing tendrils.description:
Declare: Pick the terrain feature that is closest to the **quarry** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units are wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** while they are wholly within 6" of the target.
questing tendrils.lore: Snaking vines writhe through the undergrowth towards the quarry, driven by the urge to drag them down into the gore-soaked loam.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

merciful strike.name: Merciful Strike
merciful strike.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
merciful strike.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT MONSTER** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice and add the number of damage points the target has. If the result exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
merciful strike.lore: For those who join the divine hunt, the moment of the final, killing blow is one of momentous importance. It must be delivered swiftly and surely.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

a prize quarry is sighted.name: A Prize Quarry is Sighted
a prize quarry is sighted.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
a prize quarry is sighted.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit to be the target.

Effect: The target becomes the **quarry** for the rest of the battle. If there was already a **quarry** on the battlefield when you declared this ability, that unit is no longer the **quarry**.
a prize quarry is sighted.lore: When a mighty prey is sighted, the hunters of Kurnoth focus all their efforts upon taking it down, for only a successful kill will appease their master.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

nature aetheric.name: Nature Aetheric
nature aetheric.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature that is within friendly territory to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, friendly units are wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** while they are wholly within 6" of the target.
nature aetheric.lore: Rapid growth and abundant life follow the Evergreen Hunt.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

rhythm of the chase.name: Rhythm of the Chase
rhythm of the chase.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
rhythm of the chase.description:
Declare: If there is no **quarry** on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: The target is the **quarry** for the rest of the battle.
rhythm of the chase.lore: The Evergreen Hunt relentlessly tracks its prey, skilfully manoeuvring it into a killing ground to administer a fatal blow.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

song of the hunt.name: Song of the Hunt
song of the hunt.description:
Effect: The following cumulative effects apply to friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** units depending on the number of **chords** you have:

**1 chord – *Simple***: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.

**2 chords – *Tuneful***: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks that target an enemy unit wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.

**3-5 chords – *Melodic***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are in combat with the quarry.

**6+ chords – *Mellifluous***: While a friendly unit is in combat with the quarry, the quarry has **STRIKE-LAST**.
song of the hunt.lore: The stirring battle-song of Kurnoth’s hunters grows in intensity with every foe slain, until the world resounds to a crescendo of deafening, harshly melodic notes.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

abundant growth.name: Abundant Growth
abundant growth.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abundant growth.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit that is wholly within 3" of a terrain feature to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal (1)** each target.
abundant growth.lore: Lush, restorative flora blossoms and blooms in the path of the Evergreen Hunt.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

opening horn blast.name: Opening Horn Blast
opening horn blast.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
opening horn blast.description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round.

Effect: Your chords are reset to 0. Then, you gain 1 **chord**:

• If a friendly **Belthanos** is on the battlefield.
• For each friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit that is wholly within the same large quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.
• For each quarry destroyed so far during the battle.
opening horn blast.lore: The ear-shattering peal of a hunting horn signals the coming of Kurnoth’s faithful, and foretells the bloody death of their prey.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

heartwood hunting horn.name: Heartwood Hunting Horn
heartwood hunting horn.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
heartwood hunting horn.lore: Grown in the forests of Kurnotheal, this horn emits a melody that naturally harmonises with the song of the hunt.
heartwood hunting horn.groupName: The Evergreen Hunt Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Evergreen Hunt

ancient might.name: Ancient Might
ancient might.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it is in combat. If the charge roll is 3 or less when it does so, it does not count as having charged.
ancient might.lore: Of unfathomable age, this gigantic elder Treelord pulverises all in their path.
ancient might.groupName: Lords of the Clan Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Lords of the Clan

our reach is long.name: Our Reach is Long
our reach is long.description:
Effect: The **creeping overgrowth** (referenced by other abilities) extends 6" from each terrain feature that has a friendly **overgrown token**.

Increase this range by 1" for each friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN** unit that is wholly outside friendly territory.
our reach is long.lore: These heroes of old are not simply content with holding on to what they have; they would claim back all that has been lost.
our reach is long.groupName: Lords of the Clan Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Lords of the Clan

dormant heroes.name: Dormant Heroes
dormant heroes.description:
Declare: If there are more friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN** units on the battlefield than there are in reserve, pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve as a **dormant forest spirit**. It has now been deployed.
dormant heroes.lore: Throughout the Age of Chaos, many forests were devastated. The spirits that inhabited them fell into deep slumber, awaiting the call to awaken and fight once more.
dormant heroes.groupName: Lords of the Clan Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Lords of the Clan

roused to fury.name: Roused to Fury
roused to fury.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following units:

• A friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN** unit that is in reserve as a **dormant forest spirit**.
• A friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER** that has been destroyed.

Set up the unit you picked, or a replacement unit if you picked a destroyed unit, within 9" of the target, wholly within 6" of that friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** and not in combat. If you set up a replacement unit, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

Then, remove that friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** from the battlefield.
roused to fury.lore: The presence of these powerful Sylvaneth is accompanied by booming reverberations in the spirit-song that alert powerful forest spirits to the enemy’s incursion.
roused to fury.groupName: Lords of the Clan Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Lords of the Clan

elder authority.name: Elder Authority
elder authority.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if there is a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** on the battlefield.

Effect: You can set up up to 2 additional **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield (an **Awakened Wyldwood** is a single tree miniature with a crescent- shaped base). The first can be set up anywhere on the battlefield more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly outside of enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original* **Awakened Wyldwood** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
elder authority.lore: Even the trees themselves respect the authority of the Sylvaneth’s regal ancients.
elder authority.groupName: Lords of the Clan Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Lords of the Clan

rejuvenating companions.name: Rejuvenating Companions
rejuvenating companions.lore: Over their long life, colonies of symbiotic plants, fungi and spites have proliferated upon this hero, invigorating their barken form with nutrients, healing magic and innocent, uplifting melodies in the spirit-song.
rejuvenating companions.groupName: Lords of the Clan Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Lords of the Clan

song of persistence.name: Song of Persistence
song of persistence.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER** that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the effect of the ‘Battle Damaged’ ability on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, the target has **WARD (6+)** until the start of your next turn.
song of persistence.lore: Memories of the unwavering courage of glades past permeate the spirit-song at the Sylvaneth’s will, stirring the noble souls of their kin and inspiring them to impossible acts of endurance.

call forth the forest.name: Call Forth the Forest
call forth the forest.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If there are fewer than 9 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, you can set up an **Awakened Wyldwood** wholly within 24" of the caster, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all enemy units and other terrain features. If there are 9 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, **Heal (3)** each friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** instead.
call forth the forest.lore: The strongest Sylvaneth wizards have a potent spiritual connection to the wyldwoods and can coax forth these eldritch copses with the proper entreaties.

jade winds.name: Jade Winds
jade winds.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

• **Gladewyrm**
• **Spiteswarm Hive**
• **Vengeful Skullroot**

Effect: If you picked a **Gladewyrm** or **Vengeful Skullroot**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Spiteswarm Hive**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
jade winds.lore: The caster draws ambient motes of Ghyranite magic unto them and shapes them into a form with solidity, identity and vicious intent.

lores.name: Lords of the Clan Prayer Lore
Lords of the Clan Spell Lore
Lords of the Clan Manifestation Lore

clarionbuds.name: Clarionbuds
clarionbuds.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
clarionbuds.description:
Declare: If there is an enemy unit wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove**, pick up to 3 friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS** units to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove** and more than 6" from all enemy units.
clarionbuds.lore: These flowers, nestled in the undergrowth, are easily overlooked. Should any who bear hostile intent towards the grove draw near to them, they explosively unfurl in a puff of pollen and brilliant colour. Their true worth, however, lies in the strident resonance in the spirit-song when they do so, which alerts Sylvaneth defenders to the incursion.

devoted protector.name: Devoted Protector
devoted protector.description: Effect: If this unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove**, before removing this unit from the battlefield, **Heal (10)** your **Soulpod Grove**.
devoted protector.lore: With their final breath, the grove’s head guardian gives the last of their life energy to save their beloved haven.

jade haven.name: Jade Haven
jade haven.description: Effect: The Health characteristic of your **Soulpod Grove** is 18. The **creeping overgrowth** extends 12" from your **Soulpod Grove**.
jade haven.lore: The trees and spirits of a soulpod grove radiate healing magic.

heart of the forest.name: Heart of the Forest
heart of the forest.description: Effect: You cannot allocate more than 10 damage points per phase to a friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS** unit while it is wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove** (remaining damage points inflicted on it in that phase have no effect).
heart of the forest.lore: Saturated as they are with restorative power, soulpod groves and their guardians are not easily destroyed.

the sacred groves.name: The Sacred Groves
the sacred groves.description:
Declare: You must use this ability.

Effect: Set up 3 **Awakened Wyldwoods** (an Awakened Wyldwood is a single tree miniature with a crescent-shaped base) wholly within friendly territory, more than 1" from all other terrain features and more than 3" from all objectives. The tips of each crescent-shaped base must touch, forming a circle.

Once you have done so, for the rest of the battle, the 3 tree miniatures join to form 1 **Soulpod Grove** terrain feature. The area inside the circle formed by the trees is part of the terrain feature
the sacred groves.lore: Sentient trees abound in the sacred groves of the Sylvaneth, awakened by the bountiful magics of genesis.

vengeance for the lost.name: Vengeance for the Lost
vengeance for the lost.description: Effect: If your **Soulpod Grove** has been demolished this battle, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS** units’ melee weapons.
vengeance for the lost.lore: Should they witness the desecration of their sacred groves, the Sylvaneth will attack with a merciless and frenzied aggression.

jade winds.name: Jade Winds
jade winds.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

• **Gladewyrm**
• **Spiteswarm Hive**
• **Vengeful Skullroot**

Effect: If you picked a **Gladewyrm** or **Vengeful Skullroot**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Spiteswarm Hive**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
jade winds.lore: The caster draws ambient motes of Ghyranite magic unto them and shapes them into a form with solidity, identity and vicious intent.

song of vengeance.name: Song of Vengeance
song of vengeance.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS** unit that is wholly within 12" of them and not in combat or that is wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove** to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. The target(s) can move up to 5" and can end that move in combat.
song of vengeance.lore: The grovekeeper cries out in vengeful fury, exhorting their forest kin to strike down the invading enemy and water the soil with their lifeblood.

cradling vines.name: Cradling Vines
cradling vines.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 5 to the control scores of friendly units while they are contesting the target objective.
cradling vines.lore: The caster calls upon the surrounding vegetation to envelop precious soulpods and draw them closer to the centre of the grove where they can be better protected.

leering gitshield.name: Leering Gitshield
leering gitshield.description: Effect: Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved.
leering gitshield.lore: The spiteful enchantments woven into this hideous shield ensure terrible misfortune falls on any who dare attack its bearer.

the clammy cowl.name: The Clammy Cowl
the clammy cowl.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.
the clammy cowl.lore: This enchanted hood wreathes its wearer in damp gloom, causing enemies to swing wildly at their blurred outline and weapons to slip in suddenly moistened palms.

backstabber s blade.name: Backstabber's Blade
backstabber s blade.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
backstabber s blade.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
backstabber s blade.lore: A slitta made from pure shadow and malice, this blade always finds its victim’s weak spots.

fight another day.name: Fight Another Day
fight another day.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
fight another day.lore: This warlord has mastered the ignoble art of striking then running away before the enemy can hit back.

loontouched.name: Loontouched
loontouched.description: Effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it has **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
loontouched.lore: This warlord’s magical prowess is boosted by the Bad Moon’s light.

the clammy hand.name: The Clammy Hand
the clammy hand.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
the clammy hand.lore: This boss is obviously destined for great things and can call upon vast troglodytic hordes.

fast as frazzlegit.name: Fast As Frazzlegit
fast as frazzlegit.description: Effect: Friendly units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on friendly units by **RETREAT** abilities.
fast as frazzlegit.lore: The Gitmob packs are always on the move, a speeding melange of howling Snarlfangs and cackling grots.

squigalanche.name: Squigalanche
squigalanche.description: Effect: Set up this unit wholly within your territory, wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
squigalanche.lore: A curious, arrhythmic pounding and cackles of wicked glee in the distance signal the approach of a mob of manic Squig Hoppers!

under the light of the bad moon.name: Under the Light of the Bad Moon
under the light of the bad moon.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
under the light of the bad moon.description:
Declare: Pick a territory (either friendly territory or enemy territory) to be **under the Light of the Bad Moon**. If both players can use this ability, the players roll off and the winner picks a territory to be under the Light of the Bad Moon.

The territory picked remains under the Light of the Bad Moon in the first and second battle rounds. In the third and fourth battle rounds, the other territory is under the Light of the Bad Moon.

Effect: While a friendly unit is wholly within the territory that is **under the Light of the Bad Moon**, the appropriate effect below applies to it:

***Frothing Zealots:*** If the unit is a **Moonclan Stabbas** unit, add 3 to its control score.

***Lunar Squigs:*** If the unit is a **Squig Hoppers** unit, no mortal damage is inflicted on it when it uses **Retreat** abilities.

***Moonlit Hide:*** If the unit is a **Rockgut Troggoths** unit, add 1 to save rolls for it.
under the light of the bad moon.lore: Grots are always vicious little monsters, but when their god’s light falls upon them, they become an order of magnitude more dangerous.

under the light of the bad moon.name: Under the Light of the Bad Moon
under the light of the bad moon.description:
Effect: During the battle, the effects below apply to friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units based on the current face of the Bad Moon:

***Frothing Zealots***: While the Bad Moon is **Cacklin’** or **Grinnin’**, add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**SQUIG** **MOONCLAN** units.

***Spiderfang Venom***: While the Bad Moon is **Cacklin’** or **Grinnin’**, combat attacks made by friendly **SPIDERFANG** units score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. This also affects **Companion** weapons.

***Moonlit Hide***: While the Bad Moon is **Grinnin’** or **Scowlin’**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly **TROGGOTH** units.

***Lunar Squigs***: While the Bad Moon is **Scowlin’** or **Sulkin’**, instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly **SQUIG** unit, you can use a value of 4.

***Sneaky Snarlfangs***: While the Bad Moon is **Sulkin’** or **Cacklin’**, friendly **GITMOB** units can use **CHARGE** and **SHOOT** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
under the light of the bad moon.lore: Grots are always vicious little monsters, but depending on the face of the moon, they can become an order of magnitude more dangerous.
under the light of the bad moon.restrictionText: Gloomspite Gitz armies can use the following abilities:

the faces of the bad moon.name: The Faces of the Bad Moon
the faces of the bad moon.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
the faces of the bad moon.description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round. If multiple players are commanding a Gloomspite Gitz army, then instead, at the start of the battle round, those players roll off and only the winner declares and uses this ability this battle round.
