Effect: If it is the first battle round, pick the starting face of the Bad Moon (**Grinnin’**, **Scowlin’**, **Sulkin’** or **Cacklin’**). If it is not the first battle round, the face of the Bad Moon moves to the next face in the sequence.
the faces of the bad moon.lore: The Bad Moon hurtles erratically around the realms in madcap orbits, empowering its worshippers and troubling all others with insane visions.
the faces of the bad moon.restrictionText: Gloomspite Gitz armies can use the following abilities:

creeping gloom.name: Creeping Gloom
creeping gloom.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
creeping gloom.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while friendly non-**MONSTER** non-**WAR MACHINE GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units are wholly within 3" of that terrain feature, they are not visible to enemy units more than 9" away.
creeping gloom.lore: The Gloomspite Gitz seek to plunge the realms into an eternal, clammy gloaming known as the Everdank. The icky fungal growths and obscuring spore clouds that follow them are very conducive to such conditions.
creeping gloom.restrictionText: Gloomspite Gitz armies can use the following abilities:

spoofshrooms.name: Spoofshrooms
spoofshrooms.description: Effect: Roll a dice. If this unit is **GITMOB**, roll D3+3 instead. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
spoofshrooms.lore: These warriors carry a large number of these light, powdery fungi, which can be hurled on the ground for a quick, bouncy getaway.
spoofshrooms.restrictionText:
Special Knick-knacks are unique enhancements that can be given to non‐**HERO GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units.
A unit can only have 1 Special Knick-knack.

fizzcap.name: Fizzcap
fizzcap.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
fizzcap.description: Effect: This unit can use a **SUMMON SPELL** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 12 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound. Then, if this unit is not **MOONCLAN**, roll a dice. On a 1-4, 1 model in this unit is automatically slain.
fizzcap.lore: Upon eating this fungus, the ingester’s brain fizzes and pops, and an arcane conjuration bursts out of their mouth, usually with fatal effect.
fizzcap.restrictionText:
Special Knick-knacks are unique enhancements that can be given to non‐**HERO GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units.
A unit can only have 1 Special Knick-knack.

glitzy bitz rolla.name: Glitzy Bitz Rolla
glitzy bitz rolla.description:
Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

If this unit is a non-**TROGGOTH** unit, add 1 to wound rolls for its attacks for the rest of the turn.

If this unit is a **TROGGOTH**, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Colossal Boulder Club** to 6.
• Set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Throwin’ Boulders** to 3.
• Set the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Noxious Vomit** to 3.
glitzy bitz rolla.lore: The owner of this highly polished dice often rolls it to see if today is a ‘lucky’ day. Troggoths, being as dumb as a bag of hammers, are especially susceptible to the effects.
glitzy bitz rolla.restrictionText:
Special Knick-knacks are unique enhancements that can be given to non‐**HERO GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units.
A unit can only have 1 Special Knick-knack.

the hand of gork.name: The Hand of Gork
the hand of gork.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
the hand of gork.lore: A ghostly green hand carries a mob of gitz to where they are needed.

spore maws.name: Spore Maws
spore maws.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
spore maws.lore: The caster causes the thick spores around them to coalesce into gnashing green mouths.

bad portents.name: Bad Portents
bad portents.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice. On 1-2, nothing happens. On a 3-5, the face of the Bad Moon moves to the next face. On a 6, pick a new face of the Bad Moon for this battle round.
bad portents.lore: The caster raises their staff and loudly proclaims that other mystics have incorrectly predicted the aspect of the Bad Moon; in fact, at this time, the face of the bad moon is…

gitspeed.name: Gitspeed
gitspeed.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-**TROGGOTH GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
gitspeed.lore: Rubbing a bit of scavenged sunmetal between his clammy palms and spitting a curse that causes his tongue to sizzle, the caster imbues nearby Gitz with a dose of sneaky swiftness.

gaze of glareface.name: Gaze of Glareface
gaze of glareface.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• The target cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Halve the Range characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons.
gaze of glareface.lore: The caster redirects Frazzlegit’s fearsome glare at the enemy, forcing them to shield their eyes and stumble about blindly.

bright fright.name: Bright Fright
bright fright.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 friendly visible **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Each target can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it was your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on the targets by those **RETREAT** abilities.
bright fright.lore: Sensing that the Gitz might be getting stuck in a bit beyond their depth, or maybe because they think a bit more battlefield anarchy might be in order, the caster summons a great scowling image of Glareface Frazzlegit to spook the horde into moving away from the foe.

summon mork s mighty mushroom.name: Summon Mork's Mighty Mushroom
summon mork s mighty mushroom.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Mork’s Mighty Mushroom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Mork’s Mighty Mushroom** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon mork s mighty mushroom.lore: The shaman takes a small mushroom and hurls it with all his might. When it lands, it sprouts impossibly quickly into a gigantic skullshroom, a fungus said to grow between Mork’s own toes.

summon scrapskuttle s arachnacauldron.name: Summon Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron
summon scrapskuttle s arachnacauldron.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon scrapskuttle s arachnacauldron.lore: The shaman whistles loudly, calling the squealing, bubbling Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron to their side.

summon scuttletide.name: Summon Scuttletide
summon scuttletide.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Scuttletide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Scuttletide** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon scuttletide.lore: The shaman grasps a small jade amulet in which a skullback spider is imprisoned and uses it to call forth a seething mass of the trapped creature’s kin.

summon malevolent moon.name: Summon Malevolent Moon
summon malevolent moon.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Malevolent Moon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Malevolent Moon** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon malevolent moon.lore: The shaman transforms a loonstone statue into a huge glowing terror and lets it loose on the battlefield.

itchy nuisance.name: Itchy Nuisance
itchy nuisance.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are contesting the target objective.
itchy nuisance.lore: The shaman covers the land in a bristly slime, the hairs of which cause unbearable itching.

loonshrine glow.name: Loonshrine Glow
loonshrine glow.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, if a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine** uses the ‘Moonclan Lairs’ ability, you can set up the replacement unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units instead of wholly within 12" of that **Bad Moon Loonshrine**.
loonshrine glow.lore: The wizard shines with the eerie light of the Bad Moon, drawing in troglodytic hordes.

puffballoons.name: Puffballoons
puffballoons.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an ability inflicts damage points on the target, after the ability has been resolved, the target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
puffballoons.lore: Bubble-like fungal growths appear all over nearby gitz that, when popped, shoot them into the air with a wet ‘thwip’.

formations.name: Gittish Tide
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** unit that is contesting an objective to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the control score of the target unit for each model in that unit that is not contesting any objectives.

ability.name: Grots Upon Grots
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** unit that is contesting an objective to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the control score of the target unit for each model in that unit that is not contesting any objectives.
ability.lore: The lurking presence of the Moonclans and their constant, nerve-fraying cackling makes it difficult for the enemy to focus on their battle plans.

abilities.name: Grots Upon Grots
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** unit that is contesting an objective to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the control score of the target unit for each model in that unit that is not contesting any objectives.
abilities.lore: The lurking presence of the Moonclans and their constant, nerve-fraying cackling makes it difficult for the enemy to focus on their battle plans.

formations.name: Gitmob Pack
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GITMOB** unit that is in combat to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with that **GITMOB** unit to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.

Effect: If you picked a target, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Git and Run
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GITMOB** unit that is in combat to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with that **GITMOB** unit to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.

Effect: If you picked a target, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
ability.lore: Even as Gitmob grots flee, they won’t turn down a prime opportunity for a stabbing.

abilities.name: Git and Run
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GITMOB** unit that is in combat to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with that **GITMOB** unit to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.

Effect: If you picked a target, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Even as Gitmob grots flee, they won’t turn down a prime opportunity for a stabbing.

formations.name: Sunbiter Pack
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **GITMOB** units that charged this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by the targets for the rest of turn.

ability.name: Extra Snappy
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **GITMOB** units that charged this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by the targets for the rest of turn.
ability.lore: The enterprising Gitmob grots of this tribe have equipped their Snarlfangs with sunmetal tooth-caps that absorb Hyshian magic as they pelt towards the foe, giving them a nasty bite indeed.

abilities.name: Extra Snappy
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **GITMOB** units that charged this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by the targets for the rest of turn.
abilities.lore: The enterprising Gitmob grots of this tribe have equipped their Snarlfangs with sunmetal tooth-caps that absorb Hyshian magic as they pelt towards the foe, giving them a nasty bite indeed.

formations.name: Troggherd
formations.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** that unit.

ability.name: Herd Healing
ability.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** that unit.
ability.lore: When troggoths gather in larger numbers, the sheer troggness of the herd serves as a catalyst for their regenerative abilities.

abilities.name: Herd Healing
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** that unit.
abilities.lore: When troggoths gather in larger numbers, the sheer troggness of the herd serves as a catalyst for their regenerative abilities.

formations.name: Gloomspite Horde
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** or **SPIDERFANG** units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move with the target.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

ability.name: Spreading Loonacy
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** or **SPIDERFANG** units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move with the target.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
ability.lore: When the worshippers of the Bad Moon gather, the energies of the Gloomspite surge through them like a tide, sending them frothing mad.

abilities.name: Spreading Loonacy
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** or **SPIDERFANG** units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move with the target.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: When the worshippers of the Bad Moon gather, the energies of the Gloomspite surge through them like a tide, sending them frothing mad.

formations.name: Squigalanche
formations.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **SQUIG** unit charges, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Fang-filled Gobs**, **Massive Fang-filled** **Gobs** or **Huge Fang-filled Gobs** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Bouncing Fury
ability.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **SQUIG** unit charges, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Fang-filled Gobs**, **Massive Fang-filled** **Gobs** or **Huge Fang-filled Gobs** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: A veritable tide of vicious, impossibly hungry, fang-toothed monsters boing into enemy lines, biting, chewing and swallowing their victims whole.

abilities.name: Bouncing Fury
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **SQUIG** unit charges, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Fang-filled Gobs**, **Massive Fang-filled** **Gobs** or **Huge Fang-filled Gobs** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A veritable tide of vicious, impossibly hungry, fang-toothed monsters boing into enemy lines, biting, chewing and swallowing their victims whole.

da king s guards.name: Da King's Guards
da king s guards.description:
Effect: While a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit is within the combat range of a friendly **HERO**:

• That **HERO** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **HERO**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit within that **HERO**’s combat range after the damage sequence for that **HERO** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
da king s guards.lore: Skragrott keeps a personal retinue of troggoths to protect him and favoured members of his court.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Da King's Gitz

da loonking s court.name: Da Loonking's Court
da loonking s court.description:
Declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-**UNIQUE KING’S GITZ HEROES** that do not have an enhancement.

Effect: Give each **HERO** 1 enhancement from the ‘Da King’s Gitz’ Army of Renown rules.

**Designer’s Note**: *These enhancements are given to the* **HEROES** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
da loonking s court.lore: The vast hoards of looted treasure held in the deepest, darkest caverns of the Loonking’s empire are legendary.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Da King's Gitz

the moon and the loon.name: The Moon and The Loon
the moon and the loon.description:
Effect: While a friendly unit is wholly within 9" of a friendly **Skragrott**, a friendly **Malevolent Moon** or a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine**:

•  Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** units.
•  Instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly **SQUIG** unit, you can use a value of 4.
the moon and the loon.lore: The Bad Moon’s gaze frequently falls upon the Loonking and his court.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Da King's Gitz

wotnot of prestige.name: Wotnot of Prestige
wotnot of prestige.description:
Declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
wotnot of prestige.lore: The bearer of this junk-like trinket doesn’t really know what it does. The Loonking assured them it holds great power, and they weren’t really in a position to refuse. Now the question is how to make it work…
wotnot of prestige.groupName: Da King's Gitz Artefacts of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Da King's Gitz

loonstone medallion.name: Loonstone Medallion
loonstone medallion.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**. While this unit is contesting an objective that is not being contested by any other friendly units, it has **WARD (5+)**.
loonstone medallion.lore: The medallion hanging around this grot’s neck grants them uncanny luck, which means they must be crucial to the Loonking’s plans. It probably won’t end well for them.
loonstone medallion.groupName: Da King's Gitz Artefacts of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Da King's Gitz

moonhoned shiv.name: Moonhoned Shiv
moonhoned shiv.description: Effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. In addition, each time this unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
moonhoned shiv.lore: This grot is either the most or least trusted in Skragrott’s court, as the Loonking has gifted them a stabby thing that has been quenched in the light of the Bad Moon.
moonhoned shiv.groupName: Da King's Gitz Artefacts of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Da King's Gitz

glarejester.name: Glarejester
glarejester.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit within 3" of this unit and that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. Add the roll to the distance the target can move when using **MOVE** abilities this phase. If the target ends a move in this phase within 3" of this **HERO**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on this **HERO** equal to the roll.
glarejester.lore: This grot thinks he’s the funniest in all of grotdom. Everyone else disagrees.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Da King's Gitz

da king s adjutant.name: Da King's Adjutant
da king s adjutant.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Your Turn
da king s adjutant.description:
Declare: You cannot use this ability and the **Bad Moon Loonshrine**’s ‘Moonclan Lairs’ ability in the same turn. If this unit is within 12" of a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine**, pick a friendly non-reinforced, non-**HERO**, non-**MONSTER KING’S GITZ** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine** and more than 3" from all enemy units.
da king s adjutant.lore: This grot is tasked with cajoling as many of the Loonking’s followers into battle as possible.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Da King's Gitz

da loonking s command.name: Da Loonking's Command
da loonking s command.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KING’S GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

•  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by champions in the target unit.
•  If the target uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6.
•  Add 1 to the target’s control score.
da loonking s command.lore: With a puzzling gesture from the shaman, a greenish-yellow glow emanates from the best warriors of Da King’s Gitz, spurring them on to perform acts of even greater wickedness in Skragrott’s name.

right gitz in da right place.name: Right Gitz In Da Right Place
right gitz in da right place.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KING’S GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)** until the start of your next turn.
right gitz in da right place.lore: While fiddling with a squig-skin pouch, the wild-eyed shaman mutters gobbledegook interspersed with the name of a hated enemy.

summon malevolent moon.name: Summon Malevolent Moon
summon malevolent moon.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Malevolent Moon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Malevolent Moon** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon malevolent moon.lore: The shaman transforms a loonstone statue into a huge glowing terror and lets it loose on the battlefield.

broken slumber.name: Broken Slumber
broken slumber.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** unit that is a **living** **landmark**.

Effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
broken slumber.lore: Disturbed by the approach of an enemy army, dozing troggoths – presumed till now to be part of the scenery – wake up in a blurry rage, fists and clubs swinging.

living landmark.name: Living Landmark
living landmark.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve as a **living landmark**. It has now been deployed.
living landmark.lore: Despite their great size, when some troggoths lie down for a snooze, they are easy to mistake for just another part of the landscape…

moon toughened hide.name: Moon-toughened Hide
moon toughened hide.description: Effect: In battle rounds 2 and 3, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** units.
moon toughened hide.lore: The light of the Bad Moon illuminates the troggoths’ craggy hides, its madcap magic rendering them even more resilient than usual.

herd healing.name: Herd Healing
herd healing.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** that unit.
herd healing.lore: When troggoths gather in larger numbers, the sheer troggness of the herd serves as a catalyst for their regenerative abilities.

aura of haywire magic.name: Aura of Haywire Magic
aura of haywire magic.description: Effect: The effects of a friendly **Trugg**’s ‘Malfunctioning Leystone’ ability affect friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** units anywhere on the battlefield instead of only those wholly within 12" of that friendly **Trugg**.
aura of haywire magic.lore: Those who trudge beside the Troggoth King on his long march are imbued with the same mysterious powers their liege unwittingly channels.

crunchy shinies.name: Crunchy Shinies
crunchy shinies.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
crunchy shinies.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.
crunchy shinies.lore: When eaten, these glimmering crystal shards allow a troggoth to move with something approaching agility – a novel feeling for these naturally lumbering brutes.

loonstone teef.name: Loonstone Teef
loonstone teef.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
loonstone teef.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
loonstone teef.lore: This troggoth once jammed shards of loonstone into their gums to replace missing teeth. They have since been driven mad by a constant cackling that echoes around their skull, rendering them particularly irascible and dangerous.

plucky git.name: Plucky Git
plucky git.description: Effect: While this unit has no damage points, friendly **DROGGZ'S** **GITMOB** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 9" of this unit.
plucky git.lore: This swaggering boss radiates confidence, shouting encouragements' to the ladz and taunting the foe with obscene gestures. Confidence is a fragile thing for a grot, however...

stick em and run.name: Stick 'Em and Run
stick em and run.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses a **RETREAT** ability or the ‘Frazzlegit’s Flame Stream’ ability, before moving this unit, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
stick em and run.lore: This grot might not be known for their bravery, but they're still alive - which is more than can be said for most of their rivals.

glareface s grin.name: Glareface's Grin
glareface s grin.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
glareface s grin.description:
Declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
glareface s grin.lore: When this crescent-shaped shard of metal strikes the ground, it releases the concentrated Hyshian light trapped within it.

surprise ya gitz.name: Surprise, Ya Gitz!
surprise ya gitz.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that is **outflanking the enemy**.

Effect: Set up that unit on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
surprise ya gitz.lore: When the front lines are engaged, the Gitmob flanking forces launch their ambush.

glowering light.name: Glowering Light
glowering light.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
glowering light.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that has charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target cannot make a pile-in move when it is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability.
glowering light.lore: Those who are suddenly bathed in Glareface Frazzlegit’s light are momentarily stunned by his fearsome gloweriness.

get around em.name: Get Around 'Em
get around em.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **outflanking the enemy**. It has now been deployed.
get around em.lore: With a cackle, groups of Gitmob grots race off into the distance to surround and outflank the foe.

dis fight s not fer me.name: Dis Fight's Not Fer Me
dis fight s not fer me.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
dis fight s not fer me.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DROGGZ'S GITMOB** unit that is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn and is not in combat with any enemy units that did not charge this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.
dis fight s not fer me.lore: Gitmob grots are hard to pin down in combat, whether they are riding Snarlfangs or chariots - or just not up for a fight when the odds are against them.

frazzleblast.name: Frazzleblast
frazzleblast.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DROGGZ'S GITMOB** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
frazzleblast.lore: With a wild gesticulation, the shaman imbues the Gitmobs' weapons with Frazzlegit's burning light.

summon mork s mighty mushroom.name: Summon Mork's Mighty Mushroom
summon mork s mighty mushroom.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Mork's Mighty Mushroom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Mork's Mighty Mushroom** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon mork s mighty mushroom.lore: The shaman takes a small mushroom and hurls it with all his might. When it lands, it sprouts impossibly quickly into a gigantic skullshroom, a fungus said to grow between Mork's own toes.

the officar s order.name: The Officar's Order
the officar s order.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
the officar s order.description:
Declare: Pick a battle tactic card in your hand and place it face-down separately next to your other battle tactic cards. The information on it is still hidden from your opponent but make it clear which card is separate. The card stays separate until you use the command on it or score the battle tactic on it as described below.

Effect: When you use the command on that card, it is not discarded but returns to your hand. Your opponent can check the information on it before it returns to your hand. The card goes back to being a normal battle tactic card, with the exception that you cannot use the command on it in the same phase it went back into your hand.

If you did not use the command on the card you separated, you can still score the battle tactic on it at the end of your turn as normal if you met its conditions. If you do so, discard it as normal. If you neither used the command nor scored the battle tactic on the card, it automatically returns to your hand at the end of your turn.

**Designer’s Note:** *This ability essentially lets you use a command ‘for free’, but you have to choose the command at the start of the battle round, so it requires some planning ahead!*
the officar s order.lore: Reading the flow of battle, a ranking Freeguilder dispatches an order that could well turn the tide in the Sigmarites’ favour.

cosmopolitan leader.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
cosmopolitan leader.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit is **HUMAN**, pick up to 3 eligible units to be the targets instead.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:

• If the target is **HUMAN**, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
• If the target is **DUARDIN**, add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• If the target is **AELF**, add 3 to the target’s control score.
cosmopolitan leader.lore: This officar has trained under and alongside all the myriad factions that dwell within the walls of the Cities of Sigmar. Their knowledge of many different fighting styles and disciplines is a rare quality.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Cities of Sigmar

cosmopolitan leader.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
cosmopolitan leader.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non‐**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice** for each target. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to wound rolls for each target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.
cosmopolitan leader.lore: This veteran has trained under and alongside soldiers from all walks of life across the cities of Sigmar. Their knowledge of many different fighting styles and disciplines is a rare quality.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Cities of Sigmar

draw steel.name: Draw Steel!
draw steel.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
draw steel.lore: With a bellow, the officar lunges into battle, and their troops follow them with as much steel in their hearts as they wield in their clenched fists.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Cities of Sigmar

astute tactician.name: Astute Tactician
astute tactician.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target and add 2 to run rolls for the target.
astute tactician.lore: This Sigmarite has spent as much time with their nose in military tomes as they have knee-deep in the spilled guts of their foes. Their erudition in the subject of battlefield manoeuvres is highly regarded.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Cities of Sigmar

ranger doctrines.name: Ranger Doctrines
ranger doctrines.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for your general or a friendly non-**HERO** unit wholly within 12" of your general
ranger doctrines.description:
Used By: The unit using that **FIGHT** ability.

Effect: Immediately after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of your general. Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point and not in combat.
ranger doctrines.lore: Kreel was once a captain in the Wildercorps. While he now commands an eclectic assortment of forces, the fluid tactics he honed in his prior life can still be used to great effect.

fortify position.name: Fortify Position
fortify position.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly **CASTELITE** units if they did not use a **MOVE** ability in the same turn.
fortify position.lore: Heavy pavises are slammed into the dirt, forming a wall of oak and iron as strong as a fortification.

form up.name: Form Up!
form up.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.

**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Cannonade Cogfort’.*
form up.lore: Once the order is given, shieldwalls and cannon batteries link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.
form up.restrictionText: Cities of Sigmar armies can use the following abilities:

take aim.name: Take Aim!
take aim.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
take aim.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** to use this ability.

Effect: Pick 1 of that unit’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.
take aim.lore: While their shield-slogging comrades keep the foe at bay, sharpshooters rain down punishing volumes of fire on helpless foes.
take aim.restrictionText: Cities of Sigmar armies can use the following abilities:

sound the attack.name: Sound the Attack!
sound the attack.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a unit that is under orders
sound the attack.description:
Used By: The unit using that **CHARGE** ability.

Effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.
sound the attack.lore: As the piercing note of a war-horn sounds, shields shift aside to permit cavalry and hollering assault troops to sally forth and engage the foe.
sound the attack.restrictionText: Cities of Sigmar armies can use the following abilities:

hurl them back.name: Hurl Them Back!
hurl them back.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
hurl them back.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons.
hurl them back.lore: After the enemy has spent their fury, the Sigmarites heave forward, shoving their foes off balance and leaving them open to a killing blow.
hurl them back.restrictionText: Cities of Sigmar armies can use the following abilities:

into them you dogs.name: Into Them, You Dogs!
into them you dogs.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
into them you dogs.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** that is **under orders** to use this ability. That unit is the **field officer** for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non-**HERO** units that are **under orders** and wholly within 12" of the **field officer** to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the **field officer** uses a **FIGHT** ability, you can pick a target that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn. That target is **inspirited** and the other target is **emboldened**. The **inspirited** target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by the **field officer** has been resolved. Then, if the **emboldened** target has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, it can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **inspirited** target’s **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
into them you dogs.lore: Sigmarite officers demand remarkable feats from their warriors, leading them into the furnace of battle with a rousing speech and a sword held high.
into them you dogs.restrictionText: Cities of Sigmar armies can use the following abilities:

stentorian general.name: Stentorian General
stentorian general.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.
stentorian general.lore: This hero’s bellowed threats are so intense that the enemy cowers before them.

grizzled drillmaster.name: Grizzled Drillmaster
grizzled drillmaster.description: Effect: Other visible friendly units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.
grizzled drillmaster.lore: This warrior is a grim-faced veteran who mercilessly drills regiments under their command, not out of cruelty but from a desire to ensure their survival.

beloved leader.name: Beloved Leader
beloved leader.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.
beloved leader.lore: Such is the esteem in which this officer is held that their soldiers would march into the jaws of death without fear.

the last blade of embergard.name: The Last Blade of Embergard
the last blade of embergard.description: Effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon’s Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.
the last blade of embergard.lore: This chipped and scratched blade grows steadily hotter as allies and enemies fall, fuelled by the fury of battle.

bones of saint ignifus.name: Bones of Saint Ignifus
bones of saint ignifus.phase: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** or **PRAYER** ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders
bones of saint ignifus.description: Effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.
bones of saint ignifus.lore: The seventh Supreme Pontifex of the Sigmarite faith, Ignifus perished in the act of slaying the Nightmare of Vandium. His bones thrum with righteous power.

the sphere celestial.name: The Sphere Celestial
the sphere celestial.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY HERO** that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use **MOVE** abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).
the sphere celestial.lore: By cranking the dials on this incredibly sophisticated artefact, the bearer can manipulate space and time on a local level, swapping the position of themselves and another willing ally.

prototype arco combustor uninhibitor.name: Prototype Arco-Combustor Uninhibitor
prototype arco combustor uninhibitor.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
prototype arco combustor uninhibitor.description:
Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
• This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
•No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
prototype arco combustor uninhibitor.lore: This device accelerates the burning of a Cogfort’s emberstone fuel, allowing sudden and shocking bursts of motion.
prototype arco combustor uninhibitor.restrictionText: An Ironweld Innovation is a unique enhancement that can be given to **Cannonade Cogforts** and **Conqueror Cogforts**. A unit can only have 1 Ironweld Innovation.

emergency bellows.name: Emergency Bellows
emergency bellows.description: Effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
emergency bellows.lore: This cogwork mechanism pumps cool air into an overheating arco-combustor.
emergency bellows.restrictionText: An Ironweld Innovation is a unique enhancement that can be given to **Cannonade Cogforts** and **Conqueror Cogforts**. A unit can only have 1 Ironweld Innovation.

grapple net launcher.name: Grapple-Net Launcher
grapple net launcher.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Combat Phase
grapple net launcher.description:
Declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
grapple net launcher.lore: This hull-mounted defensive device flings a steel-mesh net at onrushing foes, trapping them fast and nullifying their attacks.
grapple net launcher.restrictionText: An Ironweld Innovation is a unique enhancement that can be given to **Cannonade Cogforts** and **Conqueror Cogforts**. A unit can only have 1 Ironweld Innovation.

sudden ambush.name: Sudden Ambush
sudden ambush.description: Effect: Set up this unit within 6" of an enemy unit and not in combat.
sudden ambush.lore: The Whisperblade hides until it is the perfect moment to strike.

lady of the wheel.name: Lady of the Wheel
lady of the wheel.description: Effect: Each time a friendly model is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to that model’s Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
lady of the wheel.lore: Zenestra’s followers will defend her with a strength that can cow even a follower of the Dark Gods.

twin tailed comet of honour.name: Twin-Tailed Comet of Honour
twin tailed comet of honour.description: Effect: While this unit has any champions, add 5 to this unit’s control score.
twin tailed comet of honour.lore: Bearing one of the holiest symbols of Sigmar, this medal is awarded for exemplary acts of gallantry.
twin tailed comet of honour.restrictionText:
Decorations for Valour are unique enhancements that can be given to **CITIES OF SIGMAR** units that have the **CHAMPION** keyword.
A unit can only have 1 Decoration for Valour.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Cities of Sigmar

the living city cross.name: The Living City Cross
the living city cross.description: Effect: While this unit has any champions, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.
the living city cross.lore: Having spent many years deployed in the wilds of Ghyran, this warrior has trained their troops to use camouflage and guerrilla-style survival techniques.
the living city cross.restrictionText:
Decorations for Valour are unique enhancements that can be given to **CITIES OF SIGMAR** units that have the **CHAMPION** keyword.
A unit can only have 1 Decoration for Valour.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Cities of Sigmar

aqshian order of merit.name: Aqshian Order of Merit
aqshian order of merit.description: Effect: While this unit has any champions, if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit.
aqshian order of merit.lore: Awarded to distinguished veterans of battle in the Realm of Fire, this medal marks out those who have protected their allies against Aqshy’s rage-inducing effects.
aqshian order of merit.restrictionText:
Decorations for Valour are unique enhancements that can be given to **CITIES OF SIGMAR** units that have the **CHAMPION** keyword.
A unit can only have 1 Decoration for Valour.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Cities of Sigmar

pious veteran.name: Pious Veteran
pious veteran.description: Effect: Each time you pick targets while declaring a **PRAYER** ability used by a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST**, if this unit is eligible to be picked, you can pick it to be an additional target.
pious veteran.lore: The quiet strength of this warrior’s faith is such that tiny miracles manifest around them wherever they go.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Cities of Sigmar

bristling attitude.name: Bristling Attitude
bristling attitude.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a **CHARGE** ability for a visible unit within 12" of this unit
bristling attitude.description: Effect: Spend any number of **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll **X** dice, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the charge roll.
bristling attitude.lore: Many enemy assaults falter in the face of this general’s fiery yet determined resistance.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Cities of Sigmar

speed of the twin tailed comet.name: Speed of the Twin-Tailed Comet
speed of the twin tailed comet.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-**WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
speed of the twin tailed comet.lore: Banners blaze with ethereal fire and trail comet-like contrails as the Freeguilders hurl themselves forward to meet the enemy.

high star s light.name: High Star's Light
high star s light.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
high star s light.lore: The mage summons a simulacrum of Sigendil, the High Star of Azyr, to inspire their allies to the greatest heights of valour.

curse of scorched metal.name: Curse of Scorched Metal
curse of scorched metal.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an **ATTACK** ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that **ATTACK** ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved.
curse of scorched metal.lore: The wizard causes the weapons of their foes to grow unbearably hot, searing their flesh to the bone.

benediction of the high heavens.name: Benediction of the High Heavens
benediction of the high heavens.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick another visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.
benediction of the high heavens.lore: The priest beseeches Sigmar to rain down restorative blessings upon his faithful, seeing lacerations heal and broken bones reknit.

holy aegis.name: Holy Aegis
holy aegis.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase.
holy aegis.lore: A shimmering barrier manifests around the beneficiary, dulling the impact of enemy attacks.

reckoning of sinners.name: Reckoning of Sinners
reckoning of sinners.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.
reckoning of sinners.lore: Searing oratory causes enemies to be stricken by the weight of the sins and outrages they have committed against the God-King’s folk.

formations.name: Fearless Exemplars
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN INFANTRY HERO** to use this ability. Then, you can pick up to 1 friendly non-**HERO** **HUMAN INFANTRY** unit and up to 1 friendly **HUMAN WAR MACHINE** unit that are wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.

Effect: While the targets are wholly within 12" of that **HERO**, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target **INFANTRY** unit’s melee weapons and the target **WAR MACHINE** unit’s ranged weapons until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Front-Line Leader
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN INFANTRY HERO** to use this ability. Then, you can pick up to 1 friendly non-**HERO** **HUMAN INFANTRY** unit and up to 1 friendly **HUMAN WAR MACHINE** unit that are wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.

Effect: While the targets are wholly within 12" of that **HERO**, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target **INFANTRY** unit’s melee weapons and the target **WAR MACHINE** unit’s ranged weapons until the start of your next turn.
ability.lore: The officars of this army are the stuff of Dawnbringer legend, hard-bitten veterans that stand with the troops through thick and thin. Their exemplary behaviour and courage inspires their soldiers to fight all the harder when the going gets tough.

Effect: While the targets are wholly within 12" of that **HERO**, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target **INFANTRY** unit’s melee weapons and the target **WAR MACHINE** unit’s ranged weapons until the start of your next turn.

formations.name: Collegiate Exemplars
formations.description:
Effect: Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly **WIZARDS** that are **under orders**.

**Designer's Note:** **WIZARDS** *in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.*

ability.name: Masters of the Arcane
ability.description:
Effect: Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly **WIZARDS** that are **under orders**.

**Designer's Note:** **WIZARDS** *in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.*
ability.lore: The battlemages of the Collegiate Arcane might be intimidating and occasionally aloof, but their sorcery perfectly supplements a fighting formation.

formations.name: Swift Reinforcements
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.

Effect: If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

ability.name: Dawnbringer Crusade
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.

Effect: If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
ability.lore: Pouring forth from the Cities of Sigmar, the Dawnbringer Crusades seek to reconquer and reconsecrate the Mortal Realms in the name of the God-King.

formations.name: Stalwart Guardians
formations.description: Effect: Each time a friendly unit that is **under orders** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

ability.name: To the Last
ability.description: Effect: Each time a friendly unit that is **under orders** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
ability.lore: Determined to safeguard all that they cherish, the Sigmarites charge into battle to reinforce wavering battlelines.

formations.name: Zealous Hordes
formations.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SIGMARITE** units that target the enemy unit using that **FIGHT** ability.

ability.name: Throngs of the Faithful
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Your opponent declared a FIGHT ability
ability.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SIGMARITE** units that target the enemy unit using that **FIGHT** ability.
ability.lore: All that remains in these Sigmarites’ hearts is a burning desire for vengeance against the reavers who slaughtered their loved ones.

abilities.lore: All that remains in these Sigmarites’ hearts is a burning desire for vengeance against the reavers who slaughtered their loved ones.

formations.name: Veteran Cannoneers
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Ironweld Great Cannon** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic.

ability.name: Canny Crews
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Ironweld Great Cannon** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic.
ability.lore: The crews of these Great Cannons are so well trained they often fire the perfect shot, blasting off the heads of monsters or mowing down ranks of the enemy.

abilities.name: Canny Crews

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic.
abilities.lore: The crews of these Great Cannons are so well trained they often fire the perfect shot, blasting off the heads of monsters or mowing down ranks of the enemy.

formations.name: Thrall Warhost
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF** units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.

ability.name: Have No Mercy
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF** units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.
ability.lore: Their mistress’s commands echoing in their minds, the aelves of the Darkling Covens are compelled to murder the foe with pitiless efficiency, their dark-hearted kin joining them in the slaughter.

abilities.lore: Their mistress’s commands echoing in their minds, the aelves of the Darkling Covens are compelled to murder the foe with pitiless efficiency, their dark-hearted kin joining them in the slaughter.

formations.name: Grudgebound War Throng
formations.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** units that did not charge this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: I've Seen Worse and Killed Better
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** units that did not charge this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The duardin who battle for the Cities of Sigmar are as gruff and critical as they are loyal, courageous and bold. Little can move them once their mind is set or their feet planted.

abilities.name: I've Seen Worse and Killed Better
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** units that did not charge this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The duardin who battle for the Cities of Sigmar are as gruff and critical as they are loyal, courageous and bold. Little can move them once their mind is set or their feet planted.

castellan captain vyan philsin.name: Castellan-Captain Vyan Philsin
castellan captain vyan philsin.description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IRON MARCH INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.
castellan captain vyan philsin.lore: Infamous for launching amphibious assaults on Kruleboyz camps in the swamps of Ghyran, those who board Philsin’s Cogfort are well versed in close combat.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

commodore de gracon.name: Commodore De Graçon
commodore de gracon.description: Effect: This unit and up to 1 other friendly **IRON MARCH WAR MACHINE** within this unit’s combat range can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
commodore de gracon.lore: De Graçon is an intrepid commander known for her lightning raids on enemy positions. She has a reputation for burning through fuel at a fearsome pace.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

castellan captain regan vandercloud.name: Castellan-Captain Regan Vandercloud
castellan captain regan vandercloud.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.
castellan captain regan vandercloud.lore: Vandercloud prefers to smash their Cogfort into the foe like a stone battering ram.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

engineer kirsta loudren.name: Engineer Kirsta Loudren
engineer kirsta loudren.description: Effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice for each visible unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
engineer kirsta loudren.lore: Loudren is ferociously protective of her Cogfort’s arco-combustor, and she would rather see it utterly destroyed than have it fall into unworthy hands.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

engineer gurrn ashbrow.name: Engineer Gurrn Ashbrow
engineer gurrn ashbrow.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
engineer gurrn ashbrow.lore: Ashbrow is one of the Ironweld’s most senior Cogfort experts. His tireless repairs are as ingenious as they are swift.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

engineer bartel holst.name: Engineer Bartel Holst
engineer bartel holst.lore: Holst believes that a powerful defence is a Cogfort’s greatest boon. His war machine is clad in duardin-forged steel plate; to him, the Cogfort’s severely reduced manoeuvrability and speed is an acceptable cost.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

form up iron march.name: Form Up, Iron March!
form up iron march.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRON MARCH** unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly **IRON MARCH** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:

• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.

**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Cannonade Cogfort’ or ‘Mallus Forgepriest’.*
form up iron march.lore: Once the order is given, Cogforts and infantry alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

battle priest solantra whyl.name: Battle-Priest Solantra Whyl
battle priest solantra whyl.lore: Whyl is a veteran battle-priest who suffered crippling injuries during a Skaven artillery barrage. Since then, she has strapped herself into any Cogfort willing to give her berth, using the titan as her mobile pulpit.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

broadmoore and louse.name: Broadmoore and Louse
broadmoore and louse.description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Crew’s Leadshotters**. In addition, if this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can set up a **Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy** wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. That unit has the **IRON MARCH** keyword.
broadmoore and louse.lore: The notoriously foul-tempered Marshal Hans Broadmoore and his downtrodden Relic Envoy ‘Louse’ Renlik often ride to battle atop a Cogfort. Should foes attempt to board, the pair fight back fiercely with sabre and pistol.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

master sapper gravelock fiske.name: Master Sapper Gravelock Fiske
master sapper gravelock fiske.description: Effect: This unit’s ranged weapons have **Anti‑FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend)** and **Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**.
master sapper gravelock fiske.lore: Whether directing the fire of a realmscorcher or the bombardment of a godbreaker cannon, Fiske can pinpoint the weak spot of any enemy fortification.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Iron March

the chant of iron.name: The Chant of Iron
the chant of iron.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRON MARCH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick either a visible enemy unit within 18" of them or a visible friendly **IRON MARCH** unit that is wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If you picked an enemy unit:

• If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible enemy unit to be a second target.
•Subtract 2" from each target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

If you picked a friendly unit, **Heal (D3)** the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **IRON MARCH** unit that is wholly 12" of the chanter and that has not been healed by this ability this turn instead.
the chant of iron.lore: The alliance between Grungni the Maker and Sigmar the God-King is writ large upon the priest’s brow as divine creation and celestial wrath combine.

form up allies.name: Form up, Allies!
form up allies.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.

**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard’.*
form up allies.lore: Once the order is given, humans, aelves and duardin alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.
form up allies.groupName: Allies of the Free Cities Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities

forces of order.name: Forces of Order
forces of order.description:
Effect: While 3 friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the **AELF** keyword, 1 of those units has the **DUARDIN** keyword and 1 of those units has the **SIGMARITE** keyword:

• Those units have **WARD (5+)** against shooting attacks.
• Add 3 to those units’ control scores.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
forces of order.lore: The soldiers who stand shoulder to shoulder against the evil ravaging the Mortal Realms are hardy and bold, and they take strength from their shared bonds of fellowship.
forces of order.groupName: Allies of the Free Cities Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities

respected commander.name: Respected Commander
respected commander.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a visible **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 18" of this unit
respected commander.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
respected commander.lore: This commander is hailed as a paragon of virtue by all goodly beings, and their orders are followed with the utmost haste.
respected commander.groupName: Allies of the Free Cities Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities

signet of the city.name: Signet of the City
signet of the city.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
signet of the city.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and each visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• The targets are **under orders**.
• The targets have **WARD (6+)**.
• The targets have a maximum control score of 1.
signet of the city.lore: This piece of jewellery is bestowed upon those who have performed a great service to one of Sigmar’s cities, giving their opinion considerable weight in matters military. The bearers do tend to overstep their authority, however, countermanding earlier orders and sowing confusion.
signet of the city.groupName: Allies of the Free Cities Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities

these realms are ours.name: These Realms are Ours
these realms are ours.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for attacks that target enemy units that are contesting the target objective.
these realms are ours.lore: The allies of Sigmar share a desire to restore civilisation and stability to the realms, whatever the cost.

divine mandate.name: Divine Mandate
divine mandate.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.
divine mandate.lore: Sigmar’s quest to drive Chaos from reality and reconquer the Mortal Realms imbues his faithful with his dread aspect of war, that of a furious and all-conquering warrior king.

lores.name: Allies of the Free Cities Spell Lore
Allies of the Free Cities Prayer Lore

fate slicer.name: Fate Slicer
fate slicer.description: Effect: Gain 1 **fate point** if any models were slain by this unit this turn.
fate slicer.lore: This curving crystal blade can cut a victim’s soul from the tapestry of fate.

cloaked in wyrdflame.name: Cloaked in Wyrdflame
cloaked in wyrdflame.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.
cloaked in wyrdflame.lore: The bearer is engulfed in a wyrdflame blaze so intense that enemies shrink before it.

kairic tome.name: Kairic Tome
kairic tome.phase: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 6" of this unit
kairic tome.description: Effect: Add 1 to or subtract 1 from the casting roll for that spell. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.
kairic tome.lore: Said to be penned by the Fateweaver himself, this tome is filled with all manner of eldritch secrets.

destined for battle.name: Destined for Battle
destined for battle.phase: Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit in your turn
destined for battle.description:
Used By: The unit using that **CHARGE** ability.

Effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability.
destined for battle.lore: Hand-to-hand combat is a crude pursuit, but it has its uses.
destined for battle.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

silver simulacrum.name: Silver Simulacrum
silver simulacrum.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
silver simulacrum.lore: Like some amorphous organism, an Argent Shard splits in two to double its arcane potency.
silver simulacrum.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

smoke and mirrors.name: Smoke and Mirrors
smoke and mirrors.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
smoke and mirrors.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was not set up this turn and was not set up using this ability in the previous turn to be the target, then pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the substitute.

Effect: Set up the substitute wholly within 6" of the target and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.
smoke and mirrors.lore: With sudden and terrible clarity, Tzeentch’s foes realise they have been fighting the wrong enemy all along.
smoke and mirrors.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

destined arcana.name: Destined Arcana
destined arcana.phase: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit
destined arcana.description:
Used By: The unit using that **SPELL** ability.

Effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the casting roll for that spell.
destined arcana.lore: Tzeentch imbues the spell with a fraction of his limitless arcane might.
destined arcana.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

eldritch illusions.name: Eldritch Illusions
eldritch illusions.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units on the battlefield to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up in reserve **masked by illusion**.

Friendly units that are **masked by illusion** are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.
eldritch illusions.lore: The Disciples of Tzeentch delight in spreading confusion amongst their foes with cunningly woven glamours.
eldritch illusions.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

all part of the plan.name: All Part of the Plan
all part of the plan.description:
Effect: You start the battle with 0 **fate points**.
Gain 1 **fate point** each time:

• You lose the priority roll.
