• A spell cast by a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit is unbound.
• A friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit miscasts a spell.
• Your opponent gains control of an objective that you controlled at the start of the turn.
• A friendly **Argent Shard** is **demolished**.
all part of the plan.lore: Tzeentch is all-seeing and all-knowing, and even setbacks may ultimately serve his destined ends.
all part of the plan.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

destined to serve.name: Destined to Serve
destined to serve.description: Effect: Before allocating damage points to a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit, you can spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, remove 1 damage point in that unit’s damage pool.
destined to serve.lore: Those chosen by the Change God are not permitted to fall until they have served their fated purpose.
destined to serve.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

devolving aura.name: Devolving Aura
devolving aura.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any damage points were allocated to the target this phase. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.
devolving aura.lore: Enemies that stray close to this hero are stricken by hideous malformations.

silver summoner.name: Silver Summoner
silver summoner.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**WARFLOCK ARCANITE** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 12" of a friendly **ARGENT SHARD** that is visible to this unit.
silver summoner.lore: This hero can channel an Argent Shard’s eldritch power to create uncanny simulacra of fallen warriors.

grand illusionist.name: Grand Illusionist
grand illusionist.description: Effect: If this unit was set up this turn, it can move D3". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.
grand illusionist.lore: This hero is a supreme mountebank, able to fabricate convincing illusions that allow them to slip away undetected.

mutating blade.name: Mutating Blade
mutating blade.description: Effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons. That weapon’s Attacks characteristic is 2D6 for the rest of the battle.
mutating blade.lore: An iridescent flamberge, an axe with nine edges, a lash ending in an eagle’stalon: the form of the bearer’s weapon constantly shifts, making its strikes impossible to predict.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Disciples of Tzeentch

arcane siphon.name: Arcane Siphon
arcane siphon.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
arcane siphon.description:
Declare: Pick a visible **MANIFESTATION** (friendly or enemy) that was not set up this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target is banished.
• **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the target’s Health characteristic.
arcane siphon.lore: This enigmatic device can drain the animating force from nearby magical emanations and transmute it into a shimmering, rejuvenating tonic.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Disciples of Tzeentch

spell catcher amulet.name: Spell-Catcher Amulet
spell catcher amulet.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
spell catcher amulet.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability if any enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** were banished this phase.

Effect: This unit can use a **SUMMON** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition. That **SUMMON** ability does not count towards the total number of **SPELL** or **BANISH** abilities this unit can use this phase.
spell catcher amulet.lore: This amulet, in the shape of an unblinking eye, devours the residual energies of arcane manifestations that have been unravelled, re-imagining them in forms more pleasing to the Changer of the Ways.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Disciples of Tzeentch

cheat destiny.name: Cheat Destiny
cheat destiny.phase: Reaction: You used a command on a battle tactic card
cheat destiny.description: Effect: Instead of discarding that card, return it face down to the bottom of your battle tactic deck.
cheat destiny.lore: Can destiny truly be deceived, or are we pulled by strings we cannot see?

predict the future.name: Predict the Future
predict the future.description: Effect: You can look at up to 3 cards from the top of your battle tactic deck without adding them to your hand. Then, in any order, return each card face down to either the top or the bottom of your battle tactic deck.
predict the future.lore: Foresighted is forearmed, as the old saying goes.

fated arrival.name: Fated Arrival
fated arrival.description: Effect: Set up this unit wholly within friendly territory, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
fated arrival.lore: Followers of Tzeentch ride the waves of fate to ultimate victory.

masters of destiny.name: Masters of Destiny
masters of destiny.phase: Once per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
masters of destiny.description:
Effect: Roll 9 dice and put them to one side. These are your **destiny** **dice**. During the battle, instead of rolling the dice for 1 of the rolls from the list below, you can pick one of your **destiny** **dice** and use it as the roll. Once a destiny dice has been used, it is discarded.

If you want to replace a roll that uses more than one D6, you must use the same number of **destiny dice** (e.g. you would need to use 2 **destiny dice** in place of a 2D6 casting roll). Rolls that are replaced count as unmodified rolls and cannot be re-rolled or modified unless noted.

The following rolls can be replaced with **destiny dice**:

• Casting rolls
• Run rolls
• Charge rolls
• Hit rolls
• Wound rolls
• Save rolls – you must still modify the roll by the Rend characteristic of the attacking weapon.
masters of destiny.lore: To serve the Changer of the Ways is to instinctively understand the ebb and flow of future events and manipulate them at will.

the five verses of volarian.name: The Five Verses of Volarian
the five verses of volarian.description: Effect: This unit has a Move characteristic of 14" and has **FLY**.
the five verses of volarian.lore: Upon reciting these stanzas, the reader is granted the gift of flight. Some acquire a Disc of Tzeentch; others sprout iridescent wings; others still find themselves propelled through the aether by an invisible force.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Disciples of Tzeentch

the searing eye.name: The Searing Eye
the searing eye.phase: Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit wholly within 12" of this unit
the searing eye.description:
Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll a dice. If the roll is the same as any of the dice in the casting roll, that spell is miscast. Otherwise, add the roll to the casting roll.
the searing eye.lore: This unblinking orb is said to be the eye of a Lord of Change, its purpose as much to spy on potential rivals as to reward minions with foresight of future events.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Disciples of Tzeentch

tome of scorched insight.name: Tome of Scorched Insight
tome of scorched insight.phase: Reaction: You declared a non-SUMMON SPELL ability for this unit
tome of scorched insight.description: Effect: Change the casting roll for that spell to a value of 12 that cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound and this unit cannot use that **SPELL** ability again for the rest of the battle.
tome of scorched insight.lore: This book is a double-edged gift: it grants incredible arcane prowess but at a steep price, as the book slowly consumes the bearer’s own knowledge of magic.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Disciples of Tzeentch

vision of defiant supremacy.name: Vision of Defiant Supremacy
vision of defiant supremacy.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
vision of defiant supremacy.description: Effect: If you won the priority roll this battle round and chose for your opponent to take the first turn or if your opponent seized the initiative this battle round, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
vision of defiant supremacy.lore: As the tide of battle turns, you and your brethren will find yourselves in the thick of the fighting, but you will have the upper hand.
vision of defiant supremacy.restrictionText: Visions of Fate are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST** **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units. A unit can only have 1 Vision of Fate.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Disciples of Tzeentch

vision of arcane sacrifice.name: Vision of Arcane Sacrifice
vision of arcane sacrifice.description:
Effect: While units (friendly or enemy) are within 6" of this unit:

• Add 1 to unbinding rolls for those units.
• Spells cast by those units are miscast on an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less.

The first time this unit is destroyed, gain D6 **fate points**.
vision of arcane sacrifice.lore: All around you, incantations will wither on lips and spells will backfire catastrophically – until the moment of your fated demise.
vision of arcane sacrifice.restrictionText: Visions of Fate are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST** **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units. A unit can only have 1 Vision of Fate.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Disciples of Tzeentch

vision of destined conquest.name: Vision of Destined Conquest
vision of destined conquest.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Your Turn
vision of destined conquest.description:
Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective that you control that is wholly outside friendly territory:

• If you are the **underdog**, gain 1 **fate point** for each command point you have.
• If you are not the **underdog**, roll a dice for each command point you have. For each 3+, gain 1 **fate point**.
vision of destined conquest.lore: The winds of fate will blow strong as you and your warriors overrun a site of import deep in enemy lands.
vision of destined conquest.restrictionText: Visions of Fate are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST** **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units. A unit can only have 1 Vision of Fate.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Disciples of Tzeentch

transformed to spawn.name: Transformed to Spawn
transformed to spawn.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain by this ability, you can pick a friendly **CHAOS SPAWN OF TZEENTCH** unit that is **masked by illusion** and set it up on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.
transformed to spawn.lore: Tzeentch is the Changer of the Ways; to be in the presence of his minions risks being mutated into a Chaos Spawn.

bolt of tzeentch.name: Bolt of Tzeentch
bolt of tzeentch.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
bolt of tzeentch.lore: This spell manifests as a prismatic beam of raw magic that tears its victims apart in a display of multispectral colour.

fold reality.name: Fold Reality
fold reality.description:
Declare: Pick a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then you can pick a friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set the target up in reserve **masked by illusion.** Then, you can pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** and set it up wholly within 12" of the caster or a friendly **Argent Shard** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Both parts of the effect are optional; you can carry out either part or both.*
fold reality.lore: The sorcerer contorts the very fabric of the cosmos, allowing their minions to slip from hither to thither in an eye-blink.

summon burning sigil of tzeentch.name: Summon Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
summon burning sigil of tzeentch.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summon burning sigil of tzeentch.lore: Brief incantations in the Dark Tongue see these burning symbols of worship spark into reality.

summon tome of eyes.name: Summon Tome of Eyes
summon tome of eyes.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Tome of Eyes** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Tome of Eyes** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon tome of eyes.lore: With a snap of the conjurer’s fingers, the Tome appears at their side from a spark of blue wyrdflame.

summon daemonic simulacrum.name: Summon Daemonic Simulacrum
summon daemonic simulacrum.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Daemonic Simulacrum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Daemonic Simulacrum** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon daemonic simulacrum.lore: The wizard draws upon their understanding of change-lore to create a temporary portal for this mirage to enter the fray.

infernal gateway.name: Infernal Gateway
infernal gateway.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll either 5 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of **fate points** you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
infernal gateway.lore: The sorcerer opens a portal to the Realm of Chaos, pulling enemies to their doom.

shield of fate.name: Shield of Fate
shield of fate.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• ﻿﻿The target has **WARD (5+)**.
﻿﻿• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit.
shield of fate.lore: There is little better protection than to be guided by destiny itself and to be defended by the very hand of fate.

wyrdflame haze.name: Wyrdflame Haze
wyrdflame haze.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while those friendly units are wholly within 12" of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was set up in the same turn.
wyrdflame haze.lore: The caster causes the smoke from arcane blazes to linger on the battlefield, obscuring those lurking within.

formations.name: Malevolent Schemers
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, gain 1 **fate point**.

ability.name: Inevitable Ending
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, gain 1 **fate point**.
ability.lore: It is the duty of some simply to die, for their lifeblood will grease the ever‑turning cogs of fate.

abilities.name: Inevitable Ending
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, gain 1 **fate point**.
abilities.lore: It is the duty of some simply to die, for their lifeblood will grease the ever‑turning cogs of fate.

formations.name: Mutants and Mad Things
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Hideous Unpredictability
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.lore: Tzeentch’s strange blessings allow his malformed servants to outmanoeuvre and outflank their prey.

abilities.name: Hideous Unpredictability
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Tzeentch’s strange blessings allow his malformed servants to outmanoeuvre and outflank their prey.

formations.name: Denizens of the Silver Towers
formations.description:
Effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses an ability that requires you to spend 1 or more **fate points**, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

If you remove 1 or more damage points from the damage pool of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit as a result of the ‘Destined to Serve’ ability, after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

ability.name: Twist of Fate
ability.description:
Effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses an ability that requires you to spend 1 or more **fate points**, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

If you remove 1 or more damage points from the damage pool of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit as a result of the ‘Destined to Serve’ ability, after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.
ability.lore: Those who dwell within the Silver Towers are suffused by an aura of fate‑altering magic.

abilities.name: Twist of Fate
abilities.description:
Effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses an ability that requires you to spend 1 or more **fate points**, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

If you remove 1 or more damage points from the damage pool of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit as a result of the ‘Destined to Serve’ ability, after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.
abilities.lore: Those who dwell within the Silver Towers are suffused by an aura of fate‑altering magic.

formations.name: Masters of Fate
formations.description: Effect: Friendly **ARCANITE** units’ melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit.

ability.name: Symbiotic Madness
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **ARCANITE** units’ melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit.
ability.lore: Arcanites who battle alongside the daemons of their manipulative deity receive maddening glimpses of the twisting strands of fate, allowing them to take advantage of fleeting gaps in their foes’ defences in the press of combat.

abilities.name: Symbiotic Madness
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **ARCANITE** units’ melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit.
abilities.lore: Arcanites who battle alongside the daemons of their manipulative deity receive maddening glimpses of the twisting strands of fate, allowing them to take advantage of fleeting gaps in their foes’ defences in the press of combat.

formations.sourcePublication: Scourge of Ghyran: Disciples of Tzeentch

formations.name: Spellweaver Coven
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** that is in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can use a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, but only the caster or enemy units in combat with the caster can be picked to be the targets of that **SPELL** ability.

ability.name: Sorcerers of War
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** that is in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can use a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, but only the caster or enemy units in combat with the caster can be picked to be the targets of that **SPELL** ability.
ability.lore: These champions of Tzeentch bring the fires of change directly to their god’s foes, revelling in the infinite fractals of fate that spiral from the madness of a melee.

abilities.name: Sorcerers of War
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** that is in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can use a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, but only the caster or enemy units in combat with the caster can be picked to be the targets of that **SPELL** ability.
abilities.lore: These champions of Tzeentch bring the fires of change directly to their god’s foes, revelling in the infinite fractals of fate that spiral from the madness of a melee.

formations.sourcePublication: Scourge of Ghyran: Disciples of Tzeentch

formations.name: Fated Blades
formations.description: Effect: If you make a charge roll of 9+ for a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Cometh the Hour
ability.description: Effect: If you make a charge roll of 9+ for a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: As moment of preordained glory, these warriors attack with renewed zeal.

abilities.name: Cometh the Hour
abilities.description: Effect: If you make a charge roll of 9+ for a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As moment of preordained glory, these warriors attack with renewed zeal.

spell eater pendant.name: Spell-Eater Pendant
spell eater pendant.description: Effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell or banishes an enemy **MANIFESTATION**, gain 1 **fate point**.
spell eater pendant.lore: This amulet devours magic and channels it to empower its bearer.

call of anarchy.name: Call of Anarchy
call of anarchy.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit, then pick a friendly non-**HERO CHANGE-CULT** unit that is **masked by illusion** or that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: If you picked a unit that is **masked by illusion**, set it up wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.

If you picked a unit that has been destroyed, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Units can be set up in reserve masked by illusion using the Fatemaster’s ‘Long in the Planning’ ability.*
call of anarchy.lore: As the uprising swells, its architect calls forth more cultists to join the anarchy.

puppet on a string.name: Puppet on a String
puppet on a string.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
puppet on a string.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE-CULT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **CORE** ability, gain 1 **fate point**.

**Designer’s Note:** *You can only gain fate points using this ability and the ‘Spell-eater Pendant’ ability.*
puppet on a string.lore: Whether they know it or not, the enemy hero serves the will of Tzeentch.

illusory infiltration.name: Illusory Infiltration
illusory infiltration.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-reinforced **CHANGE-CULT KAIRIC ACOLYTES** units to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and not in combat.
illusory infiltration.lore: Cunning glamours conceal the advance of Kairic cultists.

overtaken by events.name: Overtaken by Events
overtaken by events.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
overtaken by events.description:
Declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy unit within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE‑CULT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
overtaken by events.lore: Stricken by indecision, the enemy’s leader flails helplessly.

seeds of discord.name: Seeds of Discord
seeds of discord.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
seeds of discord.description:
Declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy model within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE-CULT HERO** to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target’s combat range to be the victim.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.
seeds of discord.lore: Cunning lies and misdirections cause infighting amongst the foe.

silver simulacrum.name: Silver Simulacrum
silver simulacrum.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
silver simulacrum.lore: Like some amorphous organism, an Argent Shard splits in two to double its arcane potency.

shifting manifestations.name: Shifting Manifestations
shifting manifestations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHANGE-CULT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**

Effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.
shifting manifestations.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

eldritch strength.name: Eldritch Strength
eldritch strength.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHANGE-CULT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CHANGE-CULT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
eldritch strength.lore: The caster imbues their minions with supernatural might.

nexus of fate.name: Nexus of Fate
nexus of fate.description: Effect: Roll a dice. If you have 9 unspent **destiny dice**, you must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll. Otherwise, place that dice to one side as a **destiny dice**.
nexus of fate.lore: Tzeentch’s favoured servants manipulate what mortals consider ‘destiny’ as if it were a puppet.
nexus of fate.groupName: The Oracles of Fate Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate

corrupted leystone.name: Corrupted Leystone
corrupted leystone.description: Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again contesting an objective and more than 7" from all enemy units.
corrupted leystone.lore: This obsidian stone is attuned to sites of arcane power, allowing the bearer to teleport between ley lines.
corrupted leystone.groupName: The Oracles of Fate Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate

ninefold blessings.name: Ninefold Blessings
ninefold blessings.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn
ninefold blessings.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if the total value of your unspent **destiny dice** is exactly 9.

Effect: Re-roll all of your unspent **destiny dice**. Then, until the start of your next turn:

• Friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** units have **WARD (5+)**.
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Add together the values shown on each unspent destiny dice to find the total value.*
ninefold blessings.lore: Nine is the sacred number of Tzeentch and presages great victories and glories for his servants.
ninefold blessings.groupName: The Oracles of Fate Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate

masters of destiny.name: Masters of Destiny
masters of destiny.description:
Effect: Roll 9 dice and place them to one side. These are your **destiny dice**. **Destiny dice** can be spent during the battle to change certain dice rolls. You can never have more than 9 **destiny dice** at once.

During the battle, instead of making a roll from the list below for a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** unit, you can spend your **destiny dice**. The roll you would have made is replaced with the roll on the **destiny dice** you spend. If you want to replace a 2D6 roll, 3D6 roll, etc. you must spend a number of destiny dice equal to the number before ‘D6’. Any rolls that have been replaced count as unmodified rolls, and they cannot be re-rolled or modified by other friendly abilities except for those that apply negative modifiers (but they can be modified by enemy abilities). You cannot spend destiny dice to replace re-rolls.

**Destiny dice** can be spent in place of the following dice rolls:

• Casting rolls
• Unbinding rolls
• Banishment rolls
• Run rolls
• Charge rolls in your turn
• Hit rolls
• Wound rolls
• Save rolls
masters of destiny.lore: To serve the Changer of the Ways is to instinctively understand the ebb and flow of future events and be able to manipulate their potential to the fullest.
masters of destiny.groupName: The Oracles of Fate Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate

fateweaver s gift.name: Fateweaver's Gift
fateweaver s gift.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Change the Past:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the caster, that is in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. Roll either 4 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of unspent destiny dice you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
***Seize the Present:*** Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
***Predict the Future:*** Roll a dice. You must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll.
fateweaver s gift.lore: Kairos can bestow his extraordinary insight into the past and future upon those he considers worthy.

shifting manifestations.name: Shifting Manifestations
shifting manifestations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly Manifestations below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**

Effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.
shifting manifestations.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

lores.name: The Oracles of Fate Spell Lore
The Oracles of Fate Manifestation Lore

calculated feint.name: Calculated Feint
calculated feint.description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **CAVALRY** units by **RETREAT** abilities.
calculated feint.lore: To the Ossiarch legions, battle is but a plan to be enacted, each part meticulously choreographed down to the last detail.

kavalos lance.name: Kavalos Lance
kavalos lance.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
kavalos lance.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can pass across enemy models as if it had **FLY.**
kavalos lance.lore: These warriors form the tip of the spear, crashing through enemy formations with terrifying ease.

contingent arrival.name: Contingent Arrival
contingent arrival.description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
contingent arrival.lore: Marching in perfect unison, a reinforcing unit of Mortek Guard arrives.

relentless discipline.name: Relentless Discipline
relentless discipline.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.

Effect: Make a **discipline roll** of D6. Add I to the roll if the target is wholly within 12" of your general. On a 4+, pick 1 of the effects below:

• **Your Movement Phase:** Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the phase.

• **Your Charge Phase:** Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.

• **Any Combat Phase:** Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by the target for the rest of the phase.

• **Any Combat Phase:** The target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the phase.
relentless discipline.lore: The Ossiarchs are infamous for their cohesive discipline.

dread descent.name: Dread Descent
dread descent.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
dread descent.description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
dread descent.lore: There are fewer more unwelcome sights to an enemy than the arrival of one of the Great Necromancer's heralds.

manufactured mind.name: Manufactured Mind
manufactured mind.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round
manufactured mind.description: Effect: When picking a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO** to be the target of the 'Immortal Elite' ability this battle round, you can pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO** that has been destroyed.
manufactured mind.lore: This commander's soul-stuff is a blend of some of the realms' finest military minds. This grants them moments of unparalleled insight, even in the face of utter disaster and the complete dissolution of the chain of command.

immaculate defender.name: Immaculate Defender
immaculate defender.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY** unit in the combat phase while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
immaculate defender.lore: This warlord knows precisely how to maximise the peerless resilience of the Ossiarch Bonereapers through defensive formations and overlapping shieldwalls.

imperious will.name: Imperious Will
imperious will.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for a non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
imperious will.description: Effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that non-**HERO** unit and that did not charge this turn to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **FIGHT** ability.
imperious will.lore: The exacting leadership of this commander inspires their cohorts of Ossiarch soldiery to fight with a ruthless determination to utterly vanquish the enemy.

amulet of gnosis.name: Amulet of Gnosis
amulet of gnosis.description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units by **RETREAT** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
amulet of gnosis.lore: This talisman contains the siphoned intellects of many esteemed martial leaders distilled into a single black gemstone, which bestows upon the bearer the knowledge of a thousand battles. Such military acumen ensures any troops under their command will act with supreme precision on the battlefield.

shard of necris.name: Shard of Necris
shard of necris.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4 and this unit did not charge in the same turn, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
shard of necris.lore: This ancient shard is a fragment of the armour known as the Necris Infinus. Though it was shattered in a war long ago, the remaining piece is still imbued with the darkest of Shyishan sorceries. Once worn by Haakesh the Indomitable and Kheramet the Undying, its potent magics render the wearer almost invulnerable. Almost...

blade of the nadir.name: Blade of the Nadir
blade of the nadir.description: Effect: Pick 1 of this unit's non-**Companion** melee weapons. For the rest of the battle, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made with that weapon, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
blade of the nadir.lore: Compressed to a barely visible sliver by the metaphysical weight of the Shyish Nadir itself, this weapon is so incomparably sharp that flesh and steel dissolves around it as it sweeps through enemy ranks.

pitiless assault.name: Pitiless Assault
pitiless assault.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for a unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase
pitiless assault.description:
Used By: The unit using that **FIGHT** ability.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability.
pitiless assault.lore: The Bonereapers deliver blows that make a mockery of enemy defences.
pitiless assault.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

immortal elite.name: Immortal Elite
immortal elite.phase: Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
immortal elite.description:
Declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HEROES** on the battlefield. Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO** to be the target.

Effect: You gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number after the target's **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent **relentless discipline** points are lost.
immortal elite.lore: The Ossiarch legions march to war in perfect unison, efficiently and precisely enacting the will of their generals without the mortal inadequacies of doubt, fear or regret.
immortal elite.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

ruthless extermination.name: Ruthless Extermination
ruthless extermination.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for a unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase
ruthless extermination.description:
Used By: The unit using that **SHOOT** ability.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Subtract l from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **SHOOT** ability.
ruthless extermination.lore: With the enemy fully engaged, the Ossiarchs send a hail of fire raining down on them with cold efficiency.
ruthless extermination.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

remorseless march.name: Remorseless March
remorseless march.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to use this ability.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of that unit for the rest of the phase. That unit cannot use **RUN** abilities for the rest of the turn.
remorseless march.lore: The Ossiarchs advance into battle swiftly and mercilessly.
remorseless march.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

impassive retreat.name: Impassive Retreat
impassive retreat.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to use this ability.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
impassive retreat.lore: The Bonereapers disengage and charge back into the fray, heedless of any losses sustained by their own ranks.
impassive retreat.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

inviolate legions.name: Inviolate Legions
inviolate legions.description:
Used By: A friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit targeted by that **ATTACK** ability. Friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units can use this ability more than once per phase.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. That unit has **WARD (5+)** against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability.
inviolate legions.lore: Ossiarch warriors snap into defensive formations that grant them even greater resilience.
inviolate legions.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

perpetually empowered weapons.name: Perpetually Empowered Weapons
perpetually empowered weapons.description: Effect: This unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
perpetually empowered weapons.lore: The Mortisans have permanently imbued these constructs’ and their steeds’ weapons with deadly power.
perpetually empowered weapons.restrictionText: Mortisan Refinements are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Mortisan Refinement.

elongated tibias.name: Elongated Tibias
elongated tibias.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.
elongated tibias.lore: These Bonereapers have considerably longer leg bones than many other constructs, allowing for greater bursts of speed on the charge.
elongated tibias.restrictionText: Mortisan Refinements are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Mortisan Refinement.

utterly unquestioning.name: Utterly Unquestioning
utterly unquestioning.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 5+, subtract 1 from the number of **relentless discipline** points that must be spent to use that ability.
utterly unquestioning.lore: The spirit-essence in these Ossiarchs’ soultrap gems is derived from the most loyal of ancient seneschals.
utterly unquestioning.restrictionText: Mortisan Refinements are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Mortisan Refinement.

banner of old ossia.name: Banner of Old Ossia
banner of old ossia.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Rally’ command for a visible **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
banner of old ossia.description:
Effect: When resolving that command, you can spend rally points in the following additional ways:

•  For each rally point spent, **Heal (1)** another visible friendly non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
•  You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
banner of old ossia.lore: Imbued with a similar enchantment to Katakros’s personal standard, the bearer of this banner can direct the repair and reconstruction of Ossiarch warriors across the battlefield, ensuring that each cohort is at optimal strength.

scarabaean cloak.name: Scarabaean Cloak
scarabaean cloak.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
scarabaean cloak.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
scarabaean cloak.lore: This writhing mantle is formed of thousands of osseous scarabs that can take flight as one, carrying the wearer into the air.

soulweb gem.name: Soulweb Gem
soulweb gem.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
soulweb gem.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it was destroyed this turn.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to this unit on the battlefield wholly within friendly territory and not in combat. Then, allocate a number of damage points to the replacement unit equal to its Health characteristic minus 1 (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
soulweb gem.lore: This construct bears a mastercrafted soultrap gem that has been magically bound to that of a chosen vassal. Should they fall, their animus can inhabit their subordinate’s form, usually at a safer distance from the foe.

soul claim.name: Soul-Claim
soul claim.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of that **WIZARD** to be a friendly target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. If any models are slain by this ability, pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (3)** the friendly target.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
soul claim.lore: The caster drains the spirit-essence from the foe, repurposing it to imbue their constructs with animus.

bolster creation.name: Bolster Creation
bolster creation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase.
bolster creation.lore: Power flowing from their talons, the Mortisan hardens the osseous frames of their crafted soldiers.

invigorate the ranks.name: Invigorate the Ranks
invigorate the ranks.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
invigorate the ranks.lore: The Mortisan pours energy into nearby soldiers, multiplying their combat prowess thricefold.

summon bone tithe shrieker.name: Summon Bone-tithe Shrieker
summon bone tithe shrieker.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bone‑tithe Shrieker** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bone-tithe Shrieker** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon bone tithe shrieker.lore: The caster conjures a four-headed, all-seeing monstrosity to hunt down those who would escape the Ossiarch tithe.

summon soulstealer carrion.name: Summon Soulstealer Carrion
summon soulstealer carrion.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Soulstealer Carrion** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Soulstealer Carrion** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon soulstealer carrion.lore: Soaring from its caster’s spread fingertips, the Soulstealer Carrion takes wing above the battlefield.

summon nightmare predator.name: Summon Nightmare Predator
summon nightmare predator.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Nightmare Predator** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Nightmare Predator** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon nightmare predator.lore: The Nightmare Predator is a looming conjuration of Shyishan magic that takes the form of a disturbing terror.

empower nadirite weapons.name: Empower Nadirite Weapons
empower nadirite weapons.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn. If all of the target's non-**Companion** melee weapons had **Crit (2 Hits)** when they were picked to be the target of this ability, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.

Friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units can be affected by this ability multiple times.
empower nadirite weapons.lore: Mortisans imbue the Bonereapers' blades with deadly power, acting in concert to increase the weapons' lethality to truly fearsome levels.

immolating flames.name: Immolating Flames
immolating flames.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
immolating flames.lore: The caster wreathes an Ossiarch cohort in dark, flaming magic that discharges in a burst of fiery energy should any of their number be felled.

drain vitality.name: Drain Vitality
drain vitality.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.
drain vitality.lore: This cursed spell saps a foe’s strength, leaving them weak and vulnerable.

formations.name: The Inevitable Empire
formations.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.

ability.name: Silent Empire
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.
ability.lore: To invade the Ossiarch Empire is to enter a realm of doleful columns, grim architecture and deathly silence.

abilities.name: Silent Empire
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.
abilities.lore: To invade the Ossiarch Empire is to enter a realm of doleful columns, grim architecture and deathly silence.

formations.name: Border Guards
formations.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.

ability.name: Grim Sentinels
ability.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.
ability.lore: The borders of the Ossiarch Empire stretch across continents in every Mortal Realm, and they are ever expanding ...

abilities.name: Grim Sentinels
abilities.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.
abilities.lore: The borders of the Ossiarch Empire stretch across continents in every Mortal Realm, and they are ever expanding ...

formations.name: Remorseless Conquerors
formations.description:
Used By: The unit using that **RUN** ability.

Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: Unfaltering Pace
ability.phase: Reaction: You declared a **RUN** ability for a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit
ability.description:
Used By: The unit using that **RUN** ability.

Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
ability.lore: The soldiers of the Ossiarch legions neither rest nor tire; their expansions are limited only to the availability of osseous matter with which to create fresh soldiers.

abilities.name: Unfaltering Pace
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a **RUN** ability for a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit
abilities.description:
Used By: The unit using that **RUN** ability.

Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
abilities.lore: The soldiers of the Ossiarch legions neither rest nor tire; their expansions are limited only to the availability of osseous matter with which to create fresh soldiers.

formations.name: Hekatos Drillmasters
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY** unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **WARD (5+)**.
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks.
• The target’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.

ability.name: Disciplined Hekatoi
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY** unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **WARD (5+)**.
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks.
• The target’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
ability.lore: Crafted with specially selected soul-stuff from skilled officers, the Hekatoi of this legion exhibit an unusual degree of battlefield initiative.

abilities.name: Disciplined Hekatoi
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY** unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **WARD (5+)**.
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks.
• The target’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
abilities.lore: Crafted with specially selected soul-stuff from skilled officers, the Hekatoi of this legion exhibit an unusual degree of battlefield initiative.

formations.name: Ruthless Legion
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that charged this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Nadirite Wedge
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that charged this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: As the attacking speartip of the Ossiarch legions drive home their charge, enemy defences quail and then shatter outright.

abilities.name: Nadirite Wedge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that charged this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As the attacking speartip of the Ossiarch legions drive home their charge, enemy defences quail and then shatter outright.

formations.name: Tithe Guards
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 visible friendly non-**FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units wholly within 12" of that **WIZARD** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (X)** the target where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic equal to or less than the roll.

ability.name: Plentiful Bone
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 visible friendly non-**FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units wholly within 12" of that **WIZARD** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (X)** the target where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic equal to or less than the roll.
ability.lore: Guarded supply lines provide this force with near-limitless bone reserves, allowing for swift repair of damaged constructs.

abilities.name: Plentiful Bone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 visible friendly non-**FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units wholly within 12" of that **WIZARD** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (X)** the target where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic equal to or less than the roll.
abilities.lore: Guarded supply lines provide this force with near-limitless bone reserves, allowing for swift repair of damaged constructs.

blood smeared hooves.name: Blood-smeared Hooves
blood smeared hooves.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that charged this turn and has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons, including **Companion** weapons, for the rest of the turn.
blood smeared hooves.lore: As the charge crashes home, Zandtos's rage infects even his warriors' mounts, who grind the enemy to pulp beneath their hooves.
blood smeared hooves.groupName: The Lance of Ossia Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Lance of Ossia

fury of zandtos.name: Fury of Zandtos
fury of zandtos.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that charged this turn and that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. The target's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
fury of zandtos.lore: Zandtos's ire burns so brightly that his warriors are fuelled by a bloodlust usually absent among the cold and brutal Ossiarchs.
fury of zandtos.groupName: The Lance of Ossia Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Lance of Ossia

vengeful outriders.name: Vengeful Outriders
vengeful outriders.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the phase.
vengeful outriders.lore: Zandtos hurls his forces towards the enemy with unchecked fury.
vengeful outriders.groupName: The Lance of Ossia Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Lance of Ossia

praetorian elite.name: Praetorian Elite
praetorian elite.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
praetorian elite.description:
Declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA HEROES** on the battlefield. Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA HERO** to be the target.

Effect: You gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number shown after the target's **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent **relentless discipline** points are lost.
praetorian elite.lore: The Lance of Ossia ride to war in perfect unison, efficiently and precisely enacting Zandtos's will without the mortal inadequacies of doubt, fear or regret.
praetorian elite.groupName: The Lance of Ossia Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Lance of Ossia

silent menace.name: Silent Menace
silent menace.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. The target cannot use the 'Redeploy' command for the rest of the turn.
silent menace.lore: As the thundering charge of the Lance of Ossia bears down upon the foe, their unblinking witchlight stares and deathly silence can unnerve even the most stalwart of enemies.
silent menace.groupName: The Lance of Ossia Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Lance of Ossia

kavalos lance.name: Kavalos Lance
kavalos lance.description: Effect: When a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit uses the 'Power Through' command, the target does not have to have a lower Health characteristic than that friendly unit.
kavalos lance.lore: Those who fight with Zandtos want nothing more than to carve a red path through those who would defile their lord's domain.
kavalos lance.groupName: The Lance of Ossia Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Lance of Ossia

helm of tyranny.name: Helm of Tyranny
helm of tyranny.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
helm of tyranny.lore: This helm radiates the oppressive will of the wearer, filling nearby foes with supernatural dread.
helm of tyranny.groupName: The Lance of Ossia Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Lance of Ossia

prevailing tactician.name: Prevailing Tactician
prevailing tactician.description: Effect: If a friendly **Arch-Kavalos Zandtos** is not wholly within 12" of this unit, you gain 2 **relentless discipline** points.
prevailing tactician.lore: As one of Zandtos's direct subordinates, this Liege-Kavalos knows well how to lead the host while their lord engages in the more pressing business of egregious slaughter.
prevailing tactician.groupName: The Lance of Ossia Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Lance of Ossia

gothizzar cartouche.name: Gothizzar Cartouche
gothizzar cartouche.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.
gothizzar cartouche.lore: Inscribed by Nagash himself, this cartouche is emblematic of the hatred the dead have for the living and stokes their desire for revenge.
gothizzar cartouche.groupName: The Null Myriad Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Null Myriad

arcane immunity.name: Arcane Immunity
arcane immunity.description: Effect: Friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units have **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS.**
arcane immunity.lore: Forged to fight wars at the Perimeter Inimical, the Null Myriad are innately resistant to even the most potent magic.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Null Myriad

supernatural absorption.name: Supernatural Absorption
supernatural absorption.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
supernatural absorption.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MANIFESTATION** within a friendly **NULL MYRIAD** unit's combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• The target is banished and removed from play.
• If that friendly unit is damaged, **Heal (X)** that friendly unit, where **X** is the target's Health characteristic.
• If that friendly unit is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to **X,** where **X** is the target's Health characteristic.
supernatural absorption.lore: The runes carved into the warriors of the Null Myriad flare into life, absorbing hostile manifestations to power the regeneration of damaged constructs.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Null Myriad

first of the mortarchs.name: First of the Mortarchs
first of the mortarchs.description:
Effect: Each time you make a casting roll for a friendly **Arkhan the Black,** if all the following are true, that spell cannot be unbound:

• The unmodified casting roll contains 2 or more results of the same value.
• The casting roll equals or exceeds the spell's casting value.
• The spell is not miscast.
first of the mortarchs.lore: Arkhan the Black is the closest thing to a truly trustworthy agent of the Great Necromancer. His loyalty, never in question, has been rewarded with access to mystical power above and beyond his quarrelsome peers.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Null Myriad

aura of enervation.name: Aura of Enervation
aura of enervation.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
aura of enervation.lore: Ending magics shroud this hero, sapping the force from arrows and other projectiles.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Null Myriad

reinforce construct.name: Reinforce Construct
reinforce construct.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NULL MYRIAD WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NULL MYRIAD** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
reinforce construct.lore: The Null Myriad are strengthened against the corrosive magic of the realms' wilds, and this endurance can be magnified to resist more terrestrial damage.

unearthly aura.name: Unearthly Aura
unearthly aura.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NULL MYRIAD WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NULL MYRIAD** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.
unearthly aura.lore: The caster takes the powerful magical defences of the Null Myriad and inverts them, allowing their weapons to effortlessly cleave through magical defences.

summon horror of the necropolis.name: Summon Horror of the Necropolis
summon horror of the necropolis.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NULL MYRIAD WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

• **Soulstealer Carrion**
• **Bone-tithe Shrieker**
• **Nightmare Predator**

Effect: Set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon horror of the necropolis.lore: The Mortisans of the Null Myriad are masters in manipulating the horrors that inhabit the furthest reaches of the realms.

the hunger.name: The Hunger
the hunger.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **VAMPIRE** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after all of its attacks have been resolved, **Heal (X)** that **VAMPIRE** unit where **X** is the number of damage points allocated by those attacks.
the hunger.lore: Those who bear the Soulblight Curse constantly crave blood and are empowered by feasting upon their foes.

the hunger.name: The Hunger
the hunger.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
the hunger.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **VAMPIRE** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** each target. **Heal (2D3)** the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a **FIGHT** ability.
the hunger.lore: Soulblight vampires are revitalised by feasting upon the blood of their foes.
the hunger.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

swoop down.name: Swoop Down
swoop down.description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
swoop down.lore: The sky darkens as the Vargheists descend.

unbending will.name: Unbending Will
unbending will.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add D6 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
unbending will.lore: This immortal tyrant and their minions are a force of unliving conquest like no other.

lash of the sire.name: Lash of the Sire
lash of the sire.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+:

•  If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
•  If the target is in combat, it can make a pile‑in move.
lash of the sire.lore: Such is the domineering force of this undead overlord’s willpower that it can imbue nearby vassals with sudden impetus.

unhinged rampager.name: Unhinged Rampager
unhinged rampager.description: Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.
unhinged rampager.lore: This creature’s bestial hunger sees them close on the foe without hesitation.

the rising dead.name: The Rising Dead
the rising dead.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
the rising dead.description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
the rising dead.lore: Clawing their way through the soil and rock, more undead warriors join the fight.

the rising dead.name: The Rising Dead
the rising dead.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **in the grave**.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** and more than 9" from all enemy units, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.
the rising dead.lore: Clawing their way through the soil and rock, more undead warriors join the fight.
the rising dead.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

aura of antiquity.name: Aura of Antiquity
aura of antiquity.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
aura of antiquity.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly units to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
aura of antiquity.lore: Prolonged exposure to the necrotic energies that animate these Deathrattle warriors can cause the equipment of their foes to corrode and crumble with unnatural speed.

shard of night.name: Shard of Night
shard of night.description: Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).
shard of night.lore: This undead lord’s armour was crafted using elements of an abyssal stalker and grants the bearer that awful creature’s shadowy aura.

terminus clock.name: Terminus Clock
terminus clock.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 18" of this unit.
terminus clock.lore: Created by a mad clockwright of Ulfenkarn, this bizarre cogwork piece ticks without rhyme or reason. Whenever its eclectic count ends, however, the power of magic seems to deaden across the field.

amulet of graves.name: Amulet of Graves
amulet of graves.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
amulet of graves.description: Effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield, set up a **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
amulet of graves.lore: The bearer of this amulet can call upon a long-dead soul in Shyish, manifesting their final resting place onto the battlefield in a storm of necromantic energy.

ancient burial sites.name: Ancient Burial Sites
ancient burial sites.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note**: *The original* **Cursed Sepulchre** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
ancient burial sites.lore: Across the Mortal Realms stand time-worn mausoleums and barrows, housing the remains of the long dead.
ancient burial sites.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

deathly invocation.name: Deathly Invocation
deathly invocation.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
deathly invocation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** units wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
deathly invocation.lore: Skilled wielders of death magic can summon hordes of undead.
deathly invocation.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

endless legions.name: Endless Legions
endless legions.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
endless legions.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.

If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **CHARGE** abilities this turn.
endless legions.lore: To the Gravelords, the dead are mere chattel to be raised and expended.
endless legions.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

the unquiet dead.name: The Unquiet Dead
the unquiet dead.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the grave**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the grave** than there are on the battlefield.
the unquiet dead.lore: Animated by necromancy, the undead rise from their graves, balefire eyes blazing with dark purpose.
the unquiet dead.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

immortal ego.name: Immortal Ego
immortal ego.description: Effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
