immortal ego.lore: Few mortals would claim to be the mightiest slayer in the Mortal Realms or to have a peerless mastery of the blade, given the existence of gods, daemons, demigods and more besides.

immortal ego.name: Immortal Ego
immortal ego.description: Effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
immortal ego.lore: Few mortals would claim to be the mightiest slayer in the Mortal Realms or to have a peerless mastery of the blade, given the existence of gods, daemons, demigods and more besides. This unliving paragon’s ego has no such frailties.

a wastrel and a vagabond.name: A Wastrel and a Vagabond
a wastrel and a vagabond.description:
Effect: While a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** or **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Add 2 to run rolls for that unit.
• Add 3" to the distance that unit can move when it piles in.
a wastrel and a vagabond.lore: This spiteful creature is an embarrassment to their undead peers: perhaps a vampire fallen from favour, a wight who failed in their duty to their king, or a Necromancer who pushed their luck one time too many. Regardless of the reason, they seem to have an affinity with the basest undead minions.

frightening vitality.name: Frightening Vitality
frightening vitality.description: Effect: Each time an ability would heal exactly 1 or 2 of this unit’s damage points, heal 3 damage points instead.
frightening vitality.lore: This deathless champion is an undead juggernaut, capable of a type of regeneration that is rare even amongst the ranks of the unliving.

the empty graveyard.name: The Empty Graveyard
the empty graveyard.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 7" of a terrain feature or wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge. This unit cannot use **MOVE** abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.
the empty graveyard.lore: Folks tell of a cemetery where the day after a mass funeral, each newly filled burial plot was found empty, with footprints leading away from them into the wilds...
the empty graveyard.restrictionText: Origins of Terrifying Folk Tales are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Origin of Terrifying Folk Tales

the never dead.name: The Never-Dead
the never dead.description:
Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for an attack that targets this unit, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends
the never dead.lore: It is said that there is a rampaging band of warriors who yearn for the sweet release of death, but as punishment for transgressions past, Elder Bones refuses to let them die.
the never dead.restrictionText: Origins of Terrifying Folk Tales are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Origin of Terrifying Folk Tales

the incarnadine killers.name: The Incarnadine Killers
the incarnadine killers.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat and an enemy unit was destroyed by its combat attacks this turn, this unit can move up to D6". It can end that move in combat.
the incarnadine killers.lore: Beware the Incarnadine Killers, for they are cursed with an insatiable lust for slaughter. Do not think that distance shall keep you safe; should you spy their bloodied forms upon the horizon one moment, their blades will be lodged in your throat the next.
the incarnadine killers.restrictionText: Origins of Terrifying Folk Tales are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Origin of Terrifying Folk Tales

furious endings.name: Furious Endings
furious endings.description: Effect: Each time a **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit is removed from play, gain 1 **rage dice**.
furious endings.lore: This being can harness the power created when Shyishan and Aqshian magics mingle, which often occurs when arcane manifestations meet their end in the Bright Realm.

eternal thrall.name: Eternal Thrall
eternal thrall.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly non-**UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:
• If this unit is a **Necromancer**, add 1 to this unit’s power level.
• If this unit is a **VAMPIRE**, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
• If this unit is **DEATHRATTLE**, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
eternal thrall.lore: Such is this warlord’s notoriety that they have acquired something of a cult following. One of their most ardent supporters is renowned in their own right, and they bask in the adulation of this follower the most.

summon hand of nagash.name: Summon Hand of Nagash
summon hand of nagash.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Hand of Nagash** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Hand of Nagash** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon hand of nagash.lore: From out a yawning portal looms a colossal skeletal arm, infused to its cursed marrow with the magic of Shyish.

summon unholy reliquary.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
summon unholy reliquary.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Unholy Reliquary** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Unholy Reliquary** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 3" from all enemy units.
summon unholy reliquary.lore: Pulled forth from the underworlds, the remains of a long perished vampire rises from the ground amidst a vortex of death magic.

summon sanguine swarm.name: Summon Sanguine Swarm
summon sanguine swarm.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanguine Swarm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Sanguine Swarm** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Sanguine Swarm** spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
summon sanguine swarm.lore: The skies darken as screeching swarms of spectral bats descend upon the battlefield, hungry for blood.

prison of grief.name: Prison of Grief
prison of grief.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** until the start of your next turn.
prison of grief.lore: Victims of this curse relive their tragedies, their will to fight replaced by overwhelming self-pity.

waste away.name: Waste Away
waste away.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
waste away.lore: The wizard causes the muscles of the foe to atrophy, robbing them of their strength.

vile transference.name: Vile Transference
vile transference.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, **Heal (D3)** the caster.
vile transference.lore: The caster siphons the animus from nearby enemies and uses it to restore their deathless form.

formations.name: Cryptmasters
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** to be the target.

Effect: The target has **WARD (4+)** until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Unholy Site
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** to be the target.

Effect: The target has **WARD (4+)** until the start of your next turn.
ability.lore: Some gravesites have witnessed such horrors that the death magic suffusing them makes them even more difficult to cleanse of the undead’s influence.

abilities.name: Unholy Site
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** to be the target.

Effect: The target has **WARD (4+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Some gravesites have witnessed such horrors that the death magic suffusing them makes them even more difficult to cleanse of the undead’s influence.

formations.name: Skinshifters
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY VAMPIRE HERO** to be the target.

Effect: The target can move up to 12" and has **FLY** when it does so. It cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: The Speed of Death
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY VAMPIRE HERO** to be the target.

Effect: The target can move up to 12" and has **FLY** when it does so. It cannot end that move in combat.
ability.lore: Many vampires are capable of swiftly traversing nearly any terrain by assuming a different form or through the application of the sheer bestial strength and agility granted them by their curse.

abilities.name: The Speed of Death
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY VAMPIRE HERO** to be the target.

Effect: The target can move up to 12" and has **FLY** when it does so. It cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Many vampires are capable of swiftly traversing nearly any terrain by assuming a different form or through the application of the sheer bestial strength and agility granted them by their curse.

formations.name: Bacchanal of Blood
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **VAMPIRE** units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **VAMPIRE** units that charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Aristocracy of the Night
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **VAMPIRE** units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **VAMPIRE** units that charged in the same turn.
ability.lore: These vampires are expected to excel in all martial and mystical disciplines.

abilities.name: Aristocracy of the Night
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **VAMPIRE** units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **VAMPIRE** units that charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: These vampires are expected to excel in all martial and mystical disciplines.

formations.name: Deathmarch
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

ability.name: Tide of Bones and Blades
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.
ability.lore: The relentless advance of these skeletal undead can overwhelm even the most tenacious resistance.

abilities.name: Tide of Bones and Blades
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.
abilities.lore: The relentless advance of these skeletal undead can overwhelm even the most tenacious resistance.

formations.name: Legion of Shyish
formations.description: Effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability.

ability.name: Horror Unending
ability.description: Effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability.
ability.lore: The never-ending waves of deathly minions summoned by a Legion of Shyish shatter all hopes of victory for those who stand against them.

abilities.name: Horror Unending
abilities.description: Effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability.
abilities.lore: The never-ending waves of deathly minions summoned by a Legion of Shyish shatter all hopes of victory for those who stand against them.

formations.name: Deathstench Drove
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEADWALKERS** units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

ability.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEADWALKERS** units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
ability.lore: Hordes of shambling Deadwalker Zombies flow around and over their victims like a rotten tide, bearing them to the ground through sheer weight of numbers before tearing them limb from limb.

abilities.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEADWALKERS** units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Hordes of shambling Deadwalker Zombies flow around and over their victims like a rotten tide, bearing them to the ground through sheer weight of numbers before tearing them limb from limb.

chalice of the blood dragon.name: Chalice of the Blood Dragon
chalice of the blood dragon.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
chalice of the blood dragon.lore: Said to have been possessed by the Crimson Keep’s first castellan, this chalice can be drained to renew a vampire’s vigour.
chalice of the blood dragon.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep

the crimson keep.name: The Crimson Keep
the crimson keep.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Crimson Keep**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the Crimson Keep** than there are on the battlefield.
the crimson keep.lore: None can predict where the Crimson Keep will manifest next, but wherever it appears, the slaughter its occupants will wreak will be total.
the crimson keep.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep

blood rampage.name: Blood Rampage
blood rampage.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
blood rampage.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP MONSTER** that is in combat and has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: This unit can make a move of 2D6". It must end that move in combat with the target unit. Then, roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
blood rampage.lore: The nightmarish behemoths that roost among the upper spires of the Crimson Keep tear through the enemy’s ranks, sending bloody chunks and gore flying in all directions.
blood rampage.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep

carve a bloody path.name: Carve A Bloody Path
carve a bloody path.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can use a **CHARGE** ability even though it is in combat and even if it has already used a **CHARGE** ability this turn.
carve a bloody path.lore: With unstoppable force, a wedge of Blood Knights punches through the enemy’s lines leaving a trail of broken foes in their wake.
carve a bloody path.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep

from a quarter unseen.name: From A Quarter Unseen
from a quarter unseen.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Movement Phase
from a quarter unseen.description:
Declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick each friendly unit that is **in the Crimson Keep** to be the targets.

Effect: Set up each target wholly within 9" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you set up any units using this ability in the third or a subsequent battle round, do not spend any command points when using the ‘Carve a Bloody Path’ command this turn.
from a quarter unseen.lore: Prince Vhordrai has mastered the art of trapping the foe between his main force and reserves that sally forth from the Crimson Keep at his signal.
from a quarter unseen.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep

immortal dedication.name: Immortal Dedication
immortal dedication.description:
Effect: This unit receives D3 **martial prowess tokens**. Each **martial prowess token** can be spent to do 1 of the following:

• Re-roll a hit roll for this unit.
• Re-roll a wound roll for this unit.
• Re-roll a save roll for this unit.

At the start of the next turn, remove all this unit’s **martial prowess tokens**.
immortal dedication.lore: Having spent centuries in undeath honing their martial skill, this Gravelord is a master of combat.
immortal dedication.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep

summon unholy reliquary.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
summon unholy reliquary.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Unholy Reliquary** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Unholy Reliquary** wholly within 18" of the caster.
summon unholy reliquary.lore: Pulled forth from the underworlds, the remains of a long perished vampire rises from the ground amidst a vortex of death magic.

siphon strength.name: Siphon Strength
siphon strength.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the caster.
siphon strength.lore: The vampire draws on the life essence of the enemy to flood their limbs with strength and heighten their senses.

deathly gale.name: Deathly Gale
deathly gale.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CRIMSON KEEP** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.
deathly gale.lore: A foul wind carrying a stench of death and decay races across the battlefield, speeding the charge of the Knights of the Crimson Keep.

awakened fury.name: Awakened Fury
awakened fury.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Crimson Keep unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Companion** melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
awakened fury.lore: At the sorcerer’s gesture, hooves are wreathed in balefire and monstrous talons grow elongated and wickedly sharp.

lores.name: Knights of the Crimson Keep Manifestation Lore
Knights of the Crimson Keep Spell Lore

lord of the arcane aegis.name: Lord of the Arcane Aegis
lord of the arcane aegis.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following keywords:

• **INFANTRY**
• **CAVALRY**
• **MONSTER**
• **BEAST**

For the rest of the battle, each time an attack targets this unit, if the attacking unit has the keyword you picked, an unmodified save roll of 4+ for that attack is always successful.
lord of the arcane aegis.lore: Even in undeath, this wight still recalls all manner of warding cantrips to protect his forces from the enemy.

spirit eater.name: Spirit-eater
spirit eater.description: Effect: If any models were slain by your general this turn, **Heal (D6)** your general.
spirit eater.lore: The souls of slain enemies are drawn into this king of undeath, imbuing him with unholy might.

restless tyrant.name: Restless Tyrant
restless tyrant.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BARROW LEGION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
restless tyrant.lore: The skeletal warriors under this one’s command are driven ever forward.

crypt dagger.name: Crypt Dagger
crypt dagger.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
crypt dagger.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
crypt dagger.lore: Foul sorcery flickers and dances across the ancient iron of this cursed blade, and its bite can bring instant death.

crown of cold command.name: Crown of Cold Command
crown of cold command.phase: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
crown of cold command.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BARROW LEGION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
•  If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
crown of cold command.lore: This eldritch crown compels this king’s warriors from ages past to rise from their graves and fight once more.

grave sand pendant.name: Grave-sand Pendant
grave sand pendant.description: Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
grave sand pendant.lore: When shattered, the Shyishan realmstone within this talisman can forestall the bearer’s final destruction, granting them one last chance to claim revenge.

amulet of nightmares.name: Amulet of Nightmares
amulet of nightmares.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
amulet of nightmares.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** this phase.
amulet of nightmares.lore: The nightmares of the bearer, who endures a torturous existence trapped in their mouldering undead form, are projected into the minds of the living by this onyx talisman.

ring of stricken souls.name: Ring of Stricken Souls
ring of stricken souls.lore: Violet clouds swirl within the Shyishan amethyst set in this ring, which grants the bearer uncanny protection.

the royal crypt.name: The Royal Crypt
the royal crypt.description:
Declare: This ability must be used instead of the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain Feature’ ability.

Effect: Set up 3 **Cursed Sepulchres** wholly within friendly territory, each within ½" of any of the others and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, they have been deployed and they are considered to be a single **Cursed Sepulchre** terrain feature that has a Health characteristic of 24 instead of 8.
the royal crypt.lore: These crumbling ruins marks the ancient holdings of a powerful wight.

all to dust.name: All to Dust
all to dust.description: Effect: In the third and subsequent battle rounds, while a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** is on the battlefield, subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.
all to dust.lore: Acting as a conduit to the Shyish Nadir, the death magic that swirls around this barrow legion’s tomb causes trespassers to atrophy and their armour to corrode under the weight of ages.

endless legions of bone.name: Endless Legions of Bone
endless legions of bone.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
endless legions of bone.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE BARROW LEGION** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **BARROW LEGION HERO** or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.

If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **CHARGE** abilities this turn.
endless legions of bone.lore: When the Deathrattle armies are roused to war, their numbers are unending.

grave sentinels.name: Grave Sentinels
grave sentinels.description: Effect: The melee weapons used by friendly **BARROW LEGION** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**.
grave sentinels.lore: Unwavering in their eternal vigilance, the deathly warriors of this legion’s overlord guard his ancient resting place.

gifts to the petty kingdoms.name: Gifts to the Petty Kingdoms
gifts to the petty kingdoms.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-**UNIQUE BARROW LEGION HEROES** that do not have an artefact of power to be the targets (you can pick units in reserve).

Effect: Give each target 1 artefact of power from the ‘Barrow Legion’ Army of Renown rules.

**Designer’s Note**: *These artefacts of power are given to the* **HEROES** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
gifts to the petty kingdoms.lore: To each of his vassal kingdoms, this legion’s monarch bestowed a gift bearing a curse that bound them to his service for evermore.

recruitment drive.name: Recruitment Drive
recruitment drive.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
recruitment drive.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the **hunter** and an enemy unit with 5 or more models to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the **hunter**’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit. In addition, if the target is destroyed this turn by the **hunter**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the **hunter**’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
recruitment drive.lore: The butchery of a few peons yields a reserve of future ‘recruits’.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

seek worthy blood.name: Seek Worthy Blood
seek worthy blood.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
seek worthy blood.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)**. In addition, if the target destroys any enemy **HEROES** this turn, the target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the battle.
seek worthy blood.lore: Only the finest ichor will suffice for the vampires of Nulahmia. It is considered an art to eviscerate an enemy champion whilst collecting as much of their blood as possible.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

the queen s prize.name: The Queen's Prize
the queen s prize.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
the queen s prize.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 5 to the target’s control score.

In addition, at the end of this turn, after determining control of objectives, if the target is contesting an objective that you control and that was controlled by your opponent at the start of this turn, add 5 to the target’s control score for the rest of the battle.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

thaumic realignment.name: Thaumic Realignment
thaumic realignment.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
thaumic realignment.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly **WIZARD** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to casting rolls for the target. In addition, at the end of this turn, if the target successfully cast any spells this turn, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle.
thaumic realignment.lore: The seeding of deathly energies soon sees the fell winds rise…
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

amulet of leeches.name: Amulet of Leeches
amulet of leeches.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Dire** **Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell** **Bats** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
amulet of leeches.lore: This ancient and corroded talisman allows the wielder to draw upon the necromantic energies of their minions for protection.
amulet of leeches.groupName: Scions of Nulahmia Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

keeper of the royal menagerie.name: Keeper of the Royal Menagerie
keeper of the royal menagerie.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
keeper of the royal menagerie.lore: Those vampires who maintain the bleak menageries of Nulahmia have an instinctive bond with undead beasts.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

invocation of nulahmia.name: Invocation of Nulahmia
invocation of nulahmia.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: You can return 1 slain model to that unit.
invocation of nulahmia.lore: This ancient spell, said to hail from the sun-blasted birthplace of necromancy, is wielded by each of Neferata’s chosen.

scarlet thirst.name: Scarlet Thirst
scarlet thirst.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
scarlet thirst.lore: At the wizard’s command, a fierce compulsion to feed flares up inside the vampiric court, who eagerly await the chance to indulge their blood hunger without restraint.

thrall drain.name: Thrall Drain
thrall drain.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: D3 models in the target are slain. Then, remove all damage points from the caster.
thrall drain.lore: Vampires are consummate and ruthless survivors; they will gladly drain the energy of their subordinates in order to heal their own wounds.

leave the land in ruin.name: Leave the Land in Ruin
leave the land in ruin.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
leave the land in ruin.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature or objective that does not have a friendly **desolation token** and is contested by a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Give the target a **desolation token**.
leave the land in ruin.lore: Both raw resources and esoteric pain are needed to fuel the Helsmiths’ forge-craft, demanding they lay lands to waste.
leave the land in ruin.restrictionText: Helsmiths of Hashut armies can use the following abilities:

harness daemonic power.name: Harness Daemonic Power
harness daemonic power.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Your Turn
harness daemonic power.description:
Effect: You must use this ability at the start of each of your turns. Remove all **daemonic power points** from each friendly unit. Then, gain 1 **daemonic power point** for each friendly **desolation token** on the battlefield.

Then, allocate your daemonic power points to friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units. Each unit can have a maximum of 3 **daemonic power points**. Then, all unallocated **daemonic power points** are lost.

**Designer’s Note:** *Non*-**HOBGROT** *units have abilities that become more powerful depending on how many daemonic power points they have. We recommend using coloured dice to track the number of points each unit has.*
harness daemonic power.lore: The Helsmiths of Hashut believe themselves above the fell influence of Chaos and readily harness daemonic power to embolden their spellcraft and ensorcelled weapons.
harness daemonic power.restrictionText: Helsmiths of Hashut armies can use the following abilities:

reserves of daemonic power.name: Reserves of Daemonic Power
reserves of daemonic power.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
reserves of daemonic power.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit that has no **daemonic power points** to be the target.

Effect: Give 2 **daemonic power points** to the target.
reserves of daemonic power.lore: When venturing forth into the untainted reaches of the realms, the Helsmiths of Hashut draw upon reserves of daemonic power to establish a foothold.
reserves of daemonic power.restrictionText: Helsmiths of Hashut armies can use the following abilities:

gauntlets of punishment.name: Gauntlets of Punishment
gauntlets of punishment.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
gauntlets of punishment.lore: Cooled in the blood of duardin who sought to betray their sworn overlords, a spiteful gesture from these gauntlets can wrack a soul with unbearable pain.

crucible of spite.name: Crucible of Spite
crucible of spite.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
crucible of spite.description: Effect: Give up to 3 **daemonic power points** to this unit. However, you cannot allocate or give any more **daemonic power points** to this unit for the rest of the battle.
crucible of spite.lore: This charm, a hollowed and profane statuette of Grungni, contains raging daemon essences that can be drawn on for strength. Yet such eager blasphemy does not go unpunished…

scroll of petrification.name: Scroll of Petrification
scroll of petrification.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
scroll of petrification.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

•  The target has **WARD (2+)**.
•  The target cannot use non-passive abilities or be picked to be the target of friendly abilities.
•  Enemy units can ignore the target’s combat range for the purposes of movement and charging.
• Enemy units can ignore the target for the purposes of setting up on the battlefield but cannot be set up on the target.
scroll of petrification.lore: Though they cannot control the stone-flesh curse, the Zharrdron still believe it can be harnessed. This scroll is the result of such a belief. One who reads from it can transform themselves or their minions into stone for a fleeting moment.

breath of contempt.name: Breath of Contempt
breath of contempt.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
breath of contempt.lore: This war machine has been fitted with chambers that store excess steam under pressure that can be released in scalding gouts at nearby foes.
breath of contempt.restrictionText: Accursed Devices are a special type of enhancement for **WAR MACHINES**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Accursed Device and give it to a **WAR MACHINE** on your army roster.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Helsmiths of Hashut

greed pistons.name: Greed Pistons
greed pistons.description: Effect: When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
greed pistons.lore: At great expense the Daemonsmiths have fitted this machine with advanced piston assemblies, enabling it to perform fearsome turns of speed.
greed pistons.restrictionText: Accursed Devices are a special type of enhancement for **WAR MACHINES**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Accursed Device and give it to a **WAR MACHINE** on your army roster.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Helsmiths of Hashut

overdrive switch.name: Overdrive Switch
overdrive switch.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **ATTACK** ability for this unit
overdrive switch.description:
Effect: For the rest of the phase:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks, including those made with **Companion** weapons, that target an enemy unit within 9" of it.
• Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack made by this unit is 1, allocate 1 damage point to this unit after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
overdrive switch.lore: Pushing this war engine beyond its normal limits will wreak devastation on the enemy but risks damaging blowbacks from the daemonfire bound within it.
overdrive switch.restrictionText: Accursed Devices are a special type of enhancement for **WAR MACHINES**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Accursed Device and give it to a **WAR MACHINE** on your army roster.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Helsmiths of Hashut

fire you worms.name: 'Fire, You Worms!'
fire you worms.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must have charged this phase. If the unmodified hit roll for any of those attacks is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
fire you worms.lore: A pitiless enforcer of discipline, this duardin expects their underlings to keep firing even as the foe bears down on them.

servile automaton.name: Servile Automaton
servile automaton.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT AUTOMATON** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit’s bodyguard and the following effects apply:

•  While this unit is in combat and its bodyguard is within its combat range, its bodyguard has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
•  If this unit is **INFANTRY**, it has **WARD (5+)** while its bodyguard is within its combat range.
servile automaton.lore: This paranoid overlord shuns traditional bodyguards, instead favouring a looming daemon engine entirely bound to them through burning Zharralid carvings.

an eye for weakness.name: An Eye for Weakness
an eye for weakness.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units that target that enemy unit.
an eye for weakness.lore: Whether bargaining a Wage of Toil or considering the press of battle, this duardin can readily sense vulnerability.

gem of utorak.name: Gem of Utorak
gem of utorak.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
gem of utorak.description:
Effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it has **WIZARD (2)** until the start of your next turn.

If this unit is a **WIZARD**, until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
• Add D3 to casting rolls for this unit.
gem of utorak.lore: Utorak created many of these crystals, each of which grants a measure, albeit fleeting, of arcane power. His censure and eradication followed swiftly after.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Helsmiths of Hashut

casque of belittlement.name: Casque of Belittlement
casque of belittlement.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to each roll. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
casque of belittlement.lore: The wearer of this helm hears a constant scornful voice in their ear, one that sneers at and derides them until they explode in a fit of pique.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Helsmiths of Hashut

horn of the bullfather.name: Horn of the Bullfather
horn of the bullfather.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit to be the target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly **Hobgrot Vandalz** unit to be a second target.

Effect: Remove each target from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
horn of the bullfather.lore: Using this dread clarion, duardin warriors and disposable lackeys across the battlefield can be sent to outflank the enemy.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Helsmiths of Hashut

infernal motivators.name: Infernal Motivators
infernal motivators.description: Effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
infernal motivators.lore: The daemonic matter that powers this machine consistently provides it with feverish animation.
infernal motivators.restrictionText:
Accursed Devices are unique enhancements that can be given to **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES**.
A unit can only have 1 Accursed Device.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Helsmiths of Hashut

earthwrack stabilisers.name: Earthwrack Stabilisers
earthwrack stabilisers.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it has not charged in the same turn.
earthwrack stabilisers.lore: Large metal rods embedded in this war machine’s frame plunge deep into the earth, reducing its mobility but providing incredible stability while attacking.
earthwrack stabilisers.restrictionText:
Accursed Devices are unique enhancements that can be given to **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES**.
A unit can only have 1 Accursed Device.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Helsmiths of Hashut

bullfather s scorn.name: Bullfather's Scorn
bullfather s scorn.description:
Effect: You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

This unit’s ranged weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn. If each of this unit’s ranged weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, this unit’s shooting attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.
bullfather s scorn.lore: This war machine has been stamped with infernal runes of contempt that grant immense power on command.
bullfather s scorn.restrictionText:
Accursed Devices are unique enhancements that can be given to **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES**.
A unit can only have 1 Accursed Device.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Helsmiths of Hashut

hateful fractures.name: Hateful Fractures
hateful fractures.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
hateful fractures.lore: The sorcerer clenches a contemptuous fist, seeing firm ground beneath their foes suddenly splinter and crack.

ashen smog.name: Ashen Smog
ashen smog.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them that has a friendly **desolation token** to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: That terrain feature has the ‘Obscuring’ ability (Terrain, 1.2) until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting the target terrain feature. On a 2+, inflict an amount of damage equal to the roll on that unit.
ashen smog.lore: Clouds of choking ash seep from the sorcerer’s outstretched talon before settling across the lands as an impenetrable, blinding pall.

molten metal.name: Molten Metal
molten metal.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified casting roll. Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each roll that equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic.
molten metal.lore: A wave of hellish, liquid metal that strips armour and melts flesh surges forth into the enemy line.

black flames of hashut.name: Black Flames of Hashut
black flames of hashut.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.
black flames of hashut.lore: Spitting the Bullfather’s contempt, the priest causes their enemies to be wreathed in abyssal fire – a worthy punishment for the weak.

storm of obsidian shards.name: Storm of Obsidian Shards
storm of obsidian shards.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and subtract 3 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
storm of obsidian shards.lore: The sheer vitriol of this duardin priest is incarnated as a tumult of flesh-shredding stone splinters.

furnace blessing.name: Furnace Blessing
furnace blessing.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, that unit’s melee weapons also have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.
furnace blessing.lore: The priest pours burning scorn upon the daemonic essences bound in duardin steel, seeing the weapons of the Hashutites blaze in molten outrage.

formations.name: Industrial Polluters
formations.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINE.**

ability.name: Smog and Smoke
ability.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINE.**
ability.lore: The heavy exhaust fumes billowing from the Helsmiths’ war machines envelops their warriors in an obscuring, pollutant-laden smoke.

abilities.name: Smog and Smoke
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINE.**
abilities.lore: The heavy exhaust fumes billowing from the Helsmiths’ war machines envelops their warriors in an obscuring, pollutant-laden smoke.

formations.sourcePublication: Scourge of Ghyran: Helsmiths of Hashut

formations.name: Daemonsmith Cabal
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, unbinding rolls, banishment rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARDS** and **PRIESTS** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.

ability.name: Arcane Dominance
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, unbinding rolls, banishment rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARDS** and **PRIESTS** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
ability.lore: Despite all that its pursuit costs them, the sorcerers of the ziggurats are ever lusting for greater power.

abilities.name: Arcane Dominance
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, unbinding rolls, banishment rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARDS** and **PRIESTS** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
abilities.lore: Despite all that its pursuit costs them, the sorcerers of the ziggurats are ever lusting for greater power.

formations.name: Domination Force
formations.description:
Effect: Double the Health characteristic of friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units for the purposes of the ‘Power Through’ command.


**Designer’s Note:** *The effect of this ability applies both when you use ‘Power Through’ and when your opponent uses ‘Power Through’.*

ability.name: Dominion Hexes
ability.description:
Effect: Double the Health characteristic of friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units for the purposes of the ‘Power Through’ command.


**Designer’s Note:** *The effect of this ability applies both when you use ‘Power Through’ and when your opponent uses ‘Power Through’.*
ability.lore: The armour of these Helsmiths has been imbued by the Daemonsmiths with hexes of subjugation that weaken the resolve of those who seek to stand in their way.

abilities.name: Dominion Hexes
abilities.description:
Effect: Double the Health characteristic of friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units for the purposes of the ‘Power Through’ command.


**Designer’s Note:** *The effect of this ability applies both when you use ‘Power Through’ and when your opponent uses ‘Power Through’.*
abilities.lore: The armour of these Helsmiths has been imbued by the Daemonsmiths with hexes of subjugation that weaken the resolve of those who seek to stand in their way.
