formations.name: The Bullfather's Horns
formations.description: Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT CAVALRY** and **MONSTER** units while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.

ability.name: Bulls of the Ziggurat
ability.description: Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT CAVALRY** and **MONSTER** units while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
ability.lore: When unleashed, those warriors and constructs shaped in Hashut’s image are relentless.

abilities.name: Bulls of the Ziggurat
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT CAVALRY** and **MONSTER** units while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
abilities.lore: When unleashed, those warriors and constructs shaped in Hashut’s image are relentless.

formations.name: Hashutite Host
formations.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit with 3 **daemonic power points** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

ability.name: Amassed Legions
ability.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit with 3 **daemonic power points** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
ability.lore: The hosts of the ziggurats march to conquer and claim, advancing into verdant lands and leaving them barren.

abilities.name: Amassed Legions
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit with 3 **daemonic power points** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: The hosts of the ziggurats march to conquer and claim, advancing into verdant lands and leaving them barren.

formations.name: Castigation Battery
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.

ability.name: Experimental Munitions
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
ability.lore: In trying to control Chaos, duardin engineers have crafted all manner of eldritch ammunition for their war machines. In doing so, they have given the power of ruin even more destructive outlets.

abilities.name: Experimental Munitions
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
abilities.lore: In trying to control Chaos, duardin engineers have crafted all manner of eldritch ammunition for their war machines. In doing so, they have given the power of ruin even more destructive outlets.

talisman of obsidian.name: Talisman of Obsidian
talisman of obsidian.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.
talisman of obsidian.lore: The obsidian jewel set within this amulet shrouds the bearer and protects them from harm.
talisman of obsidian.groupName: Taar's Grand Forgehost Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Taar's Grand Forgehost

masterful daemonworks.name: Masterful Daemonworks
masterful daemonworks.description: Effect: Friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST WAR MACHINES** have **WARD (6+)**.
masterful daemonworks.lore: Those engines marshalled by the First Daemonsmith are masterworks of cursed engineering.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Taar's Grand Forgehost

rising fire.name: Rising Fire
rising fire.description:
Effect: The following cumulative effects apply to friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST** units in each battle round after the first.

**Battle Round 2:**
***Daemonic Weaponry:*** Those units’ weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

**Battle Round 3:**
***Harnessed Sorcery:*** Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for those units.

**Battle Round 4:**
***Channelled Power:*** Attacks made by those units score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

**Battle Round 5:**
***Arcane Dominance:*** Add 1 to the power level of those units if they are a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**.
rising fire.lore: The hosts of Urak Taar fight with obsessive precision instead of haste – but once the furnaces are lit, victory is inevitable.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Taar's Grand Forgehost

dread ranks unbroken.name: Dread Ranks Unbroken
dread ranks unbroken.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
dread ranks unbroken.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO GRAND FORGEHOST INFANTRY** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up), wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
dread ranks unbroken.lore: Serried legions of duardin march in service to Urak Taar and the Forge Anathema.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Taar's Grand Forgehost

ruthless overseer.name: Ruthless Overseer
ruthless overseer.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
ruthless overseer.lore: The magnates and warlords in service to Urak Taar are hungry to distinguish themselves and demand faultless discipline.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Taar's Grand Forgehost

reinforce daemonsteel.name: Reinforce Daemonsteel
reinforce daemonsteel.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit in each phase while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
reinforce daemonsteel.lore: At a sorcerer’s chanting, the sigils inscribed on their minions’ armour glow with protective power.

shackling curse.name: Shackling Curse
shackling curse.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target’s attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
shackling curse.lore: A daemonic hex of Urak Taar’s own devising is placed upon the foe, blunting their strikes.

lava storm.name: Lava Storm
lava storm.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST PRIEST** to chant this prayer. Pick an enemy unit to be the target and roll 6 dice. For each 6, pick an additional enemy unit to be a target. Then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, pick an additional enemy unit to be a target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
lava storm.lore: The skies above burn a polluted red as globs of black lava are called to rain onto the enemy.

grasp of stone.name: Grasp of Stone
grasp of stone.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, the target also has **STRIKE-LAST** until the start of your next turn.
grasp of stone.lore: The Drazghar have observed Urak Taar’s ability to channel his curse. They attempt to replicate this via invocations, though Taar ensures that none learn too much…

run roughshod.name: Run Roughshod
run roughshod.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

•  The target can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.
run roughshod.lore: Only a fool believes they can stop Hashut’s chosen from going where they wish.

break them one and all.name: 'Break Them, One and All...'
break them one and all.description: Effect: Any number of friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** units can use the ‘Power Through’ command in the same turn.
break them one and all.lore: A Ziggurat Stampede is unleashed for one reason – to crush all in its path.

let the realms tremble.name: Let The Realms Tremble
let the realms tremble.description: Effect: Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** units that have already charged this phase.
let the realms tremble.lore: The onslaught of Hashutite war machines are a tide of annihilation that cannot be resisted.

raging animus.name: Raging Animus
raging animus.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
raging animus.lore: Within this Taurus is bound an especially diabolical spirit – one that takes any opportunity to violently burst free.

visage of the great bull.name: Visage of the Great Bull
visage of the great bull.description: Effect: In your charge phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
visage of the great bull.lore: This graven, gilded mask is wrought in the visage of a Taurus, supplanting the bearer’s will with Hashut’s crushing purpose.

flaming weapons.name: Flaming Weapons
flaming weapons.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
flaming weapons.lore: At a gesture, the cuneiform-inscribed weapons of the sorcerer’s host glow white-hot and ignite.

burn to ash.name: Burn to Ash
burn to ash.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a terrain feature within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target has a Health characteristic, inflict 2D3 mortal damage on it. Then, if the target was not destroyed or does not have a Health characteristic:

• The target gains the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability for the rest of the battle (Terrain, 1.2).
• If the target is **FACTION TERRAIN**, until the start of your next turn, abilities on that terrain feature’s warscroll have no effect.
burn to ash.lore: Twisted Zharralid cantrips ignite the land until it is blackened and withered.

searing detonation.name: Searing Detonation
searing detonation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick each enemy unit in combat with them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
searing detonation.lore: The sorcerer grasps dark fire in their claws, crushing it into a dense and howling nova before unleashing it in a wave of devastation.

heads must roll.name: Heads Must Roll
heads must roll.phase: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
heads must roll.description:
Declare: Spend 3 **blood tithe points** and pick up to 3 friendly units.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of those units’ melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
heads must roll.lore: A terrible hunger is awoken in the gore-slick weapons of the Bloodbound.

the blood tithe.name: The Blood Tithe
the blood tithe.description: Effect: Each time a unit is destroyed during the battle, you receive 1 **blood tithe point**.
the blood tithe.lore: Khorne’s warriors receive divine rewards when blood is shed; whether the sacrifice is theirs or that of their foes matters not.

murderlust.name: Murderlust
murderlust.phase: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
murderlust.description:
Declare: Spend 1 **blood tithe point** and pick up to D3 friendly units.

Effect: Each of those units can move D6" (roll for each).
murderlust.lore: All servants of Khorne feel the urge to kill, but when prey is near, the impulse becomes all-consuming.

murderlust.name: Murderlust
murderlust.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
murderlust.description:
Effect: Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that **CHARGE** ability after that ability is resolved.

You do not need to unlock this ability to use it. It is already unlocked.
murderlust.lore: When worthy opponents are near, the impulse to kill becomes all-consuming.
murderlust.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

skull collector.name: Skull Collector
skull collector.description:
Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **HERO** by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy **HERO** has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
skull collector.lore: Even other warriors of Khorne are in awe of this champion's fixation on decapitation.

frenzied taskmaster.name: Frenzied Taskmaster
frenzied taskmaster.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit within this unit's combat range that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit's combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
frenzied taskmaster.lore: This champion does not allow their followers to shirk the slaughter.

magical scorn.name: Magical Scorn
magical scorn.description:
Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for **WIZARDS** while they are within 12" of this unit.

Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy **PRIESTS** while they are within 12" of this unit.
magical scorn.lore: This warrior's loathing of the arcane and esoteric exudes from them in waves.

revel in battle.name: Revel in Battle
revel in battle.description:
Effect: Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit have no effect.

You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Punish the Pacifist'.
revel in battle.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

glorious combat or naught.name: Glorious Combat or Naught
glorious combat or naught.description:
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units.

You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Divine Scorn' or 'Punish the Pacifist'.
glorious combat or naught.lore: The air boils, charring arrows and melting musket shot.
glorious combat or naught.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

cleave wide the grin of khorne.name: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne
cleave wide the grin of khorne.description:
Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units.

You can only unlock this ability if you have already unlocked 'Revel in Battle' or 'Glorious Combat or Naught'.
cleave wide the grin of khorne.lore: Gore begets gore, and death begets death.
cleave wide the grin of khorne.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

punish the pacifist.name: Punish the Pacifist
punish the pacifist.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
punish the pacifist.description:
Declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy **MANIFESTATION** that is not in combat is a target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.
punish the pacifist.lore: To shirk from combat is to sin against the War God.
punish the pacifist.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

murder the mystic.name: Murder the Mystic
murder the mystic.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
murder the mystic.description:
Declare: Pick up to 4 enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** to be the target(s).

Effect: Make a **banishment roll** of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that **MANIFESTATION**'s warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is **banished** and removed from play.

You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Divine Scorn'.
murder the mystic.lore: Those who cower behind conjured spellcraft will be punished severely.
murder the mystic.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

blood drenched.name: Blood-drenched
blood drenched.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ‘Skulls for the Skull Throne’ ability
blood drenched.description:
Effect: After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a **BLOOD TITHE** ability this turn, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:
***Wild-eyed Brutality:*** Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
***Blood Haze:*** If the target is **BLOODBOUND**, its **Blood-hungry** weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
***Weapons of Murder:***  If the target is a non-**MONSTER DAEMON** unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its **Blood-hungry** weapons, including **Blood-hungry Companion** weapons.
***Bloodlords Supreme:*** If the target is a **MONSTER**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its **Blood-hungry** weapons.
blood drenched.lore: As blood gushes down blades, armour and teeth, the fervent warriors of the Blood God are driven into a divine frenzy.
blood drenched.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

blood drenched.name: Blood-drenched
blood drenched.phase: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
blood drenched.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that slew any enemy models using a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal).**
blood drenched.lore: As blood gushes down blades, armour and teeth, the fervent warriors of the Blood God are driven into a divine frenzy.
blood drenched.groupName: Fangs of the Blood God Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Spearhead: Fangs of the Blood God

blood for the blood god.name: Blood for the Blood God
blood for the blood god.description: Effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock **BLOOD TITHE** abilities. You can only use **BLOOD TITHE** abilities that are unlocked. Once a **BLOOD TITHE** ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.
blood for the blood god.lore: *Khorne cares not from where the blood flows...*
blood for the blood god.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

divine scorn.name: Divine Scorn
divine scorn.phase: Once per Turn, Start of Any Turn
divine scorn.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy **WIZARDS** or **PRIESTS** within 6" of any friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units to be the target(s).

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.
divine scorn.lore: The battlefield is Khorne's temple, and Khorne's alone.
divine scorn.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

skulls for the skull throne.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne
skulls for the skull throne.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
skulls for the skull throne.description: Effect: Pick a **BLOOD TITHE** ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability (shown in the top-right corner of the ability). That **BLOOD TITHE** ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.
skulls for the skull throne.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

slaughter triumphant.name: Slaughter Triumphant
slaughter triumphant.description:
Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units that charged in the same turn.

You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Glorious Combat or Naught' or 'Murder the Mystic'.
slaughter triumphant.lore: Khorne's fury floods the field, burning out all thought but to slay.
slaughter triumphant.restrictionText: Blades of Khorne armies can use the following abilities:

the quarry.name: The Quarry
the quarry.description: Effect: If no enemy units are the **quarry**, pick an enemy unit to be the **quarry** (you can pick an enemy unit in reserve).
the quarry.lore: Karanak's hunt is eternal, for there is no end to those who offend Khorne's creed.
the quarry.groupName: Fangs of the Blood God Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Spearhead: Fangs of the Blood God

collar of contempt.name: Collar of Contempt
collar of contempt.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1).** Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
collar of contempt.lore: This thrice-damned brass collar is the bane of magical power.

butcher s blade.name: Butcher's Blade
butcher s blade.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
butcher s blade.lore: One cut from this blade can see a target brutally exsanguinated.

ar gath the king of blades.name: Ar'gath, The King of Blades
ar gath the king of blades.description: Effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy **HEROES** while they are in combat with this unit.
ar gath the king of blades.lore: This daemonic blade hungers for the flesh of champions and will not be denied by trickery or magic.

scorpion tails.name: Scorpion Tails
scorpion tails.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: • Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• If the target unit’s starting size was 1, subtract 1 from wound rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
scorpion tails.lore: With their powerful arachnoid stingers, these warriors inject deadly venom into the enemy.
scorpion tails.restrictionText: Brazen Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Brazen Mutation.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Blades of Khorne

brass flesh.name: Brass Flesh
brass flesh.description: Effect: Unmodified save rolls of 5+ for this unit cannot fail.
brass flesh.lore: Arrows and blades alike simply glance off the burnished, metallic skin of these warriors.
brass flesh.restrictionText: Brazen Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Brazen Mutation.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Blades of Khorne

blade limbs.name: Blade-Limbs
blade limbs.description: Effect: Each time this unit is picked to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for the attacks made as part of that ability, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.
blade limbs.lore: Fashioned into living engines of destruction, these warriors have secondary limbs that end in razor-sharp blades.
blade limbs.restrictionText: Brazen Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Brazen Mutation.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Blades of Khorne

summon hexgorger skulls.name: Summon Hexgorger Skulls
summon hexgorger skulls.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Set up a **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation has 2 parts that must be set up within 8" of each other.
summon hexgorger skulls.lore: Hexgorger Skulls are the physical manifestation of Khorne's hatred of the arcane arts. They drift across the battlefield, seeking to feed upon eldritch energy and those conjurers who attempt to use it.

summon wrath axe.name: Summon Wrath-axe
summon wrath axe.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Wrath-axe** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Set up a **Wrath-axe** wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon wrath axe.lore: A Wrath-axe is a manifestation of Khorne's otherworldly anger, its razor-sharp edges glowing from the heat of the Blood God's rage. As a chanting priest carves the ground open, these eldritch axes appear to tear the air in twain, reality set ablaze at its passage.

summon bleeding icon.name: Summon Bleeding Icon
summon bleeding icon.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bleeding Icon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bleeding Icon** wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.
summon bleeding icon.lore: A common sight in the crimson skies above Khorne's domain, a Bleeding Icon can be summoned to the Mortal Realms to signal the attention - and the displeasure - of the Lord of Battles.

final act of violence.name: Final Act of Violence
final act of violence.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
final act of violence.lore: The spat invectives of this priest inspire their faithful to slaughter to their last breath.

uncontrollable rage.name: Uncontrollable Rage
uncontrollable rage.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability (see 'Blades of Khorne Battle Traits') apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of'Wild-eyed Brutality' on the target.
uncontrollable rage.lore: Opening their own veins while chanting hateful catechisms of worship, the priest spreads their own depthless fury to their allies.

blood boil.name: Blood Boil
blood boil.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.
blood boil.lore: Spitting ritualistic words of wrath into the air, the priest turns the blood coursing through the veins of the enemy red-hot, burning them from the inside out.

runes of loathing.name: Runes of Loathing
runes of loathing.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (3+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS** (including **FIGHT** abilities). If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
runes of loathing.lore: With a guttural curse, the priest carves runes into their flesh that are antithetical to hated sorcery, which sympathetically manifest upon the armour of nearby followers.

goreflesh.name: Goreflesh
goreflesh.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
goreflesh.lore: Glistening, steaming blood flows over the flesh of the priest’s followers before coagulating into a gruesome second skin that dulls the strikes of the foe.

gift of apoplexy.name: Gift of Apoplexy
gift of apoplexy.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a **MOVE, CHARGE** or **FIGHT** ability, after that ability is resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.
gift of apoplexy.lore: Chanting words of carnage, the Slaughterpriest invokes a murderous rage in their enemies that will drive them to tear each other apart with hands and teeth should the opportunity to unleash violence on their foes not present itself.

gift of apoplexy.name: Gift of Apoplexy
gift of apoplexy.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a **MOVE** or **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage o the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.
gift of apoplexy.lore: The priest invokes a murderous rage in their enemies to which they must give vent... either against their foes or against each other.

stoke the flames.name: Stoke The Flames
stoke the flames.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with the target, your opponent cannot spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.
• If the target is destroyed, you gain 1 **rage dice**. If the chanting roll was 6+, you gain 2 **rage dice** instead.
stoke the flames.lore: The priest calls for their followers to slay and be slain as they channel the ire of Khorne.

fetters of blood.name: Fetters of Blood
fetters of blood.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• The targets cannot use **RETREAT** or **RUN** abilities.
• The targets cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow them to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.
fetters of blood.lore: Erupting from the ground by the enemy’s feet, these chains ensnare those who would flee the wrath of Khorne.

formations.name: Khornate Legion
formations.description:
Used By: The unit using that **FIGHT** ability.

Effect: Pick a friendly **BLOODBOUND** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

ability.name: Butchers of Nations
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit
ability.description:
Used By: The unit using that **FIGHT** ability.

Effect: Pick a friendly **BLOODBOUND** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
ability.lore: When the daemonic hosts of Khorne join their Bloodbound followers in battle, they crush all before them in a storm of gore-splattered carnage.

abilities.name: Butchers of Nations
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit
abilities.description:
Used By: The unit using that **FIGHT** ability.

Effect: Pick a friendly **BLOODBOUND** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: When the daemonic hosts of Khorne join their Bloodbound followers in battle, they crush all before them in a storm of gore-splattered carnage.

formations.name: Brass Stampede
formations.description: Effect: Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY** or **MONSTER** units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.

ability.name: Drawn to Carnage
ability.description: Effect: Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY** or **MONSTER** units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.
ability.lore: Nothing can stop the thunderous onset of a Brass Stampede once it has begun to gain momentum.

abilities.name: Drawn to Carnage
abilities.description: Effect: Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY** or **MONSTER** units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.
abilities.lore: Nothing can stop the thunderous onset of a Brass Stampede once it has begun to gain momentum.

formations.name: Tournament of Skulls
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO BLOODBOUND** unit and a friendly non-**HERO BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit to be the targets.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ combat attacks.

ability.name: Bloody Competitors
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO BLOODBOUND** unit and a friendly non-**HERO BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit to be the targets.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ combat attacks.
ability.lore: Where the mortal followers and daemons of Khorne fight next to one another, they compete to reap the most skulls in the name of their grim deity.

abilities.name: Bloody Competitors
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ combat attacks.

formations.sourcePublication: Scourge of Ghyran: Blades of Khorne

formations.name: The Goretide
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLOODBOUND HERO** and up to 2 other friendly **BLOODBOUND** units that are wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.

Effect: Add 2" to the targets’ Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Tide of Savagery
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BLOODBOUND HERO** and up to 2 other friendly **BLOODBOUND** units that are wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.

Effect: Add 2" to the targets’ Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: Since Korghos Khul’s ascension to daemonhood, the Goretide are filled with renewed purpose, rushing into battle with ever greater vigour.

abilities.name: Tide of Savagery
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:

Effect: Add 2" to the targets’ Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

formations.name: Murderhost
formations.description: Effect: Each friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit that has used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Eager Killers
ability.description: Effect: Each friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit that has used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
ability.lore: Khorne's daemons care only for violence; any moment spent not slaying is a moment wasted.

abilities.name: Eager Killers
abilities.description: Effect: Each friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit that has used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Khorne's daemons care only for violence; any moment spent not slaying is a moment wasted.

formations.name: Bloodbound Warhorde
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BLOODBOUND** units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

ability.name: Tireless Conquerors
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BLOODBOUND** units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.
ability.lore: The Bloodbound surge across the battlefield with blades held high, salivating and baying as they rip the enemy from their strongholds.

abilities.name: Tireless Conquerors
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BLOODBOUND** units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.
abilities.lore: The Bloodbound surge across the battlefield with blades held high, salivating and baying as they rip the enemy from their strongholds.

born of butchery.name: Born of Butchery
born of butchery.phase: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
born of butchery.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE** **BALEFUL LORDS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number plus the number of units (friendly and enemy) that have been destroyed this battle. If the roll contains 8 or more results of 3+, set up a replacement unit identical to the target on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
born of butchery.lore: So long as gore flows in rivers and hate chokes mortal souls, the Baleful Lords shall rise again and anew.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

drawn by blood.name: Drawn By Blood
drawn by blood.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
drawn by blood.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can move D6". It can end that move in combat but only with units it was in combat with at the start of the phase.

If that unit destroyed any enemy units this turn, then instead:

That unit can move 2D6". It can end that move in combat with any units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn.
drawn by blood.lore: For the Baleful Lords, nothing is more pressing than to commit atrocity.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

the price of mercy.name: The Price of Mercy
the price of mercy.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
the price of mercy.description:
Declare: You must use this ability. Pick each friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit that did not charge or use a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be a target.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
the price of mercy.lore: Inaction is hateful to all Khorne's daemons, but to the Baleful Lords, it is utterly anathemic.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

sunder the sorcerous.name: Sunder the Sorcerous
sunder the sorcerous.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
sunder the sorcerous.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy **MANIFESTATION** within 3" of a friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit to be a target.

Effect: Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value of the target:
• That target is banished and removed from play.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy unit that summoned the target.
sunder the sorcerous.lore: The Baleful Lords are veterans of impossible battles across the mind-bending vistas of the Realm of Chaos. No mere spell, nor its caster, can oppose them.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

bellow of hatred.name: Bellow of Hatred
bellow of hatred.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
bellow of hatred.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target. The target cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
bellow of hatred.lore: The enmity released by this blood-curdling scream stuns nearby enemies.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

first in his sight.name: First In His Sight
first in his sight.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
first in his sight.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **BALEFUL LORDS HERO** that is in combat.
first in his sight.lore: Of all Khorne's daemon legions the Baleful Lords are highest in his favour, and the inferno of his rage burns hot in their immortal veins.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

mage eaters.name: Mage-Eaters
mage eaters.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability.
mage eaters.description:
Used By: A friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit targeted by that **SPELL** ability.

Effect: Make a magic-eater roll of D6. On a 3+, that spell is unbound. If the spell was unbound and the magic-eater roll was 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
mage eaters.lore: Those who dare wield spells in the presence of these daemons are soon punished.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

crown of the slaughterborn.name: Crown of the Slaughterborn
crown of the slaughterborn.description: Effect: Enemy units within 12" of this unit cannot be healed and cannot have slain models returned to them.
crown of the slaughterborn.lore: A prize won on the battlefields of the Great Game, this spiked circlet of brass and iron torments stirring souls and ensures bloody wounds shall not heal.
crown of the slaughterborn.groupName: The Baleful Lords Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

unrivalled battlelust.name: Unrivalled Battlelust
unrivalled battlelust.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
unrivalled battlelust.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
unrivalled battlelust.lore: With a terrifying roar, this marshal amongst Bloodthirsters goads their kin to even greater heights of carnage.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Baleful Lords

the scarring blade.name: The Scarring Blade
the scarring blade.description:
Effect: Allocate D3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add **X** to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** units for the rest of the turn, where **X** is equal to the number of damage points allocated to this unit this turn by this ability.

For the rest of the battle, this unit cannot use the ‘Hate-fuelled Killers’ ability and cannot be healed.
the scarring blade.lore: It is said that wounds caused by this dagger never cease leaking blood - and that one who turns it upon themselves in bleak reverence will earn great favour.

warmonger s icon.name: Warmonger's Icon
warmonger s icon.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warmonger s icon.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to D3 friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** units within this unit's combat range to be the targets.

Effect: The targets have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
warmonger s icon.lore: The personal standard of a warhorde's master inspires a frenzied devotion.

bloodmist skull.name: Bloodmist Skull
bloodmist skull.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.
bloodmist skull.lore: A thick sanguine pall spills from the mouth of this rune-carved skull, burning enemy projectiles to ash mid-flight.

hate fuelled killers.name: Hate-fuelled Killers
hate fuelled killers.description: Effect: The first time each friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 5+, that unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** that unit.
hate fuelled killers.lore: Anger, hate and violence run through the veins of the Gorechosen, allowing them to ignore otherwise fatal blows.

brutal lashmaster.name: Brutal Lashmaster
brutal lashmaster.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **Bloodstoker** uses the 'Whipped to Fury' ability, another friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO** within its combat range can be picked to be the target of that ability instead of a non-**HERO BLOODBOUND** unit.
brutal lashmaster.lore: A favoured Bloodstoker can drive even other champions to battle.

legendary slayers.name: Legendary Slayers
legendary slayers.description: Effect: **Blood-hungry** weapons used by friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** units have **Crit (Mortal)**.
legendary slayers.lore: To be Gorechosen is to have slain hundreds, if not thousands.

the red god s eye.name: The Red God's Eye
the red god s eye.lore: When the Gorechosen fight in unity, the Blood God's gaze is drawn. None would dare falter under such scrutiny.

murder won trophies.name: Murder-won Trophies
murder won trophies.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO** to be the target.

Effect: Give the target 1 artefact of power from the 'Gorechosen Champions' Army of Renown rules.

**Designer's Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the **HERO** during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
murder won trophies.lore: The Gorechosen have ripped countless trophies from the carcasses of worthy foes.

crowned in butchery.name: Crowned in Butchery
crowned in butchery.description: Effect: Add 20 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.
crowned in butchery.lore: To yoke the lords of the Gorechosen demands a champion of singular, terrifying will.

summon wrath axe.name: Summon Wrath-Axe
summon wrath axe.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Wrath-axe** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Set up a **Wrath-axe** wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon wrath axe.lore: A Wrath-axe is a manifestation of Khorne's otherworldly anger, its razor-sharp edges glowing red-hot from the Blood God's rage. At signs of weakness or wizardry, such a blazing axe appears in the air, splitting reality with its downwards stroke.

cowed and broken.name: Cowed and Broken
cowed and broken.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them that is in combat with a friendly unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll 8 dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to each roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
cowed and broken.lore: The priest channels Khorne's seething hatred through a Gorechosen, causing the bones of foes who stand in the way of worthier targets to agonisingly twist and snap.

eruption of apoplexy.name: Eruption of Apoplexy
eruption of apoplexy.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them that is in combat with a friendly unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. If the target is destroyed, before removing the last model in that unit from play, inflict D3 mortal damage on every unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of that model, or D6 mortal damage instead if the chanting roll was 8+.
eruption of apoplexy.lore: The priest focuses the rage of all the battle's combatants into a single warrior, whose organs rupture under the strain - or whose entire body violently explodes in a magnificent shower of boiling gore and bone shrapnel.

skin of brass.name: Skin of Brass
skin of brass.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
skin of brass.lore: A shimmering skull manifests over a chosen champion, spilling gore upon them and granting their skin the hue and toughness of freshly forged brass.

oaths of darkness.name: Oaths of Darkness
oaths of darkness.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
oaths of darkness.description:
Effect: You can reveal 1 **battle tactic card** in your hand to your opponent. If you do so, that **battle tactic card becomes your oath** for the rest of the turn.

While this **battle tactic card is your oath**, you can still use the command on it, or attempt to score the battle tactic on it, as normal.

If you score the battle tactic on your oath this turn, your oath is **fulfilled.** Instead of discarding the card, it is placed to one side but you can still use the command on it. Once you do so, the card is discarded as normal. Fulfilled oaths placed to one side in this way do not count towards the 3 battle tactic cards you can have in your hand.

If you use the command on your oath before it is scored, it is discarded as normal. At the end of the turn, if the oath is still in your hand and that oath has not been fulfilled, it ceases to be your oath.
oaths of darkness.lore: The Darkoath are roving barbarian raiders who seek to prove their might by swearing oaths of bloodshed and murder to the Dark Gods.

favoured of the pantheon.name: Favoured of the Pantheon
favoured of the pantheon.description: Effect: If this unit is picked as the target of the ‘Eye of the Gods’ ability, it gains 3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.
favoured of the pantheon.lore: The gods watch this warlord’s deeds particularly closely.

deathmonger.name: Deathmonger
deathmonger.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
deathmonger.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
deathmonger.lore: Feared across the realms, this hero leaves naught in their wake but a trail of sun-bleached bones.

radiance of dark glory.name: Radiance of Dark Glory
radiance of dark glory.description:
Declare: Pick each damaged friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, **Heal (1)** the target. **Heal** **(3)** the target instead if it is a **MONSTER**.
radiance of dark glory.lore: In the presence of this champion, the mutative energies of Chaos can seal shut even the most grievous of wounds.

pledge to chaos.name: Pledge to Chaos
pledge to chaos.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
pledge to chaos.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit that does not already have one of the keywords below to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following **Pledge to Chaos** keywords:

• **PLEDGED TO KHORNE**
• **PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH**
• **PLEDGED TO NURGLE**
• **PLEDGED TO SLAANESH**

The target has that keyword for the rest of the battle.
pledge to chaos.lore: The Slaves to Darkness forsake their souls by pledging to the Dark Gods.

dark apotheosis.name: Dark Apotheosis
dark apotheosis.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
dark apotheosis.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit with 8 or more **Dark Apotheosis** points to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following:

***Aura of Chaos***: **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to the target. In addition, the target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the battle.

***Daemonhood***: Set up a **Daemon Prince** within 1" of the target. Then, remove the target from the battlefield. If the target is your general, the **Daemon Prince** becomes your general instead and is added to your general’s regiment. If the target has any enhancements, the **Daemon Prince** has those enhancements instead. If the target has a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword, the **Daemon Prince** has the same keyword. Otherwise, pick 1 **Pledge to Chaos** keyword for the **Daemon Prince** to have for the rest of the battle. If any **MANIFESTATIONS** that were summoned by the target are on the battlefield, those **MANIFESTATIONS** are removed from play.
dark apotheosis.lore: Favoured by the Dark Gods, this champion is bestowed with fell glory.

pledged to nurgle.name: Pledged to Nurgle
pledged to nurgle.description: Effect: Friendly **PLEDGED TO NURGLE** units have **WARD (6+).** If a unit already has **WARD (6+),** it has **WARD (5+)** instead.
pledged to nurgle.lore: The Father of Plagues bestows gifts of rot and decay upon his followers.

pledged to khorne.name: Pledged to Khorne
pledged to khorne.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **PLEDGED TO KHORNE** units.
pledged to khorne.lore: The Blood God instils a blind rage in his most frenzied adherents.

pledged to slaanesh.name: Pledged to Slaanesh
pledged to slaanesh.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for friendly **PLEDGED TO SLAANESH** units, you can roll 1 additional dice (to a maximum of 3), but if you do, you must discard 1 dice of your choice.
pledged to slaanesh.lore: The thrill of battle drives these warriors to charge at spectacular speed.

eye of the gods.name: Eye of the Gods
eye of the gods.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE WARRIORS OF CHAOS** or **DARKOATH HERO** to be the target.

Effect: During the battle, the target gains **Dark Apotheosis** points as follows:

• Each time the target uses a **FIGHT** ability, it gains D3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.
• At the end of each of your turns, if the target is contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory, it gains D3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.
eye of the gods.lore: The mortal champions of Chaos seek to attract the notice of the gods by performing great deeds in battle.

eye of the gods.name: Eye of the Gods
eye of the gods.phase: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
eye of the gods.description:
Declare: Pick one of the following friendly units to use this ability:

• A unit that is **contesting an objective not controlled by your opponent** and is not in combat.
• A unit that **destroyed an enemy unit** this turn.

Effect: Roll once on the **Eye of the Gods table** for that unit. That unit gains the **Eye of the Gods** passive ability that corresponds to the roll (the unit keeps all Eye of the Gods abilities gained in previous turns). If the same unit gains the same ability more than once in the battle, the effects are **not** cumulative.
eye of the gods.lore: The Slaves to Darkness seek to attract the notice of the gods by performing great deeds in battle.

pledged to tzeentch.name: Pledged to Tzeentch
pledged to tzeentch.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
pledged to tzeentch.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH** unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. Then pick a point within a number of inches of the target equal to the roll. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units.
pledged to tzeentch.lore: Reality twists and weaves around these warriors as they become intertwined in the machinations of the Change God.

head of the unworthy.name: Head of the Unworthy
head of the unworthy.description: Effect: If a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO** with any **Dark Apotheosis** points is destroyed, give this unit 8 **Dark Apotheosis** points.
head of the unworthy.lore: This grim trophy is a bleak reminder that the gods’ favour, even if earned over centuries of battle, can be lost and bestowed on another in a heartbeat.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Slaves to Darkness

amulet of chaos.name: Amulet of Chaos
amulet of chaos.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **DARKOATH INFANTRY** unit in combat with that enemy unit to be the friendly target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
• If there is a friendly target, return a number of slain models to it equal to the roll.
amulet of chaos.lore: Life, death, creation, obliteration. Maddening potential swirls within the gemstone set in this talisman. It need only be loosed by belief.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Slaves to Darkness

the varanite shackle.name: The Varanite Shackle
the varanite shackle.description: Effect: Friendly non-**WARRIORS OF CHAOS SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
the varanite shackle.lore: This writhing torque radiates an aura that twists reality, aiding those who serve the will of the Dark Gods yet are blind or indifferent to the import of their actions.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Slaves to Darkness

dreaded arrival.name: Dreaded Arrival
dreaded arrival.description: Effect: Set up this unit wholly within your territory, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
dreaded arrival.lore: To the thunderous beating of flame-trailing hooves and clattering Chaos Armour, the knights arrive to shatter the enemy.

realmwarper s twist rune.name: Realmwarper's Twist-rune
realmwarper s twist rune.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
realmwarper s twist rune.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target does not have the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model’s unit.
realmwarper s twist rune.lore: One who bears this cursed rune can bind warped landscapes to their will. Ruptured chasms open as thick palls of dark energy obscure the favoured and their servants from view.

infernal puppet.name: Infernal Puppet
infernal puppet.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
infernal puppet.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** within 24" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target is picked to use a **SPELL** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target as a reaction. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **SPELL** ability.
infernal puppet.lore: As it dances upon the aetheric winds, this eldritch marionette violently disrupts the spellcraft of enemy mages.

the conqueror s crown.name: The Conqueror's Crown
the conqueror s crown.description: Effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **INFANTRY** units while they are in combat with this unit.
the conqueror s crown.lore: This blasphemous diadem grants the bearer dominion over the minds of lesser mortals.

the banner of rage.name: The Banner of Rage
the banner of rage.description:
Effect: This unit has the **PLEDGED TO KHORNE** keyword.

In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
the banner of rage.lore: Sewn from strings of congealed gore, this banner radiates bloodlust so strong that those beneath it are goaded into a state of permanent rage.
the banner of rage.restrictionText: An Ensorcelled Banner is a unique enhancement that can be given to **SLAVES TO DARKNESS INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units with the **STANDARD BEARER** keyword. A unit can only have 1 Ensorcelled Banner.

the banner of screaming flesh.name: The Banner of Screaming Flesh
the banner of screaming flesh.description:
Effect: This unit has the **PLEDGED TO SLAANESH** keyword.

In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, if this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
the banner of screaming flesh.lore: Fashioned from flayed aelven faces that scream in perpetual agony, the exhilarating pitch of this banner heightens the senses of the followers of the Dark Prince.
the banner of screaming flesh.restrictionText: An Ensorcelled Banner is a unique enhancement that can be given to **SLAVES TO DARKNESS INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units with the **STANDARD BEARER** keyword. A unit can only have 1 Ensorcelled Banner.

the dread banner.name: The Dread Banner
the dread banner.description: Effect: While this unit includes any standard bearers, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.
the dread banner.lore: Marked with sigils of each of the Dark Gods, the bearers of this banner strike fear into those who oppose them.
the dread banner.restrictionText: An Ensorcelled Banner is a unique enhancement that can be given to **SLAVES TO DARKNESS INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units with the **STANDARD BEARER** keyword. A unit can only have 1 Ensorcelled Banner.

the eroding icon.name: The Eroding Icon
the eroding icon.description:
Effect: This unit has the **PLEDGED TO NURGLE** keyword.

In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
the eroding icon.lore: As this fell icon arrives upon the enemy line, warriors find their weapons corroding and crumbling to rust.
the eroding icon.restrictionText: An Ensorcelled Banner is a unique enhancement that can be given to **SLAVES TO DARKNESS INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units with the **STANDARD BEARER** keyword. A unit can only have 1 Ensorcelled Banner.

the blasted standard.name: The Blasted Standard
the blasted standard.description:
Effect: This unit has the **PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH** keyword.

In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, this unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.
the blasted standard.lore: Woven from threads of dark magic, this standard is inscribed with writhing runes and surrounded with the coruscating fires of change.
the blasted standard.restrictionText: An Ensorcelled Banner is a unique enhancement that can be given to **SLAVES TO DARKNESS INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units with the **STANDARD BEARER** keyword. A unit can only have 1 Ensorcelled Banner.

aelfskin scroll.name: Aelfskin Scroll
aelfskin scroll.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 18" of this unit
aelfskin scroll.description: Effect: Pick a visible friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** within 18" of this unit. After that **SPELL** ability has been resolved, that friendly **WIZARD** can use a **SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, and the casting roll for that spell is equal to the casting roll for that enemy spell. Do not count that spell towards the number of **SPELL** abilities that friendly **WIZARD** can use this phase.
aelfskin scroll.lore: Upon reciting the words on this unholy scroll, the aelf-soul bound to it is twisted into the perfect fuel for the foulest of magic.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Slaves to Darkness

darkflame pendant.name: Darkflame Pendant
darkflame pendant.description: Effect: Weapons used for attacks that target this unit have a maximum Damage characteristic of 1.
darkflame pendant.lore: This unsettling-looking necklace wreathes the wearer in shadowy flames that see arrows lose momentum and blades dull upon impact.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Slaves to Darkness

rune of murder.name: Rune of Murder
rune of murder.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
rune of murder.description:
Declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

• Inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, double the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
• Add D6 to the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
rune of murder.lore: Tracing their fingers over the symbol etched on this stone, the bearer feels their muscles swell with fell strength. Should they smear their own blood over the rune, the power intensifies.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Slaves to Darkness

brand of unbreakable bonds.name: Brand of Unbreakable Bonds
brand of unbreakable bonds.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
brand of unbreakable bonds.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of an objective you control and not in combat. This unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
brand of unbreakable bonds.lore: This brand binds those who bear it to a site of corrupted earth. As yet, none know what importance this forsaken land holds.
brand of unbreakable bonds.restrictionText:
Brands of the Dark Gods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO SLAVES TO DARKNESS INFANTRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 Brand of the Dark Gods.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Slaves to Darkness

brand of apoplexy.name: Brand of Apoplexy
brand of apoplexy.description: Effect: While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s weapons.
brand of apoplexy.lore: When those marked with this brand see red, all hell breaks loose.
brand of apoplexy.restrictionText:
Brands of the Dark Gods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO SLAVES TO DARKNESS INFANTRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 Brand of the Dark Gods.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Slaves to Darkness

brand of the unaligned.name: Brand of the Unaligned
brand of the unaligned.description:
Effect: Remove all of this unit’s **Pledge to Chaos** keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following **Pledge to Chaos** keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.

**• Pledged to Khorne**
**• Pledged to Tzeentch**
**• Pledged to Nurgle**
**• Pledged to Slaanesh**

This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.
brand of the unaligned.lore: The warriors bearing this brand are beholden to no single deity; they regularly shift their allegiance depending on which Dark God’s power is in ascendancy.
brand of the unaligned.restrictionText:
Brands of the Dark Gods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO SLAVES TO DARKNESS INFANTRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 Brand of the Dark Gods.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Slaves to Darkness

daemonic speed.name: Daemonic Speed
daemonic speed.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.
daemonic speed.lore: Infernal winds blow at the back of these hordes, speeding them into battle against the enemies of the gods.

spite tongue curse.name: Spite-tongue Curse
spite tongue curse.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the casting attempt is unsuccessful or if the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

Effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.
spite tongue curse.lore: Uttering the foul syllables of the Dark Tongue until blood pours from their mouth, the caster beseeches the Chaos Gods to destroy their enemies – though such pacts carry with them a terrible cost…

binding damnation.name: Binding Damnation
binding damnation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** until the start of your next turn.
binding damnation.lore: At the caster’s urging, tendrils of raw Chaos burst from the tortured ground, entwining the limbs of their enemies and rendering them easy prey.

summon darkfire daemonrift.name: Summon Darkfire Daemonrift
summon darkfire daemonrift.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Darkfire Daemonrift** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Darkfire Daemonrift** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon darkfire daemonrift.lore: Darkfire Daemonrifts are eldritch portals torn ajar by dark incantations. Once the veil has been sundered, raw magic seeping from the Realm of Chaos forms an opening for the horrors beyond to vent their spite, widened and empowered by spellcraft that draws upon the essence of Chaos.

summon eightfold doom sigil.name: Summon Eightfold Doom-sigil
summon eightfold doom sigil.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them
summon eightfold doom sigil.lore: Eightfold Doom-Sigils are icons of Chaos in all its glory, blazing symbols of pure ruin. To fall in the presence of such a sorcerous construct is to be damned, for these lingering spells hungrily suck souls into the Realm of Chaos for the gods to feast upon.

summon realmscourge rupture.name: Summon Realmscourge Rupture
summon realmscourge rupture.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Realmscourge Rupture** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Realmscourge Rupture** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon realmscourge rupture.lore: Realmscourge Ruptures are not subtle weapons. When the necessary magical power has been channelled and released by a tribal shaman, the land itself writhes in the grip of Chaos, sharpened spikes surging forth like an accursed tidal wave to overwhelm anything in their path.

formations.name: Champions of Chaos
formations.description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-**MONSTER SLAVES TO DARKNESS HEROES**.

ability.name: Paragons of Darkness
ability.description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-**MONSTER SLAVES TO DARKNESS HEROES**.
ability.lore: Those who have long walked the Path to Glory and bear the scars and mutations to prove it are some of the most dangerous warriors in all the Mortal Realms.

formations.name: Legion of Chaos
formations.description: Effect: While there is at least 1 friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS HERO** and 1 other friendly **DAEMON HERO** or **DARKOATH HERO** on the battlefield, add 2 to the control scores of friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units while they are contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

ability.name: United in Darkness
ability.description: Effect: While there is at least 1 friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS HERO** and 1 other friendly **DAEMON HERO** or **DARKOATH HERO** on the battlefield, add 2 to the control scores of friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units while they are contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.
ability.lore: The myriad forces of Chaos march to war under a common cause, led by warlords who have put aside their rivalries in the name of laying waste to the lands of a shared foe.

abilities.lore: The myriad forces of Chaos march to war under a common cause, led by warlords who have put aside their rivalries in the name of laying waste to the lands of a shared foe.

formations.name: Chaos Horde
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit. Then, pick up to 2 visible friendly **DARKOATH** units that do not have a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword and are wholly within 12" of that **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit to be the targets.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the targets have the same **Pledge to Chaos** keyword as that **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit.

ability.name: Devotees of Ruin
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit. Then, pick up to 2 visible friendly **DARKOATH** units that do not have a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword and are wholly within 12" of that **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit to be the targets.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the targets have the same **Pledge to Chaos** keyword as that **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit.
ability.lore: Though the Darkoath do not know the true significance of the Dark Gods’ runes, when armour-clad warriors bearing those same sigils arrive in their lands, these visitors are often hailed as divine crusaders sent to save them.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the targets have the same **Pledge to Chaos** keyword as that **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit.

formations.name: Darkoath Horde
formations.description:
Declare: If there is a friendly **DARKOATH HERO** on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DARKOATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Rally The Tribes
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: If there is a friendly **DARKOATH HERO** on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DARKOATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.
ability.lore: One of the horde’s commanders looses a terrifying battle cry, calling more of their blade-sworn warriors to their side.

formations.name: Despoilers
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Daemon Prince** to use this ability. Then, pick a visible non-**DAEMON** non-**UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Remove any **PLEDGE TO CHAOS** keywords the target has. Then, the target gains any **PLEDGE TO CHAOS** keywords this unit has.

ability.name: Feral Ruin
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Daemon Prince** to use this ability. Then, pick a visible non-**DAEMON** non-**UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Remove any **PLEDGE TO CHAOS** keywords the target has. Then, the target gains any **PLEDGE TO CHAOS** keywords this unit has.
ability.lore: A Daemon Prince’s unholy radiance draws to them the most savage of chaotic creatures, abominations against nature that hunger to spill blood.

Effect: Remove any **PLEDGE TO CHAOS** keywords the target has. Then, the target gains any **PLEDGE TO CHAOS** keywords this unit has.
abilities.lore: A Daemon Prince’s unholy radiance draws to them the most savage of chaotic creatures, abominations against nature that hunger to spill blood.

formations.name: Godswrath Warband
formations.description:
Declare: Pick an objective that is contested by any friendly units to be the target.

Effect: Place a **defiled token** next to the target objective. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting an objective that has a friendly **defiled token**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

ability.name: Ironclad Onslaught
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an objective that is contested by any friendly units to be the target.

Effect: Place a **defiled token** next to the target objective. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting an objective that has a friendly **defiled token**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
ability.lore: When a Chaos horde is on the march, the realms tremble. Hundreds of heavily armoured warriors desecrate all in their path as they roar oaths to the Dark Pantheon.

abilities.name: Ironclad Onslaught
