dread marshal.name: Dread Marshal
dread marshal.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly units wholly within 12" of this unit to be targets.

Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.
dread marshal.lore: This mighty warrior has proved their devotion to Be’lakor above all, and their loyalty has been rewarded with a host of warriors to command.
dread marshal.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince

first damned prince.name: First-Damned Prince
first damned prince.description:
Effect: While a friendly **Be’lakor** is within the combat range of any friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON** units:

• That friendly **Be’lakor** has **WARD (4+)**.

• In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **Be’lakor**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON** unit within **Be’lakor**’s combat range after the damage sequence for **Be’lakor** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
first damned prince.lore: Be’lakor courts the favour of all of the Chaos Gods to crush his foes. In battle, he surrounds himself with their lesser daemons to do his bidding.
first damned prince.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince

daemonic reinforcements.name: Daemonic Reinforcements
daemonic reinforcements.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
daemonic reinforcements.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **Be’lakor** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
daemonic reinforcements.lore: Lesser daemons bound to the Dark Master’s will are summoned forth from the Realm of Chaos to swell Be’lakor’s ranks.
daemonic reinforcements.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince

storm of blackened blades.name: Storm of Blackened Blades
storm of blackened blades.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
storm of blackened blades.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Eternus** that is in combat and up to 2 friendly non-**HERO** non-**DAEMON LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** units wholly within 12" of that **Eternus** to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
storm of blackened blades.lore: Eternus commands the mortal legions sworn to Be’lakor to bring ruin to all who dare oppose the First Prince.
storm of blackened blades.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince

bestow favour.name: Bestow Favour
bestow favour.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
bestow favour.description:
Declare: If a friendly **Be’lakor** is on the battlefield, pick a non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 5 to the target’s control score.
• If the target is a **DAEMON** unit, add 1 to save rolls for the target.
• If the target is a non-**DAEMON** unit, it has **WARD (6+)**.
bestow favour.lore: The Great Game plays out in the blackened skies above the First Prince’s legions as oaths are sworn, enemies are crushed, and dark rewards are granted.
bestow favour.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince

black ritual dagger.name: Black Ritual Dagger
black ritual dagger.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit
black ritual dagger.description: Effect: Allocate 1 damage point to this unit. Then, you can re-roll the casting roll.
black ritual dagger.lore: Dark tendrils of chaotic magic coil around this obsidian blade. The bearer’s mind is filled with promises of arcane power if its thirst for blood is quenched.
black ritual dagger.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince

summon eightfold doom sigil.name: Summon Eightfold Doom-Sigil
summon eightfold doom sigil.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-Sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-Sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon eightfold doom sigil.lore: Eightfold Doom-Sigils are icons of Chaos in all its glory, blazing symbols of pure ruin. To fall in the presence of such a sorcerous construct is to be damned, for these lingering spells hungrily suck souls into the Realm of Chaos for the gods to feast upon.

dark cantrip.name: Dark Cantrip
dark cantrip.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each target.
dark cantrip.lore: Uttering blasphemous words in the Dark Tongue, the sorcerer calls forth bolts of black chaotic energy that strike the foe, searing flesh, melting armour and leaving them as a bubbling mass of tentacles.

shroud in darkness.name: Shroud in Darkness
shroud in darkness.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat. In addition, until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units while they are more than 12" away.
shroud in darkness.lore: At the sorcerer’s bidding, unnatural shadows fall upon Be’lakor’s warriors, allowing them to move unseen.

lores.name: Legion of the First Prince Manifestation Lore
Legion of the First Prince Spell Lore

speed of the blood crow.name: Speed of the Blood Crow
speed of the blood crow.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Charge Phase
speed of the blood crow.description:
Declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
speed of the blood crow.lore: A single scarlet crow flies in the skies above, imbuing these warriors with a supernatural swiftness and predatory focus.
speed of the blood crow.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

hunger of shesh shan.name: Hunger of Shesh'shan
hunger of shesh shan.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
hunger of shesh shan.description:
Declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
hunger of shesh shan.lore: Possessed by a wild euphoria, these warriors launch themselves at the foe with abandon, gloating as they revel in the screams and arterial sprays of blood.
hunger of shesh shan.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

rage of arkhar.name: Rage of Arkhar
rage of arkhar.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
rage of arkhar.description:
Declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: Spend 2 **oath points**. The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
rage of arkhar.lore: Unholy anger is stoked in the hearts of these warriors, filling them with hate-fuelled stamina.
rage of arkhar.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

daemonfire weapons.name: Daemonfire Weapons
daemonfire weapons.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
daemonfire weapons.description:
Declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
daemonfire weapons.lore: As if kissed by the breath of the Chimera, the weapons of these warriors blaze with black flames that make a mockery of armour.
daemonfire weapons.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

shroud of the pale elk.name: Shroud of the Pale Elk
shroud of the pale elk.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
shroud of the pale elk.description:
Used By: A friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit targeted by that **ATTACK** ability, if you have 1 or more **oath points**.

Effect: If that friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit has not used an **OATH** ability this turn, spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, that friendly unit has **WARD (4+)**.
shroud of the pale elk.lore: A thick, shimmering miasma swirls around these warriors, surrounding them in fractal mirages that confuse the foe and cause them to strike at nothing but thin air.
shroud of the pale elk.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

messengers of the gods.name: Messengers of the Gods
messengers of the gods.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), End of Any Turn
messengers of the gods.description:
Declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS Darkoath Marauders** or **Fellriders** unit that has been destroyed and has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: Spend 2 **oath points**. Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.
messengers of the gods.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

pledges to the dark gods.name: Pledges to the Dark Gods
pledges to the dark gods.description:
Effect: Each time a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit uses 1 of the following abilities and the effect of that ability is resolved, gain 1 **oath point**.

• ‘Oath of Bloodshed’
• ‘Oath of Murder’
• ‘Oath of Supremacy’
• ‘Oath of the Marauder’
• ‘Oath of the Raider’
• ‘Oath of Conquest’

**Designer’s Note**: *The abilities listed above are abilities on* **DARKOATH** *warscrolls. By using those abilities (i.e. completing the oaths), the player gains* **oath points**, *which can then be spent to use the* **OATH** *abilities in these Army of Renown rules.*
pledges to the dark gods.lore: Few Darkoath tribes swear such grand and terrible oaths as those of the Snow Peaks. Fewer still fulfil so many of their brutal pledges.
pledges to the dark gods.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

oath of kinship.name: Oath of Kinship
oath of kinship.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of another friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks.
oath of kinship.lore: Before the eyes of their fellow tribe members, this chieftain has made a bold oath that they are compelled to honour in order to reaffirm their right to rule.
oath of kinship.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

grand offering.name: Grand Offering
grand offering.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Movement Phase
grand offering.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS Wilderfiend** within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Give the target D6 **sacrifice points**.
grand offering.lore: Before the battle, sacrifices were heaped before the lair of a particularly dreaded Wilderfiend known to haunt the region.
grand offering.groupName: Tribes of the Snow Peaks Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Tribes of the Snow Peaks

demands of the dark gods.name: Demands of the Dark Gods
demands of the dark gods.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
demands of the dark gods.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Demand of Khorne***: For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units.

***Demand of Tzeentch***: Pick 1 visible enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that is not in combat and roll a D6. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

***Demand of Nurgle***: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit. Then pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that healed any damage points this turn. Until the start of the next battle round, that unit has **WARD (6+)**.

***Demand of Slaanesh***: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units until the start of the next battle round.
demands of the dark gods.lore: Each of the Dark Gods covets Archaon’s service and that of the Swords of Chaos also. The Varanguard may exploit this to wrest boons from them – so long as their loyalty to the Everchosen remains paramount.
demands of the dark gods.groupName: The Swords of Chaos Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Swords of Chaos

descent from ruinous skies.name: Descent From Ruinous Skies
descent from ruinous skies.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that is **in the Ruinous Skies**.

Effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
descent from ruinous skies.lore: Riding down from fell portals torn open in the sky, the Swords of Chaos descend to unleash apocalyptic destruction upon the enemies of the Everchosen.
descent from ruinous skies.groupName: The Swords of Chaos Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Swords of Chaos

knights of the first circle.name: Knights of the First Circle
knights of the first circle.description:
Declare: If there are more friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Ruinous Skies**. It has now been deployed.
knights of the first circle.lore: The First Circle of the Varanguard comprises Archaon’s own elite retinue. When they strike from the Chaos-cursed skies, ruin surely follows.
knights of the first circle.groupName: The Swords of Chaos Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Swords of Chaos

the blackstorm apostates.name: The Blackstorm Apostates
the blackstorm apostates.description: Effect: Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
the blackstorm apostates.lore: These warriors are a rare prize indeed for the Everchosen: Azyrites who have embraced Chaos and speed themselves with imprisoned and tortured celestial winds.
the blackstorm apostates.restrictionText: You can include up to 3 First Circle Title enhancements in your army. First Circle Titles can only be given to **Varanguard** units. The same unit cannot have more than 1 First Circle Title.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Swords of Chaos

tamers of haradh s torment.name: Tamers of Haradh's Torment
tamers of haradh s torment.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons.
tamers of haradh s torment.lore: The steeds of these knights once roamed Haradh’s Torment, where a gargant warlord roused the beasts of the Eightpoints to challenge Archaon – and was later punished for it.
tamers of haradh s torment.restrictionText: You can include up to 3 First Circle Title enhancements in your army. First Circle Titles can only be given to **Varanguard** units. The same unit cannot have more than 1 First Circle Title.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Swords of Chaos

betrayers of the anvilking.name: Betrayers of the Anvilking
betrayers of the anvilking.lore: To earn Archaon’s favour, these former apprentices of an ancient smith-lord betrayed their master but preserved his secrets of forgecraft.
betrayers of the anvilking.restrictionText: You can include up to 3 First Circle Title enhancements in your army. First Circle Titles can only be given to **Varanguard** units. The same unit cannot have more than 1 First Circle Title.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Swords of Chaos

the hounds apocalyptus.name: The Hounds Apocalyptus
the hounds apocalyptus.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within enemy territory, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
the hounds apocalyptus.lore: These champions have ridden far across the realms and are rabid in seizing whatever the Everchosen deems a worthy prize.
the hounds apocalyptus.restrictionText: You can include up to 3 First Circle Title enhancements in your army. First Circle Titles can only be given to **Varanguard** units. The same unit cannot have more than 1 First Circle Title.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Swords of Chaos

the grimroot order.name: The Grimroot Order
the grimroot order.description: Effect: Add 1 to this unit’s Health characteristic.
the grimroot order.lore: Corruption suffuses these warriors so deeply that it is said they can endure wounds that would slay even fellow Varanguard.
the grimroot order.restrictionText: You can include up to 3 First Circle Title enhancements in your army. First Circle Titles can only be given to **Varanguard** units. The same unit cannot have more than 1 First Circle Title.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Swords of Chaos

numberless pests.name: Numberless Pests
numberless pests.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units.
numberless pests.lore: The Nurglites are obscured by flies.

burgeoning filth.name: Burgeoning Filth
burgeoning filth.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly units.
burgeoning filth.lore: Nurgle’s followers grow bolder as their infestations multiply.

nauseous revulsion.name: Nauseous Revulsion
nauseous revulsion.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.
nauseous revulsion.lore: These revolting warriors are too hideous to gaze upon for too long.

plague of misery.name: Plague of Misery
plague of misery.description: Effect: While enemy units are within 6" of any friendly units, they cannot use abilities that heal or return slain models to a unit.
plague of misery.lore: A pall of despair covers the battlefield.

nurgle s embrace.name: Nurgle's Embrace
nurgle s embrace.description: Effect: Spend any number of your **disease points**. For each disease point you spend, pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any of your units and roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit (you can pick the same unit more than once).
nurgle s embrace.lore: The Grandfather’s generosity proves overwhelming for many…

daemonic summoning.name: Daemonic Summoning
daemonic summoning.description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
daemonic summoning.lore: The scions of Nurgle enter the battlefield through rifts torn in reality.

diseased.name: Diseased
diseased.description: Effect: Each time an attack made by a friendly model scores a critical hit, you receive 1 **disease point**, to a maximum of 7.
diseased.lore: Each of the Maggotkin is a walking vector of diseases that ravage both body and spirit.

unctuous preacher.name: Unctuous Preacher
unctuous preacher.description: Effect: If this unit is not a **PRIEST**, it has **PRIEST (1)**. If this unit is already a **PRIEST**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.
unctuous preacher.lore: Even this hero’s brethren consider them to be far too enthusiastic in their preachings of Grandfather Nurgle’s blessings.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Maggotkin of Nurgle

corpulent avalanche.name: Corpulent Avalanche
corpulent avalanche.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to this unit’s Move characteristic. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

If any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, this unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.
corpulent avalanche.lore: As this hulk’s momentum builds, its bulk becomes nothing less than a blubbery, pus-filled battering ram.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Maggotkin of Nurgle

living plague.name: Living Plague
living plague.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
living plague.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.
living plague.lore: As this hero slams into the foe, they spread Nurgle’s potent gifts of contagion.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Ghyran: Maggotkin of Nurgle

desperate remedies.name: Desperate Remedies
desperate remedies.description: Effect: If an ability would heal or return slain models to a **DISEASED** enemy unit, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, it no longer has the **DISEASED** keyword.
desperate remedies.lore: When fighters are afflicted with the plagues of Nurgle, all efforts must be made to stem the spread of those diseases.
desperate remedies.restrictionText: Maggotkin of Nurgle armies can use the following abilities:

burst pustules.name: Burst Pustules
burst pustules.description: Effect: Each time a **DISEASED** enemy unit is destroyed, before the last model in the unit is removed from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick another enemy unit within 9" of that model to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature. The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.
burst pustules.lore: As blighted flesh is pierced and hewn, quivering boils erupt, showering all with Nurgle’s glistening gifts.
burst pustules.restrictionText: Maggotkin of Nurgle armies can use the following abilities:

wracked with disease.name: Wracked with Disease
wracked with disease.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
wracked with disease.description:
Declare: Pick each **DISEASED** enemy unit to be the targets.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
wracked with disease.lore: The Maggotkin wage war with weeping wounds and pustulant boils as well as with rusted weapons.
wracked with disease.restrictionText: Maggotkin of Nurgle armies can use the following abilities:

blessed by the plaguefather.name: Blessed by the Plaguefather
blessed by the plaguefather.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
blessed by the plaguefather.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Infect:*** Pick an enemy unit within 7" of any friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle units to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.
• If the target is in combat with any friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units, it has the **DISEASED** keyword.
• If the target is not in combat with any friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units, roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

***Spread:*** Pick a **DISEASED** enemy unit to be the target. Each other enemy unit within the target’s combat range, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, has the **DISEASED** keyword.

***Mutate:*** If all enemy units on the battlefield, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, have the **DISEASED** keyword, inflict 1 mortal damage on each of them.
blessed by the plaguefather.lore: Each of the Maggotkin is a walking vector of disease, a willing incubator for maladies that ravage the body and spirit with horrific virulence.
blessed by the plaguefather.restrictionText: Maggotkin of Nurgle armies can use the following abilities:

ceaseless infectors.name: Ceaseless Infectors
ceaseless infectors.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ceaseless infectors.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was in combat with a friendly **ROTBRINGERS** unit that was destroyed this turn to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has the **DISEASED** keyword.
ceaseless infectors.lore: Upon their deaths, Rotbringers’ bodies will purge their ‘gifts’, infecting those nearby and ensuring the continued propagation of Nurgle’s diseases.
ceaseless infectors.restrictionText: Maggotkin of Nurgle armies can use the following abilities:

blighted regrowth.name: Blighted Regrowth
blighted regrowth.description:
Declare: You can use this ability if there are no friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield.

Effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield wholly within 12" of an objective you control and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.
blighted regrowth.lore: Feculent Gnarlmaws burst forth from contaminated lands like pus from a rotting wound.
blighted regrowth.restrictionText: Maggotkin of Nurgle armies can use the following abilities:

grandfather s blessing.name: Grandfather's Blessing
grandfather s blessing.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat with a **Diseased** enemy unit, **Heal (D3)** this unit.
grandfather s blessing.lore: This mighty Nurglite is so diseased that they are rejuvenated by decay and plague.

gift of febrile frenzy.name: Gift of Febrile Frenzy
gift of febrile frenzy.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
gift of febrile frenzy.lore: This general can invigorate their usually sluggish minions by releasing a fever upon them that drives them into a wild delirium.

overpowering stench.name: Overpowering Stench
overpowering stench.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: You and your opponent must roll off. If your roll is higher, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.
overpowering stench.lore: This general exudes an odour so wretched that even Nurgle’s daemons cannot adequately describe it. Enemies recoil, choking on their own vomit at the slightest whiff, rendered speechless as their senses are overwhelmed.

rustfang.name: Rustfang
rustfang.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
rustfang.lore: Rustfang is a cursed battleaxe whose blade crawls with a thick layer of sentient corrosion. The slightest touch of this blade spreads its blight, chewing away the foe’s defences in moments.

the witherstave.name: The Witherstave
the witherstave.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
the witherstave.lore: Carved from the heartwood of a tormented Treelord, the Witherstave thrums with a soured mockery of the Sylvaneth spirit-song. Those that hear it feel a terrible weakness shiver their limbs as a jarring dirge of despair clouds their minds.

the carrion dirge.name: The Carrion Dirge
the carrion dirge.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
the carrion dirge.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Subtract 5 from each target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
the carrion dirge.lore: When blown, this filth-encrusted horn shrieks with the tongues of seven hundred and seventy-seven carrion crows. Those outside Nurgle’s favour who hear it are struck with a deep despondency. Why stand defiant? Why seek victory? Why do anything at all?

snuggling sickness.name: Snuggling Sickness
snuggling sickness.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• Each time the target uses a **RETREAT** ability, if it is in combat with this unit, roll 2D6 as a reaction and add the target’s Control characteristic to the roll. On an 8+, that **RETREAT** ability has no effect.
• The target cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.
snuggling sickness.lore: Pathologically affectionate, these Nurglites envelop their foes in near-immobilising hugs.
snuggling sickness.restrictionText:
Plaguefather’s Poxes are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Plaguefather’s Pox.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Maggotkin of Nurgle

chuckling murrain.name: Chuckling Murrain
chuckling murrain.description:
Effect: Your opponent must spend 1 additional **rage dice** for a unit to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability while it is in combat with this unit.

When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with this unit, each time your opponent would spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, they must spend 1 additional **rage dice**.

In both cases, that additional dice does not count towards the number of **rage dice** spent for the purposes of the ability.
chuckling murrain.lore: These cheerful Nurglites are afflicted with a minor variant of the Chortling Murrain; to be near them is to see one’s anger dissipate into snorting giggles.
chuckling murrain.restrictionText:
Plaguefather’s Poxes are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Plaguefather’s Pox.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Maggotkin of Nurgle

the weeping flux.name: The Weeping Flux
the weeping flux.description: Effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to this unit’s Health characteristic. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit.
the weeping flux.lore: These Nurglites constantly secrete liberal amounts of noxious ooze from their pores. The ‘splashback’ from landing a telling blow against them is highly injurious to health.
the weeping flux.restrictionText:
Plaguefather’s Poxes are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Plaguefather’s Pox.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Maggotkin of Nurgle

gift of disease.name: Gift of Disease
gift of disease.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with the chanter. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, each enemy unit in combat with the chanter, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, has the **DISEASED** keyword.
gift of disease.lore: The priest licks an oozing sore, savouring the tangy flavour of a ripe contagion, before coughing a phlegmy litany that wreathes them and their allies in a pain-inuring ague.

favoured poxes.name: Favoured Poxes
favoured poxes.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the chanter to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 2 from charge rolls for the target. If the chanting roll was 10+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1, instead.
favoured poxes.lore: With an overwide grin, the priest generously anoints some unwilling victims with a slew of debilitating contagions.

bloated with sickness.name: Bloated with Sickness
bloated with sickness.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-**MONSTER MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
bloated with sickness.lore: The priest hawks a glob of green-black mucus into their palm, leaving fat, writhing parasites in their grasp. With a swift clench of their fist, they grant their followers a putrefying resilience.

infectious surge.name: Infectious Surge
infectious surge.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
infectious surge.lore: As the power of Nurgle waxes, his followers gain the momentum of a spreading pandemic.

frothing mucus.name: Frothing Mucus
frothing mucus.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability has no effect on combat attacks that target the target. If the chanting roll was 6+, weapon abilities other than the **Companion** weapon ability have no effect instead.
frothing mucus.lore: The priest blesses their kin with a rancid layer of protective slime.

agonising vomiting.name: Agonising Vomiting
agonising vomiting.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll 7 dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, add 2 to each roll. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
agonising vomiting.lore: Presaged by a deep rumble within their distended guts, the priest belches forth a deluge of thick, corrosive vomit.

agonising vomiting.name: Agonising Vomiting
agonising vomiting.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll 7 dice. If the target is **DISEASED**, add 1 to each roll. If the chanting roll was 7+, add 1 to each roll. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
agonising vomiting.lore: Presaged by a deep rumble within their distended guts, the priest belches forth a deluge of thick, corrosive vomit.

fleshy abundance.name: Fleshy Abundance
fleshy abundance.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
• **Heal (D3)** the target.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.
fleshy abundance.lore: The sorcerer generously bestows a growth spurt of the most repulsive kind upon their allies, causing their bodies to bloat with great wobbling mounds of grey-green fat.

cloying quagmire.name: Cloying Quagmire
cloying quagmire.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
•  Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
•  If the target’s Save characteristic is 3+ or better, subtract 1 from run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
cloying quagmire.lore: The sorcerer thrusts their hands into the soil, causing the ground beneath their enemies to putrefy into a sucking, grasping quagmire.

crippling despair.name: Crippling Despair
crippling despair.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
crippling despair.lore: With a sweep of their hand, the sorcerer imbues upon their victim with an overwhelming sense of hopelessness that renders them oblivious to their surroundings.

blunting blight.name: Blunting Blight
blunting blight.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, the targets’ attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
blunting blight.lore: The priest ‘improves’ their foe’s weapons, corroding their nasty sharp edges and dulling their horridly glinting points.

febrile advance.name: Febrile Advance
febrile advance.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 3" to the distance each target can move when making pile‐in moves.
febrile advance.lore: Burning up with fever, the priest’s kin dive headlong into the fray in a twitching rush.

formations.name: Tallyband of Nurgle
formations.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the **plague progenitor** for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.

Effect: Roll 2D3. On a 6, or if the roll equals or exceeds the **plague progenitor**’s Health characteristic, it has the **DISEASED** keyword.

In the first battle round, if an ability would heal or return any slain models to a **DISEASED plague progenitor**, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

Each time the **plague progenitor** is picked to be the target of the ‘Spread’ effect of the ‘Blessed by the Plaguefather’ ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within its combat range, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, in addition to the effect of that ability.

ability.name: Plague Progenitor
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the **plague progenitor** for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.

Effect: Roll 2D3. On a 6, or if the roll equals or exceeds the **plague progenitor**’s Health characteristic, it has the **DISEASED** keyword.

In the first battle round, if an ability would heal or return any slain models to a **DISEASED plague progenitor**, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

Each time the **plague progenitor** is picked to be the target of the ‘Spread’ effect of the ‘Blessed by the Plaguefather’ ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within its combat range, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, in addition to the effect of that ability.
ability.lore: Simply to be in the presence of this unwitting pathogen incubator is to see one’s body ravaged by disease.

formations.name: Nurgle's Menagerie
formations.description: Effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

ability.name: Denizens of the Garden
ability.description: Effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
ability.lore: The beasts that dwell deep in Nurgle’s Garden carry the most virulent diseases.

formations.description: Effect: Each time you make a run roll for a friendly non-**MONSTER MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit, you can change that roll to a 4.

ability.name: Filth-laden Daemonic Blooms
ability.description: Effect: Each time you make a run roll for a friendly non-**MONSTER MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit, you can change that roll to a 4.
ability.lore: Nurgle’s influence has spread far and wide, invigorating his daemonic followers.

formations.description: Effect: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**HERO ROTBRINGERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** units.

ability.name: Vectors of Contagion
ability.description: Effect: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**HERO ROTBRINGERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** units.
ability.lore: These Nurglites are empowered by the presence of plague daemons.
