abilities.lore: These Nurglites are empowered by the presence of plague daemons.

plague of misery.name: Plague of Misery
plague of misery.description: Effect: While enemy units are within 12" of any friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** units, they cannot use abilities that heal or return slain models to a unit.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

nauseous revulsion.name: Nauseous Revulsion
nauseous revulsion.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

unnatural vitality.name: Unnatural Vitality
unnatural vitality.description: Effect: Friendly non-**MONSTER CYCLE OF CORRUPTION HEROES** have **WARD (4+)**.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

burgeoning filth.name: Burgeoning Filth
burgeoning filth.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** units.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

corrupted regrowth.name: Corrupted Regrowth
corrupted regrowth.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
corrupted regrowth.description:
Effect: **Heal (7)** each friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw**.

If there are no friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield, you can set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

rampant disease.name: Rampant Disease
rampant disease.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly non-**HERO CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

revolution and revulsion.name: Revolution and Revulsion
revolution and revulsion.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
revolution and revulsion.description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round.

Effect: If it is the first battle round, roll a dice to determine which **CYCLE** ability is ripe for the rest of the battle round.

1 ‘Unnatural Vitality’
2 ‘Fecund Vigour’
3 ‘Burgeoning Filth’
4 ‘Plague of Misery’
5 ‘Nauseous Revulsion’
6 ‘Rampant Disease’
7 ‘Corrupted Regrowth’

If it is not the first battle round, the next **CYCLE** ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round. If the ‘Corrupted Regrowth’ ability was ripe last battle round, the ‘Unnatural Vitality’ ability is ripe this battle round.

You can only use a **CYCLE** ability if it is ripe. Only 1 **CYCLE** ability is ripe each battle round.
revolution and revulsion.lore: Nurgle’s power and blessings follow a never-ending cycle of fecundity and decay.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

fecund vigour.name: Fecund Vigour
fecund vigour.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
fecund vigour.description: Effect: **HEAL (D3)** each friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** unit.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

utterly disgusting.name: Utterly Disgusting
utterly disgusting.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.
utterly disgusting.lore: The sight of this hero’s hideously mutated body is truly nauseating.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

cankerous nail.name: Cankerous Nail
cankerous nail.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
cankerous nail.lore: This nail has been dipped in Nurgle’s cauldron and seethes with corruption.
cankerous nail.groupName: Cycle of Corruption Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Cycle of Corruption

epidermal crustitis.name: Epidermal Crustitis
epidermal crustitis.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target the caster.
epidermal crustitis.lore: The caster grins widely as their skin hardens into a crusty layer.

spittledrain.name: Spittledrain
spittledrain.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target, to a maximum of 7.
spittledrain.lore: The wizard coughs up a expanding wad of corrosive phlegm to spit at the foe.

rank and vile.name: Rank and Vile
rank and vile.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain, after removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 4+, return 1 slain model to a friendly non-**HERO CYCLE OF CORRUPTION INFANTRY** unit within 6" of the target.
rank and vile.lore: Slain foes are festooned with disease only to rise again amidst the Nurglite ranks.

bacterial blessing.name: Bacterial Blessing
bacterial blessing.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks. If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
bacterial blessing.lore: The priest blesses their comrades’ weapons with colonies of bacteria.

virulent agonies.name: Virulent Agonies
virulent agonies.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within the target’s combat range. If the chanting roll was 7+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target instead of 1.
virulent agonies.lore: The priest calls forth a painful, nerve-burning malady to blight their foes.

ever turning.name: Ever Turning
ever turning.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: The next **CYCLE** ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round instead of the current **CYCLE** ability. If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick which **CYCLE** ability is ripe.
ever turning.lore: The priest beseeches Nurgle to bestow his gifts upon his Rotbringer followers.

transplanting.name: Transplanting
transplanting.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
transplanting.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE HERO** and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.
transplanting.lore: The most proficient of Nurgle’s gardeners can coax a Feculent Gnarlmaw to their side.
transplanting.groupName: The Gardeners of Nurgle Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Gardeners of Nurgle

sickly sores.name: Sickly Sores
sickly sores.description: Effect: While a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE INFANTRY** unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw**, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to it in each phase.
sickly sores.lore: The blighted seeds released by the Feculent Gnarlmaws invigorate those who tend the Garden.
sickly sores.groupName: The Gardeners of Nurgle Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Gardeners of Nurgle

putrescent sap.name: Putrescent Sap
putrescent sap.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
putrescent sap.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit within 3" of any friendly **Feculent** **Gnarlmaws** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
putrescent sap.lore: Vile black fluid oozes from bark-sores and withered tree limbs.
putrescent sap.groupName: The Gardeners of Nurgle Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Gardeners of Nurgle

the head gardener.name: The Head Gardener
the head gardener.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
the head gardener.description: Effect: The friendly **Horticulous Slimux** can use his ‘Cultivating the Garden of Nurgle’ ability this phase even if there are 1 or more friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield.
the head gardener.lore: The daemon responsible for tending the Garden has no equal in the propagation of its blighted orchards.
the head gardener.groupName: The Gardeners of Nurgle Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Gardeners of Nurgle

foul fauna.name: Foul Fauna
foul fauna.description: Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE** **Beasts of Nurgle** and **Plague Drones** units while they are wholly within 6" of any friendly **Feculent** **Gnarlmaws**.
foul fauna.lore: The creatures that inhabit the Garden of Nurgle are ebullient monstrosities…
foul fauna.groupName: The Gardeners of Nurgle Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Gardeners of Nurgle

the garden grows.name: The Garden Grows
the garden grows.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
the garden grows.description: Effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.
the garden grows.lore: The tendrils of decay reach ever outwards to find fresh places of purity to contaminate.
the garden grows.groupName: The Gardeners of Nurgle Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Gardeners of Nurgle

foetid orchardist.name: Foetid Orchardist
foetid orchardist.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks while it is wholly within 7" of any friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws**.
foetid orchardist.lore: Those who tend the copses of Feculent Gnarlmaws will fight vigorously to protect their arboreal charges.
foetid orchardist.groupName: The Gardeners of Nurgle Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Gardeners of Nurgle

stinking sporeseed.name: Stinking Sporeseed
stinking sporeseed.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
stinking sporeseed.description: Effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** within 3" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.
stinking sporeseed.lore: Chewed by blackened teeth, this seed is ripe with putrescence. Once planted, it germinates into a pestilential bloom of magnificent proportions.
stinking sporeseed.groupName: The Gardeners of Nurgle Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Gardeners of Nurgle

canopy of virulence.name: Canopy of Virulence
canopy of virulence.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws**, ward rolls cannot be made for enemy units in combat with the target.
canopy of virulence.lore: Those who labour in the shadow of Nurgle’s orchards are empowered by this arcane rite.

munificent blights.name: Munificent Blights
munificent blights.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted on the target by the ‘Putrescent Sap’ ability.
munificent blights.lore: This pestilential rite makes the Garden even more generous with gifts for its guests.

scumfall.name: Scumfall
scumfall.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE** units that are wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** are not visible to units more than 9" away.
scumfall.lore: With murmured incantation, the caster coaxes forth a scummy dust from Nurgle’s orchards to blanket his followers in an obfuscating cloud.

lores.name: The Gardeners of Nurgle Spell Lore

phoenix stone.name: Phoenix Stone
phoenix stone.description: Effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.
phoenix stone.lore: This ancient crystal, at once hot and cold to the touch, shatters just as the bearer’s anima is about to flee their body, releasing swirling flames that reknit flesh rather than burn, granting the bearer a precious second chance to fulfil their destiny.

silver wand.name: Silver Wand
silver wand.description: Effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
silver wand.lore: This slender wand, unassuming in its delicate grace and simplicity, is covered with finely engraved, winding Lumineth runes. It is imbued with the quiet dignity of the one who crafted it, a power that can be channelled by the bearer to dispel wild outbursts of enemy magics and focus their own spellweaving.

waystone.name: Waystone
waystone.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.
waystone.lore: This small sliver of dark rock hovers above the bearer’s outstretched palm, leading them along hidden paths towards that which they desire. Its use requires exceptional discipline or stillness of the mind, for what one thinks one desires is ever elusive – often perilously so.

lightning reactions.name: Lightning Reactions
lightning reactions.description: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 units instead of 1. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.
lightning reactions.lore: Lumineth possess a natural alacrity beyond that of most rivals.

power of hysh.name: Power of Hysh
power of hysh.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
power of hysh.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, until the start of your next turn, attacks made by that unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
power of hysh.lore: Vanari can use their innate arcane abilities to empower their sunmetal weapons.

shining company.name: Shining Company
shining company.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls that target friendly units.
shining company.lore: Numinous light shines from this aelven formation, bedazzling the foe.

facets of war.name: Facets of War
facets of war.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
facets of war.description: Effect: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round. Pick 1 **FACET OF WAR** ability. That **FACET OF WAR** ability can be used this battle round but the other two cannot.
facets of war.lore: The arts of war practised by the Lumineth are subtle, precise and devastating.

flawless commander.name: Flawless Commander
flawless commander.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY** units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
flawless commander.lore: This aelf has dedicated their life to mastering battlefield manoeuvres. Infantry formations that march under their banner operate in perfect unison, swiftly making way for each other and allowing them to advance with awe-inspiring discipline.

flawless commander.name: Flawless Commander
flawless commander.description: Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
flawless commander.lore: Under this aelf’s command, the serried ranks of the Lumineth advance in a perfect march.

masterful tactician.name: Masterful Tactician
masterful tactician.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
masterful tactician.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
masterful tactician.lore: This shrewd commander has a crystal-clear understanding of the flow of battle, knowing precisely when to direct their warriors to bolster a weak point in their line or exploit one in that of the enemy.

acolyte of the runes.name: Acolyte of the Runes
acolyte of the runes.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: That **HERO** can be picked as an additional target the next time you use the ‘Depict Rune’ ability.
acolyte of the runes.lore: This aelf regularly meditates upon the aelven runic scripture. Over time, they have become particularly sensitive to the sigils’ power.

gale force.name: Gale Force
gale force.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **ATTACK** ability
gale force.description:
Used By: The unit using that **ATTACK** ability.

Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability if the target of that ability is closer to the **leeward** battlefield edge than the unit using this ability.
gale force.lore: Aligning their attacks with the direction of the wind allows the Hurakan to strike with deadlier force.

storm brewing.name: Storm Brewing
storm brewing.description:
Declare: Pick a battlefield edge to be the target.

Effect: That battlefield edge is **leeward**. For the rest of the battle, each time a friendly **RIDE THE HURRICANE** ability is used, after that ability has been resolved, change the **leeward** battlefield edge to the next edge clockwise.

pulled by winds.name: Pulled by Winds
pulled by winds.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
pulled by winds.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can move D6" but must end that move closer to the **leeward** battlefield edge. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
pulled by winds.lore: The Hurakan allow themselves to be pulled by the winds to more tactical locations.

depict rune.name: Depict Rune
depict rune.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
depict rune.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following runes to depict on your **battle scripture**. The effect and conditional enhanced effects of that rune last for the rest of the battle round. Each rune remains on your **battle scripture** for the rest of the battle or until it is removed or replaced by another ability.

**Varinor, Rune of Strength:** Pick up to 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for each target. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 1 to wound rolls for each target’s combat attacks.
• While **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

**Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain**: Pick up to 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Each target has **WARD (5+)**. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, the targets’ melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets.

**Ydriliqi, Rune of the River**: Pick up to 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of any of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by the targets.
• If **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can immediately move up to 3". They can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

**Oreali, Rune of the Wind**: Pick up to 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your battle scripture, add 4" to each target’s Move characteristic.
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 5 to each target’s control score.

**Thalari, Rune of the Zenith**: Add 2 to casting rolls for friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units. In addition, if you have 4 or more unique runes depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 4" to the Move characteristic of friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units and friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units’ attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

**Designer’s Note:** *We recommend noting the runes you have inscribed in each battle round on a piece of paper to keep track of which are currently depicted on your **battle scripture.** Feel free to note them by type (Strength, River, Mountain etc.), by initial (each has a different first letter) or, if you are feeling particularly adventurous, you can try your hand at aelven calligraphy and learn to draw each rune!*
depict rune.lore: The Lumineth magically inscribe runes of power into the lands themselves to enhance their armies and heal the realms of Chaos corruption.
depict rune.restrictionText: Lumineth Realm‑lords armies can use the following abilities:

aetherquartz requisitioner.name: Aetherquartz Requisitioner
aetherquartz requisitioner.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD within this unit’s combat range
aetherquartz requisitioner.description: Effect: Add 3 to the casting roll for that spell.
aetherquartz requisitioner.lore: This aelf keeps an emergency supply of aetherquartz that can be used to enhance a critical spell.

martial perfectionist.name: Martial Perfectionist
martial perfectionist.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is damaged or that had any models slain this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
martial perfectionist.lore: This aelf expects their warriors to commit fully to each and every task; they will accept no half measures.

scholar of the sigils.name: Scholar of the Sigils
scholar of the sigils.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following runes and apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the battle. That rune cannot be depicted on your battle scripture for the rest of the battle.

***Varinor, Rune of Strength***: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

***Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain***: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.

***Ydriliqi, Rune of the River***: This unit’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge** **(+1 Rend)** and this unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat**.

***Oreali, Rune of the Wind***: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target this unit.

***Thalari, Rune of the Zenith***: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
scholar of the sigils.lore: This aelf has dedicated their life to the study of runic scripture; few are as knowledgeable as they.

peerless swordsman.name: Peerless Swordsman
peerless swordsman.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit with a starting size of 1 that is in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons to be the **parrying blade**.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the Attacks characteristic of the **parrying blade**. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s non‐**Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, for each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
peerless swordsman.lore: This warrior’s skill with their favoured weapon is such that deflecting even the most grievous of blows is as child’s play to them.

dispassionate soul.name: Dispassionate Soul
dispassionate soul.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
dispassionate soul.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat with an enemy **HERO**, reduce your opponent’s **fury level** by **X**, where **X** is the number of unique runes depicted on your battle scripture.
dispassionate soul.lore: So impassive is this aelf that they can pacify others with their mere presence.

perfect footwork.name: Perfect Footwork
perfect footwork.description: Effect: If each model in this unit is contesting the same objective, this unit can move up to 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move. It does not have to end that move in combat. It must end that move with each of its models contesting the same objective. Then, this unit cannot use **RUN** abilities for the rest of the turn.
perfect footwork.lore: These warriors can seamlessly shift their position on key sites.
perfect footwork.restrictionText: Flawless Manoeuvres are unique enhancements that can be given to non‐**HERO** non‐**MONSTER** **LUMINETH** **REALM-LORDS** units. A unit can only have 1 Flawless Manoeuvre.

patient strike.name: Patient Strike
patient strike.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that is in combat with the target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
patient strike.lore: The implacable focus of these Lumineth grants them the discipline required to wait for the enemy’s inevitable misstep.
patient strike.restrictionText: Flawless Manoeuvres are unique enhancements that can be given to non‐**HERO** non‐**MONSTER** **LUMINETH** **REALM-LORDS** units. A unit can only have 1 Flawless Manoeuvre.

dazzling phalanx.name: Dazzling Phalanx
dazzling phalanx.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a **CHARGE** ability for a unit within 9" of and visible to this unit
dazzling phalanx.description: Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target the enemy unit using that **CHARGE** ability.
dazzling phalanx.lore: These warriors angle the light emitted by their sunmetal weapons to blind and disorientate the foe as they bear down upon them.
dazzling phalanx.restrictionText: Flawless Manoeuvres are unique enhancements that can be given to non‐**HERO** non‐**MONSTER** **LUMINETH** **REALM-LORDS** units. A unit can only have 1 Flawless Manoeuvre.

beacon of hysh.name: Beacon of Hysh
beacon of hysh.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly non-**MONSTER LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly with 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets that friendly unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
beacon of hysh.lore: The caster imbues allies with an aura of brilliance that blinds their opponents.

overwhelming heat.name: Overwhelming Heat
overwhelming heat.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn, then roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.
overwhelming heat.lore: The caster summons the searing light and oppressive heat of the Hyshian deserts to sap their foes’ strength and inflict them with crippling thirst.

piercing refraction.name: Piercing Refraction
piercing refraction.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
piercing refraction.lore: The caster looses a thin, burning ray of light that leaps between a group of foes in a dazzling series of perfectly straight beams, scorching minute holes through them that can prove instantly lethal.

summon rune of petrification.name: Summon Rune of Petrification
summon rune of petrification.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Rune of Petrification** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Rune of Petrification** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon rune of petrification.lore: The caster calls forth a hovering sigil formed from the very crust of the realm.

summon hyshian twinstones.name: Summon Hyshian Twinstones
summon hyshian twinstones.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Hyshian Twinstones** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Hyshian Twinstones** endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon hyshian twinstones.lore: The caster calls forth two giant crystal teardrops that orbit around each other.

summon sanctum of amyntok.name: Summon Sanctum of Amyntok
summon sanctum of amyntok.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanctum of Amyntok** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Sanctum of Amyntok** wholly within 12" of the caster and more than 3" from all enemy units. A **Sanctum of Amyntok** has 3 parts that must be set up touching each other so that they form a ring.
summon sanctum of amyntok.lore: Triple manifestations of the rune Yngra form a protective barrier around the summoner.

elemental push.name: Elemental Push
elemental push.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of them that was not set up this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is in combat.

Effect: The target can move up to 5". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
elemental push.lore: Carried upon a shifting patch of earth or sped by a benevolent zephyr, a group of Lumineth are carried to a more advantageous position by the spirits of the land.

focused erosion.name: Focused Erosion
focused erosion.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
focused erosion.lore: The caster calls upon nearby spirits of wind, water and stone, which work together to assail the weapons of the foe in a sentient storm that dulls blades and spoils ammunition.

realmshield.name: Realmshield
realmshield.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
realmshield.lore: Whether buffeting air spirits that hinder incoming attacks or minor earth aelementors that move to obstruct the Lumineth’s foes, the land around the caster is stirred to provide protection to the aelves.

unseen force.name: Unseen Force
unseen force.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use **RUN** abilities. In addition, if that enemy unit has already been picked to be the target of this ability this battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
unseen force.lore: Focusing on the balance of the cosmos, the caster turns the foe’s own aggression against them, channelling an invisible barrier to hold back their advance.

beam of hysh.name: Beam of Hysh
beam of hysh.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this battle round to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the casting value of this spell for each time it has been successfully cast by a friendly **WIZARD** this turn.

Effect: Inflict D3+**X** mortal damage on the target, where **X** is the number of times, to a maximum of 3, that this spell has previously been successfully cast by a friendly **WIZARD** this turn.
beam of hysh.lore: Tracing the rune of Varinor in the air, the caster looses a brilliant lance of searing light.

beacons of protection.name: Beacons of Protection
beacons of protection.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to friendly non-**MONSTER LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units each phase while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD**. Add 3" to the range for each additional time this spell has been successfully cast by a friendly **WIZARD** this battle round.
beacons of protection.lore: Glowing with inner light, the Lumineth’s spellcasters envelop themselves and nearby allies in a radiant shield.

formations.name: Scinari Council
formations.description: Effect: **SPELL** abilities from the Lore of Hysh or the Lore of the Awakened Realms used by friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** **WIZARDS** have the **UNLIMITED** keyword. However, you cannot pick the same unit to be the target of the same **SPELL** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Arcane Focus
ability.description: Effect: **SPELL** abilities from the Lore of Hysh or the Lore of the Awakened Realms used by friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** **WIZARDS** have the **UNLIMITED** keyword. However, you cannot pick the same unit to be the target of the same **SPELL** ability in the same turn.
ability.lore: The Scinari mages in this host have collectively dedicated their lives to studying the magics of the realms.

abilities.name: Arcane Focus
abilities.description: Effect: **SPELL** abilities from the Lore of Hysh or the Lore of the Awakened Realms used by friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** **WIZARDS** have the **UNLIMITED** keyword. However, you cannot pick the same unit to be the target of the same **SPELL** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Scinari mages in this host have collectively dedicated their lives to studying the magics of the realms.

formations.name: Warhost of Duality
formations.description: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** units instead of 1. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.

ability.name: Strike as One
ability.description: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** units instead of 1. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.
ability.lore: Symmetry is fundamental to aelven nature and culture. These warriors exemplify the concept, fighting in awe-inspiring synchrony.

abilities.name: Strike as One
abilities.description: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** units instead of 1. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.
abilities.lore: Symmetry is fundamental to aelven nature and culture. These warriors exemplify the concept, fighting in awe-inspiring synchrony.

formations.name: Aelementor Guardians
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS MONSTER** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of the target.

ability.name: Ancient Spirits
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS MONSTER** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of the target.
ability.lore: The aelementor spirits that accompany this host are venerable indeed. They have weathered the march of aeons; they will not yield to the petty aggression of short-lived mortals.

abilities.name: Ancient Spirits
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS MONSTER** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of the target.
abilities.lore: The aelementor spirits that accompany this host are venerable indeed. They have weathered the march of aeons; they will not yield to the petty aggression of short-lived mortals.

formations.name: Pilgrims of Haixiah
formations.description: Effect: Friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units can use the ‘Power Through’ command even if they have not charged this turn.

ability.name: Trick of the Light
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units can use the ‘Power Through’ command even if they have not charged this turn.
ability.lore: These Lumineth have journeyed to the far reaches of Hysh. The wild magic of that region has found purchase in them, occasionally surrounding them with prismatic distortions and mirages that confuse nearby foes as to their precise location.

abilities.name: Trick of the Light
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units can use the ‘Power Through’ command even if they have not charged this turn.
abilities.lore: These Lumineth have journeyed to the far reaches of Hysh. The wild magic of that region has found purchase in them, occasionally surrounding them with prismatic distortions and mirages that confuse nearby foes as to their precise location.

nullstone beads.name: Nullstone Beads
nullstone beads.description: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
nullstone beads.lore: These beads, each graven with the rune Danoi, are cold to the touch, and the owner risks drifting into a deep slumber should they wear them for too long. However, they possess powerful anti-magic properties and can cause enemy spells to wither and dissipate when brandished with purpose.

swiftfeather talisman.name: Swiftfeather Talisman
swiftfeather talisman.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
swiftfeather talisman.lore: This delicate talisman, in the form of a feather engraved with the rune Senlui, can instil sudden swiftness and lightness of step in the bearer or their chosen companions.

phoenix blade.name: Phoenix Blade
phoenix blade.description: Effect: This unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
phoenix blade.lore: This blade is imbued with a portion of the Lord Phoenix’s incandescent power; those who feel its bite have the potential to suddenly ignite in purifying flames.

master duellist.name: Master Duellist
master duellist.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+:
• If the target has an artefact of power, it no longer has that artefact of power.
• The target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
master duellist.lore: Not only is this warrior a paragon of single combat, landing multiple strikes before their opponent even has a chance to respond, but they have also studied an ancient technique of arcane unforging that robs the foe’s magical artefacts of their power.

rewards of valour.name: Rewards of Valour
rewards of valour.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE VANARI HERO** that does not have an artefact of power to be the target.

Effect: Give the target 1 artefact of power from the 'Vanari Paragons' Army of Renown rules.

**Designer's Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the* **HERO** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
rewards of valour.lore: Recognising excellence is a core precept among the ranks of the Vanari. Their finest are often rewarded with powerful heirlooms in recognition of their deeds.

blessing of tyrion.name: Blessing of Tyrion
blessing of tyrion.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
blessing of tyrion.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have completed 3 **labours**.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units have **WARD (5+)**.
blessing of tyrion.lore: Those who uphold the Decree Tyrionic and the values of the Lord Phoenix shine with a radiant glory that repels evil.

labour of might.name: Labour of Might
labour of might.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
labour of might.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed this battle.

Effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units.
labour of might.lore: The Vanari vow to vanquish those who threaten the sanctity of the realms.

labour of precision.name: Labour of Precision
labour of precision.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
labour of precision.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if there are no enemy units with an artefact of power on the battlefield.

Effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 10 to the control scores of friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** units.
labour of precision.lore: The Vanari seek to deliver a series of perfect strikes to unravel the cohesion of the foe, eliminating their commanders with precision and decisiveness.

labour of control.name: Labour of Control
labour of control.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
labour of control.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if there is at least 1 different friendly unit within 6" of each battlefield edge.

Effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units.
labour of control.lore: As proof of their mastery of battle, the Vanari task themselves with dominating all corners of the battlefield.

world mage.name: World-Mage
world mage.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each unique rune depicted on your **battle scripture**.
world mage.lore: While they have dedicated themselves to one of the elements, this mage has meditated long on the Hysh-Mhensa as a whole, unlocking truths that allow them to draw power from all aspects of the World Rune.

aelementor focus.name: Aelementor Focus
aelementor focus.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next **SPELL** ability used by this unit from the target instead of from this unit.
aelementor focus.lore: Whether a shard of igneous rock rendered glittering by the weight of a soaring peak, a simple whistle that plays notes pleasing to mischievous air spirits, or a perfectly smooth pebble crafted by the millennia-long caress of a crystal rapid, this object acts as a more direct channel of communion with the spirits of the land.

world runes.name: World Runes
world runes.description:
Effect: Add 1 **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** to your **library** for each friendly **ALARITH** unit on the battlefield.

Add 1 **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** to your **library** for each friendly **HURAKAN** unit on the battlefield.

Add 1 **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** to your **library** for each friendly **YDRILAN** unit on the battlefield.

You can have a maximum of 6 of each type of rune in your **library**.
world runes.lore: The aelementiri are particularly sensitive to the runes of the core elements that constitute the Hysh-Mhensa, for these sigils represent the natural forces to which they have dedicated their lives.

depict rune.name: Depict Rune
depict rune.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
depict rune.description:
Declare: You must use this ability.

Effect: Remove all runes from your **battle scripture**. Then, pick any number of runes to remove from your **library** and depict them on your **battle scripture**. Runes removed from your library in this way are removed for the rest of the battle.

**Designer’s Note:** *Runes are used to activate powerful abilities on your units’ warscrolls.*
depict rune.lore: Channelling the power of their temple’s runes, the aelementiri bring their extraordinary powers to bear against the foe.

entreat spirits.name: Entreat Spirits
entreat spirits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
entreat spirits.description:
Declare: You can use this ability if you have 3 or more runes in your **library**. Pick a friendly non- **UNIQUE MONSTER** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Remove any 3 runes from your **library**. Then, set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Allocate 6 damage points to the replacement unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
entreat spirits.lore: Even should an aelementor’s war-form be vanquished, the spirit itself is not so easily undone. Amidst its natural environment, the combined power of multiple runes of the land can call it back to battle, seeing it return to inhabit the sacred armour that was forged for it.

the realms fight back.name: The Realms Fight Back
the realms fight back.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
the realms fight back.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature. Then, pick an enemy unit within 6" of that terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3 and apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn.

**1.  Eruption of Earth:** Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.
**2.  Howling Winds:** Subtract 5 from the target’s control score.
**3.  Flash Flood:** The target has **STRIKE-LAST**.
the realms fight back.lore: The spirits of the land itself awaken to aid the Lumineth in their struggle against the powers of ruin.

vexing spirits.name: Vexing Spirits
vexing spirits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **AELEMENTIRI CONCLAVE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands.
vexing spirits.lore: Shifting shingle, stinging winds or sudden fog, minor spirits of the land band together to bedevil and harass the foe.

cycle manifestation.name: Cycle Manifestation
cycle manifestation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **AELEMENTIRI CONCLAVE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

• **Sanctum of Amyntok**
• **Hyshian Twinstones**
• **Rune of Petrification**

Effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that **MANIFESTATION** is a **Sanctum of Amyntok**, it must instead be set up wholly within 12" of the caster, more than 3" from all enemy units, and with its 3 parts touching each other so that they form a ring.
cycle manifestation.lore: With a deft gesture, the caster dismisses one manifestation and uses its power to summon another.

crimson draught.name: Crimson Draught
crimson draught.description: Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.
crimson draught.lore: This vile mixture grants the drinker incredible bursts of speed. Fatal in all but the most controlled of doses, it is often 'gifted' to those whom Morathi is keeping an eye on.

darkling elixir.name: Darkling Elixir
darkling elixir.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
darkling elixir.lore: Crafted from the blood of creatures best left unnamed, this wicked brew lends the imbiber’s outline a smoky, wispy appearance.

witchbrew.name: Witchbrew
witchbrew.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
witchbrew.lore: This holy potion drives the imbiber into such an ecstasy of destruction that they will fight on in the face of impossible odds.

shadowmasked.name: Shadowmasked
shadowmasked.phase: Once Per Turn, Any Charge Phase
shadowmasked.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that is in combat and did not charge this turn to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit for the rest of the turn.
shadowmasked.lore: The umbral arts of the Khainite Shadowstalkers and the gore-smoke of the Cauldron are utilised to mask the movements of the Shadow Coven.

blessings of khaine.name: Blessings of Khaine
blessings of khaine.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
blessings of khaine.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you performed any blood rites this turn.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following blessings that is not **active**. That blessing is **active**. While a blessing is **active**, its effect applies to friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** units. The effects of more than 1 blessing can apply to a unit at the same time.

• ***Blessing of Ruthlessness:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
• ***Blessing of Hatred:*** Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
• ***Blessing of Haste:*** Add 3" to those units’ Move characteristic.
• ***Blessing of Zeal:*** If those units charged in the same turn, they have **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
• ***Blessing of Shadow:*** Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target those units.
• ***Blessing of Cruelty:*** Those units can use **CHARGE** and/or **SHOOT** abilities even if they have used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
• ***Blessing of Clarity:*** Add 1 to chanting rolls and casting rolls for those units.
blessings of khaine.lore: As ever more blood is spilt in tribute, so too are the Khainites lavished with ever more blessings from their deity.
blessings of khaine.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

anointed ritualist.name: Anointed Ritualist
anointed ritualist.description:
Declare: If there are no friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE HERO** on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: The target is **anointed** for the rest of the battle, even if it has been destroyed. Friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield treat **EXALTED** abilities on the warscrolls of friendly **anointed** units that have been destroyed as if they were on their warscrolls.
anointed ritualist.lore: The skin of a worthy champion is smeared with oil and daubed with sacred blood runes, and they are granted the honour of leading those gory rituals beloved of Morathi-Khaine.
anointed ritualist.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

strident war cry.name: Strident War Cry
strident war cry.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for an anointed unit
strident war cry.description:
Used By: That **anointed** unit.

Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of that **anointed** unit and has not charged this turn to be the target. If that **anointed** unit charges, after that **CHARGE** ability has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.
strident war cry.lore: As the anointed champion unleashes a piercing battle cry, her faithful rush to join her in the crucible of combat.
strident war cry.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

bloody succession.name: Bloody Succession
bloody succession.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed, after removing it from play, you can immediately use the ‘Anointed Ritualist’ ability as if it were the start of the first battle round.
bloody succession.lore: As one anointed champion falls, the runes painted on their skin fade away, only to reappear upon the body of another faithful soul.
bloody succession.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

blood rites.name: Blood Rites
blood rites.description:
Effect: You perform a blood rite each time:

• An enemy unit is destroyed and any damage points were allocated to that unit by a friendly **anointed** unit’s combat attacks in the same turn.
• A friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed.
• A friendly unit contesting an objective you control is destroyed.
• An enemy unit is destroyed by a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit’s attacks and any models in that enemy unit were contesting an objective you do not control in the same phase.
• A unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed and it was within 3" of a **Place of Power** at the start of the phase.

Only one blood rite can be performed per unit destroyed.
blood rites.lore: Manifold are the Khainite blood rituals, but no offering holds greater weight than the spilling of gore in a ritualistic bacchanal.
blood rites.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

murderous duellist.name: Murderous Duellist
murderous duellist.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of the target’s attacks must target this unit.
murderous duellist.lore: This hero has trained extensively in gladiatorial arenas across the realms and is utterly dedicated to the art of single combat.

hand of khaine.name: Hand of Khaine
hand of khaine.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. If the target is destroyed by this ability, this unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
hand of khaine.lore: This murderer has mastered Khaine’s killing touch, a move so lethal it can sunder plate, body and soul in equal measure.

shadow blooded.name: Shadow-Blooded
shadow blooded.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
shadow blooded.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
shadow blooded.lore: This hero hails from one of the darkest parts of Ulgu, and their heritage grants them a significant aptitude for deception.

murder manifested.name: Murder Manifested
murder manifested.phase: Reaction: This unit used the 'Activate Place of Power' ability
murder manifested.description:
Effect: Apply the effect below instead of the effect of that ‘Activate Place of Power’ ability.

Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. On a 2+, if there are no friendly **Avatars of Khaine** on the battlefield, set up an **Avatar of Khaine** wholly within 12" of this unit, visible to it and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit has summoned that **MANIFESTATION**.
murder manifested.lore: This warrior can use sacrificial magics in order to summon avatars of the Bloody‐Handed God.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Daughters of Khaine

loyal unto death.name: Loyal Unto Death
loyal unto death.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE HERO** that has a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit’s Health characteristic to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, if this unit is within the target’s combat range when the target would be destroyed, the target is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** the target. Then, this unit is destroyed.
loyal unto death.lore: Some amongst the sisterhood are devoutly loyal to the point of self-sacrifice.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Daughters of Khaine

honoured among sects.name: Honoured Among Sects
honoured among sects.description: Effect: If this unit is **anointed**, the effect of all blessings from the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability apply to this unit as if they were **active**.
honoured among sects.lore: This warrior is uniquely favoured by Khaine, granting them impressive abilities.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Daughters of Khaine

ulguan reactions.name: Ulguan Reactions
ulguan reactions.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
ulguan reactions.lore: Their preternatural movements obscured, these warriors can deflect incoming blows and visit them back upon the attacker.
ulguan reactions.restrictionText:
Boons of Shadow are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Boon of Shadow.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Daughters of Khaine

talismans of shadow.name: Talismans of Shadow
talismans of shadow.phase: Reaction: You declared a SPELL, PRAYER or UNBIND ability for a unit within 3" of this unit
talismans of shadow.description: Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to that casting roll, chanting roll or unbinding roll.
talismans of shadow.lore: In the presence of these blessed warriors, the potency of shadow magic is amplified and beseechments to Khaine are often answered.
talismans of shadow.restrictionText:
Boons of Shadow are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Boon of Shadow.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Daughters of Khaine

tenebrous aura.name: Tenebrous Aura
tenebrous aura.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• The target cannot use **RETREAT** abilities.
• If an ability would heal or return any slain models to the target unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.
tenebrous aura.lore: The darkling nature of these sistren is so unsettling that foes find themselves utterly transfixed... and ultimately vulnerable.
tenebrous aura.restrictionText:
Boons of Shadow are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Boon of Shadow.
sourcePublications: Scourge of Aqshy: Daughters of Khaine

dance of doom.name: Dance of Doom
dance of doom.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, the target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
dance of doom.lore: The priest exhorts their followers to launch themselves into the fray and cut down the enemy in a display of lethal acrobatics.

catechism of murder.name: Catechism of Murder
catechism of murder.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 7+, the target’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn.
catechism of murder.lore: Khaine’s followers enter a killing frenzy that knows no bounds, lashing out in a slicing storm of razor‑sharp steel.

covenant of the iron heart.name: Covenant of the Iron Heart
covenant of the iron heart.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 10 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase until the start of your next turn.
covenant of the iron heart.lore: The hearts of the Murder God’s followers become as cold and hard as iron, crushing their fears and doubts with a chilling contempt.

summon bladewind.name: Summon Bladewind
summon bladewind.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bladewind** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bladewind** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon bladewind.lore: The caster calls upon their mastery of blood magic to conjure a twirling quartet of giant, blood-slick blades.

summon heart of fury.name: Summon Heart of Fury
summon heart of fury.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Heart of Fury** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Heart of Fury** wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.
summon heart of fury.lore: The skies turn crimson as this bleeding icon descends upon the battle.

summon bloodwrack viper.name: Summon Bloodwrack Viper
summon bloodwrack viper.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bloodwrack Viper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bloodwrack Viper** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon bloodwrack viper.lore: The caster weaves their outstretched hand in an elaborate pattern that mimics the structure of a monstrous snake drenched in blood.

black horror of ulgu.name: Black Horror of Ulgu
black horror of ulgu.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them, pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that point to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The targets cannot use **RUN** abilities until the start of your next turn.
black horror of ulgu.lore: A writhing mass of shadowy tentacles emerges though a conjured portal to coil around the limbs of nearby foes, who suddenly feel as if they are wading through mud.

steed of shadows.name: Steed of Shadows
steed of shadows.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
steed of shadows.lore: A coal-black creature with wings of night materialises from the darkness and swoops across the battlefield, hastening the movement of the Khainites below.

mindrazor.name: Mindrazor
mindrazor.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)** until the start of your next turn.
mindrazor.lore: The wizard summons spectral blades into their allies’ hands, weapons whose edges are honed by the wielder’s faith as much as the victim’s fear.

scathscale.name: Scáthscale
scathscale.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target of this ability instead.
scathscale.lore: Hissing syllables of vicious intent, the priestess causes the bare flesh of her sisters to shimmer with serpentine scales the hue of iron that turn the blades of their foes.

exultation of murder.name: Exultation of Murder
exultation of murder.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks. In addition, if the chanting roll was 9+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
exultation of murder.lore: Shrieking to the skies, the priestess draws upon a divine bloodlust that drives her sisters into a murderous rapture.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this prayer this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: The target can move up to 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
shadowstep.lore: Imbibing the blood of a sacrificed leathanam, the priestess calls upon the shadows themselves to speed her flock to where they are needed most.

formations.name: Fervent Ritualists
formations.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit contesting an objective to be the targets.

Effect: Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2. Return up to 1 slain model to each target that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.

ability.name: Final Frenzy
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit contesting an objective to be the targets.

Effect: Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2. Return up to 1 slain model to each target that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.
ability.lore: While in a state of ritualistic frenzy, not even a mortal wound can prevent a Khainite from spilling blood.

abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:

Effect: Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2. Return up to 1 slain model to each target that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.
abilities.lore: While in a state of ritualistic frenzy, not even a mortal wound can prevent a Khainite from spilling blood.

formations.name: Arena Veterans
formations.description: Effect: For the rest of the phase, friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** units have **WARD (5+)** until they have used a **FIGHT** ability.

ability.name: Graceful Elusion
ability.description: Effect: For the rest of the phase, friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** units have **WARD (5+)** until they have used a **FIGHT** ability.
ability.lore: Years of combat in the gladiatorial arenas of the temple-cities have honed the survival skills of these aelves to near perfection.

abilities.name: Graceful Elusion
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the phase, friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** units have **WARD (5+)** until they have used a **FIGHT** ability.
abilities.lore: Years of combat in the gladiatorial arenas of the temple-cities have honed the survival skills of these aelves to near perfection.

formations.sourcePublication: Scourge of Ghyran: Daughters of Khaine

formations.name: Frenzied Devotees
formations.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Heretic's Bane
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Enemy Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: Hot blood pours from the eyes and mouths of any who dare counter the Khainites’ divine works with those of their own.

Effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Hot blood pours from the eyes and mouths of any who dare counter the Khainites’ divine works with those of their own.

formations.name: Coven Zealots
formations.description: Effect: Return D3 slain models to each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit.

ability.name: Higher Purpose
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description: Effect: Return D3 slain models to each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit.
ability.lore: These aelves fight with a purity of purpose that sees them fight on even in the face of the most horrendous carnage, heedless of their losses.

formations.name: Coven of Blood
formations.description: Effect: While each model in a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.

ability.name: The Breath of Khaine
ability.description: Effect: While each model in a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.
ability.lore: A blood-red mist billows across the battlefield, obscuring those Khainites consecrating ground in the Bloody‑Handed One’s name.

abilities.description: Effect: While each model in a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.
abilities.lore: A blood-red mist billows across the battlefield, obscuring those Khainites consecrating ground in the Bloody‑Handed One’s name.

formations.name: Cold-Hearted Murderers
formations.description:
Used By: That **anointed** unit.

Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within that anointed unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by that **anointed** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn. If its melee weapons already have **Crit (Auto-wound)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn instead.

ability.name: Bloody-Handed Worshippers
ability.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for an anointed unit
ability.description:
Used By: That **anointed** unit.

Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within that anointed unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by that **anointed** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn. If its melee weapons already have **Crit (Auto-wound)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn instead.
ability.lore: This sacrament calls for the anointed champion and their followers to commit murder of the most violent kind.

abilities.name: Bloody-Handed Worshippers
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for an anointed unit
abilities.description:
Used By: That **anointed** unit.

Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within that anointed unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by that **anointed** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn. If its melee weapons already have **Crit (Auto-wound)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn instead.
abilities.lore: This sacrament calls for the anointed champion and their followers to commit murder of the most violent kind.

khaine s inheritor.name: Khaine's Inheritor
khaine s inheritor.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
khaine s inheritor.lore: Those imbued with Khaine’s potent blood who survive the ordeal soon learn to wield that power as a weapon, causing waves of unbearable agony in their foes.

amulet of the bladed queen.name: Amulet of the Bladed Queen
amulet of the bladed queen.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)**. Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
amulet of the bladed queen.lore: This prodigy has earned the blessing of Morathi-Khaine: a magnificent serpentine amulet through the goddess can both protect and keep a watchful eye on her subordinate.

the blood saints.name: The Blood Saints
the blood saints.description: Effect: While the friendly **Shadow Queen** is wholly within 6" of a friendly non-**HERO ZAINTHAR KAI** unit, both that **Shadow Queen** and that non-**HERO** unit have **WARD (5+)**.
the blood saints.lore: As the first and most revered of the Scáthborn, the loyalty of these creatures towards Morathi-Khaine is ironclad.

cursed heritage.name: Cursed Heritage
cursed heritage.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
cursed heritage.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any non-**UNIQUE ZAINTHAR KAI** units to be the targets.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
cursed heritage.lore: Each Zainthar Kai warrior carries at least three drops of Khaine’s potent ichor in their veins, and they can call upon its simmering power to send boiling blood erupting from their foes’ eyes in an agonising torrent.

dark majesty.name: Dark Majesty
dark majesty.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by a non-**HERO** unit that targets the friendly **Morathi‑Khaine** is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
dark majesty.lore: Morathi-Khaine’s charm, allure and sheer authority is near impossible to resist; to so much as raise a blade against such an exalted creature requires an effort of willpower beyond most mortals.

matriarch of the zainthar kai.name: Matriarch of the Zainthar Kai
matriarch of the zainthar kai.description:
Declare: Pick the friendly **Morathi-Khaine** to use this ability.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

• Until the start of your next turn, this unit has a Move characteristic of 12" and has **FLY**.
• This unit can use the ‘Iron Heart of Khaine’ ability as if you had performed a blood rite.
• Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target’s attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
• Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE ZAINTHAR KAI HERO** that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 3" of this unit.
