matriarch of the zainthar kai.lore: Surrounded by beings soul-crafted to be her perfect bodyguards, Morathi-Khaine can unleash her true power, safe in the knowledge that no jealous rival nor so-called ally will seek to do her harm.

speed of the scathborn.name: Speed of the Scáthborn
speed of the scathborn.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
speed of the scathborn.lore: The potential lurking in the blood of the Zainthar Kai can be unleashed with a sorcerous word.

ethereal grace.name: Ethereal Grace
ethereal grace.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
ethereal grace.lore: The sorceress grants their fellow Scáthborn the swiftness of a fleeting shadow.

on wings of shadow.name: On Wings of Shadow
on wings of shadow.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
on wings of shadow.lore: With a flick of their wrist, the caster summons umbral tendrils that carry their allies away along paths unseen.

manifestations of murder.name: Manifestations of Murder
manifestations of murder.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Bloodwrack Viper**
**• Bladewind**
**• Heart of Fury**

Effect: If you picked a **Bloodwrack Viper** or **Bladewind**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Heart of Fury**, set it up wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
manifestations of murder.lore: The wizard channels their power and calls one of the sacred manifestations of Khaine to the battlefield.

hero of the killing games.name: Hero of the Killing Games
hero of the killing games.description:
Effect: For the rest of the turn, while this unit is in combat with any enemy **HEROES**:
• Add 1 to the Attacks, Rend and Damage characteristics of this unit’s melee weapons.
• All of its combat attacks must target the same enemy **HERO**.
hero of the killing games.lore: This hero has an infamous winning streak in the Khainite arenas and delights in eviscerating worthy foes.
hero of the killing games.groupName: Champions of the Arena Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Champions of the Arena

arena of slaughter.name: Arena of Slaughter
arena of slaughter.description:
Effect: If the number of units (friendly or enemy) that have been destroyed this battle equals or exceeds any of the numbers below, the corresponding effect applies to friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** units for the rest of the battle. More than 1 effect can apply to a unit at the same time.

**1** Add 1 to run rolls for those units.
**2** Add 1 to charge rolls for those units.
**3**  Add 1 to hit rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
**4**  Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
**5**  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units’ melee weapons.
arena of slaughter.lore: This battlefield is dedicated to the havoc and murder beloved of Khaine, and his acolytes seek to drench it in arterial sprays of the most elaborate kind.
arena of slaughter.groupName: Champions of the Arena Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Champions of the Arena

frenzied restoration.name: Frenzied Restoration
frenzied restoration.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Champions of the Arena Hero** that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of a friendly **Shrine of Dark Tribute** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
frenzied restoration.lore: The powerful magics that emanate from a Shrine of Dark Tribute cause even gravely wounded aelves to stagger to their feet, gore pouring from open wounds and dripping from features made feral with frenzy.
frenzied restoration.groupName: Champions of the Arena Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Champions of the Arena

let the blood flow.name: Let the Blood Flow
let the blood flow.description:
Effect: All effects of the ‘Arena of Slaughter’ ability apply to friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** units while they are wholly within **X**" of a friendly **Shrine of Dark Tribute**, where **X** is determined by the current battle round, as follows:

**Battle Round** - **X**
1 - 9"
2 - 12"
3 - 15"
4 - 18"
5 - 21"
let the blood flow.lore: As the bloodshed escalates, the power of the Shrine of Dark Tribute waxes stronger and stronger, ushering in communal and murderous rage.
let the blood flow.groupName: Champions of the Arena Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Champions of the Arena

explosive fury.name: Explosive Fury
explosive fury.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
explosive fury.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Slaughter Queen** to use this ability, then pick each friendly **Blood Hags** unit on the battlefield and each visible friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** unit wholly within 12" of that **Slaughter Queen** to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a target makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.
explosive fury.lore: Led by their Slaughter Queens and the Blood Hags, these aelves rush into battle with astounding speed.
explosive fury.groupName: Champions of the Arena Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Champions of the Arena

death razor.name: Death Razor
death razor.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
death razor.description: Effect: After that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by this unit’s attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability, you can pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Instead of making a chanting roll for the next **PRAYER** ability used by the target, you can use a value of 10 for the roll that cannot be modified, even if this unit has been destroyed.
death razor.lore: This blade absorbs the souls of those it kills, converting their energy into divine power.
death razor.groupName: Champions of the Arena Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Champions of the Arena

violent consecration.name: Violent Consecration
violent consecration.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a chanting roll of D6.

**• Bloodwrack Viper**
**• Bladewind**
**• Heart of Fury**

Effect: If you picked a **Bloodwrack Viper** or **Bladewind**, set it up wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Heart of Fury**, set it up wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.

If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick a second **MANIFESTATION** from the list above that is not on the battlefield and set it up as described above.
violent consecration.lore: The priestess cries out to their divine patron, beseeching her to grace the arena with a display of bloodthirsty power.

shield of blood.name: Shield of Blood
shield of blood.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick up to 2 other eligible units to be additional targets. Each target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
shield of blood.lore: A literal targe of dripping gore interposes itself between the aelven gladiators and incoming attacks.

divine rush.name: Divine Rush
divine rush.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. For each target:

• If the target is not in combat, it can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile‑in move.
divine rush.lore: The priestess’s oratory serves to invigorate their flock, lending them speed and agility in equal measure.

call of the arena.name: Call of the Arena
call of the arena.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to run rolls for friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter.
call of the arena.lore: The priestess urges their followers to sprint headlong into danger, all the better to savour the contest for as long as possible.

lores.name: Champions of the Arena Manifestation Lore
Champions of the Arena Prayer Lore

blade of prophetic doom.name: Blade of Prophetic Doom
blade of prophetic doom.phase: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
blade of prophetic doom.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+:

• If the target is not damaged, inflict 1 mortal damage on it.
• If the target is damaged, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the roll.
blade of prophetic doom.lore: Some weapons are in thrall to the grimmest prophecies imaginable, and are fated to cause untold disaster with a single strike.
blade of prophetic doom.groupName: The Croneseer’s Pariahs Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Croneseer's Pariahs

proselyte of morai heg.name: Proselyte of Morai-Heg
proselyte of morai heg.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.
proselyte of morai heg.lore: This general has heeded the words imparted by Morai-Heg’s vessel and can see the predicted patterns of battle.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Croneseer's Pariahs

guided by morai heg.name: Guided by Morai-Heg
guided by morai heg.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of combat attacks made by friendly non-**HERO INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **Krethusa**.
guided by morai heg.lore: Morai-Heg guides her followers’ weapons into subtle chinks in the enemy’s armour.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Croneseer's Pariahs

skilled skirmishers.name: Skilled Skirmishers
skilled skirmishers.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
skilled skirmishers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS CAVALRY** unit that has not charged this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On 3+, the target can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by that **RETREAT** ability.
skilled skirmishers.lore: Doomfire Warlocks excel in strike-and-fade warfare, evading their foes while unleashing a hail of death.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Croneseer's Pariahs

plumes of auspicious smoke.name: Plumes of Auspicious Smoke
plumes of auspicious smoke.description:
Effect: Friendly **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** units are either **empty** or **full**. They start the battle **empty**. While a friendly **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** unit is **full**:

• That **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** has **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by shooting attacks.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** units while they are wholly within 9" of that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**.
plumes of auspicious smoke.lore: The mists that spill from the Croneseer’s cauldrons are thick with augury and omen, and those who inhale them are forewarned of imminent danger.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Croneseer's Pariahs

laden with prophecy.name: Laden with Prophecy
laden with prophecy.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **empty Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**.

Effect: If any enemy models were slain this turn by that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit'**s combat attacks, it becomes **full**.
laden with prophecy.lore: The viscera collected in a Cauldron of Blood and burned to enhance Krethusa’s haruspicy shroud all those nearby in a blood-tinged pall.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Croneseer's Pariahs

the blood reveals all.name: The Blood Reveals All
the blood reveals all.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
the blood reveals all.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS HERO** within the combat range of a friendly **empty** **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**. Then, pick another unit within the combat range of that **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Allocate a number of damage points to the target equal to the roll (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** becomes **full**.
the blood reveals all.lore: It matters not from which body the entrails are taken.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Croneseer's Pariahs

augury of battle.name: Augury of Battle
augury of battle.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (5+)**. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick up to 2 friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** units wholly within 18" of the caster instead of 1.
augury of battle.lore: Perhaps Morai-Heg has foreseen the deaths of these warriors today. Or perhaps she has not.

wings of the crone goddess.name: Wings of the Crone Goddess
wings of the crone goddess.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **FLY**.
• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 6" to the target’s Move characteristic instead.
wings of the crone goddess.lore: Morai-Heg grants the blessing of flight to her faithful as sable feathers burst from their limbs.

auspicious strike.name: Auspicious Strike
auspicious strike.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the unmodified hit roll for an attack made against the target is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 1 mortal damage for each unmodified hit roll of 1-2 instead.
auspicious strike.lore: Morai-Heg imparts a brief vision of a deadly weapon thrust.

beacon of azyr.name: Beacon of Azyr
beacon of azyr.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
beacon of azyr.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** or **PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The next time this turn that the target uses a **PRAYER** or **SPELL** ability, instead of making a casting roll or chanting roll for them, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified. After that ability is resolved, if the target has any ritual points, reset their ritual points total to 0.

**Designer’s Note:** *Ritual points apply modifiers so cannot be used with this ability to increase the chanting roll to more than 7.*
beacon of azyr.lore: This beacon is brimming with the magic of the Celestial Realm. When unleashed, holy lightning surges forth, empowering a nearby Stormcast Eternal who is attuned to the tempest.

sigil of morrda.name: Sigil of Morrda
sigil of morrda.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command or a **RAMPAGE** ability for a unit in combat with this unit
sigil of morrda.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that command or **RAMPAGE** ability has no effect, it still counts as having been used and any command points spent to use that ability are still lost.
sigil of morrda.lore: This sigil is one of the god Morrda, a death god that escaped Nagash’s purge of Shyish. Their power, perhaps not what it once was, is still potent and to be rightly feared.

banner of sigmar.name: Banner of Sigmar
banner of sigmar.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
banner of sigmar.description:
Declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, your opponent cannot control the target objective while they have no units contesting it.
banner of sigmar.lore: The hero unfurls a mighty banner and plunges its pommel into the earth with the force of a falling comet, where it stands upright and proud, declaring Sigmar’s reckoning to all who bear witness to its majesty.

staunch defender.name: Staunch Defender
staunch defender.description: Effect: While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units contesting that objective.
staunch defender.lore: To contest the sacred grounds of Sigmar is to invoke the almighty power of Azyr.

shock and awe.name: Shock and Awe
shock and awe.description:
Effect: Each time this unit is set up using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round.

In addition, each time a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit is set up wholly within 12"of this unit using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.
shock and awe.lore: When this warrior and their Stormcasts take to the field, their shining visages strike fear into the foe.

envoy of the heavens.name: Envoy of the Heavens
envoy of the heavens.description:
Declare: If a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12"of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
envoy of the heavens.lore: When a Stormcast Eternal is laid low, the light that carries the warrior’s soul back to Azyr invigorates those who fight on.

scions of the storm.name: Scions of the Storm
scions of the storm.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that is **in the** **Celestial Realm**.

Effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
scions of the storm.lore: Upon blessed bolts of lightning do the Stormcast Eternals ride to war, the furious rumble of thunder heralding their arrival.
scions of the storm.restrictionText: Stormcast Eternals armies can use the following abilities:

the celestial realm.name: The Celestial Realm
the celestial realm.description:
Declare: If there are more friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Celestial Realm**. It has now been deployed.
the celestial realm.lore: In High Azyr, the Stormcast Eternals await their call to deliver retribution.
the celestial realm.restrictionText: Stormcast Eternals armies can use the following abilities:

their finest hour.name: Their Finest Hour
their finest hour.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
their finest hour.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that has not used this ability this battle to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit’s combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for that unit.
their finest hour.lore: Stormcast Eternals are bastions of hope for the forces of Order. In times of desperate need, each fighter does what is necessary to keep their enemies at bay.
their finest hour.restrictionText: Stormcast Eternals armies can use the following abilities:

heavens sent.name: Heavens-sent
heavens sent.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
heavens sent.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units.
heavens sent.lore: More reinforcements are sent down from Azyr in their fellow warriors’ time of need.
heavens sent.restrictionText: Stormcast Eternals armies can use the following abilities:

lightning strike arrival.name: Lightning-Strike Arrival
lightning strike arrival.description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
lightning strike arrival.lore: With a clap of thunder, Yndrasta and her allies strike down onto the battlefield.

intense piety.name: Intense Piety
intense piety.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **PRIEST** or **WIZARD** within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
intense piety.lore: This hero’s intense and unwavering devotion to the Sigmar’s mission is one of such absolute focus that they can cause the followers of rival gods to hesitate and falter with a few well-chosen words or soul-piercing stare.

hour of glory.name: Hour of Glory
hour of glory.description: Effect: This unit can be picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability even if it has already used it this battle. In addition, when this unit is picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.
hour of glory.lore: This hero’s hour has come; their deeds will shatter the wicked, deliver the weak and protect the Mortal Realms themselves from any evil that would see them undone.

legendary tenacity.name: Legendary Tenacity
legendary tenacity.description: Effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.
legendary tenacity.lore: This hero might well be struck down, but there is little in the Mortal Realms that can stop them from rising again, bloodied but unbowed.

mirrorshield.name: Mirrorshield
mirrorshield.description: Effect: This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.
mirrorshield.lore: This shield reflects the rays of Hysh in questing beams that seek out the eyes of enemy marksmen.

quicksilver draught.name: Quicksilver Draught
quicksilver draught.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
quicksilver draught.description: Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
quicksilver draught.lore: This potion lends uncanny speed to the one who imbibes it.

null pendant.name: Null Pendant
null pendant.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
null pendant.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 5 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
null pendant.lore: This dark amulet holds magic within that can sap the resolve of the enemy.

shield of azyr.name: Shield of Azyr
shield of azyr.phase: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
shield of azyr.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, that unit has **WARD (5+)**.
shield of azyr.lore: Roaring oaths to Sigmar, these warriors are surrounded by an aura of divine protection.

storm charge.name: Storm Charge
storm charge.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
storm charge.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat.

Effect: That unit can use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
storm charge.lore: These warriors are driven forward by their faith, ever eager to bring Sigmar’s holy retribution to his enemies.

pennant of azyrite majesty.name: Pennant of Azyrite Majesty
pennant of azyrite majesty.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target, then you can pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn, while it is visible to this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the enemy target.
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the friendly target.
pennant of azyrite majesty.lore: This banner pulses with celestial energies; to look upon it is to be either empowered by or overwhelmed by the glory of Sigmar and the heavens.

fractured astral jewel.name: Fractured Astral Jewel
fractured astral jewel.description: Effect: If an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while it is within 6" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.
fractured astral jewel.lore: Touched by a spark from the Anvil of Apotheosis, this gem once released waves of fortifying energy. Now irreparably cracked, its aura has an antithetical effect.

blade of the six smiths.name: Blade of the Six Smiths
blade of the six smiths.description:
Declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• Halve the Attacks characteristic of the target weapon (rounding up).
• Double the Damage characteristic of the target weapon.
• Attacks made with the target weapon score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 3+.
blade of the six smiths.lore: Crafted by the demigod apprentices of the Great Maker, the strikes of this burnished weapon are truly potent.

pyrotechnic souls.name: Pyrotechnic Souls
pyrotechnic souls.description: Effect: When this unit is destroyed, gain 3 **rage dice**.
pyrotechnic souls.lore: When these warriors discorporate, it makes for a spectacularly explosive display.
pyrotechnic souls.restrictionText: Scars of War are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST STORMCAST ETERNALS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Scar of War.

uncaged lightning.name: Uncaged Lightning
uncaged lightning.description: Effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with this unit moves or is removed from the battlefield, after that ability has been resolved, if that enemy unit is on the battlefield and not in combat with this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
uncaged lightning.lore: The divine lightning wrought into these warriors’ forms has become unstable; it leaps forth from them unexpectedly, usually towards those who try to escape their wrath.
uncaged lightning.restrictionText: Scars of War are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST STORMCAST ETERNALS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Scar of War.

veterans of amberstone watch.name: Veterans of Amberstone Watch
veterans of amberstone watch.description:
Effect: Enemy units do not have the **STRIKE-FIRST** keyword while they are in combat with this unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *Enemy units that have* **STRIKE-LAST** *would still have* **STRIKE-LAST***; they would not be treated as having neither* **STRIKE-FIRST** *nor* **STRIKE-LAST.**
veterans of amberstone watch.lore: Practised at fighting cunning foes, these warriors ensure they always have the upper hand.
veterans of amberstone watch.restrictionText: Scars of War are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST STORMCAST ETERNALS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Scar of War.

translocation.name: Translocation
translocation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.
translocation.lore: The priest summons bolts of lightning to transport nearby warriors across the battlefield.

healing storm.name: Healing Storm
healing storm.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.
healing storm.lore: The priest calls down cleansing bolts from the sky, their invigorating energies closing even the most grievous wounds.

bless weapons.name: Bless Weapons
bless weapons.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 12+, this ability affects all visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units wholly within 12" of the chanter.
bless weapons.lore: The priest imbues the weapons of their brethren with the pure essence of the storm.

summon celestian vortex.name: Summon Celestian Vortex
summon celestian vortex.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Celestian Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Celestian Vortex** wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon celestian vortex.lore: The wizard casts a pair of ensorcelled hammers into the air, which begin to spin. As the vortex gets more intense, the hammers multiply to form a maelstrom of skull-crushing force.

summon dais arcanum.name: Summon Dais Arcanum
summon dais arcanum.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Dais Arcanum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY HERO** that does not have **FLY** and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Dais Arcanum** within ½" of the target, visible to the caster and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and place it on the platform of that **Dais Arcanum**.
summon dais arcanum.lore: The wizard calls down a single bolt of lightning to strike the ground at their feet, leaving behind a perfect sigmarite disc for a chosen Stormcast to mount and be carried into the air.

summon everblaze comet.name: Summon Everblaze Comet
summon everblaze comet.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Everblaze Comet** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Everblaze Comet** wholly within 18" of the caster.
summon everblaze comet.lore: Reaching an arm to the heavens, the wizard calls down a pure comet of Azyrite energy that crashes into the foe’s ranks with devastating effect.

lightning blast.name: Lightning Blast
lightning blast.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then pick the closest visible enemy unit to them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. If 2 or more visible enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
lightning blast.lore: The wizard releases pent-up storm energy into the foe, the tang of ozone and the stench of charred flesh filling the air as their enemies are burned and blasted by crackling arcs of lightning.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
starfall.lore: Gazing towards the heavens, the wizard hurls meteoric rain into the enemy's path, forcing them to turn an aggressive push into a cautious advance.

thundershock.name: Thundershock
thundershock.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
thundershock.lore: The wizard unleashes the power of Sigmar's storm as a wave of pure force, leaving the foe stunned and disoriented.

formations.name: Sentinels of the Bleak Citadels
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit.

Effect: That unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Ancient Aura
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit.

Effect: That unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: Storm-charged energy ebbs and flows around the warriors of the Ruination chamber, surrounding them in a scouring aura of power. Finding purchase with a weapon on these ancient heroes can be a difficult task for even the mightiest of mortal foes.

abilities.name: Ancient Aura
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit.

Effect: That unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Storm-charged energy ebbs and flows around the warriors of the Ruination chamber, surrounding them in a scouring aura of power. Finding purchase with a weapon on these ancient heroes can be a difficult task for even the mightiest of mortal foes.

formations.name: Thunderhead Host
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly non-**HERO** non-**BEAST STORMCAST ETERNALS** units that do not have the **WARRIOR CHAMBER** keyword.

ability.name: Synchronised Strikes
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly non-**HERO** non-**BEAST STORMCAST ETERNALS** units that do not have the **WARRIOR CHAMBER** keyword.
ability.lore: The core of a Thunderhead Host is often made up of fighters from the Warrior chambers; having trained relentlessly with the sworn brethren of their Stormhost, they operate like a well-oiled cogfort.

abilities.name: Synchronised Strikes
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly non-**HERO** non-**BEAST STORMCAST ETERNALS** units that do not have the **WARRIOR CHAMBER** keyword.
abilities.lore: The core of a Thunderhead Host is often made up of fighters from the Warrior chambers; having trained relentlessly with the sworn brethren of their Stormhost, they operate like a well-oiled cogfort.

formations.name: Lightning Echelon
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EXTREMIS CHAMBER** unit that charged this turn.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Oncoming Storm
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EXTREMIS CHAMBER** unit that charged this turn.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: First to the fight, the Lightning Echelon is akin to a spear-thrust into the heart of the enemy. Deployed only in times of great need, they smash into the foe’s vanguard with the force of an oncoming tempest.

abilities.name: Oncoming Storm
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EXTREMIS CHAMBER** unit that charged this turn.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: First to the fight, the Lightning Echelon is akin to a spear-thrust into the heart of the enemy. Deployed only in times of great need, they smash into the foe’s vanguard with the force of an oncoming tempest.

formations.name: Vanguard Wing
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **VANGUARD CHAMBER** unit that did not use a **MOVE** ability this turn and is not in combat.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Peerless Manoeuvres
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **VANGUARD CHAMBER** unit that did not use a **MOVE** ability this turn and is not in combat.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.lore: These warriors are the precision weapon of the God-King, skilled at manipulating a battlefield in their favour by feinting from view and reappearing where they are needed most.

abilities.name: Peerless Manoeuvres
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **VANGUARD CHAMBER** unit that did not use a **MOVE** ability this turn and is not in combat.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: These warriors are the precision weapon of the God-King, skilled at manipulating a battlefield in their favour by feinting from view and reappearing where they are needed most.

the celestial realm.name: The Celestial Realm
the celestial realm.description:
Declare: If there are more friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Celestial Realm**. It has now been deployed.
the celestial realm.lore: In High Azyr, the Stormcast Eternals await their call to deliver retribution.
the celestial realm.groupName: Heroes of the First-Forged Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Heroes of the First-Forged

summon the storm.name: Summon the Storm
summon the storm.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
summon the storm.description:
Declare: If a friendly **Bastian Carthalos** is on the battlefield and was not set up this turn, you can pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that is **in the Celestial Realm**.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Bastian** **Carthalos** and more than 3" from all enemy units. If the target is a unit of **Annihilators** or **Annihilators with Meteoric** **Grandhammers**, for the rest of the turn, the target counts as having used the 'Scions of the Storm' ability for the purposes of the 'Blazing Impact' ability.
summon the storm.lore: With a voice of booming thunder, Bastian can call forth his warriors, bringing them down in the heart of the enemy army.
summon the storm.groupName: Heroes of the First-Forged Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Heroes of the First-Forged

punch through.name: Punch Through
punch through.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
punch through.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit in combat that has not charged this turn to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can immediately use the 'Charge' ability and can move through enemy models when it does so.
punch through.lore: Like a plated fist, the warriors of the First-Forged drive deep into the enemy's ranks, smashing aside those in their path.
punch through.groupName: Heroes of the First-Forged Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Heroes of the First-Forged

scions of the storm.name: Scions of the Storm
scions of the storm.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that is **in the** **Celestial Realm**.

Effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
scions of the storm.lore: Upon blessed bolts of lightning do the Stormcast Eternals ride to war, the furious rumble of thunder heralding their arrival.
scions of the storm.groupName: Heroes of the First-Forged Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Heroes of the First-Forged

shield of skjordamar.name: Shield of Skjordamar
shield of skjordamar.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the battle.
shield of skjordamar.lore: Said to have been forged with a sliver of the Great Bolt Skjordamar, this shield delivers a blast of celestial energy that can banish the corruption spread by malign magics.
shield of skjordamar.groupName: Heroes of the First-Forged Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Heroes of the First-Forged

thegn of bellicos.name: Thegn of Bellicos
thegn of bellicos.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons while it is wholly within 6" of a friendly **Bastian** **Carthalos**.
thegn of bellicos.lore: In their mortal life, this warrior fought alongside Bastian at the Battle of Burning Skies and still does so after their Reforging.
thegn of bellicos.groupName: Heroes of the First-Forged Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Heroes of the First-Forged

storm s wrath.name: Storm's Wrath
storm s wrath.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FIRST-FORGED WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 9" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
storm s wrath.lore: The mage calls down a barrage of colossal lightning blasts that boom across the battlefield, blasting to ash clusters of the foe.

wreathed in the storm.name: Wreathed in the Storm
wreathed in the storm.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FIRST-FORGED WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets the target unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
wreathed in the storm.lore: Lightning ripples across the armour of these warriors, delivering a lethal shock to enemies who approach them.

summon everblaze comet.name: Summon Everblaze Comet
summon everblaze comet.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Everblaze Comet** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FIRST-FORGED WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Everblaze Comet** wholly within 18" of the caster.
summon everblaze comet.lore: Reaching an arm to the heavens, the wizard calls down a comet of pure Azyrite energy that crashes into the foe's ranks with devastating effect.

speed of the righteous.name: Speed of the Righteous
speed of the righteous.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FIRST-FORGED PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be a target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of the target for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
speed of the righteous.lore: The warrior-priest calls upon Sigmar to speed their brethren with the winds aetheric so that they might enact his judgement with greater haste.

lores.name: Heroes of the First-Forged Spell Lore
Heroes of the First-Forged Manifestation Lore
Heroes of the First-Forged Prayer Lore

celestium ensign.name: Celestium Ensign
celestium ensign.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
celestium ensign.description: Effect: **Heal (3)** each friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
celestium ensign.lore: The sight of this ancient heirloom spurs Draconith to draw upon hidden reserves of strength.

thunderous roar.name: Thunderous Roar
thunderous roar.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
thunderous roar.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING MONSTER** that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 5 from that target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
thunderous roar.lore: A deafening roar is unleashed, drowning out the din of battle momentarily and melting the resolve of even the most stalwart foes.

aetheric cyclone.name: Aetheric Cyclone
aetheric cyclone.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
aetheric cyclone.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING MONSTER** that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
aetheric cyclone.lore: The mighty Draconith whips its wings to create a ferocious squall that buffets the enemy lines, driving them to their knees.

exemplars of fury.name: Exemplars of Fury
exemplars of fury.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING HEROES** while they are within 6" of 2 or more friendly **Stormdrake Guard** units.
exemplars of fury.lore: The leaders of the Skywings urge their scaled companions to strike with devastating force, their bloody assault an inspiration to all who witness it.

shields of the warden.name: Shields of the Warden
shields of the warden.description:
Effect: While any friendly **Stormdrake Guard** units are within a friendly **Ionus Cryptborn**’s combat range:

• That friendly **Ionus Cryptborn** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **Ionus Cryptborn**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly **Ionus Cryptborn** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
shields of the warden.lore: Ionus often goes into battle accompanied by an elite band of Stormdrake Guard whose sole duty is to protect their commander.

fearless fliers.name: Fearless Fliers
fearless fliers.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately make a D6" move and can end that move in combat.
fearless fliers.lore: Such is the bond between this rider and their mount that they can perform the most graceful aerial manoeuvres in order to close the distance on their prey.

summon everblaze comet.name: Summon Everblaze Comet
summon everblaze comet.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Everblaze Comet** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Everblaze Comet** wholly within 18" of the caster.
summon everblaze comet.lore: Reaching an arm to the heavens, the wizard calls down a comet of pure Azyrite energy that crashes into the foe’s ranks with devastating effect.

regal authority.name: Regal Authority
regal authority.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 5 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
regal authority.lore: Halos of lightning surround the wizard’s allies, casting them as resplendent and terrifying paragons of war.

sigmar s grace.name: Sigmar's Grace
sigmar s grace.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (2D3)** the target instead.
sigmar s grace.lore: Shafts of golden light burst through the clouds to heal Sigmar’s wounded.

sanctification.name: Sanctification
sanctification.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 30" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 12+, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** for the rest of the battle and friendly **PRIESTS** cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
sanctification.lore: Holy energies radiate from the cleric, disrupting the works of spellcasters who bear hostile intent.

hallowed scrolls.name: Hallowed Scrolls
hallowed scrolls.description: Effect: If this unit is **INFANTRY**, it has **WARD (5+)**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (6+)**.
hallowed scrolls.lore: Parchments inscribed with Sigmarite blessings adorn this warrior's armour.

corven lord.name: Corven Lord
corven lord.description: Effect: If this unit has the 'Ruination Chamber', ability, it can use that ability once per turn regardless of whether another friendly unit has used it during the same turn.
corven lord.lore: The souls of those who lead the Ruination chambers are anathema to malign influence.

entropic screech.name: Entropic Screech
entropic screech.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
entropic screech.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER MONSTER** that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. The unit using this ability cannot use any more **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
entropic screech.lore: Cocking its head back, the Morrgryph unleashes a soul-piercing screech that causes foes to wither and collapse under its necrotic onslaught.

hallowed presence.name: Hallowed Presence
hallowed presence.description: Effect: While friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units are wholly within 12" of any friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** units, those friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units have **WARD (6+)**.
hallowed presence.lore: While fighting alongside the Ruination chambers, those of the Warrior chambers are granted a measure of the incorruptible nature of their solemn brethren.

ancient aura.name: Ancient Aura
ancient aura.phase: Once Per Turn (Army) Any Hero Phase
ancient aura.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit.

Effect: That unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
ancient aura.lore: Storm-charged energy ebbs and flows around the warriors of the Ruination chambers, surrounding them in a scouring aura of power. Finding purchase with a weapon on these ancient heroes can be a difficult task for even the mightiest of mortal foes.

temper the flaw.name: Temper the Flaw
temper the flaw.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
temper the flaw.description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the end of each turn. Each friendly non-**HERO RUINATION CHAMBER** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn is a target.

Effect: For each target, pick 1 of the following effects:

• ***Guided:*** If the target is wholly within 12" of any friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER HEROES**, return 1 slain model to it.
• ***Tormented:*** If the target is not wholly within 12" of any friendly **RUINATIONS CHAMBER HEROES**, it becomes tormented until the end of the next turn. While a unit is tormented, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons but it cannot contest objectives or use commands.
temper the flaw.lore: The warriors of the Ruination chambers must be shepherded by the mentors of the Bleak Citadels, else they risk losing what little remains of their soul.

morrda s embrace.name: Morrda's Embrace
morrda s embrace.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain. If the chanting roll was 10+, roll 2D6 instead.
morrda s embrace.lore: Sinister shadows converge above the priest's head before enveloping a foe in a deadly embrace.

raven s flight.name: Raven's Flight
raven s flight.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, in addition, for the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they have used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
raven s flight.lore: Wings of jet black frame the priest as they summon a chill wind that speeds their allies.

murderous flock.name: Murderous Flock
murderous flock.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit for each 4+ instead.
murderous flock.lore: A flight of phantasmal ravens is summoned from the darkened skies, diving down into the enemy's ranks to peck out eyes and pierce throats.

lifekelp pod.name: Lifekelp Pod
lifekelp pod.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN CAVALRY** unit within this unit’s combat range.
lifekelp pod.lore: Radiant with Ghyranite energy, this golden seed pod bursts in a spray of vital power.

dritchleech.name: Dritchleech
dritchleech.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 18" of this unit. In addition, each time an enemy spell fails, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (1)** this unit.
dritchleech.lore: Incredibly rare, these worms feed upon magic and are capable of draining arcane energies.

armour of the cythai.name: Armour of the Cythai
armour of the cythai.description: Effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
armour of the cythai.lore: This gleaming panoply was given by Teclis to the ancestors of the Idoneth. Upon the command of its bearer, it can radiate the power of Hysh – a fitting property for a gift from the Great Illuminator.

swift tide.name: Swift Tide
swift tide.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
swift tide.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Concealing Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units can use Run abilities and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.
swift tide.lore: The sheer rapidity of the sea’s advance sees the Idoneth outpace their foes.
swift tide.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

sea s embrace.name: Sea's Embrace
sea s embrace.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
sea s embrace.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Swift Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
sea s embrace.lore: Those engulfed by the vast ocean can do nothing but await their fate.
sea s embrace.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

concealing tide.name: Concealing Tide
concealing tide.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
concealing tide.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units that did not use any **CHARGE** abilities in the same turn.
concealing tide.lore: Freezing and impenetrable mists descend across the battlefield.
concealing tide.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

endless sea storm.name: Endless Sea-storm
endless sea storm.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
endless sea storm.description:
Effect: If this unit is a **WIZARD**, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the turn. If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it gains **WIZARD (1)** for the rest of the turn.

In addition, add 2 to the next casting roll or banishment roll for this unit this turn.
endless sea storm.lore: This hero summons the force of the ethersea to batter their foes with waves of pelagic force.

merciless raider.name: Merciless Raider
merciless raider.description: Effect: If this unit is within 6" of a damaged enemy unit, this unit can move 6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit.
merciless raider.lore: This aelf gives no quarter to the enemies of the Idoneth. When in the vicinity of a wounded foe, they surge forwards to finish the job.

lord of storm and sea.name: Lord of Storm and Sea
lord of storm and sea.description: Effect: Each time an ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.
lord of storm and sea.lore: This hero is a living embodiment of the glory of Mathlann and an inspiration to all those who still worship the Lord of the Deep.

form of the fangmora.name: Form of the Fangmora
form of the fangmora.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
form of the fangmora.lore: This champion has mastered a defensive sword-art that mimics the fluid movements of the swift Fangmora Eels.

hunter of souls.name: Hunter of Souls
hunter of souls.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following weapon abilities for this unit’s melee weapons to have this battle:
•  **Anti-CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)**
hunter of souls.lore: This hero seeks neither glory nor territory; their only interest is the capture of potent soul-stuff.

nightmare legacy.name: Nightmare Legacy
nightmare legacy.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.
nightmare legacy.lore: The repressed horror of the Idoneth’s long incarceration emanates from this dark-visaged warrior in palpable waves of doom.

storm s wrath.name: Storm's Wrath
storm s wrath.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
storm s wrath.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Inexorable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units’ melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.
storm s wrath.lore: Woe to those caught in the path of the storm’s destructive fury.
storm s wrath.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

inexorable tide.name: Inexorable Tide
inexorable tide.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
inexorable tide.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units for the rest of the battle round.
inexorable tide.lore: When the tide sweeps in, no force of nature or magic can keep it at bay.
inexorable tide.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

unpredictable tide.name: Unpredictable Tide
unpredictable tide.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
unpredictable tide.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round. Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
unpredictable tide.lore: Only the Deepkin can anticipate the mercurial currents of the ocean.
unpredictable tide.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

ironshell barnacles.name: Ironshell Barnacles
ironshell barnacles.description:
Effect: • If this unit is **INFANTRY**, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.

• If this unit is **CAVALRY**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.

• If this unit is a **MONSTER**, ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for it.
ironshell barnacles.lore: Attaching themselves to hides and armour, the extra durability granted by these crustaceans is welcomed.
ironshell barnacles.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

stonefoot anemone.name: Stonefoot Anemone
stonefoot anemone.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use **MOVE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
stonefoot anemone.lore: The toxins in this creature’s sting render foes briefly immobile.
stonefoot anemone.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

aqshian sea nettles.name: Aqshian Sea Nettles
aqshian sea nettles.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Other enemy units cannot use **FIGHT** abilities if the target is eligible to be picked.
• If possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.

**Designer’s Note**: *This ability does not override the* **STRIKE-FIRST** *or* **STRIKE-LAST** *constraints.*
aqshian sea nettles.lore: Floating around their owners, these jellyfish instinctively lash out at nearby foes, causing panic and confusion.
aqshian sea nettles.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

twin tides.name: Twin Tides
twin tides.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **ATTACK** ability for a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit
twin tides.description:
Used By: The friendly **AKHELIAN** unit using that **ATTACK** ability.

Effect: Pick a visible friendly **NAMARTI** unit that has not used an **ATTACK** ability this phase to be the target.

•  If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability, immediately after the **SHOOT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase.

•  If this unit used a **FIGHT** ability, immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s attacks.
twin tides.lore: Though the Idoneth’s military structure is uncompromisingly rigid, their fluidity in battle is astounding. The Akhelians lead; the Namarti follow. Such discipline, alloyed to aelven speed and grace, has spelled the doom of numberless foes.

abyssal dweller.name: Abyssal Dweller
abyssal dweller.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abyssal dweller.description:
Declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, while enemy units are contesting the target objective:
• Subtract the current battle round number from those units’ Move characteristic.
• Those units cannot use **RUN**, **RETREAT** or **CHARGE** abilities.
abyssal dweller.lore: Hailing from the lightless depths, this champion can manipulate the ethersea so as to plunge areas into total darkness.

cursed lineage.name: Cursed Lineage
cursed lineage.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your opponent’s **fury level**. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
cursed lineage.lore: This Idoneth channels the profound despair once felt by the Cythai and reflects it back at the foe, causing soul-deep wounds.

adherent of kir nadarr.name: Adherent of Kir-Nadarr
adherent of kir nadarr.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units that target that enemy unit.
adherent of kir nadarr.lore: This Idoneth has embraced the bellicose Way of the Storm, and so too do their warriors seek to embody the surging force of destruction.

pressure of the deep.name: Pressure of the Deep
pressure of the deep.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
pressure of the deep.lore: The wizard enfolds their victims in a shimmering bubble of crushing force.

steed of tides.name: Steed of Tides
steed of tides.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
steed of tides.lore: The wizard conjures an agile elemental to transport comrades through the ethersea.

counter current.name: Counter-Current
counter current.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
counter current.lore: The wizard summons a powerful current to hold their enemies at bay.

summon incarnate of the deep.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
summon incarnate of the deep.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon incarnate of the deep.lore: The spellcaster awakens a terrifying manifestation of the ocean’s wrath.

formations.name: Namarti Corps
formations.description: Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit.

ability.name: Surge Forward
ability.description: Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit.
ability.lore: The Namarti are the lowest caste in Idoneth society, but when formed into a Namarti Corps and led to battle by their Akhelian masters, they strike swiftly and with devastating effect.

abilities.name: Surge Forward
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit.
abilities.lore: The Namarti are the lowest caste in Idoneth society, but when formed into a Namarti Corps and led to battle by their Akhelian masters, they strike swiftly and with devastating effect.

formations.name: Deep-sea Stalkers
formations.description:
Effect: While a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit if it has not charged this turn.
• Add 2" to the Move characteristic of that unit.

ability.name: Outflank The Enemy
ability.description:
Effect: While a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit if it has not charged this turn.
• Add 2" to the Move characteristic of that unit.
ability.lore: Used to living on the periphery of society, these Idoneth are expert at blending into the shadows and using hidden paths to traverse the battlefield.

abilities.name: Outflank The Enemy
abilities.description:
Effect: While a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit if it has not charged this turn.
• Add 2" to the Move characteristic of that unit.
abilities.lore: Used to living on the periphery of society, these Idoneth are expert at blending into the shadows and using hidden paths to traverse the battlefield.

formations.name: Soul-raid Ambushers
formations.description: Effect: When using the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.

ability.name: Fade Like Mist
ability.description: Effect: When using the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.
ability.lore: The Soul-raid Ambushers are experts in hit-and-run tactics, riding the currents of the ethersea to strike the foe from new directions.

abilities.name: Fade Like Mist
abilities.description: Effect: When using the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.
abilities.lore: The Soul-raid Ambushers are experts in hit-and-run tactics, riding the currents of the ethersea to strike the foe from new directions.

formations.name: Akhelian Beastmasters
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by friendly **AKHELIAN** units.

ability.name: Ferocious Predators
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by friendly **AKHELIAN** units.
ability.lore: With the aid of the Embailors, the Akhelian Beastmasters are able to turn oceanic carnivores into truly terrifying weapons of war.

abilities.name: Ferocious Predators
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by friendly **AKHELIAN** units.
abilities.lore: With the aid of the Embailors, the Akhelian Beastmasters are able to turn oceanic carnivores into truly terrifying weapons of war.

formations.name: Ethersea Predators
formations.description:
Declare: If any friendly or enemy units were destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **Akhelian Allopex** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Blood In The Water
ability.description:
Declare: If any friendly or enemy units were destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **Akhelian Allopex** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.lore: As the gore of the slain diffuses through the ethersea, ancient predators are drawn to battle.

abilities.name: Blood In The Water
abilities.description:
Declare: If any friendly or enemy units were destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **Akhelian Allopex** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: As the gore of the slain diffuses through the ethersea, ancient predators are drawn to battle.

formations.name: Isharann Council
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly **ISHARANN** units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **ISHARANN** units.

ability.name: Wisdom of the Deep
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly **ISHARANN** units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **ISHARANN** units.
ability.lore: The Isharann are born with a talent for harnessing arcane forces. This power is only amplified when these aelves convene an Isharann Council and head to war.

abilities.name: Wisdom of the Deep
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly **ISHARANN** units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **ISHARANN** units.
abilities.lore: The Isharann are born with a talent for harnessing arcane forces. This power is only amplified when these aelves convene an Isharann Council and head to war.

the last living cythai.name: The Last Living Cythai
the last living cythai.lore: High King Volturnos is the greatest Idoneth warrior to have ever lived, and few can match his blinding speed in battle.
the last living cythai.groupName: First Phalanx of Ionrach Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

the shield of ulchiss.name: The Shield of Ulchiss
the shield of ulchiss.description:
Declare: You must spend 1 **asydrazor point** each time a friendly **FIRST PHALANX** unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

•  That unit can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
the shield of ulchiss.lore: Mastery of the ebb and flow of battle is core to the teachings of Ulchiss, which state that a timely withdrawal can open up enemy vulnerabilities.
the shield of ulchiss.groupName: First Phalanx of Ionrach Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

teachings of the asydrazor.name: Teachings of the Asydrazor
teachings of the asydrazor.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
teachings of the asydrazor.lore: As part of their asydrazor training, Akhelians must study the strategic theorems and methods of war set down by the legendary Cythai heroes of yore.
teachings of the asydrazor.groupName: First Phalanx of Ionrach Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

the sword of gwynnar.name: The Sword of Gwynnar
the sword of gwynnar.description:
Declare: You must spend 1 **asydrazor point** each time a friendly **FIRST PHALANX** unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.

Effect: That unit has **STRIKE‑FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
the sword of gwynnar.lore: To emulate Queen Gwynnar is to anticipate the enemy’s next move and gain the upper hand in combat.
the sword of gwynnar.groupName: First Phalanx of Ionrach Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

the spear of asphoren.name: The Spear of Asphoren
the spear of asphoren.description:
Declare: You must spend 1 **asydrazor point** each time a friendly **FIRST PHALANX** unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.
the spear of asphoren.lore: Those Idoneth who wish to follow the example of legendary commander Asphoren must strike at the foe like the surging tide.
the spear of asphoren.groupName: First Phalanx of Ionrach Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

voidchill darkness.name: Voidchill Darkness
voidchill darkness.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit if this unit charged this turn.
voidchill darkness.lore: This breed can turn the ethersea around it ice-cold and dark.
