voidchill darkness.restrictionText: A Bond-beast Trait is a unique enhancement that can be given to **FIRST PHALANX CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Bond-beast Trait.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

deep connection.name: Deep Connection
deep connection.description: Effect: Ignore the effect of the **Companion** weapon ability on this unit’s weapons.
deep connection.lore: These mounts are so attuned to their riders’ emotions that they can instinctively predict their next command.
deep connection.restrictionText: A Bond-beast Trait is a unique enhancement that can be given to **FIRST PHALANX CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Bond-beast Trait.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

swift finned skirmisher.name: Swift-Finned Skirmisher
swift finned skirmisher.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for this unit
swift finned skirmisher.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that this unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
swift finned skirmisher.lore: These creatures react to subtle ripples in the ethersea to avoid danger.
swift finned skirmisher.restrictionText: A Bond-beast Trait is a unique enhancement that can be given to **FIRST PHALANX CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Bond-beast Trait.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

crest of the ionrach.name: Crest of the Ionrach
crest of the ionrach.lore: This crystal relic of the Ionrach is granted only to its greatest heroes and most rigorous defenders.
crest of the ionrach.groupName: First Phalanx of Ionrach Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

prodigy of the asydrzor.name: Prodigy of the Asydrzor
prodigy of the asydrzor.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared an **ASYDRAZOR** ability for a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit wholly within 12" of this unit
prodigy of the asydrzor.description: Effect: No **asydrazor points** are spent to use that ability.
prodigy of the asydrzor.lore: A true product of the Deepkin’s martial enlightenment, this warrior is renowned for their strategic brilliance.
prodigy of the asydrzor.groupName: First Phalanx of Ionrach Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach

call forth the tsunami.name: Call Forth the Tsunami
call forth the tsunami.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
call forth the tsunami.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have 3 or more **chorrileum spirit points**. Pick a friendly unit **awaiting a summons** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with it.
call forth the tsunami.lore: When summoned to defend the legacy of the Idoneth, an Eidolon’s fury is terrible indeed.
call forth the tsunami.groupName: Wardens of the Chorrileum Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Wardens of the Chorrileum

spirits of the chorrileum.name: Spirits of the Chorrileum
spirits of the chorrileum.description:
Effect: Each turn, you can gain up to 1 **chorrileum spirit point**. You gain 1 **chorrileum spirit point** the first time 1 of the following occurs in a turn:

• You make an unmodified casting roll of 8 or more for a friendly **ISHARANN WIZARD**.
• An enemy unit is destroyed while it is within 12" of any friendly **ISHARANN** units.
• A friendly unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **ISHARANN** units or while it is contesting an objective you control
spirits of the chorrileum.lore: The spirit matter that animates an Eidolon is a malleable force that ebbs and surges in power as battle ensues.
spirits of the chorrileum.groupName: Wardens of the Chorrileum Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Wardens of the Chorrileum

the ocean conceals.name: The Ocean Conceals
the ocean conceals.description:
Declare: This ability must be used to deploy the friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** instead of the ‘Deploy Unit’ ability or the ‘Deploy Regiment’ ability.

Effect: Set up the friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** in reserve **awaiting a summons**. It has now been deployed.
the ocean conceals.lore: Hidden by the froth and churn of the ethersea, an Eidolon of Mathlann can emerge in the very midst of its enemies.
the ocean conceals.groupName: Wardens of the Chorrileum Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Wardens of the Chorrileum

wrath of mathlann.name: Wrath of Mathlann
wrath of mathlann.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
wrath of mathlann.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** unit that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, that unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn. The unit using this ability cannot use any other **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
wrath of mathlann.lore: Calling upon every vestige its of strength and rage, the Eidolon comes crashing down upon the foe.
wrath of mathlann.groupName: Wardens of the Chorrileum Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Wardens of the Chorrileum

serve the enclave.name: Serve the Enclave
serve the enclave.description: Effect: While this unit and a friendly **CHORRILEUM NAMARTI** unit are contesting the same objective, this unit has a control score of 10 that cannot be modified.
serve the enclave.lore: With the fate of their people at stake, this hero inspires a fearless resolve in those Namarti under their command.
serve the enclave.groupName: Wardens of the Chorrileum Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Wardens of the Chorrileum

ammonite carnyx.name: Ammonite Carnyx
ammonite carnyx.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ammonite carnyx.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM NAMARTI** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ammonite carnyx.lore: This war-horn is carved from pearlescent shell. When blown, its thundering call summons every nearby Idoneth to battle.
ammonite carnyx.groupName: Wardens of the Chorrileum Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Wardens of the Chorrileum

summon incarnate of the deep.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
summon incarnate of the deep.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon incarnate of the deep.lore: The spellcaster awakens a terrifying manifestation of the ocean’s wrath.

slipstream.name: Slipstream
slipstream.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CHORRILEUM** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.
slipstream.lore: The wizard deftly manipulates the surging currents of the ethersea to aid allies.

essence of the chorrileum.name: Essence of the Chorrileum
essence of the chorrileum.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CHORRILEUM** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is **NAMARTI**, you can return D6 slain models to it. Otherwise, **Heal (D3)** the target
essence of the chorrileum.lore: The powerful energies of an Idoneth soul-reef can heal flesh and mend shattered bones.

lores.name: Wardens of the Chorrileum Manifestation Lore
Wardens of the Chorrileum Spell Lore

blazebeard and sons bamboozling flakgun.name: Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun
blazebeard and sons bamboozling flakgun.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
blazebeard and sons bamboozling flakgun.description: Effect: Pick 1 dice in that charge roll. Then, make a **bamboozling flak roll** of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the value on the dice, remove that dice from the charge roll.
blazebeard and sons bamboozling flakgun.lore: This large-barrelled, stumpy weapon fires a mishmash of workshop swarf coated in phosphor-laced aether-gold that produces a blinding, bewildering display when the trigger is pulled – highly effective for stopping an advancing enemy in their tracks.

celestium burst grenade.name: Celestium Burst Grenade
celestium burst grenade.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
celestium burst grenade.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
celestium burst grenade.lore: Typically used by the Grundstok ‘black marines’, this specialised anti-ethereal weapon can nullify magical wards.

voidstone orb.name: Voidstone Orb
voidstone orb.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 30" of this unit
voidstone orb.lore: This small, unassuming black globe contains the power to disrupt enemy spells.

emberstone flare.name: Emberstone Flare
emberstone flare.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
emberstone flare.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS** unit that has **FLY** and is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
emberstone flare.lore: The bearer shoots a flare into the sky, signalling a skyvessel or a group of endrin-borne Kharadron to rapidly relocate.

karst bana aether powered combat rig.name: Karst-Bana Aether-Powered Combat Rig
karst bana aether powered combat rig.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)**. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
karst bana aether powered combat rig.lore: This pioneer is a firm believer that wealth is be wrested from the Mortal Realms at gunpoint or at the business end of an aether-powered hammer. This has led to a custom-built combat harness, commissioned to provide overwhelming strength and protection in equal measure.

spell in a bottle.name: Spell in a Bottle
spell in a bottle.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
spell in a bottle.description: Effect: This unit can use a **SUMMON** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that **SUMMON** ability, the casting roll is 7 and cannot be modified. That **SUMMON** ability cannot be unbound.
spell in a bottle.lore: The bearer pops the rune-stamped cork of this bottle and unleashes an arcane manifestation previously sealed up for safekeeping.

gunhauler escort.name: Gunhauler Escort
gunhauler escort.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of a friendly **Grundstok Gunhauler**.
gunhauler escort.lore: The threatening presence of a Grundstok Gunhauler overhead makes it difficult for enemies to focus their attacks on the Trailblazers’ ground forces.

shrewd opportunist.name: Shrewd Opportunist
shrewd opportunist.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 other friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS** non-**HERO INFANTRY** units to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
shrewd opportunist.lore: This duardin’s mind is as sharp as a gem cutter. They are quick to see openings and do not hesitate to seize upon them. Such a quality is, of course, highly conducive to profit!

bold as brass.name: Bold As Brass
bold as brass.description: Effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score.
bold as brass.lore: Whether their roared oaths ring louder than the summons to Musterpress or the sheer audacity of their actions speaks volumes, this officer is an imposing presence on the battlefield.

combat grafter.name: Combat Grafter
combat grafter.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
combat grafter.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the phase.
combat grafter.lore: Knuckling down and cracking skulls is what this officer does best.

ply the skies.name: Ply the Skies
ply the skies.phase: Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for an Arkanaut Frigate
ply the skies.description:
Used By: The **Arkanaut Frigate** that is using that **MOVE** ability.

Effect: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that is wholly within the combat range of that **Arkanaut Frigate** and not in combat to be transported. Remove that **INFANTRY** unit from the battlefield. Then, when the **Arkanaut Frigate** ends its move, set up the **INFANTRY** unit on the battlefield again, wholly within the combat range of the **Arkanaut Frigate** and not in combat. A unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.
ply the skies.lore: The Kharadron rule the skies of the realms with fleets of fearsome airships crewed by hardened duardin.

flying high.name: Flying High
flying high.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** that is in a regiment from which no units have been deployed, then pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are in its regiment.

Effect: Set up all of those units in reserve **in the clouds**. They have now been deployed.
flying high.lore: Often one skyvessel will hold back high above the battlefield, only to descend and deploy additional troops where and when they are most needed.
flying high.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

the flagship.name: The Flagship
the flagship.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** to be the target. The target can be in reserve.

Effect: The target has the **FLAGSHIP** keyword for the rest of the battle. If the target does not have a Great Endrinwork, give the target 1 Great Endrinwork.

**Designer’s Note:** *This Great Endrinwork is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
the flagship.lore: Every fleet commander designates one of their vessels to be their flagship.
the flagship.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

descend from the clouds.name: Descend from the Clouds
descend from the clouds.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL in the clouds** to use this ability.

Effect: Set up that **SKYVESSEL** anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units that were set up **in the clouds** with that **SKYVESSEL** wholly within 6" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.
descend from the clouds.lore: As a skyvessel swoops down to the battlefield, its Kharadron passengers scramble to disembark and storm the enemy lines.
descend from the clouds.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

transport skyfarers.name: Transport Skyfarers
transport skyfarers.phase: Your Movement Phase, Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL
transport skyfarers.description:
Effect: Pick a number of units up to that **SKYVESSEL**’s Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it and not in combat to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.

Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **SKYVESSEL** ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **SKYVESSEL** and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.
transport skyfarers.lore: The Kharadron rule the skies of the realms with fleets of fearsome airships crewed by hardened duardin.
transport skyfarers.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

skyvessel cover.name: Skyvessel Cover
skyvessel cover.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units that have not charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 6" of a friendly **Arkanaut Ironclad** or **Arkanaut Frigate** that has not charged in the same turn.
skyvessel cover.lore: With a mighty skyvessel floating above providing covering fire, Kharadron Overlords are much harder to target.
skyvessel cover.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

tracer fire rounds.name: Tracer-fire Rounds
tracer fire rounds.phase: Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit
tracer fire rounds.description: Effect: If all of the attacks target the same enemy unit, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls for those attacks.
tracer fire rounds.lore: Imported Excelsian glimmerings have been worked into the casings of these rounds, causing them to subtly correct their trajectory to their target.
tracer fire rounds.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

coalbeard s collapsible bombrack.name: Coalbeard's Collapsible Bombrack
coalbeard s collapsible bombrack.description: Effect: Add 1 to each dice roll when using this unit’s ‘Heavy Bomb Racks’, ‘Medium Bomb Racks’ or ‘Light Bomb Racks’ ability.
coalbeard s collapsible bombrack.lore: This munitions storage rig has a clever folding design that allows it to carry additional bombs.
coalbeard s collapsible bombrack.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

gruksson wide bore cylinders.name: Gruksson Wide-bore Cylinders
gruksson wide bore cylinders.description: Effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
gruksson wide bore cylinders.lore: This modified endrin guzzles fuel like Jakkob Bugmansson XI samples his stock, and is similarly energised for doing so.
gruksson wide bore cylinders.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

grandiose fuselage.name: Grandiose Fuselage
grandiose fuselage.description: Effect: Add 5 to this unit’s Control characteristic.
grandiose fuselage.lore: Whether emblazoned with gaudy runic slogans advocating guild sponsors or bearing a particularly impressive figurehead, this vessel is doubly imposing to foes.
grandiose fuselage.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

hegsson solutions old reliable hullplate.name: Hegsson Solutions 'Old Reliable' Hullplates
hegsson solutions old reliable hullplate.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** against damage inflicted by **SHOOT** abilities.
hegsson solutions old reliable hullplate.lore: These hull plates are renowned for their ability to absorb damage without failing.
hegsson solutions old reliable hullplate.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

nullstone galvanisation.name: Nullstone Galvanisation
nullstone galvanisation.description: Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on each enemy **MANIFESTATION** within this unit’s combat range.
nullstone galvanisation.lore: Thanks to metalwork treated with an anti-magic coating, arcane conjurations that linger in proximity to this ship are gradually undone.
nullstone galvanisation.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

zonbarcorp dealbreaker battle ram.name: Zonbarcorp 'Dealbreaker' Battle Ram
zonbarcorp dealbreaker battle ram.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
zonbarcorp dealbreaker battle ram.lore: A vessel with this best-selling upgrade need not fear full-on collisions. The same cannot be said for those in its way, however.
zonbarcorp dealbreaker battle ram.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

voidstone repulser vents.name: Voidstone Repulser Vents
voidstone repulser vents.phase: Reaction: A friendly unit within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of an enemy SPELL ability
voidstone repulser vents.description:
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+:

• Ignore the effect of that spell on that friendly unit.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but you can only roll once for each friendly unit per spell cast.
voidstone repulser vents.lore: Clouds of voidstone ground into a fine dust are released from these ports to nullify and deflect enemy spells.
voidstone repulser vents.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

blazebeard and sons ejector pod.name: Blazebeard and Sons Ejector Pod
blazebeard and sons ejector pod.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
blazebeard and sons ejector pod.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO** wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again wholly within 18" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
blazebeard and sons ejector pod.lore: This incredible device provides a potent fail-safe for any shrewd Kharadron leader. However after use, the warranty for the device is void, making subsequent uses a risk no sane Kharadron would ever take!
blazebeard and sons ejector pod.restrictionText: Great Endrinworks are a special type of enhancement for **SKYVESSELS**. During army composition, when you add enhancements, you can pick 1 Great Endrinwork and give it to a **SKYVESSEL** on your army roster.

artycle 25 point 6.name: Artycle 25, Point 6
artycle 25 point 6.description: Effect: Friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS HEROES** have **WARD (5+)** while they are within this unit’s combat range.
artycle 25 point 6.lore: Crew members must ensure the adequate defence of their superiors during perilous expeditions.
artycle 25 point 6.restrictionText: Artycle References are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** **INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Artycle Reference.

artycle 15 point 4.name: Artycle 15, Point 4
artycle 15 point 4.description:
Effect: • Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has **FLY**.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that does not have **FLY**.
artycle 15 point 4.lore: All duardin should be well versed in multiple combat techniques that can be employed against airborne and ground‐based enemies.
artycle 15 point 4.restrictionText: Artycle References are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** **INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Artycle Reference.

artycle 20 amendment 2.name: Artycle 20, Amendment 2
artycle 20 amendment 2.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Charge Phase
artycle 20 amendment 2.description:
Declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target’s attacks cannot score critical hits for the rest of the turn (treat them as regular hits instead).
artycle 20 amendment 2.lore: Flare guns may be used in extremis to disorientate marauders and others with sinister motives.
artycle 20 amendment 2.restrictionText: Artycle References are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** **INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Artycle Reference.

persistent drillbill.name: Persistent Drillbill
persistent drillbill.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• If the target unit’s starting size was 1, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
persistent drillbill.lore: This avian cog-familiar is relentless; once it has a foe in its sights, it will harry and peck them to the exclusion of all else.

experimental aether powered ejector rig.name: Experimental Aether-Powered Ejector Rig
experimental aether powered ejector rig.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
experimental aether powered ejector rig.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
experimental aether powered ejector rig.lore: This pioneer firmly believes that combat is for other duardin.

heat seeking auto endrin.name: Heat-Seeking Auto-Endrin
heat seeking auto endrin.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract your opponent’s **fury level** from the target’s control score.

***Designer’s Note**: Use your opponent’s fury level at the point the unit’s control score is determined.*
heat seeking auto endrin.lore: Designed to home in on sources of rage-induced heat – of which there are no shortage in fiery Aqshy – this tiny auto-endrin harasses and distracts the incensed foe.

formations.name: Rapid Redeployment Squadron
formations.description: Effect: Friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers** can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units instead of 1 and with a combined model count of up to 6 instead of 5 (see Kharadron Overlords Battle Traits).

ability.name: Extra Rappel Anchors
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers** can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units instead of 1 and with a combined model count of up to 6 instead of 5 (see Kharadron Overlords Battle Traits).
ability.lore: The Grundstok Gunhaulers in this force have been fitted with extra ports to which privateers can tether themselves in order to hitch a ride in battle.

abilities.name: Extra Rappel Anchors
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers** can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units instead of 1 and with a combined model count of up to 6 instead of 5 (see Kharadron Overlords Battle Traits).
abilities.lore: The Grundstok Gunhaulers in this force have been fitted with extra ports to which privateers can tether themselves in order to hitch a ride in battle.

formations.name: Veteran Ground Troops
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Arkanaut Company** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, if the target has not been set up this battle round and while it has not moved this turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that unit.

ability.name: Entrenched Crews
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Arkanaut Company** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, if the target has not been set up this battle round and while it has not moved this turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that unit.
ability.lore: The Arkanauts in this fleet are no strangers to ground-based combat. Once in position, they will make clever use of the terrain to stymie the attacks of the foe.

abilities.name: Entrenched Crews
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Arkanaut Company** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, if the target has not been set up this battle round and while it has not moved this turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that unit.
abilities.lore: The Arkanauts in this fleet are no strangers to ground-based combat. Once in position, they will make clever use of the terrain to stymie the attacks of the foe.

formations.name: Endrineers Guild Expeditionary Force
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO** that does not have an artefact of power. The target can be in reserve.

Effect: Give that **HERO** 1 artefact of power from the ‘Inventions of the Sky-ports’ or the ‘Ingenious Innovations.

**Designer’s Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

ability.name: Special Procurement
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO** that does not have an artefact of power. The target can be in reserve.

Effect: Give that **HERO** 1 artefact of power from the ‘Inventions of the Sky-ports’ or the ‘Ingenious Innovations.

**Designer’s Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
ability.lore: The Endrineers Guild often charter expeditionary forces equipped with the most advanced inventions in the realms.

abilities.name: Special Procurement
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO** that does not have an artefact of power. The target can be in reserve.

Effect: Give that **HERO** 1 artefact of power from the ‘Inventions of the Sky-ports’ or the ‘Ingenious Innovations.

**Designer’s Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
abilities.lore: The Endrineers Guild often charter expeditionary forces equipped with the most advanced inventions in the realms.

formations.name: Pioneers and Scavengers
formations.description: Effect: Friendly **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** and **Vongrim Salvagers** units have **WARD** **(6+)** while they are contesting an objective.

ability.name: Gritty Fortune-hunters
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** and **Vongrim Salvagers** units have **WARD** **(6+)** while they are contesting an objective.
ability.lore: The Vongrim guilders in this expedition have almost depleted their current reserves of aether-gold. Their very existence depends on the success of this venture, and they’ll be damned if anyone tries to cheat them of their imminent windfall!

abilities.name: Gritty Fortune-hunters
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** and **Vongrim Salvagers** units have **WARD** **(6+)** while they are contesting an objective.
abilities.lore: The Vongrim guilders in this expedition have almost depleted their current reserves of aether-gold. Their very existence depends on the success of this venture, and they’ll be damned if anyone tries to cheat them of their imminent windfall!

master of discipline.name: Master of Discipline
master of discipline.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, you can re-roll the dice.
master of discipline.lore: This duardin is popular amongst their crews but also knows when to crack the whip and remind them who pays their wages.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

flanking fire.name: Flanking Fire
flanking fire.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW SKYVESSELS** that target an enemy unit in combat with this unit.
flanking fire.lore: A master of tactics, this officer is an expert at orchestrating deadly crossfires, often boldly using themselves as the bait.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

aerodynamism.name: Aerodynamism
aerodynamism.description: Effect: If this unit moved this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.
aerodynamism.lore: Borne by state-of-the-art endrins, the speed and agility with which this duardin navigates the battlefield makes them a very difficult target.
aerodynamism.groupName: The Magnate's Crew Artefacts of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

guns for all occasions.name: Guns For All Occasions
guns for all occasions.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
guns for all occasions.lore: This canny duardin always has a backup plan in the form of a cleverly stowed aetherblaster.
guns for all occasions.groupName: The Magnate's Crew Artefacts of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

cutting edge endrinpacks.name: Cutting-Edge Endrinpacks
cutting edge endrinpacks.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
cutting edge endrinpacks.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** units that are wholly within 9" of a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW SKYVESSEL** to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
cutting edge endrinpacks.lore: The Lord-Magnate outfits his soldiers with the latest and most agile endrinharnesses.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

loyalty to the magnate.name: Loyalty to the Magnate
loyalty to the magnate.description: Effect: While a friendly **Brokk Grungsson** is wholly within the combat range of another friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** unit, both those units have **WARD (5+)**.
loyalty to the magnate.lore: Some call it loyalty; Brokk calls it ‘contractual motivation’.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

pay your debts.name: Pay Your Debts
pay your debts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield or in reserve to be **indebted**.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** units that target the **indebted** unit.
pay your debts.lore: Grungsson never forgets an insult and always settles the score with those who have done him wrong.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

constant barrage.name: Constant Barrage
constant barrage.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
constant barrage.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** unit’s attacks to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move within 10" of any friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** units, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
constant barrage.lore: Brokk’s expert gunners are so precise that they can bombard the enemy even as they move to engage nearby Kharadron infantry.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

invictunite lined hull.name: Invictunite-lined Hull
invictunite lined hull.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
invictunite lined hull.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW SKYVESSEL** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. For the rest of the turn, subtract **X** from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that **SKYVESSEL**, where **X** is equal to the roll.
invictunite lined hull.lore: Only the Lord-Magnate could afford to line his ships’ hulls with the incredibly strong meteoric metal invictunite.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

bold moves.name: Bold Moves
bold moves.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
bold moves.description:
Declare: Pick any number of friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** units that are in combat to be the targets. Make an **emergency launch roll** of 3D6 for each target.

Effect: Each target can move a distance up to the value of its **emergency launch roll**. It **can** move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but **cannot** end that move in combat with an enemy unit that it was not in combat with at the start of the phase.

The target(s) cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
bold moves.lore: Massive profits alone have not taken Brokk Grungsson to the apex of Kharadron society. His uncanny ability to take his foes off-guard has proven just as valuable.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Magnate's Crew

entrenchment expert.name: Entrenchment Expert
entrenchment expert.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘All-out Defence’ command for a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this HERO
entrenchment expert.description: Effect: That friendly unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
entrenchment expert.lore: This hero prefers to engage their foes from heavy cover, keeping their own losses to a minimum.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

gun butt low blow.name: Gun Butt Low Blow
gun butt low blow.description: Effect: While a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE INFANTRY** unit is contesting an objective that you control, its melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
gun butt low blow.lore: Grizzled veterans all, the Grundcorps are used to fighting dirty if it means getting what they want.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

grudgefire rounds.name: Grudgefire Rounds
grudgefire rounds.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
grudgefire rounds.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE INFANTRY** unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the phase.
grudgefire rounds.lore: This ammunition bursts into white-hot flames when it hits its target.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

no safe haven.name: No Safe Haven
no safe haven.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the control score of that unit for each damage point allocated to it this turn by a shooting attack made by a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE** unit, to a maximum of 10 damage points.
no safe haven.lore: The firepower of the Grundcorps pelts the ground so aggressively that no cover can protect their targets for long.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

transport skyfarers.name: Transport Skyfarers
transport skyfarers.phase: Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL
transport skyfarers.description:
Used By: The **SKYVESSEL** using that **MOVE** ability.

Effect: Pick a number of units up to that **SKYVESSEL**’s Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.

Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **SKYVESSEL** ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **SKYVESSEL** and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.
transport skyfarers.lore: The Kharadron rule the skies of the realms with fleets of fearsome airships crewed by hardened duardin.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

aetheric nullifier.name: Aetheric Nullifier
aetheric nullifier.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SHOOT or FIGHT ability for a MANIFESTATION within 9" of the bearer
aetheric nullifier.description: Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the **MANIFESTATION**’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. You cannot pick the same **MANIFESTATION** to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.
aetheric nullifier.lore: This unassuming cylindrical tool is fashioned from a potent anti-magic alloy.
aetheric nullifier.groupName: Grundstok Expeditionary Force Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

copper fingers.name: Copper Fingers
copper fingers.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability for a Zontari Endrin Dock
copper fingers.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within 9" of that **Zontari Endrin Dock**, instead of resolving the effect of the ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability, set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **Zontari Endrin Dock** and more than 3" from all enemy units.
copper fingers.lore: Though not a qualified member of the Endrineers Guild, this officer comes from a long line of tinkerers with an aptitude for aethermatics.

territorial trailblazer.name: Territorial Trailblazer
territorial trailblazer.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
territorial trailblazer.lore: This stubborn and audacious duardin is surrounded by an almost tangible aura of defiance that makes enemies think twice about challenging them for control of resources.

secure investments.name: Secure Investments
secure investments.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
secure investments.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if any enemy units that were within 3" of your **Zontari Endrin Dock** this turn were destroyed this turn.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly non-**INFANTRY PIONEER** units or friendly faction terrain features.
secure investments.lore: The wise profiteer ensures that their assets are well protected.

market dominance.name: Market Dominance
market dominance.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
market dominance.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if you control every objective that is not wholly within enemy territory.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, each time you use your **Zontari Endrin Dock**’s ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability, you can set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on a manufacturing roll of 3+ instead of 4+.
market dominance.lore: Even if you have secured an unassailable monopoly, it is vital to aggressively defend your interests.

aggressive acquisitions.name: Aggressive Acquisitions
aggressive acquisitions.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
aggressive acquisitions.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if there is a friendly **PIONEER** unit in each large quarter of the battlefield. Each of those units must be more than 6" from all other large quarters of the battlefield and not in combat.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, enemy units cannot be set up within your territory or within 9" of an objective that you control.
aggressive acquisitions.lore: In war and profit, leave no avenue for your enemies to progress.

initial investment.name: Initial Investment
initial investment.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
initial investment.description: Effect: Each friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** can move 2D6" but cannot finish that move in combat.
initial investment.lore: Kharadron doctrine emphasises the importance of good reconaissance.

settling accounts.name: Settling Accounts
settling accounts.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
settling accounts.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** was destroyed this turn by an enemy unit.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, each time a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** is removed from the battlefield, before removing it, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of that **AUTO-ENDRIN**.
settling accounts.lore: The artycles of engagement encourage the settling of one’s debts through the application of heavy explosives.

hostile takeover.name: Hostile Takeover
hostile takeover.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
hostile takeover.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if an enemy **HERO** was destroyed by shooting attacks made by a friendly **PIONEER** unit this turn.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **PIONEER** units or friendly faction terrain features.
hostile takeover.lore: The simplest route to profit is the elimination of one’s main rivals.

thorgsson s universal automaton actuator.name: Thorgsson's Universal Automaton Actuator
thorgsson s universal automaton actuator.description: Effect: Add 6" to the Move characteristic of friendly **AUTO-ENDRINS** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
thorgsson s universal automaton actuator.lore: This portable cartridge radiates an energy field that gives nearby Auto-Endrins that extra bit of spark and verve. No batteries necessary.

rockbuster charges.name: Rockbuster Charges
rockbuster charges.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature that this unit passed across this turn. Each enemy unit within 1" of that terrain feature is a target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
rockbuster charges.lore: Dropped from on high, these drill-tipped bomblets bore into the ground before detonating in shredding storms of rock and shrapnel.

stave of suffering.name: Stave of Suffering
stave of suffering.description: Effect: While this unit is within 12" of any damaged enemy units or enemy units that have had any models slain, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
stave of suffering.lore: This staff drinks in the misery and pain of nearby living things and converts it into powerful magic that can be harnessed by Nighthaunt spellcasters.

tombstone of the penitent.name: Tombstone of the Penitent
tombstone of the penitent.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for each non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature that is being contested by friendly units, to a maximum of 8.
tombstone of the penitent.lore: This tombstone, chained to the gheist cursed to bear it, begins to burn with spectral flames as the land around them is suffused with deathly energies.

amulet of waking nightmares.name: Amulet of Waking Nightmares
amulet of waking nightmares.description:
Declare: Pick a enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target cannot be affected by the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability or the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability.
amulet of waking nightmares.lore: This loathsome amulet afflicts harrowing visions on a chosen victim, whose subsequent throat- rending screams allow Nighthaunt marksmen to locate their target no matter where they hide.

brazier of nagashizzar.name: Brazier of Nagashizzar
brazier of nagashizzar.phase: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit
brazier of nagashizzar.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
brazier of nagashizzar.lore: Green flames billow from this brazier, lashing at nearby gheists and ensuring that there is no rest for the wicked.

lightshard of the harvest moon.name: Lightshard of the Harvest Moon
lightshard of the harvest moon.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
lightshard of the harvest moon.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.
lightshard of the harvest moon.lore: This lightshard is filled with a baleful gloom that, upon release, casts the battlefield in an eerie glow, readying the enemy for the reaping.

mirror of echoing failures.name: Mirror of Echoing Failures
mirror of echoing failures.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability for a WIZARD or PRIEST within 12" of this unit
mirror of echoing failures.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy **WIZARD** and **PRIEST** within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, for the rest of the phase:

• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the targets.
• Each time any of the targets fails to cast a spell or chant a prayer, inflict 1 mortal damage on that target.
mirror of echoing failures.lore: To fail in front of this awful artefact is to have those miseries echoed in excruciating detail by a caterwauling reflection of your own face deriding your futile efforts.

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units, excluding **Nagash.**
ethereal.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
ethereal.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly units.
ethereal.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.

ethereal translocation.name: Ethereal Translocation
ethereal translocation.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ethereal translocation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is not in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
ethereal translocation.lore: The Nighthaunt appear and disappear from sight to torment their prey.
ethereal translocation.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

mounting dread.name: Mounting Dread
mounting dread.description: Effect: Subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.
mounting dread.lore: The keening wails and harrowing shrieks of the Nighthaunt are a continuous assault on the courage of those who face them in battle, until their will to fight has all but crumbled.
mounting dread.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

sepulchral apparitions.name: Sepulchral Apparitions
sepulchral apparitions.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Nexus of Grief** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield. Each must be set up wholly outside enemy territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original* **Nexus of Grief** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
sepulchral apparitions.lore: Like sinister visions intruding upon reality, the haunted crypts of the Nighthaunt shimmer into existence wherever there are souls to be captured and tortured.
sepulchral apparitions.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

cackling arrival.name: Cackling Arrival
cackling arrival.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
cackling arrival.description:
Declare: Pick 1 of your units in reserve.

Effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
cackling arrival.lore: Whether diving from the skies or rising suddenly from the very ground, a host of gheists catches the foe unaware.

ruler of the spectral hosts.name: Ruler of the Spectral Hosts
ruler of the spectral hosts.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ruler of the spectral hosts.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to **X,** where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
ruler of the spectral hosts.lore: The deathly power of this spirit is like a siren call, an unseen signal that beckons to those who have passed beyond the grave.

deathly possessor.name: Deathly Possessor
deathly possessor.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target's combat range to be the victim.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target with that weapon against the victim.
deathly possessor.lore: In a flash ofbalefire, the Nighthaunt vanishes. An instant later, a nearby foe's eyes glow with spectral power and they lash out at their allies, cackling in a voice not their own.

shadowy aura.name: Shadowy Aura
shadowy aura.phase: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit wholly within 12" of this unit
shadowy aura.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.
shadowy aura.lore: A pall of gloom hangs over this champion, concealing the movements of nearby gheists and allowing them to ambush their victims.

tome of the restless crypts.name: Tome of the Restless Crypts
tome of the restless crypts.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
tome of the restless crypts.description: Effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield, set up a **Nexus of Grief** within 3" of a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit, more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 1" from all other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.
tome of the restless crypts.lore: This volume holds the secrets to calling forth more hungering mausoleums.

ethereal fetters.name: Ethereal Fetters
ethereal fetters.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, if possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
ethereal fetters.lore: Spectral chains erupt from this Nighthaunt’s form to temporarily shackle the souls of nearby foes, ensuring they cannot escape.

urn of despondency.name: Urn of Despondency
urn of despondency.description:
Effect: Spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll **X**D6, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the roll but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit and/or an enemy unit that has fewer models than its starting size.
urn of despondency.lore: From this funerary urn emerge swirling spirits that feed upon negative emotions. Empowered by resentment, they become as a spectral whirlwind, speeding the bearer to new sources of suffering.

vociferous defamers.name: Vociferous Defamers
vociferous defamers.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit. Add 2 to casting rolls instead if this unit is also in combat with an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**.
vociferous defamers.lore: These wretches denied the Great Necromancer’s arcane might; as punishment, they are beholden to Nagash’s mages.
vociferous defamers.restrictionText: Crimes of the Condemned are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Crime of the Condemned.

backstabbing betrayers.name: Backstabbing Betrayers
backstabbing betrayers.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is more than 12" from all other friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.
backstabbing betrayers.lore: Condemned to eternal solitude for their traitorous deeds, these spectres take out their loneliness on the enemy.
backstabbing betrayers.restrictionText: Crimes of the Condemned are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Crime of the Condemned.

cowards and deserters.name: Cowards and Deserters
cowards and deserters.phase: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
cowards and deserters.description:
Effect: After that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice. You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Add 1 to the roll.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
cowards and deserters.lore: Fearful and craven in life, these gheists continue to flee from their enemies beyond the grave.
cowards and deserters.restrictionText: Crimes of the Condemned are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Crime of the Condemned.

fell blades.name: Fell Blades
fell blades.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **FIGHT** ability, if all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, after that ability has been resolved, subtract 1 from save rolls for that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
fell blades.lore: A malignant curse screeched to blackened skies coalesces on spectral blades, causing the weapons to glow with the magics of ending.

chains of death.name: Chains of Death
chains of death.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
chains of death.lore: With an unearthly howl, hundreds of spectral chains burst from the caster's billowing form, ensnaring their straining victim from head to foot.

wrench souls.name: Wrench Souls
wrench souls.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly non-**HERO** **NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.
wrench souls.lore: With a clasped fist and a horrible twist, the caster drags a horde of gheists to their desired location.

summon vault of souls.name: Summon Vault of Souls
summon vault of souls.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Vault of Souls** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vault of Souls** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summon vault of souls.lore: This summoned chest siphons souls, filling itself to overflowing with the rich spirits of mortalkind.

summon shyish reaper.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
summon shyish reaper.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Shyish Reaper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Shyish Reaper** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon shyish reaper.lore: The wizard sweeps down their arm as they utter this spell’s final incantation, and a fearsome scythe formed of purest amethyst magic tears through their foes with unstoppable force.

summon mortalis terminexus.name: Summon Mortalis Terminexus
summon mortalis terminexus.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Mortalis Terminexus** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Mortalis Terminexus** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summon mortalis terminexus.lore: A spectral hourglass filled with shifting grave-sand takes shape, promising temporal grace or doom to mortal and immortal alike.

formations.name: Royal Procession
formations.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the targets.

Effect: The targets' melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Lethal Rancour
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the targets.

Effect: The targets' melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The gheists of this horde are drawn from haughty nobles and obsequious courtiers who refused to admit fault even at the very end. They rail constantly at their kingdom's doom, and their undying bitterness renders their spectral touch even more deadly against those they perceive as interlopers.

They rail constantly at their kingdom's doom, and their undying bitterness renders their spectral touch even more deadly against those they perceive as interlopers.

formations.name: Hungry Nexus
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Nexus of Grief** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target has a Move characteristic of 3". It can immediately move up to 3" and can move into combat but cannot end that move on a terrain feature or within 3" of an objective.

ability.name: Greedy for Souls
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Nexus of Grief** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target has a Move characteristic of 3". It can immediately move up to 3" and can move into combat but cannot end that move on a terrain feature or within 3" of an objective.
ability.lore: A Nexus of Grief’s bricks fly apart and its metal rails extend outwards like a grasping claw, dragging it ever nearer to living, breathing victims.

abilities.lore: A Nexus of Grief’s bricks fly apart and its metal rails extend outwards like a grasping claw, dragging it ever nearer to living, breathing victims.

formations.name: Shrieker Host
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with the target.

ability.name: Petrify
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with the target.
ability.lore: The screams and wails of this procession's bloodthirsty champions are so terrifying that their foes often become rooted in place, ripe for the slaughter.

abilities.lore: The screams and wails of this procession's bloodthirsty champions are so terrifying that their foes often become rooted in place, ripe for the slaughter.

formations.name: Quicksilver Gheists
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.

ability.name: Vanish and Reappear
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.
ability.lore: These mercurial spirits are feared for their ability to dissolve into nothingness before suddenly reappearing elsewhere - often right behind their next targets' backs.

abilities.name: Vanish and Reappear
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: These mercurial spirits are feared for their ability to dissolve into nothingness before suddenly reappearing elsewhere - often right behind their next targets' backs.

formations.name: Death Stalkers
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• The target can use **CHARGE** and **SHOOT** abilities even if it has used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
• The target can use the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

ability.name: There Is No Escape
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• The target can use **CHARGE** and **SHOOT** abilities even if it has used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
• The target can use the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
ability.lore: Death Stalkers are spectral killers that relentlessly hunt down a chosen enemy. They are constantly on the move in pursuit of their quarry and nigh impossible to pin down.

abilities.name: There Is No Escape
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
