• The target can use the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Death Stalkers are spectral killers that relentlessly hunt down a chosen enemy. They are constantly on the move in pursuit of their quarry and nigh impossible to pin down.

formations.name: Deathrust Gheists
formations.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Blades of Eternal Rust
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The weapons of these Nighthaunt constantly shed flakes of spectral rust that cause whatever physical substance they come to rest upon to corrode in moments.

abilities.name: Blades of Eternal Rust
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The weapons of these Nighthaunt constantly shed flakes of spectral rust that cause whatever physical substance they come to rest upon to corrode in moments.

pitiless reapers.name: Pitiless Reapers
pitiless reapers.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
pitiless reapers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that passed across any enemy units this phase to use this ability, then pick 1 of those enemy units to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that passed across the target. Add 1 to the roll if any friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION Black Coaches** passed across the target this phase. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
pitiless reapers.lore: The chill blades of the Clattering Procession flash down and reap a deadly harvest as they pass through the enemy ranks.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Clattering Procession

spectral swiftness.name: Spectral Swiftness
spectral swiftness.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
spectral swiftness.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.
spectral swiftness.lore: The incorporeal cavalry of the Clattering Procession are impossible to surround and pin down.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Clattering Procession

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.
ethereal.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Clattering Procession

the speed of death.name: The Speed of Death
the speed of death.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
the speed of death.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that used a **CHARGE** or **RETREAT** ability this turn, is not in combat and is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge to use this ability.

Effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.
the speed of death.lore: With terrifying speed, the ethereal steeds of the Clattering Procession climb into darkened skies, leaving a steep trail of burning spectral hoofprints in the air.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Clattering Procession

silent overseer.name: Silent Overseer
silent overseer.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the targets can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
silent overseer.lore: With a gesture of a translucent finger, this gheist orders those spirits who have fled from their enemies to charge again, heedless of the cost.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Clattering Procession

talisman of the nadir.name: Talisman of the Nadir
talisman of the nadir.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
talisman of the nadir.description: Effect: If a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1).** Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability.
talisman of the nadir.lore: A tiny, spell-eating mote of the Shyish Nadir rages in this ornate hourglass, devouring enemy magics with eager abandon.
talisman of the nadir.groupName: The Clattering Procession Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Clattering Procession

spectral lashes.name: Spectral Lashes
spectral lashes.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
spectral lashes.lore: With a rattling shriek, the caster causes spectral lashes to manifest around the ethereal steeds of the Clattering Procession, driving them forward with pitiless blows.

fell riders.name: Fell Riders
fell riders.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick the caster and up to 1 other visible friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.
fell riders.lore: Words of power twist the air and ghostly green flames explode from the hooves of the Clattering Procession's steeds, giving them a deadly burst of speed.

summon shyish reaper.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
summon shyish reaper.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Shyish Reaper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Shyish Reaper** wholly within 9" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon shyish reaper.lore: The wizard sweeps down their arm as they utter this spell's final incantation, and a fearsome scythe formed of purest amethyst magic tears through their foes with unstoppable force.

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units, excluding **Nagash.**
ethereal.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Eternal Nightmare

gather power.name: Gather Power
gather power.description:
Effect: The following effects apply to the friendly **Nagash** during the first and second battle rounds, as shown:

**Battle Round 1:**

• His Move characteristic is'-' and he cannot make pile-in moves.
• He has **WARD (3+).**
• He has a Control characteristic of 1.
• **Alakanash** and **Zefet-nebtar** each have an Attacks characteristic of 2 instead of 4.

**Battle Round 2:**

• His Move characteristic is 6".
• He cannot end a move more than 6" from the **ritual site.**
• He has **WARD (4+).**
• He has a Control characteristic of 5.
• **Alakanash** and **Zefet-nebtar** each have an Attacks characteristic of 2 instead of 4.
gather power.lore: Nagash's formidable will gathers magical power to reinvest his divine spirit with corporeal raiment once more. During his unholy resurrection, there is a brief window where he is at his most vulnerable.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Eternal Nightmare

unholy vessel.name: Unholy Vessel
unholy vessel.description: Effect: The **ritual site** has **WARD (4+)** and cannot use the 'Hungry Crypts' ability.
unholy vessel.lore: As Nagash gathers his power, a tiny portion of his godly might is invested in the Nexus of Grief that plays host to his disembodied spirit.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Eternal Nightmare

the ritual begins.name: The Ritual Begins
the ritual begins.description:
Declare: You must use this ability to set up the friendly **Nagash.** Pick a friendly **Nexus of Grief** wholly within friendly territory to be the **ritual site.**

Effect: Set up the friendly **Nagash** within 1" of the **ritual site** and wholly within friendly territory. After you have done so, he has been **deployed.** That **Nexus of Grief** is the **ritual site** for the rest of the battle.
the ritual begins.lore: Nagash's potent spirit anchors itself to a nearby Nexus of Grief, and it is from here that his form shall be remade once more in all its macabre glory.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Eternal Nightmare

damned vessel.name: Damned Vessel
damned vessel.description: Effect: Whenever you declare a **SPELL** ability for a friendly **Nagash** within 18" of this unit, you can measure the range and visibility of that **SPELL** ability from this unit instead of that **Nagash**.
damned vessel.lore: With a wretched wail, a gheist's will is temporarily eclipsed as Nagash channels his power through their ragged shape.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Eternal Nightmare

the seal of nagash.name: The Seal of Nagash
the seal of nagash.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
the seal of nagash.description: Effect: Allocate 3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, **Heal (3)** the friendly **Nagash.**
the seal of nagash.lore: This sigil, magically seared into this gheist's spectral form, binds them to Nagash so that he may readily drain their power to sustain himself at a moment's notice.
the seal of nagash.groupName: The Eternal Nightmare Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Eternal Nightmare

the will of nagash.name: The Will of Nagash
the will of nagash.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, if the unmodified hit roll or unmodified wound roll for an attack that targets the target unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
the will of nagash.lore: Eye sockets flaring with power, the wizard renders nearby gheists almost invulnerable to enemy attacks.

divine terror.name: Divine Terror
divine terror.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 3 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.
divine terror.lore: The inevitability of Nagash's return inspires utter dread, and it is a matter of little effort for the wizard to magnify that fear tenfold.

summon mortalis terminexus.name: Summon Mortalis Terminexus
summon mortalis terminexus.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Mortalis Terminexus** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Mortalis Terminexus** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summon mortalis terminexus.lore: A spectral hourglass filled with shifting grave-sand takes shape, promising temporal grace or doom to mortal and immortal alike.

summon shyish reaper.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
summon shyish reaper.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Shyish Reaper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Shyish Reaper** wholly within 9" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon shyish reaper.lore: The wizard sweeps down their arm as they utter this spell's final incantation, and a fearsome scythe formed of purest amethyst magic tears through their foes with unstoppable force.

summon vault of souls.name: Summon Vault of Souls
summon vault of souls.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Vault of Souls** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vault of Souls** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summon vault of souls.lore: This summoned chest siphons souls, filling itself to overflowing with the rich spirits of mortalkind.

a splendid pageant.name: A Splendid Pageant
a splendid pageant.description:
Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**:

•  Each time a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** uses a **RUN** ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
•  While a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS INFANTRY HERO** is within the combat range of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS INFANTRY** unit that has 5 or more models, that **HERO** is not visible to enemy units more than 6" away.
a splendid pageant.lore: Believing they follow some grand religious icon and its holy custodians, devoted ghouls surge across the field.
a splendid pageant.restrictionText: Flesh-eater Courts armies can use the following abilities:

muster guard.name: Muster Guard
muster guard.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
muster guard.description:
Declare: Pick any number of friendly **NOBLES** to be the targets.

Effect: For each target, pick 1 of the following:

•  Return up to 3 slain models to a friendly **SERFS** unit wholly within 12" of it.
•  Return 1 slain model to a friendly **KNIGHTS** unit wholly within 12" of it.

The same unit cannot have models returned to it by this ability more than once per turn.
muster guard.lore: Cannibal nobles have the charisma to rally wavering troops.
muster guard.restrictionText: Flesh-eater Courts armies can use the following abilities:

a kingdom deluded.name: A Kingdom Deluded
a kingdom deluded.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
a kingdom deluded.description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the start of each turn. If it is the first turn of the battle, pick a **DELUSION** from these battle traits or, unless otherwise specified, from the warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield. If it is not the first turn, make a delusion roll of D6.

Effect: On a delusion roll of 1-2, you must pick a different **DELUSION** to the one you picked last turn. 

On a 3-4, you must pick the same **DELUSION** as the one you picked last turn, even if it is on the warscroll of a unit that has been destroyed. In such cases, the effect of that **DELUSION** applies as if the unit had not been destroyed. 

On a 5-6, you must pick a **DELUSION** like you did in the first turn. For the rest of the turn, you believe the **DELUSION** you picked.
a kingdom deluded.lore: The mass delusions suffered by these cannibals are volatile but intense.
a kingdom deluded.restrictionText: Flesh-eater Courts armies can use the following abilities:

royal blood.name: Royal Blood
royal blood.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
royal blood.description:
Declare: Pick any number of friendly **ABHORRANTS** to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.
royal blood.lore: The blood coursing through an abhorrant’s veins has restorative properties.
royal blood.restrictionText: Flesh-eater Courts armies can use the following abilities:

feeding frenzy.name: Feeding Frenzy
feeding frenzy.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
feeding frenzy.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.
feeding frenzy.lore: The presence of an abhorrant drives their followers into a furore
feeding frenzy.restrictionText: Flesh-eater Courts armies can use the following abilities:

feeding frenzy.name: Feeding Frenzy
feeding frenzy.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **HEROES** that have 6 **noble deeds points**.
feeding frenzy.lore: To witness an abhorrant at war spurs a mad hunger in the ghouls

a glorious banquet.name: A Glorious Banquet
a glorious banquet.description: Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES**.
a glorious banquet.lore: As the court closes on its prey, the nobility signal for the feast to begin.
a glorious banquet.restrictionText: Flesh-eater Courts armies can use the following abilities:

summon loyal subjects.name: Summon Loyal Subjects
summon loyal subjects.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
summon loyal subjects.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ABHORRANT** to use this ability, then pick a friendly **SERFS** or **KNIGHTS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon loyal subjects.lore: To the ghouls, an abhorrant’s howl is a call to defend their lands.
summon loyal subjects.restrictionText: Flesh-eater Courts armies can use the following abilities:

summon loyal subjects.name: Summon Loyal Subjects
summon loyal subjects.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** with any **noble deeds points** to use this ability.

Effect: Spend any number of that **HERO**’s **noble deeds points** as follows:

Pick a friendly **Cryptguard** unit within 9" of this unit and spend 1 **noble deeds point** to return 1 model to that unit.

Pick a friendly **Morbheg Knights** unit within 9" of this unit and spend 2 **noble deeds points** to return 1 model to that unit.
summon loyal subjects.lore: Ghouls flock to their vampiric masters.

stronger in madness.name: Stronger in Madness
stronger in madness.description:
Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.
In addition, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks that target this unit have no effect.
stronger in madness.lore: The Boon of Ushoran has rendered this warrior’s physical form near indestructible.

cruel taskmaster.name: Cruel Taskmaster
cruel taskmaster.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target.
cruel taskmaster.lore: The warriors under this courtier’s command instantly obey their summons.

savage beyond reason.name: Savage Beyond Reason
savage beyond reason.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, if it did not use a **FIGHT** ability in the previous turn. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons instead while this unit has not used a **FIGHT** ability this battle.
savage beyond reason.lore: The fury of battle drives this general into an intense rage.

noble deeds.name: Noble Deeds
noble deeds.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **HERO** uses a **FIGHT** ability, after its attacks have been resolved, give that **HERO** a number of **noble deeds points** equal to the number of damage points allocated by that ability. Each **HERO** can have a maximum of 6 **noble deeds points** at any time.
noble deeds.lore: Each member of a ghoulish court is constantly seeking to prove their valour by performing worthy exploits on the battlefield.

delusions and madness.name: Delusions and Madness
delusions and madness.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
delusions and madness.description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round. If it is the first battle round, pick a **DELUSION**. Otherwise, make a delusion roll by rolling a D6.

Effect: On a 1-3, you must pick a different **DELUSION** to the one you picked last time. On a 4+, you must pick the same **DELUSION** as last time. For the rest of the battle round, you believe the **DELUSION** you picked.
delusions and madness.lore: The Flesh‑eaters’ delusions can change on a whim.

delusion of the great feast.name: Delusion of the Great Feast
delusion of the great feast.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
delusion of the great feast.description:
Declare: If you believe this **DELUSION**, pick each friendly unit on the battlefield to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal (1)** each target. If the target is a **SERFS** unit, return D3 slain models to it instead.
delusion of the great feast.lore: In victory’s wake, the ghouls gorge upon their ‘bounty’…

delusion of the knightly host.name: Delusion of the Knightly Host
delusion of the knightly host.description: Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, if the unmodified charge roll for a friendly **HERO** or **KNIGHTS** unit is 8+, add 1 to hit rolls for that unit’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
delusion of the knightly host.lore: The earth shakes and the sky screams as the ghouls charge.

charnel vestments.name: Charnel Vestments
charnel vestments.description: Effect: If this unit is not a **PRIEST**, it has **PRIEST (1)**. If this unit is already a **PRIEST**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit. If this unit is a **WIZARD**, it cannot use **SPELL** abilities and **PRAYER** abilities in the same phase.
charnel vestments.lore: Strips of flayed skin and crudely stitched sinew form a gruesome parody of priestly robes.

the grisly pennant.name: The Grisly Pennant
the grisly pennant.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the target’s Control characteristic or is a 6, the following effects apply for the rest of the turn:

•  Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
•  Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that target that enemy unit.
the grisly pennant.lore: This raggedy flag of flesh, recently torn from an unfortunate victim, is an icon of purity and nobility to the cannibal army but a terrifying spectacle to their enemies.

the splintered femur.name: The Splintered Femur
the splintered femur.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following:

•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  Subtract 1 from the target’s power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.
•  If the target is a **MANIFESTATION**, it is banished and removed from play.
the splintered femur.lore: A venerated relic of the infamous Spell-eater Queen, this club can easily break not only limbs but also the arcane.

revered monstrosity.name: Revered Monstrosity
revered monstrosity.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by other friendly non‐**UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
revered monstrosity.lore: This noble beast has long served the court and exerts a strange dominance
revered monstrosity.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

savage abomination.name: Savage Abomination
savage abomination.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons.
savage abomination.lore: Any foe in reach of this beast’s snapping jaws and fearsome claws is unlikely to see another dawn.
savage abomination.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

horribly resilient.name: Horribly Resilient
horribly resilient.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit. If this unit is not a **HERO**, **Heal (2D3)** this unit instead.
horribly resilient.lore: Grown strong on great lakes of death magic that coalesced around the remains of a butchered empire, the desiccated form of this monstrosity is nearly impossible to destroy.
horribly resilient.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **MONSTERS**.

fool s cap.name: Fool's Cap
fool s cap.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Each time the target uses a **CHARGE** ability, if possible, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of this unit.
• While the target is in combat with this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks that do not target this unit.
fool s cap.lore: This warrior has manipulated the bones of a Mancrusher Gargant’s skeletal hand into the shape of a jester’s hat. Prancing about with it on their head ensures they acquire an audience...

flayed flags.name: Flayed Flags
flayed flags.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, when resolving the damage sequence for enemy units contesting the target objective, your opponent cannot spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.
flayed flags.lore: When these mighty banners are unfurled in the name of Ushoran, foes find themselves losing heart. Mostly because they are made of rotting skin.

ring of nightmarish visions.name: Ring of Nightmarish Visions
ring of nightmarish visions.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. Add 1 to each roll if this unit charged this turn. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
ring of nightmarish visions.lore: This ring enhances the wearer’s delusion, twisting foes into even more hideous monsters that they attack in a rabid frenzy.

defenders of chivalry.name: Defenders of Chivalry
defenders of chivalry.description: Effect: While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
defenders of chivalry.lore: With righteous anger, these ghouls set upon those who flout the chivalric code with bone clubs and filthy talons.
defenders of chivalry.restrictionText:
Noble Pursuits are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 Noble Pursuit.

loyal squires.name: Loyal Squires
loyal squires.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **Varghulf Courtier** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the phase:
• Add 2 to charge rolls for this unit.
• If this unit uses a **CHARGE** ability, it must end the charge move in combat with the target.
loyal squires.lore: These ghouls follow their holy paladins into battle, seeking to aid them however they can.
loyal squires.restrictionText:
Noble Pursuits are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 Noble Pursuit.

homage and fealty.name: Homage and Fealty
homage and fealty.description:
Declare: If this unit is a **KNIGHT**, pick a friendly **SERF** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the target. If this unit is a **SERF**, pick a friendly **KNIGHT** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to save rolls for this unit and the target while they are within 3" of and visible to each other.
homage and fealty.lore: Just as in the feudal days of yore, where lord and vassal made commitments to one another, so do these cannibals make similar reciprocal arrangements.
homage and fealty.restrictionText:
Noble Pursuits are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units.
A unit can only have 1 Noble Pursuit.

summon cadaverous barricade.name: Summon Cadaverous Barricade
summon cadaverous barricade.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Cadaverous Barricade** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Cadaverous Barricade** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summon cadaverous barricade.lore: With a word of command, the corpses of those who once served Ushoran rise up from the grave, dragging with them the detritus of a forgotten civilisation and clawing at the living.

summon corpsemare stampede.name: Summon Corpsemare Stampede
summon corpsemare stampede.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Corpsemare Stampede** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Corpsemare Stampede** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon corpsemare stampede.lore: Imbued with grisly vigour, the undead beasts of a Corpsemare Stampede burst from the blood-soaked ground to trample across the battlefield.

summon chalice of ushoran.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
summon chalice of ushoran.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Chalice of Ushoran** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Chalice of Ushoran** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon chalice of ushoran.lore: The wizard conjures forth a manifestation of the sacred cup held by Ushoran. This bone-wrought goblet is filled with the blood of those slain in its presence.

miasma of madness.name: Miasma of Madness
miasma of madness.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
miasma of madness.lore: The wizard calls forth a sanity-warping mist to engulf the foe.

charnel feast.name: Charnel Feast
charnel feast.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell and pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target. You can also pick a friendly **SERFS** unit within 6" of the target to be the raised ranks. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each damage point allocated to the target by this ability, you can return 1 slain model to the raised ranks.
charnel feast.lore: The caster draws out the life essence of nearby foes and uses it to heal the injured warriors of the court.

deranged transformation.name: Deranged Transformation
deranged transformation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
deranged transformation.lore: The spellcaster causes the limbs of a nearby pack to bulge and lengthen, allowing the creatures to charge forwards at a furious pace and imbuing them with greater strength.

charnel conviction.name: Charnel Conviction
charnel conviction.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (5+)**. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
charnel conviction.lore: Anointed with libations by their priest, ghouls believe themselves to be invincible warriors of faith.

the summerking s favour.name: The Summerking's Favour
the summerking s favour.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. You cannot pick **Nagash** to be the target of this prayer.

Effect: Resolve the effect of ‘Renowned Might’ below. If the chanting roll was 10+, resolve the effect of either ‘Renowned Might’ or ‘Righteous Tenacity’ instead.

***Renowned Might:*** Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

***Righteous Tenacity:*** The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
the summerking s favour.lore: The priest delivers a blistering sermon lionising the deeds of a courtly champion, marking them out as an Ushorite saint in their followers’ eyes.

excommunication.name: Excommunication!
excommunication.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
excommunication.lore: Having espied unworthy warriors exiled from the Summerking’s court, the priest extends a finger and vociferously denounces them.

formations.name: Lords of the Manor
formations.description: Effect: Each time another ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit that is not in combat, after that ability has been resolved, if that unit is a **SERFS** unit, you can return 1 additional slain model to it, and if it is a **KNIGHTS** unit, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

ability.name: Raise the Banners
ability.description: Effect: Each time another ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit that is not in combat, after that ability has been resolved, if that unit is a **SERFS** unit, you can return 1 additional slain model to it, and if it is a **KNIGHTS** unit, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.
ability.lore: When an abhorrant royal family and their courtiers mass, many loyal knights and serfs inevitably follow.

On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

formations.name: Knightly Echelon
formations.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **KNIGHTS** that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES.**

ability.name: Sound the Charge
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **KNIGHTS** that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES.**
ability.lore: Those foolish enough to stand before the cannibal courts’ knights are inevitably trampled beneath claw and foot.

formations.name: Impassioned Serfs
formations.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SERFS** unit that did not charge this turn and is in combat to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that **SERFS** unit to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Overwhelming Hordes
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SERFS** unit that did not charge this turn and is in combat to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that **SERFS** unit to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: As masses of crazed ghouls drag their foes to the ground, the horror and anger of the victims’ allies shifts into a disorienting delusion that leaves them paralysed by indecision.

Effect: The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As masses of crazed ghouls drag their foes to the ground, the horror and anger of the victims’ allies shifts into a disorienting delusion that leaves them paralysed by indecision.

formations.name: Questing Courtiers
formations.description: Effect: Friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES** have **WARD (5+)** if they have destroyed a unit this battle.

ability.name: The Blessing of the Chalice
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES** have **WARD (5+)** if they have destroyed a unit this battle.
ability.lore: Eager to earn favour with their masters, the heroes compete to earn honourable trophies for their court.

abilities.name: The Blessing of the Chalice

formations.name: Royal Menagerie
formations.description:
Effect: While a friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS MONSTER** or **BEAST** is wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES**:

•  That non-**HERO** unit can use a **RAMPAGE** ability on its warscroll even if that ability has already been used by another friendly **MONSTER** in the same turn.
•  If that non-**HERO** unit charged in the same turn and the unmodified charge roll was 9+, it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Indulge, My Pretties
ability.description:
Effect: While a friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS MONSTER** or **BEAST** is wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES**:

•  That non-**HERO** unit can use a **RAMPAGE** ability on its warscroll even if that ability has already been used by another friendly **MONSTER** in the same turn.
•  If that non-**HERO** unit charged in the same turn and the unmodified charge roll was 9+, it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: Abhorrants often toss their pet monstrosities choice cuts of flesh, resulting in a burst of strength and ferocity.

formations.name: The Royal Hunt
formations.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **SERFS** unit in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
•  Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

ability.name: Like Snapping Hounds
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **SERFS** unit in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
•  Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
ability.lore: When a noble commences a hunt, packs of serfs are sent ahead of the royal houses to savage prey out of hiding.

lord of revelries.name: Lord of Revelries
lord of revelries.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
lord of revelries.lore: This cackling creature is consumed by the feast’s joys and inured to pain.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Equinox Feast

the ritual dance.name: The Ritual Dance
the ritual dance.description: Effect: In the third battle round, while a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit is in combat with an enemy unit that contains any champions, musicians or standard bearers, it can move 6" instead of 3" when it makes a pile-in move.
the ritual dance.lore: To properly welcome high summer and its magnificent king, the peasantfolk cavort and caper around grand maypoles and idols – even those that are carried by rival revellers.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Equinox Feast

a display of falconry.name: A Display of Falconry
a display of falconry.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
a display of falconry.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability in the second battle round. Pick each enemy unit that used a **CHARGE** ability this phase to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
a display of falconry.lore: As the ‘foreign revellers’ approach, the shrieking beasts that follow the ghouls swoop down to greet them.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Equinox Feast

eat your fill.name: Eat Your Fill!
eat your fill.description:
Effect: In the fourth battle round, each time a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved:

• If that unit is damaged, **Heal (D3)** that unit.
•  If that unit is not damaged, return up to 3 slain models to it.
eat your fill.lore: Now comes the most anticipated part of the celebrations: the great banquet.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Equinox Feast

the equinox parade.name: The Equinox Parade
the equinox parade.description:
Effect: In the first battle round:

•  Add 1 to run rolls for friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units for each other friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit that has used a **RUN** ability this phase.

•  Add D6" to the distance friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units can move when they use a **RETREAT** ability.
the equinox parade.lore: Clad in tatterdemalion garments of flayed flesh and swaying to the sound of shrieks and bone flutes, the serfs of the ghoul kingdoms skitter as a mad, jubilant procession.
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Equinox Feast

make merry til the morn.name: Make Merry 'Til the Morn
make merry til the morn.description: Effect: In the fifth battle round, friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units have **WARD (4+)** while they are within 3" of 2 or more other visible friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units.
make merry til the morn.lore: Sated, the revellers toast, staggering about in cackling mobs as they quaff the finest ‘red wines’…
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Equinox Feast

broken sceptre of the solstice.name: Broken Sceptre of the Solstice
broken sceptre of the solstice.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
broken sceptre of the solstice.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit that has been destroyed to be the target. This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed, but if it does, this unit must be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
broken sceptre of the solstice.lore: An image of the bone sunburst crown atop this staff burns in the ghouls’ minds, drawing more of them into the fray.
broken sceptre of the solstice.groupName: The Equinox Feast Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Equinox Feast

summon chalice of ushoran.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
summon chalice of ushoran.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Chalice of Ushoran** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Chalice of Ushoran** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summon chalice of ushoran.lore: The wizard conjures forth a manifestation of the sacred cup held by Ushoran. This bone-wrought goblet is filled with the blood of those slain in its presence.

a midsummer mania.name: A Midsummer Mania
a midsummer mania.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this prayer this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Return D3 slain models to the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, return D3+3 slain models to the target unit instead.
a midsummer mania.lore: The screeched canticles and gibberings of this Cardinal fill the ghouls with madness enough to shrug off fatal injury.

solarite flares.name: Solarite Flares
solarite flares.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield that is visible to them, then pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point to be the targets. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
solarite flares.lore: The caster conjures blasts of blinding, red-stained radiance to dizzy and disorient.

feted coronet.name: Feted Coronet
feted coronet.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (4+)** until a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** unit is destroyed.
feted coronet.lore: This crown wards the wearer so long as all their warriors chant in adoration.
feted coronet.groupName: The Knights of New Summercourt Artefact of Power
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Knights of New Summercourt

tip of the king s lance.name: Tip of the King's Lance
tip of the king s lance.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units, but it must end that move in combat.
tip of the king s lance.lore: This champion’s bulk sees them smash through defensive formations.
tip of the king s lance.groupName: The Knights of New Summercourt Heroic Trait
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Knights of New Summercourt

the summerking s colours.name: The Summerking's Colours
the summerking s colours.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** unit that contains any standard bearers to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle:

•  While the target unit contains any standard bearers, add 10 to the control scores of friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** units while they are wholly within 24" of the target.
•  Once all of the standard bearers in the target unit have been slain, subtract 5 from the control scores of friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** units.
the summerking s colours.lore: Ushoran’s flayed-flesh battle standards inspire his followers to dizzying heights of greatness – but should the colours fall, the ghouls would be left utterly bereft.
the summerking s colours.groupName: The Knights of New Summercourt Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Knights of New Summercourt

a duel good sir.name: A Duel, Good Sir!
a duel good sir.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
a duel good sir.description:
Declare: You must use this ability if the friendly **Ushoran** is in combat with the enemy general. Pick the enemy general to be the target.

Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse Ushoran’s challenge.

***Accept***: For the rest of the turn, when the friendly **Ushoran** and the target are picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of their attacks must target each other.

***Refuse***: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
a duel good sir.lore: To refuse an honourable duel with Ushoran is always to one’s detriment.
a duel good sir.groupName: The Knights of New Summercourt Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Knights of New Summercourt

red errantry hosts.name: Red Errantry Hosts
red errantry hosts.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
red errantry hosts.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KNIGHTS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
red errantry hosts.lore: Many banners of ‘knights’ jostle for a chance to fight at Ushoran’s side.
red errantry hosts.groupName: The Knights of New Summercourt Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Knights of New Summercourt

the knight s vow.name: The Knight's Vow
the knight s vow.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
the knight s vow.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** unit that did not charge this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Start rolling dice, one at a time and one for each target, and stop when you roll a 6. The target you rolled a 6 for can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. If you rolled for each target and did not roll a 6, this ability has no effect.
the knight s vow.lore: Ushoran’s chosen spawn are fanatical in defending what they deem to be his.
the knight s vow.groupName: The Knights of New Summercourt Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Knights of New Summercourt

in their sire s shadow.name: In Their Sire's Shadow
in their sire s shadow.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Charge Phase
in their sire s shadow.description:
Declare: If the friendly **Ushoran** is not in combat and has not used any **RUN** or **RETREAT** abilities this turn, pick him to use this ability. Then, pick up to 2 friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT KNIGHTS** units within his combat range that are not in combat and have not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn to be his **royal retinue**. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.

Effect: The friendly **Ushoran** can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If he does so, he has charged. If he charged, then after this ability has been resolved, each unit in his **royal retinue** can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase and you can use the charge roll from this ability instead of making a charge roll when it does so, but it must end the charge move within 3" of the friendly **Ushoran**.
in their sire s shadow.lore: When Ushoran himself takes to the field, his knights are seized by an irrepressible mania to follow at his monstrous heels.
in their sire s shadow.groupName: The Knights of New Summercourt Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Knights of New Summercourt

nightmarish charge.name: Nightmarish Charge
nightmarish charge.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** units that charged in the same turn.
nightmarish charge.lore: The sight of hulking ghoul-breeds crashing into the fray can stun any foe.
nightmarish charge.groupName: The Knights of New Summercourt Battle Traits
sourcePublications: Army of Renown: The Knights of New Summercourt

summon corpsemare stampede.name: Summon Corpsemare Stampede
summon corpsemare stampede.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Corpsemare Stampede** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Corpsemare Stampede** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summon corpsemare stampede.lore: Imbued with grisly vigour, the undead beasts of a Corpsemare Stampede burst from the blood-soaked ground to trample across the battlefield.

deranged transformation.name: Deranged Transformation
deranged transformation.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
deranged transformation.lore: The spellcaster causes the limbs of nearby ghouls to bulge and lengthen, allowing them to charge forwards at a furious pace and imbuing them with greater strength.

miasma of madness.name: Miasma of Madness
miasma of madness.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
miasma of madness.lore: The wizard calls forth a sanity-warping mist to engulf the foe.

excommunication.name: Excommunication!
excommunication.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
excommunication.lore: Having espied exiled warriors, the priest vociferously denounces them.
